jobs.title: Approvals Advisor
jobs.description:
“AECOM has given me the opportunities, support and trust to build a career that's aligned with my ambitions and interests.” Lauren Spring, Sector Manager & Growth Lead - Environment, WA

Come grow with us.

AECOM’s environmental practice is dedicated to helping industries, clients and governments meet their environmental responsibilities while protecting the natural environment. We provide advisory and technical services to support environmental compliance, manage impacts and reduce risk throughout every stage of a project.

Our WA Environment Business has an exciting opportunity for an environmental professional to join our growing Impact Assessment and Permitting (IAP) team in Perth.

With a strong pipeline of work across Energy, Transport, Mining and Defence, you will contribute to environmental impact assessments, approvals and management for a diverse range of major projects. We are open to candidates at Professional, Senior or Principal level, with the responsibilities tailored to your experience and career goals.

What will a day in this role look like?

• Prepare and coordinate environmental impact assessments, approval documentation, constraints assessments, environmental management plans and other technical deliverables.
• Work with multidisciplinary teams to identify environmental risks and ensure environmental considerations are incorporated throughout project planning, design and delivery.
• Engage with clients, regulators and stakeholders to support clear, practical and timely project outcomes.
• Coordinate project activities, including resources, programmes, budgets and deliverables, appropriate to your level of experience.
• Contribute to proposals, client relationships and the continued growth of our Impact Assessment and Permitting practice.
• Support and collaborate with colleagues across Perth and AECOM’s broader Australia and New Zealand environmental practice.

The qualities that help you thrive

The following qualifications and experience are highly desired, but if you don’t tick every box, you could still be a great fit for this role. Please apply, as all applications will be considered.

• 3+ years experience in environmental impact assessment, environmental approvals, environmental planning or a related area.
• Knowledge of WA State and/or Commonwealth environmental assessment and approvals processes.
• Experience preparing clear, accurate and well-structured environmental reports and approval documentation.
• Experience contributing to or managing projects within consulting, government, industry or a similar environment.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to build positive working relationships with clients, stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams.
• A collaborative approach, sound judgement and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.
• Appropriate tertiary qualifications in environmental science, environmental management, planning or a related discipline.

Why you’ll love working with us

• Flexible work arrangements, including alternative start/finish times, job-sharing and hybrid work options
• Purchase up to 6 weeks additional annual leave per year
• Swap public holidays – swap Easter or other holidays for ones that suit you better
• Continuous learning and growth - lunch and learns, professional development courses, financial study assistance, 5 days paid study leave, global career opportunities

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities, additional health or mental health needs, and/or neurodiverse conditions. If you require any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know.

Applications are reviewed as they come in, and the role may close earlier than expected, so if this opportunity sounds like you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Learn more about life at AECOM: LinkedIn, Facebook , Instagram, X, YouTube - explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

AECOM acknowledges the Traditional Owners and Custodians of the lands on which we, our clients and our communities live and work around Australia. We pay our respects to their cultures and to their Elders — past, present, and emerging. We are committed to connecting to Country in our work through meaningful engagement with First Nations peoples and businesses.  Find out more about our Australian Reconciliation Action Plan here: https://aecom.com/au/our-vision-for-reconciliation/.

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity

You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion – a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation and benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We also provide a robust global well-being program. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Engineer - Strategic, Retail
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.


ABOUT THE RETAIL TEAM

 - Sierra is partnering with a large and growing number of retailers - spanning apparel and beauty, grocery and big-box, home and auto, consumer services, marketplaces, and consumer technology. Our agents help millions of shoppers and members every day: tracking and returning orders, finding the right product, booking services, and resolving issues in each brand’s own voice.

 - Retail is also where AI agents go beyond support to generate revenue. From product discovery and personalized recommendations to cart recovery, win-back campaigns, and in-store support that turns unanswered store calls into visits and sales, our team is redefining what an agent can do for a brand’s top line - not just its cost line.

 - Join us to transform how the world’s most-loved consumer brands engage their customers - and help build technology that makes shopping more personal, effortless, and delightful for everyone.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Go deep on a few accounts. Learn each customer's business well enough that you could be wearing their badge in their hallways

 - Own the end-to-end technical pre-sales process by scoping customer use cases, articulating business value, designing and demoing Sierra’s incredible platform, leading technical and architecture reviews, and serving as the trusted technical expert throughout the sales cycle

 - Decide when to bring in Agent Development, Product, Security, Legal, and Sierra leaders, and what each of them needs to do. You keep everyone aimed at the same goal

 - Raise the bar for the SE team: mentor others, set standards for demos and pilots, and write the playbooks for Strategic deals and GTM processes

 - Stay with the account after the sale, through the Agent Development handoff, launch, and expansion to new use cases

 - Share what you see across your largest accounts with Product leadership and inform roadmap


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 7+ years experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering or customer-facing technical sales

 - Experience in leading the sales process with Strategic customers with deal sizes of $1M+ consistently

 - Past experience in demo building, and presenting, and working with customers or clients in the GTM function

 - Strong experience in relationship-building with prospect stakeholders, including C-suite executives and technical leaders

 - Experience leading architecture, integration, and security discussions with enterprise architects, engineering leaders, and security teams

 - Ability to leverage AI tools efficiently as a regular part of your technical sales motion — discovery prep, solution design, demo and prototype building, technical proposals. Importantly, you own the accuracy of anything you put in front of a customer, whether or not AI helped you build it

 - Experience growing accounts past initial sale and defining customer roadmaps to facilitate growth

 - Bachelor's Degree or above; bonus if in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience


EVEN BETTER...

 - Experience translating code, technical logic and user requirements to product and engineering requirements

 - Selling a technical AI product


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.title: Pharmacy Technician — Rx Processing | Eligible for benefits/sign on - hiring now
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Sign on bonus eligible

Responsibilities:

• Process data entry of electronic, faxed, and verbal prescriptions per Blink protocols, with a focus on complex and higher-difficulty entries

• Serve as point of contact for provider/physician communications, handling both outbound and inbound calls

• Accepts inbound provider calls through warm transfers, ensuring call context is established prior to acceptance; patient calls are not currently part of this role, responsibilities are subject to change as business needs evolve

• Resolve open issues submitted by a variety of departments, including pharmacists, other technicians, and Incident Coordinator team

• Perform all tasks in a safe and compliant manner consistent with corporate policies and State and Federal laws

• Other duties as assigned in the Pharmacy Technician role

Requirements:

• Minimum 6 months prior Pharmacy Technician, or similar industry experience required

• PTCB or NHA certification required prior to joining

• Licensure: Must hold an active Missouri Pharmacy Technician license or be willing to obtain and have it approved prior to start date.

• Professional phone presence in a support/service capacity

• Attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy

• Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn complex new software

• Competent in basic pharmacy calculations

Shifts: Available Shift Options:

• Rotational 40-hour per week shifts between 8 AM -7 PM CST(Monday- Friday)

• 10 AM - 6 PM CST(Monday - Friday)

• 11 AM - 7 PM CST(Monday - Friday)

• 12 pm - 8 pm CST (Monday - Friday)

• Saturday shifts rotate among the team (8 AM – 4 PM CST) you'll always know your schedule in advance.

Location: 400 South Woods Mill Rd, Chesterfield, MO

Benefits:

• Health, Dental & Vision – Multiple plan options from day 1

• Well-being Support – Employee Assistance Program with counseling, wellness coaching, legal/financial advice, and more

• Vacation – Accrue up to 80 hours (2 weeks) in year one

• Paid Sick Time – 40 hours per year

• Holidays – 9 paid holidays + 2 floating holidays per year

• Parental Leave – 12 weeks paid (birthing) / 4 weeks paid (non-birthing), including adoption and foster placement

• 401(k) – Traditional and Roth options

• Life & Disability Insurance – Provided at no cost

• Commuter Benefits – Free onsite parking + pre-tax commuter FSA+ Free shuttle service (Pittsburgh, PA only)

• Snack & Drink Stipend – Daily at all pharmacy locations

#blinkindeed

Why Join Us:

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Applicants who provide their phone number and consent to receive text messages may receive SMS or MMS updates from Blink Health regarding their application.

jobs.title: Senior Global Supply Manager, Battery Materials
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

Form Energy is hiring an experienced professional to own the development and execution of Form’s global supply chain strategy for an array of critical battery raw materials used in Form’s pioneering iron-air battery systems. This role reports to the Manager, Global Supply Management (“GSM”) for Active Battery Materials. As part of the “Actives” team, you will establish and execute on Form’s commercial-scale sourcing strategy, owning key categories like specialty carbons & catalysts, commodity & specialty chemicals, toll blending & coating, and other raw materials. You will deliver shrewd insights based on a deep understanding of upstream manufacturing processes, market trends, and Form’s requirements, ensuring delivery of quality materials that meet Form’s bold performance, cost, and timeline needs.



The successful candidate will rely on their combination of business acumen, technical depth, innate curiosity, and experience across raw materials categories to bring strategic approaches and oversight to the sourcing of these critical components, while developing and maintaining positive, productive relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners alike. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape and be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with a breakthrough technology and an incredible mission!Form Energy is hiring an experienced professional to own the development and execution of Form’s global supply chain strategy for an array of critical battery raw materials used in Form’s pioneering iron-air battery systems. This role reports to the Manager, Global Supply Management (“GSM”) for Active Battery Materials. As part of the “Actives” team, you will establish and execute on Form’s commercial-scale sourcing strategy, owning key categories like specialty carbons & catalysts, commodity & specialty chemicals, toll blending & coating, and other raw materials. You will deliver shrewd insights based on a deep understanding of upstream manufacturing processes, market trends, and Form’s requirements, ensuring delivery of quality materials that meet Form’s bold performance, cost, and timeline needs.



The successful candidate will rely on their combination of business acumen, technical depth, innate curiosity, and experience across raw materials categories to bring strategic approaches and oversight to the sourcing of these critical components, while developing and maintaining positive, productive relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners alike. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape and be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with a breakthrough technology and an incredible mission! 



Relocation assistance is available. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own the battery raw materials category at Form (e.g., specialty carbons & catalysts, commodity & specialty chemicals, toll blending & coating), including commercial relationships and contracts within our supply base and value chain

 - Monitor current category market conditions, evaluating capacities and competitive landscapes, technology roadmaps and supply challenges & opportunities

 - Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Supplier Industrialization, Manufacturing, and Leadership to define and drive execution of Form’s battery materials sourcing strategy

 - Negotiate and deliver favorable commercial terms that optimize costs, lead times, and risk

 - Ensure Form is working with best-in-class suppliers and mitigating risks by managing the end-to-end sourcing process from supplier identification through RFP, business award, and continuous improvement

 - Secure best-in-class pricing through detailed price analysis and negotiations, continual cost reductions, cost avoidance, and logistics optimization




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - Bachelors or Masters degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, or similar discipline

 - 5+ years of relevant category experience in battery raw materials, carbons, or resins, including relevant manufacturing methods and market/pricing dynamics

 - 5+ years of sourcing experience including supplier management, running RFX’s, and driving continuous improvement, in a fluid, fast-paced, manufacturing environment

 - Strong analytical skills, with a demonstrated ability to generate bottom-up “should-cost” models based on an understanding of manufacturing processes; strong with spreadsheets

 - Solid understanding of commercial terms, contract structures, and IP concepts

 - Excellent communication and organizational skills, ability to ruthlessly prioritize across multiple tasks and projects

 - Ability to work in the US and travel globally as necessary, up to 30%
   
   
   

#LI-Onsite



Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. 



When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. 



To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.




If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.

Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.

jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Talent Partner to own full-cycle recruiting at Cyberhaven, across the business, from GTM, Operations, and G&A to Engineering, Product, and beyond. You'll join a lean global talent team, so you'll work across functions and geographies. 

You'll own searches from intake through close, learn what makes each team successful, build a point of view on the talent market, and help our leaders make thoughtful hiring decisions. You'll also shape how we recruit. We run an AI-driven talent function, and you'll be expected to build with Claude and other AI tools every day: automating sourcing, screening workflows, reporting, and candidate communication, then sharing what works with the team. We're looking for someone excited by that mix of ownership, learning, and building.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO



Drive Your Searches End to End

 - Lead full-cycle recruiting from intake through offer and close, keeping searches organized and moving.

 - Partner with hiring managers to define what great looks like, calibrate early, and set realistic expectations on timing, compensation, and the market.

 - Run thoughtful screens that assess experience, skills, and motivation, and give hiring teams clear, specific recommendations.

 - Manage interview loops, keep feedback timely, and give candidates an honest view of the role and where they stand.

 - Understand what matters to each candidate and guide offer and closing conversations.


FIND A+ TALENT

 - Build targeted outbound pipelines using LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox, research, and your own growing network.

 - Get creative about where you look and how you identify strong talent, especially when the obvious approach isn't working.

 - Write personalized outreach that gives someone a real reason to respond.

 - Stay connected with strong candidates beyond a single opening and build relationships we can return to as Cyberhaven grows.


BE A TRUSTED ADVISOR

 - Learn how our teams operate, what they're trying to accomplish, and how each hire contributes.

 - Turn market research and candidate conversations into useful advice for hiring managers.

 - Speak up when scope, level, compensation, or the interview process is getting in the way of a successful search, and recommend a path forward.


BUILD SMARTER WITH AI

 - Own your recruiting process end to end, including pipeline data and reporting, from intake through close.

 - Use Claude and other AI tools daily to research, source, screen, schedule, and improve recruiting workflows. Build agents, prompts, and automations that remove manual work, and share what works with the team.

 - Use pipeline data to understand what's working, spot bottlenecks, and adjust your approach.

 - Keep Ashby accurate and up to date so the team can trust the pipeline and reporting.

 - Lead projects across referrals, employer branding, tooling, structured interviewing, and candidate experience.

 


WHO YOU ARE

 - 3+ years of prior in-house recruiting experience at fast-growing startups.

 - A track record of owning searches and building process as you go in a fast-moving, resource-lean environment.

 - A strong sourcing foundation: you know how to research a market, find great people, and build relationships through thoughtful outreach.

 - Curiosity to learn unfamiliar roles and what makes someone successful in them. You don't need to have recruited every function we support, but you're flexible enough to support hiring across the board.

 - The ability to understand candidates' motivations, build trust, and help them navigate career decisions.

 - Clear, thoughtful communication with candidates, hiring partners, and teammates.

 - Strong follow-through and organization: you keep people informed, details accurate, and searches moving.

 - Good judgment about when to take initiative, ask for help, or flag a problem.

 - Resourcefulness and real excitement about using AI to change how recruiting gets done, with hands-on experience applying AI tools (Claude, Juicebox, or similar) to sourcing, screening, or workflow automation.

 - Ability to work onsite at our Mountain View HQ two days a week (hybrid).


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience recruiting for GTM, Operations, or G&A roles at a high-growth AI or cybersecurity company.

 - Hands-on experience with Ashby or a comparable ATS, and comfort turning pipeline data into insights.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.
Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

AI Tools Disclosure: As part of Cyberhaven's hiring process, we use recruiting tools that include AI-powered features to help with tasks like scheduling, note-taking, workflow automation, and other recruiting activities ("AI Tools"). The AI Tools may process information you provide during the application and interview process. When AI-assisted interview note taking is used, candidates are notified in advance and have the option to opt out of the AI-assisted interview note taking.

Cyberhaven is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, ChatGPT Education and Learning
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The ChatGPT Learning team creates the next generation of learning experiences within ChatGPT. Millions of people use ChatGPT each week to explore concepts, practice skills, and work through challenges, making learning one of the platform’s largest consumer use cases.

We want ChatGPT to support sustained learning and progress over time, beyond answering individual questions. We’re exploring how AI can make powerful learning tools more accessible, helping people understand the world, develop skills, and pursue their goals.

Our work brings together product engineering, design, AI research, and education to serve learners around the world.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Principal Software Engineer on the ChatGPT Learning team, you will set technical direction and lead the design and development of products that help millions of people learn with ChatGPT.

You’ll remain hands-on across the stack, building polished interfaces and scalable backend services. Working closely with product managers, designers, researchers, and platform teams, you’ll bring new model capabilities into everyday learning experiences.

You’ll drive product and design decisions alongside your cross-functional partners, helping define what we build, how it works, and how it serves learners. We’re looking for an engineer with strong product judgment who can turn ambiguous opportunities into clear direction, lead complex initiatives from concept through launch, and raise the quality of the team’s technical work.

This position is based in San Francisco or New York City, with three days each week in the office. Relocation assistance is available to new employees.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead end-to-end development of learning experiences in ChatGPT, from early exploration through production and iteration.

 - Drive product and design decisions with product managers and designers, bringing technical insight, user feedback, and sound judgment to priorities and tradeoffs.

 - Set technical direction for complex initiatives and guide architecture decisions that support rapid experimentation and long-term reliability.

 - Build multimodal learning capabilities that combine text, images, voice, and interactive interfaces.

 - Develop scalable services and APIs to support learning features throughout ChatGPT.

 - Work with researchers, platform teams, designers, and engineers to prototype ideas and bring new AI capabilities to users.

 - Improve performance, reliability, and usability across ChatGPT’s learning surfaces, using experiments and user feedback to guide improvements.

 - Support other engineers through mentorship, code reviews, and clear technical guidance.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE HERE IF YOU

 - Have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping high-quality products across the full stack.

 - Have led complex technical initiatives and made architecture decisions that balance product needs, development speed, and maintainability.

 - Have experience driving product and design decisions in close partnership with product managers and designers.

 - Enjoy building consumer products and taking ownership from initial concept through production.

 - Bring clarity to ambiguous problems and translate them into practical product solutions.

 - Have strong product engineering instincts and care deeply about the quality of the user experience.

 - Have experience building interactive educational tools or learning products.

 - Have experience developing AI-powered applications or systems built around large language models.

 - Want to build products with meaningful global impact and expand access to education and learning opportunities.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. jobs.title: Business Immigration Associate – Remote, 4+ Yrs (H/L/PERM/E)
jobs.description:
Manifest Law is one of the first AI-native corporate immigration firms in the country, and one of the fastest-growing — proof that attorneys want to practice law this way. Our attorneys handle sophisticated, high-stakes matters, with technology that removes the busywork rather than replacing the lawyer.



Manifest was built to offer the best of both worlds: the scale of a larger firm with the quality client service of a boutique. Manifest OS — the technology that powers the firm — carries the operational weight, so our attorneys spend their time where it actually matters: on strategy, on judgment, on the client in front of them. The result is a practice with the care of a boutique and the capability of a large firm.



We think the practice of law should be a craft, and the attorneys who do it well deserve a practice that grows with them — supported by technology, not replaced by it, with the time and autonomy to build something that's genuinely their own. We're building the kind of institution attorneys are proud to put on their résumé.



This is a firm for attorneys who want more from their career: real ownership of your cases, the kind of client relationships that come from having time with them, a sustainable pace, and a front-row seat in building what a modern immigration practice can look like.



Immigration law has been done the same way for decades. We're here to raise the bar, and we're hiring the people who will raise it with us.






WHAT YOU'LL DO

● As a Manifest Attorney, you guide clients through one of the most important decisions of their lives and carry matters forward to the outcome they need. Owning a matter from handoff through final submission, building the legal strategy, and managing every milestone.

● The opportunity to work across a variety of immigration cases or focus on your specialty — H-1B, L-1A/B, TN, E-1/E-2/E-3, O-1A, EB-1C, EB-2 NIW, and PERM labor certification — clients could range from funded startups to large enterprises, with complexity and autonomy that scale with your experience.

● In a strategic consulting capacity: use your legal judgment to assess which prospects have legitimate cases, build trust quickly, and set honest, clear expectations.

● In a case management (production) capacity: manage the client relationship through the life of the case and work with the paralegals in your team on document collection, organization, and filing logistics so your time stays on strategy and outcomes.

● Advise clients directly on petition strategy, RFE response, and compliance obligations — including managing high-volume employer accounts, HR contacts, and deadlines.

● Use Manifest's AI tools and technology to support case quality and efficiency in either mode — not as a shortcut, but as a genuine performance multiplier.






WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

● J.D. and active U.S. bar admission

● Strong working knowledge of employment-based immigration, including NIV and IV matters – for example: H-1B, L-1A/B, TN, E-3, O-1A, EB-1C, EB-2 NIW, and PERM labor certification

● Clear, confident communication — you explain complex legal concepts in plain language and make HR contacts and beneficiaries feel supported

● Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy — you document thoroughly and hand off cleanly

● Comfort in a high-cadence environment with real volume expectations



Mid-Senior Level Associate (Yrs 4–7)

● Focus: Hands-on with high volume employment based cases, for example H-1B, PERM, and/or intracompany-transfer experience; comfort working directly with HR contacts; proactive ownership approach.




WHY ATTORNEYS JOIN MANIFEST

● Higher-agency work | Intake, document collection, status tracking, and client updates run through Manifest OS — the administrative weight of practice is reduced. Your day goes to strategy, drafting, and the client.

● No billable hour | We charge clients flat fees, so there's no timekeeping requirement and no billable target. Your work is judged on outcomes — what gets filed and how clients experience the relationship — not hours recorded.

● Remote by design | The legal side of the firm works remotely. It's how the firm was built, and there are no plans to change it — practice from wherever you do your best work.

● Real upside | Pay is competitive from day one, with incentives tied to client outcomes and firm performance, so strong work is rewarded as the practice grows.

● Ground floor | Manifest is an ambitious firm building the infrastructure to last — and to change the way law firms operate. Attorneys who join now grow with it: into senior roles, into leadership, into shaping what the practice becomes next.

● Your experience shapes the practice | Attorney feedback and firsthand case experience directly inform what the firm builds next, so the technology keeps evolving around how the best lawyers actually work.






READY TO HELP REDEFINE LEGAL WORK?

We're looking for attorneys who lead through expertise, treat Manifest's technology as a genuine performance multiplier rather than a shortcut, and want to do the most meaningful work of their careers.

The attorneys who thrive here are full-time, deeply client-centered, tech-forward, and mission-driven — energized by building something real, not just joining something finished. If that's you, we want to hear from you.



Compensation & Pay Transparency

Manifest is a remote-first firm, and this role is open to candidates in the United States. The good-faith salary range for this position is $115K - $190K USD. This range reflects base compensation and may not include bonus, equity, or other components of total compensation. Actual pay is determined by a range of factors, including but not limited to the candidate's location, experience, education, and skills, as well as the specific scope of the role. Candidates outside of the United States are welcome to apply, and compensation will be assessed according to regional models.




OUR USE OF AI IN RECRUITING

Manifest uses AI-powered tools to support administrative aspects of our recruitment process, such as organizing applications and surfacing candidate information for review. Some interviews may also be recorded and transcribed using an AI note-taking tool, used solely to support accurate note-taking — it does not score, analyze, or evaluate candidates in any way. These tools do not make hiring decisions, and no candidate is advanced, screened out, or otherwise dispositioned without review by a member of our human recruiting team. You are welcome to ask any interviewer for a non-recorded conversation instead. If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation or an alternative application process at any stage, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.title: Certified Nurse Assistant (Part-Time, 16 hrs/week; AM Shift; Unit: G2)
jobs.description:
Nestled in San Francisco's Excelsior neighborhood on a nine-acre campus, the San Francisco Campus for Jewish Living (SFCJL) is the leading senior services organization in Northern California. Our continuum of care includes: the Frank Residences assisted living and memory care; the Jewish Home and Rehabilitation Center, offering long-term skilled nursing, short-term rehabilitation, an acute geriatric psychiatric unit for adults over the age of 65; and our Foundation.

Founded in 1871 and formerly known as the Jewish Home, our legacy grounds us as our vision propels us forward. Today, we've evolved to support more than 2,500 older adults each year through innovative, comprehensive programs rooted in the Jewish values of compassion, community, and excellence. We are equally proud of our inclusive culture, where 950 team members of diverse faiths and backgrounds work together in shared purpose.

WHY WORK WITH US

• Mission-driven nonprofit organization

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits

• Meaningful work that positively impacts the lives of older adults every day

• Inclusive community, welcoming to all (you do not need to be Jewish to live or work here)

• Supportive, team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

• Collaborative leadership focused on enhancing the employee experience

POSITION SUMMARY

As a Certified Nursing Assistant, you will work under the direction of the Unit Manager or Charge Nurse to provide direct care and support to residents, ensuring their comfort, dignity, and safety. You will play a key role in maintaining a clean and supportive environment, observing and reporting changes in residents’ conditions, and assisting with daily living activities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Assist residents with personal care needs, including grooming, hygiene, nutrition, activity, rest, and elimination in a safe and respectful manner.

• Maintain a clean and comfortable environment by supporting proper ventilation, lighting, and furniture arrangements.

• Promote residents’ dignity and uphold all resident rights, including the right to be free from abuse and restraints.

• Report any signs of abuse or violations of resident rights immediately to the Charge Nurse or appropriate personnel.

• Communicate clearly and compassionately with residents, families, visitors, and healthcare team members.

• Maintain confidentiality regarding residents and their care.

• Follow individualized care plans and assist in providing restorative nursing care as directed.

• Monitor residents’ conditions and report any changes in behavior, appearance, or physical ability to the Charge Nurse or Unit Manager.

• Perform non-clinical nursing procedures under supervision, within the scope of CNA certification.

• Maintain the cleanliness and readiness of equipment and supplies; report repair or supply needs to the supervising nurse.

• Respond promptly to call lights and emergencies, ensuring timely assistance.

• Assist in transporting residents safely using appropriate equipment and proper body mechanics.

• Support residents in recreational, social, and dining activities as needed.

• Recognize and respect each resident’s emotional, cultural, and spiritual needs.

• Attend required training sessions and maintain competency in the use of equipment such as lifts, shower chairs, and adjustable beds.

• Follow all infection control and safety procedures, including hand hygiene and proper disposal of soiled materials.

• Accurately document care provided to residents in a timely and concise manner.

• Accept assignment changes as needed to ensure quality resident care.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

JOB DETAILS

*Please note, this position is non-benefitted*

• Pay Rate: $29.24 per hour

• Hours: Part-Time, 16 hrs/week

• Shift Schedule: AM shift; 7 AM - 3:30 PM

• Days Off: Monday - Friday

• Working Days: Saturday and Sunday

• Training: Approximately 2 weeks, Monday–Friday (Week 1: Classroom Education; Week 2: On-the-Floor Training). Some scheduling flexibility may be available for on-call/per diem positions.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Graduate of a Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) Program

• Current, active CNA certification in the State of California

• High school diploma or equivalent preferred

• Ability to read, write, and speak English clearly

• Strong understanding of written and verbal instructions

• Demonstrated ability to support residents’ daily care needs while maintaining dignity and resident rights

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

• Ability to lift up to 25 pounds

• Ability to stand, walk, bend, and assist residents for extended periods

• Ability to use proper body mechanics and assistive devices safely

OUR INVESTMENT IN YOU

Comprehensive benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage; a 403(b) Retirement Plan; Paid Time Off (PTO); Tuition Reimbursement; Commuter Benefits; and Weekday Shuttle Service to and from Glen Park BART Station.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Pharma CMC Manufacturing & Tech Transfer
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

Our CMC team is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Principal Engineer, Pharma CMC Manufacturing & Tech Transfer to lead process transfer, CDMO qualification, pilot scale manufacturing, and GMP manufacturing oversight for Varda's crystallization and drug product pipeline. Reporting to the VP, CMC, this role owns the path from a lab-characterized process to a validated, transferable manufacturing package executed reliably across a network of external partners. This position requires close collaboration with Pharma R&D, Quality & Regulatory, and external CDMO partners to stand up and run the manufacturing network.

This is an opportunity to build a CMC manufacturing function from the ground up — selecting and qualifying CDMO partners, executing technology transfer, running engineering & pilot scale batches, and ultimately delivering GMP clinical material — while helping shape how Varda's terrestrial and orbital manufacturing strategies come together.

Responsibilities

• Own technology transfer execution: translate R&D developed processes into robust, CDMO-ready transfer packages

• Lead pilot plant production of material to support nonclinical development

• Lead selection, qualification, and ongoing management of CDMO partners across the manufacturing network (Crystallization, Fill-Finish, and DS Partner), including RFPs, technical due diligence, and capability assessments

• Lead tech transfer of drug product fill-finish processes for the crystalline suspension, partnering with R&D on process- and product-specific technology transfer coordination

• Negotiate and manage Manufacturing Services Agreements with CDMO partners, defining scope, key terms, and deliverables, in partnership with Legal and Quality

• Establish the CDMO oversight model, including defined chain of custody across CDMO handoffs

• Lead engineering run execution and acceptance at CDMO sites, including comparability protocols confirming CDMO-produced material matches Varda-characterized material

• As volumes increase, build and lead an internal Manufacturing Sciences & Technology (MS&T) function to support process transfer, engineering runs, and GMP manufacturing oversight

• Oversee GMP manufacturing campaigns through batch release, partnering with Quality on batch record review, change control, deviation management, and release testing coordination

• Manage CDMO manufacturing timelines and budget; report progress regularly to the VP, CMC and executive team

• Partner with Quality & Regulatory on control strategy, release specifications, and CMC sections of regulatory filings related to manufacturing and tech transfer

Basic Qualifications

• 10+ years of CMC manufacturing and/or technology transfer leadership experience advancing drug product development programs to successful clinical trials

• B.S. or M.S. in life sciences, chemical engineering, or related field

• Firm understanding of cGMP and FDA regulatory guidelines as they pertain to CMC manufacturing and tech transfer

• Demonstrated experience managing external CDMO/CMO relationships, including technical oversight and contract negotiation

Preferred Skills and Experience

• 13+ years of CMC manufacturing leadership experience, including direct responsibility for process transfer and CDMO network management

• Experience with small molecule and/or biologics crystallization processes and/or high-concentration suspension drug products

• Hands-on experience standing up a CDMO network from selection through GMP manufacturing for an early-stage or growth-stage biotech/pharma company

• Experience with aseptic fill-finish operations and engineering/media fill run execution

• Advanced understanding of cGMP and FDA regulations and guidance relating to CMC manufacturing and comparability

• Excellent leadership, managerial, and communication skills in a cross-functional, multi-site environment

• Experience in an aerospace regulatory environment (e.g., AS9100) is a plus Pay Range Salary range: $187,000 - $239,000/per year This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance You will be eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards

ITAR Requirements

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Engineer - Majors, Retail
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.


ABOUT THE RETAIL TEAM

 - Sierra is partnering with a large and growing number of retailers - spanning apparel and beauty, grocery and big-box, home and auto, consumer services, marketplaces, and consumer technology. Our agents help millions of shoppers and members every day: tracking and returning orders, finding the right product, booking services, and resolving issues in each brand’s own voice.

 - Retail is also where AI agents go beyond support to generate revenue. From product discovery and personalized recommendations to cart recovery, win-back campaigns, and in-store support that turns unanswered store calls into visits and sales, our team is redefining what an agent can do for a brand’s top line - not just its cost line.

 - Join us to transform how the world’s most-loved consumer brands engage their customers - and help build technology that makes shopping more personal, effortless, and delightful for everyone.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Be the primary partner to your Sales counterparts helping to win deals and grow customers

 - Go from first discovery to a tailored, working agent in days, not weeks, across prospects and existing customers

 - Work with every team involved in the decision: CX, IT, security, procurement, and executive sponsors

 - Own the end-to-end technical pre-sales process by scoping customer use cases, articulating business value, designing and demoing Sierra’s incredible platform, leading technical and architecture reviews, and serving as the trusted technical expert throughout the sales cycle

 - Mentor newer SEs and contribute reusable assets for your industry or team

 - Stay with the account after the sale, through the Agent Development handoff, launch, and expansion to new use cases

 - Go deep on your industry, the patterns, and winning motions to scale your work


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 4-6+ years experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering or customer-facing technical sales

 - Experience in leading the sales process with large Enterprise customers with deal sizes ranging $500-$1M

 - Past experience in demo building, and presenting, and working with customers or clients in the GTM function

 - Experience in relationship-building with prospects, including executives and technical leaders

 - Ability to connect a prospect’s specific business problems and Sierra’s solutions and explain them to both a technical and non-technical audience

 - Ability to leverage AI tools efficiently as a regular part of your technical sales motion — discovery prep, solution design, demo and prototype building, technical proposals. Importantly, you own the accuracy of anything you put in front of a customer, whether or not AI helped you build it

 - Experience growing accounts past initial sale

 - Bachelor's Degree or above; bonus if in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience


EVEN BETTER...

 - Experience translating code, technical logic and user requirements to product and engineering requirements

 - Selling a technical AI product


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.title: Principal Product Application Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company:

At SK Hynix Memory Solution, we're at the forefront of semiconductor innovation, developing advanced memory solutions that power everything from smartphones to data centers. As a global leader in DRAM and NAND flash technologies, we drive the evolution of advancing mobile technology, empowering cloud computing, and pioneering future technologies. Our cutting-edge memory technologies are essential in today's most advanced electronic devices and IT infrastructure, enabling enhanced performance and user experiences across the digital landscape.

We're looking for innovative minds to join our mission of shaping the future of technology. At SK Hynix Memory, you'll be part of a team that's pioneering breakthrough memory solutions while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainability. We're not just adapting to technological change – we're driving it, with significant investments in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and eco-friendly solutions and operational practices. As we continue to expand our market presence and push the boundaries of what's possible in semiconductor technology, we invite you to be part of our journey to creating the next generation of memory solutions that will define the future of computing.

About the Team:

At SK hynix, our team's dedication to advancing enterprise SSD technologies through rigorous PCIe NVMe validation and testing has established us as industry leaders. Our focus on system-level tests, feature validation, and meticulous bug analysis underpins the reliability of our products. With expertise in testing and debugging embedded systems, we ensure that our enterprise PCIe NVMe SSD products meet the highest standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee the progress of testing, identify potential issues, and report findings to ensure compliance with design specifications, as well as with customer standards and requirements.

• Collaborate closely with other teams, including SOC, FW, and HW, to address and resolve product challenges.

• Implement coordinated efforts to debug system issues, ensuring seamless integration and reliability.

• Foster open communication channels to facilitate efficient problem-solving and enhance the overall product quality.

• Provide customer support. Address customer inquiries, resolve issues, and ensure customer satisfaction by maintaining clear communication and prompt responses.

Requirements:

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering with 10+ years of storage-related experience, OR M.S. in CS, CE, or related field with 7+ years of storage-related experience is required.

Technical Skills:

• Proficient in PCIe protocol, NVMe, and NAND is required.

• Knowledge of Linux Kernel and drivers is a plus.

• Strong understanding of storage architectures and system-level debugging is also beneficial. Experience with bus analyzers and trace evaluation tools is required.

Programming Proficiency:

• Strong proficiency in programming languages such as python, C and C++ is required.

COMPENSATION: $150,000/yr - $210,000/yr

REGARDING COMPENSATION:

SK hynix memory solutions America Inc. offers you the opportunity to apply your skills to exciting projects while working with innovative teams. Our compensation package is complimented by a generous benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance and a company 401(k) match, as well as cafeteria, onsite gym and much more. If you are motivated by technical challenges, we offer a collaborative work environment that encourages career growth. The salary offered to a selected candidate will be tailored based on several factors, including the location, job grade, relevant knowledge, skills, and experience. We also take into account the internal equity among our current team members to ensure fairness and competitiveness.

jobs.title: Data Acquisition Lead
jobs.description:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.  

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

As our Data Acquisition Lead, you will own the sourcing, evaluation, and commercial management of our data sources. You will build a reliable supplier and partner portfolio across various data providers. You will partner closely with Engineering, which owns production integrations and data collection infrastructure, as well as Product, Partnerships, Finance, and Legal.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Find and qualify providers and partners against our coverage, quality, capacity, and cost requirements

 - Structure vendor trials, run benchmarks using internal tooling, and analyze results by source, geography, and workload

 - Compare effective costs across pricing models, including retries, failures, minimum commitments, and overages

 - Negotiate pricing, service commitments, support arrangements, renewals, and exit terms

 - Maintain qualified alternatives and identify overlapping infrastructure or correlated failure risks across suppliers

 - Lead vendor performance reviews and recommend expansion, replacement, or changes in allocation

 - Coordinate onboarding and sourcing documentation with Engineering, Finance, and Legal

 - Own vendor contracts and spend, and keep a clear record of vendor status, pricing, and decisions

 - Partner cross functionally to resolve provider issues quickly

 - Help build and scale the data acquisition team as Profound grows


WHO YOU ARE

 - 5+ years of hands-on experience with external data or web data providers and partners, on either the vendor or customer side (e.g. sourcing and managing providers, solutions engineering, or technical account management)

 - Strong commercial judgment, with examples of negotiations and measurable operating improvements

 - Familiarity with data contract terms such as DPAs, usage rights, and indemnification

 - Ability to use SQL and/or Python to inspect results, run evaluations, and challenge vendor claims

 - Practical understanding of various data provider types, web data APIs, various data collection schemes, and common failure modes

 - Evidence of introducing a working alternative provider or improving coverage, reliability, or effective cost

 - Experience with unique data sets is a plus

 - Excited by the opportunity to own and shape a new function at an early stage

 - Comfortable in a fast-moving culture with autonomy, trust, and room to grow

 - Drawn to competitive compensation and meaningful equity




LOCATION

This is an on-site role based in our Union Square, NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. We are happy to support visa sponsorship for qualified international candidates.

For this role, the expected base salary range is $200,000 to $275,000. Profound's total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.

Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.
