jobs.title: Software Engineer, Native Mobile
jobs.description:
About Glean:

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About the Role:

Glean is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Mobile, to accelerate our development of fully native apps for iOS and Android. Today our apps wrap the web app; you will replace them with native Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose apps, harnessing AI to deliver a new refined and polished mobile experience. You will be responsible for setting strong technical foundations for these new codebases.

You will:

Build the apps

• Build and ship native iOS and Android apps in Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose.

• Ship user-facing features end to end: search, AI assistant, agents, notifications, and OS integrations such as widgets, App Intents, share extensions, live voice modes and more.

• Build experiences that feel native on each platform, following Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and Google’s Material Design, with strong accessibility, performance, and offline behavior.

• Define the mobile architecture: module boundaries, networking, persistence, concurrency, observability, and performance budgets.

Build the infrastructure

• Own mobile CI/CD: automated builds and tests, code signing, TestFlight and Play Store deployment, phased rollouts, and release health monitoring.

• Set up an AI-native development workflow: an agent-friendly repo, automated test generation, AI-assisted review, and tooling that lets coding agents build, run, and verify mobile changes.

Own enterprise readiness

• Build, sign, and ship enterprise app variants with their own configuration and distribution requirements.

• Own mobile authentication end to end: OAuth 2.0/PKCE, OIDC/SAML SSO, secure token and session handling, and identity-provider policies such as conditional access and device trust.

• Make the apps work in managed and BYOD environments: MDM, MAM, managed app configuration, app protection policies, and Android Enterprise work profiles.

• Design admin-controlled data protection (downloads, sharing, copy/paste, screenshots) with Security and Admin teams, and emit reliable audit events for customer security tooling.

• Represent mobile in enterprise security reviews and validate behavior on real managed and unmanaged devices.

About you:

• 6+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years shipping production mobile apps on both iOS and Android.

• Proficiency in Swift or Kotlin with working knowledge of the other, and willingness to develop cross-platform fluency, as you will be responsible for both iOS and Android.

• You have owned mobile CI/CD pipelines and release infrastructure (e.g. Fastlane, Xcode Cloud, GitHub Actions, Gradle, code signing, staged rollouts).

• You use AI coding tools daily to ship faster without lowering the quality bar, and have opinions on structuring a codebase and toolchain so agents work in it effectively.

• Experience with mobile auth: OAuth 2.0/PKCE, OIDC/SAML, MSAL, ASWebAuthenticationSession / Custom Tabs, Keychain and Android Keystore.

• Experience shipping OS integrations (widgets, App Intents / Shortcuts, extensions, background work) on at least one platform.

• Startup mindset: comfortable owning problems end to end, from infra to pixels, in an ambiguous environment.

• Nice to have: migrating a hybrid or cross-platform app to native; shipping in MDM/MAM-managed enterprise environments.

Location:

• This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View or San Francisco office)

Compensation & Benefits:

The standard base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $265,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.

We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

#LI-HYBRID

AI-First Mindset at Glean:

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement.

By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement, and I agree to the terms.

jobs.title: Senior Staff, Developer Relations
jobs.description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

As Senior Staff, Developer Relations in the RippleX Ecosystem Growth team, you will play a key role in helping developers discover, onboard, build, and scale financial applications on the XRP Ledger (XRPL). Directly support businesses, institutions, and governments in using XRPL's capabilities for financial innovation, contributing to adoption for institutional-grade use cases, including asset tokenization, Institutional DeFi, and next-generation payment infrastructure.

This role is critical to growing our developer ecosystem, gathering valuable feedback to inform XRPL product development, and ensuring blockchain technologies are implemented responsibly across diverse financial implementations. You'll deliver on developer experience initiatives for individual developers, startups, and institutions. Your success in this role will directly contribute to XRPL's growth trajectory and market position while ensuring blockchain technologies are implemented responsibly across financial use cases. Building strong relationships between the developer community and internal teams will be critical as we advance our mission of crafting reliable, scalable financial infrastructure that serves real-world institutional needs.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Lead developer engagement strategies for financial solutions, tokenization platforms, and payment applications on XRPL

• Implement and measure metrics for measuring developer success that align with business objectives, including analytics for fintech developers and financial institutions

• Contribute to scalable frameworks that accelerate developer adoption through both one-to-many and one-to-one strategies

• Organize and lead developer events, workshops, and hackathons that showcase XRPL's capabilities for tokenization and financial innovation

• Create technical content including tokenization guides, payment integration tutorials, institutional DeFi best practices, and code demos

• Speak at conferences, meetups, and events about XRPL use cases, projects, and upcoming products and features

• Provide hands-on technical support to accelerate integration for financial companies and startups

• Support technical evaluation and due diligence for projects through various Ecosystem Growth Programs such as Grants and Accelerator initiatives

• Implement and monitor adoption mechanisms and reporting structures to demonstrate success and traction

• Support recruitment and development of global developer relations team members

• Collaborate effectively with GTM, Product, Engineering, Communications, and Marketing teams as well as external partners and the broader XRPL community

• Advocate for financial developer needs and translate feedback into actionable insights for leadership

• Promote best practices for regulatory compliance and institutional-grade security adoption by developers building financial applications

• Collect and synthesize feedback to inform product roadmaps while serving as a technical liaison between developers, funded financial projects, and Ripple's product and engineering teams!

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

• 5+ years of proven track record in developer relations, developer experience, or technical product roles, with demonstrated success in growing developer ecosystems

• Institutional Finance Understanding: Strong understanding of financial instruments and market structure (equities, bonds, repos, collateralized lending, etc.). jobs.title: Sr. Electrical Engineer - Power Systems
jobs.description:
About Us

At Arbor Energy & Resources Corporation ("Arbor Energy"), we’re creating technology to power our lives while protecting the planet that sustains them.  Our advanced power systems deliver clean, reliable baseload electricity with zero operating emissions—modular, fuel-flexible, and engineered for the realities of today’s energy demand. At the core is a supercritical CO₂ turbine with integrated carbon capture, designed to bring carbon-neutral power online quickly at meaningful scale.

Our team includes aerospace engineers, combustion experts, and systems thinkers with a shared goal: to build technology worthy of the world we want to live in. While many of us began our journeys looking to the stars, we’re applying that expertise here at home to deliver dependable, emission-free baseload power and a future of lasting abundance.

If you share our values and are drawn to rigorous work with lasting impact, we’d love to learn more about you. Come build what the future will run on.

Steward our planet: We build for tomorrow, ensuring every bolt we tighten and every hand we lend leaves our environment stronger than we found it.

Lead with Love: We champion the success of our people, partners, and planet, nurturing excellence through camaraderie and rigor.

Explore the Uncharted: We embrace the unknown with curiosity, using courage and discipline to transform uncertainty into opportunity.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer – Power Systems to own the electrical architecture of Arbor's supercritical CO₂ power plants—from the first conceptual one-line through generator selection, synchronization and protection design, utility interconnection, procurement, installation, and first synchronization to the grid. As Arbor's first electrical engineer, you will set the architecture for multi-unit plants of 10–50 MW turbine-generators, both grid-tied at transmission level and in islanded behind-the-meter configurations. This is a hands-on role: you will design, specify, procure, and commission the equipment yourself, and bring in third-party engineering when the schedule demands more hands, not because the work is outside your reach. You'll partner closely with turbomachinery, controls, process, and test engineers in a fast-paced, first-of-a-kind hardware environment, building the electrical discipline that delivers carbon-neutral baseload power.

Responsibilities

• Own the power system architecture for multi-unit grid-tied plants and islanded microgrid configurations: single-line diagrams, generator step-up and medium-voltage distribution topology, auxiliary power, and DC/UPS systems.

• Lead generator, excitation, synchronization, and load-sharing design, including system behavior during load steps, faults, breaker operations, motor starting, and loss-of-generation events.

• Develop the protection philosophy and coordination strategy for generators, transformers, medium-voltage switchgear, and large motors, and produce or review relay settings and time-current coordination.

• Own utility interconnection from feasibility screening through interconnection agreement and compliance, including NERC MOD-026/027 and PRC-019/024 and IEEE 2800 requirements.

• Perform and direct load-flow, short-circuit, arc-flash, motor-starting, and transient stability studies in ETAP, PSCAD, PSS®E, or equivalent.

• Specify and procure major electrical equipment—generators, step-up transformers, switchgear, medium-voltage motors and VFDs, MCCs, and UPS—and manage vendor design reviews, factory acceptance tests, and installation.

• Own or direct hazardous-area classification, grounding, and lightning protection design for facilities handling natural gas, oxygen, and high-pressure CO₂.

• Define scope for and review third-party electrical engineering when additional capacity is needed, and lead electrical commissioning through first fire, full-speed no-load, and synchronization.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related engineering field.

• 8+ years of experience in power-generation, industrial, or utility electrical systems, including medium-voltage generation and distribution and transmission-level interconnection.

• Hands-on commissioning or startup experience with a generating plant or large industrial electrical system.

• Demonstrated ability to take electrical equipment from concept through specification, procurement, installation, and energization.

• Working fluency in generator protection, excitation, and synchronization, and in power system studies (load flow, short circuit, arc flash, motor starting, coordination) using ETAP, SKM, PSCAD, or equivalent.

• Knowledge of NEC, NFPA 70E, NESC, IEEE, and NERC standards applicable to generating facilities.

• Proven ability to own technical development of complex hardware from concept through validation in fast-paced settings.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with islanded power systems, load shedding, and generator paralleling in oil & gas, LNG, industrial-gas, or microgrid applications.

• Gas-turbine or reciprocating-engine generator package experience, including static excitation, generator protection panels, and neutral grounding.

• Utility interconnection studies and RTO/ISO or CAISO/WECC process experience.

• Advanced degree (M.S.) in Electrical Engineering with a power systems emphasis.

• Background in startup environments or first-of-a-kind hardware development.

Benefits & Compensation

• Pre-IPO stock options

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance (Arbor covers 90% for employees)

• Basic life insurance fully covered

• Health savings account (HSA) with matching

• Flexible savings account (FSA)

• Unlimited PTO

• 12+ company holidays, including Earth Day!

• 401(k)

• Commuter benefits

• Annual learning and development stipend

• And more!

Base Pay: $165,000 - $185,000 USD/year. The salary is subject to the applicant's skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

Our Commitment

Arbor Energy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. Solving global energy challenges requires a wide range of perspectives and experiences, and we are committed to building a team that reflects the world we serve.

Our hiring process is designed to be accessible, fair, and focused on the work that matters most for this role. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the hiring process and employment—please let us know if you need one.

jobs.title: Technical Project Lead
jobs.description:
About Us

At Arbor Energy & Resources Corporation ("Arbor Energy"), we’re creating technology to power our lives while protecting the planet that sustains them.  Our advanced power systems deliver clean, reliable baseload electricity with zero operating emissions—modular, fuel-flexible, and engineered for the realities of today’s energy demand. At the core is a supercritical CO₂ turbine with integrated carbon capture, designed to bring carbon-neutral power online quickly at meaningful scale.

Our team includes aerospace engineers, combustion experts, and systems thinkers with a shared goal: to build technology worthy of the world we want to live in. While many of us began our journeys looking to the stars, we’re applying that expertise here at home to deliver dependable, emission-free baseload power and a future of lasting abundance.

If you share our values and are drawn to rigorous work with lasting impact, we’d love to learn more about you. Come build what the future will run on.

Steward our planet: We build for tomorrow, ensuring every bolt we tighten and every hand we lend leaves our environment stronger than we found it.

Lead with Love: We champion the success of our people, partners, and planet, nurturing excellence through camaraderie and rigor.

Explore the Uncharted: We embrace the unknown with curiosity, using courage and discipline to transform uncertainty into opportunity.

Role Overview

We are looking for Technical Project Lead to drive the engineering and execution of Arbor’s first-of-a-kind supercritical CO₂ power plant, from front-end engineering through construction, commissioning, and first power.

Arbor acts as its own integrator, so this is an engineer's role first: someone with deep roots in process or power plant engineering who understands every dependency on a project and knows when to deploy each part of the team.

You'll start hands-on in El Segundo authoring plant-level process design during FEED, then shift toward integration and field leadership, following the plant to site through commissioning and handover to a locally hired operations team. You'll work closely with turbomachinery, combustion, controls, electrical, and test engineers to deliver the plant that proves carbon-neutral baseload power at scale.

This role is based at Arbor’s headquarters in El Segundo, CA.

Responsibilities

• Own the integrated technical execution plan: map dependencies across disciplines, permitting, and procurement, and sequence work by what each decision actually needs.

• Author or direct plant-level process design (PFDs, heat and material balances, P&IDs, relief and utility design), integrating Arbor's core technology with balance-of-plant systems.

• Identify critical-path equipment early and lead long-lead procurement: specifications, bid evaluations, vendor design reviews, and factory acceptance tests.

• Scope, select, and manage engineering firms, fabricators, and construction contractors; review their work in depth and own the interfaces between packages.

• Lead process safety (HAZID, HAZOP/LOPA, PSSR) and build constructability, modularization, and commissioning sequence into the design from the start.

• Lead on-site technical execution through construction, commissioning, first fire, and performance testing.

• Partner with project management and supply chain on estimates, schedule, and contracting strategy, and carry lessons into standardized designs for the units that follow.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Mechanical, or related Engineering field.

• 8+ years of experience in process or power plant engineering, including carrying at least one pilot, demonstration, or commercial facility from front-end design through commissioning and startup with significant time on site.

• Strong process engineering fundamentals—heat and material balances, P&IDs, equipment specification, relief design, HAZOP/LOPA—and working knowledge of ASME B31.3, BPVC Section VIII, and API 520/521.

• Enough breadth across mechanical, electrical, controls, and civil disciplines to spot cross-discipline dependencies and critically review others' work.

• Owner's-side experience directing engineering firms, vendors, and contractors, with a well-formed point of view on how contracting strategy and sequencing drive project cost and schedule.

• Ability to travel up to 75% during construction and commissioning (under 20% during engineering); permanent relocation is not required.

• Strong ownership mentality and sound judgment with incomplete information in a small, dynamic team.

Preferred Qualifications

• First-of-a-kind or new-technology scale-up experience where you carried both process design and project execution.

• Experience with gas turbine or combined-cycle plants, high-pressure rotating equipment, air separation, CO₂ compression, or supercritical CO₂ systems.

• Experience with owner-integrated, EPCM, multi-package, or modular execution as alternatives to lump-sum EPC.

• Operations or commissioning roots in a PSM-covered process facility or power plant.

• Process simulation (Aspen HYSYS, Aspen Plus) and scripting (Python, MATLAB) skills.

Benefits & Compensation

• Pre-IPO stock options

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance (Arbor covers 90% for employees)

• Basic life insurance fully covered

• Health savings account (HSA) with matching

• Flexible savings account (FSA)

• Unlimited PTO

• 12+ company holidays, including Earth Day!

• 401(k)

• Commuter benefits

• Annual learning and development stipend

• And more!

Base Pay: $180,000 - $210,000 USD/year. The salary is subject to the applicant's skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

Our Commitment

Arbor Energy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. Solving global energy challenges requires a wide range of perspectives and experiences, and we are committed to building a team that reflects the world we serve.

Our hiring process is designed to be accessible, fair, and focused on the work that matters most for this role. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the hiring process and employment—please let us know if you need one.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
MEET ASCERTAIN

Ascertain is building AI agents to automate the administrative work that burdens care teams. We are in major health systems and large specialty groups, saving hundreds of staff hours every week.

Our backers include Northwell Health, New York’s largest health system, and Deerfield Management, a leading healthcare investment firm.

Together, we’re on a mission to restore time, trust, and focus to the people who keep healthcare running. Our work is urgent — not because of startup timelines, but because our customers rely on us to drive financial resilience and operational clarity in a system under strain.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer at Ascertain, you'll ship product across the stack—from backend services and data infrastructure that power Ascertain’s healthcare AI platform to the web app that our partner operations team members use every day. You'll join a growing team of engineers, with real ownership over what we build, how we build it, and the engineering culture we grow into.

We're headquartered in New York City with a hybrid team there, plus remote engineers across the U.S. and Brazil. We operate with high autonomy, shared accountability, and deep respect for the people who use our software.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own product features end-to-end, from design through production.

 - Build user-facing experiences in React and TypeScript.

 - Design and ship backend services with Python and FastAPI.

 - Partner with product, design, and engineering peers to turn fuzzy problems into shipped software.

 - Raise the bar in code review and help shape our engineering practices.

 - Improve our development processes as we grow—testing, CI/CD, observability—the things that compound over time.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years strong full-stack experience with Python (FastAPI or similar) and TypeScript with React.

 - Comfort designing schemas and writing non-trivial SQL against relational databases (we use PostgreSQL).

 - Working knowledge of containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines.

 - Familiarity with Redis, queueing systems, or other parts of a modern production stack.

 - Experience building and operating production systems in a cloud environment (we use GCP).

 - Ability to communicate clearly in English, written and verbal—most async work happens in writing, and you'll regularly join meetings with U.S.-based teammates.

 - Background in ambiguous, early-stage environments where you've had to take ownership without much scaffolding.

 - Meaningful overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours during the workday.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in regulated environments (healthcare, fintech, etc.) and a security-minded approach to design.

 - Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform).




WHO YOU ARE

You're excited—not just willing—to learn new things, push past your comfort zone, and ship in a fast-moving environment. You communicate clearly, take ownership without being asked, and care about the people on the other end of your code.




BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Cutting-edge technology: Work directly with the latest advancements in generative AI and automation, tackling challenging problems that meaningfully impact healthcare.

 - Ownership & growth: You’ll join Ascertain at a pivotal early stage, shaping our products, technical direction, and culture, with significant opportunities for career advancement.

 - Collaborative team: Join a talented, passionate, and supportive team with backgrounds from top tech companies and clinical institutions.

 - Competitive compensation: We offer competitive salary, meaningful equity, comprehensive health insurance, and more.

Why Ascertain? Make a real difference: Your work will directly impact healthcare organizations and improve patient care. Join Ascertain in transforming healthcare with AI!

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Quality and Post-Training
jobs.description:
About Glean:

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About the Role:

The bottleneck in building reliable and useful AI agents isn't writing code anymore. It's knowing what good looks like, measuring it, and steadily closing the gap. Glean is building the next generation of enterprise AI assistants and autonomous agents that reason, plan, and act across complex, multi-step workflows. This role works at the intersection of applied research, quality, and product engineering to make those systems better.

The focus is on quality improvements across Glean's models and agent harnesses. That means hill-climbing with evals, evolving evalsets and agentic verifiers, post-training models for use cases like model routing, and training task-specific models for enterprise workflows. It also means bringing emerging research into the product and working closely with product teams and customers, turning learnings from evals and production usage into better outcomes through quality improvements.

You will:

• Use eval results and production traces to improve the entire stack, including the agent harness, model routing, prompts, and retrieval, while weighing quality against latency and cost.

• Work on post-training models with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference- or reward-based optimization (e.g., DPO, PPO, GRPO), including generating the data for training.

• Build RL environments for simulating enterprise workflows, including relevant evalsets, harness support, and LLM-based verifiers for hill-climbing and for internal and external benchmarking.

• Improve the quality of representative evalsets, LLM judges and agentic verifiers, and calibrate them against human graders so the scores can be trusted in release decisions and model training.

• Work with product, platform, and research teams across Glean to land quality improvements in production.

About you:

• 5+ years of industry experience in AI or Machine Learning Engineering.

• Hands-on experience post-training LLMs including adapting open-weight models to specialized tasks.

• Experience building evals for AI assistant and agent systems, including generating evalsets, LLM-as-a-judge verifiers, calibrating offline and online signals coupled with good judgment about when a metric reflects quality improvements.

• Strong coding skills in Python and/or Go (TypeScript is a plus), proficiency in your ML framework of choice, and a track record of shipping production ML systems.

• Product-minded, able to turn a vague problem into a concrete experiment, and thrive in a tight-knit, cross-functional team.

Location:

• This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View or San Francisco office)

Compensation & Benefits:

The standard base salary range for this position is $200,000 - $280,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.

We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

#LI-HYBRID

AI-First Mindset at Glean:

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

Location: Silicon Valley (On-site)

About Us:

Think Academy is the North American math education brand under TAL, serving K–12 families across the US. In this role, you will directly work on understanding Chinese-speaking parents in the US, growing content channels, driving user acquisition, and improving conversion. This is not a traditional content role — you will be expected to help build and optimize the full content → acquisition → conversion funnel.

We are building something relatively rare: a 0-to-1 user acquisition model for Xiaohongshu and other Chinese-language content channels in the US market. If you are interested in international expansion, cross-border business, overseas growth, or Growth Marketing, this is an opportunity to work directly on a US market growth initiative and help build a new acquisition model from the ground up.

We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to post on Xiaohongshu. We are looking for someone who knows how to turn content into user acquisition.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Drive User Acquisition through Xiaohongshu
Own the growth of Think Academy’s Xiaohongshu channel, with a focus on acquiring qualified users and generating leads. Continuously test different content directions and optimize channel performance.

2. Create High-Quality Content
Own the full content process, including topic selection, scripting, copywriting, visual content, and publishing. Create content that combines user value, platform appeal, and brand/product relevance, with the goal of attracting the right target parents — not simply maximizing traffic.

3. Connect Content with Paid Growth & Conversion
Understand Xiaohongshu advertising and basic marketing funnels. Focus on the full journey from content → inquiry → lead → conversion, using advertising and conversion data to continuously improve content and acquisition efficiency, while collaborating with the paid media and sales teams.

4. Analyze, Iterate, and Scale
Track content, traffic, and acquisition performance. Identify what works, why it works, and how to scale it, continuously improving the content strategy and building repeatable user acquisition methods.

Qualifications:

Must-Have

• 2+ years of Xiaohongshu operations experience, with experience independently managing an account and being accountable for content performance;

• Hands-on experience with Xiaohongshu paid advertising, with a solid understanding of paid media and user acquisition fundamentals;

• Experience in education, tutoring, or education technology;

• Strong content skills, with the ability to independently handle topic selection, scripting, copywriting, and content production;

• Strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and ability to proactively drive projects and deliver results;

• CET-6 or above, with the ability to communicate in English in day-to-day work;

• Willingness to work onsite in Beijing;

• Willingness to travel to the US for 3–4 months during the initial stage of the role.

Nice to Have

• Strong research skills and the ability to quickly understand and synthesize complex topics;

• Strong user insight and understanding of parents’ needs and decision-making;

• Experience using AI tools to improve content production efficiency;

• Ability to take feedback, iterate quickly, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Compensation & Growth

• Base Pay: $6000/month

• Performance Bonus: Up to 10% of base compensation

• Bonus will be evaluated based on content performance, audience reach, qualified inquiries, and relevant business outcomes.

• High-performing candidates who consistently demonstrate ownership and deliver strong results will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time role.

• What You’ll Gain: US Market Experience: Work directly on content acquisition and growth targeting Chinese-speaking families in the US; End-to-End Growth Experience: Gain hands-on experience across content, paid acquisition, lead generation, and conversion; Global Growth Experience: Help build a 0-to-1 overseas Chinese-language acquisition model and develop experience in international and cross-border growth.

About the Role:

The bottleneck in building reliable, useful AI is no longer writing code. It's defining what good looks like and measuring how well our products deliver it. That takes high-quality data and evals that teams can trust.

Our team owns data and evaluation science for Glean's AI products. We build evalsets, agentic LLM-judges, and benchmarks that capture what good looks like, along with the platform and infrastructure that run evals reliably at scale, and enterprise simulation environments where we test how our assistants and agents actually perform. Starting from real production usage, you'll turn what we learn into evals that guide improvements across the entire stack, from agent harnesses to tool use, skill iteration, model routing, and post-training of task specific models.

You'll bring new research into production and partner with R&D, product, and GTM to turn findings from evals into better products and customer outcomes. If you care about quality and want to build the systems that measure it, this role is for you.

You will:

• Build evalsets and benchmarks from expert-curated examples, production data, synthetic data, and past failures, covering edge cases and key user slices.

• Build and scale the eval platform and agent observability: experiment pipelines, trace capture and replay, and dashboards, with reproducible, affordable runs.

• Build agentic LLM verifiers for correctness, groundedness, citation quality, and task success, and calibrate them against human labels using clear rubrics.

• Run evals at every stage, from CI and pre-release suites to sampled production traffic, and report results with confidence intervals.

• Build enterprise simulation environments with simulated users and realistic company data to test multi-step agent tasks.

• Diagnose failures by slice and trace, and turn eval results into concrete fixes, weighing quality against latency and cost.

About you:

• 5+ years of software engineering experience with strong Go and/or Python and backend fundamentals: APIs, data modeling, testing, and distributed pipelines. TypeScript is a plus.

• Experience building datasets and benchmarks for LLM use-cases, RAG, or agents, including evalset curation and synthetic data generation.

• Familiarity with eval methodologies and their tradeoffs: deterministic metrics, LLM-as-a-judge, pointwise vs pairwise grading, human labeling, and judge calibration.

• Experience building eval or experiment infrastructure that runs reliably at scale, including CI/CD integrations and observability tooling like OpenTelemetry.

• Strong analytical skills: you dig into traces and failure cases, write SQL, and use data and metrics to explain why quality moved.

• Nice to have: experience with simulation environments and/or model post-training techniques.

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic, results driven individual to join our Accounting team as a Product Accounting Lead. This position will have a focus on Rippling’s expansion, and play a pivotal role in establishing and maintaining robust accounting infrastructure to support the introduction of new product offerings. This role will closely collaborate with our global expansion, legal & compliance, treasury, business development, tax, payment operations, analytics, product, and research and development teams. Responsibilities include assessing the financial implications of new products and markets, managing projects, documenting accounting requirements, designing processes, and conducting user acceptance testing to operationalize accounting and reporting procedures timely. You will be serving as a  primary liaison for product and engineering teams and will be a key stakeholder in building the foundation for new product development.

Please note: This role requires working from either our San Francisco or New York City office 1–3 days per week.

What you will do

• Serve as a primary liaison between the Product Teams and Accounting Department. Collaborate closely to understand, develop, and implement financial processes aligned with the company's new product roadmap.

• Conduct thorough User Acceptance Testing (UAT) procedures to validate system builds, ensuring seamless integration and functionality of accounting systems with new product launches and updates. This includes coordinating with cross-functional teams to address any issues identified during testing and ensuring readiness for production deployment.
• Drive process automation initiatives to streamline journal entries, reporting mechanisms, and system integrations, leveraging tools and technologies to enhance efficiency and accuracy in financial processes.
• Take ownership of ad-hoc requests and special projects in addition to daily responsibilities, demonstrating adaptability and a proactive approach to addressing evolving business needs.

What you will need

jobs.title: Security Operations Engineer II
jobs.location: Scottsdale, Arizona, United States; Washington, United States
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

As a Security Operations Engineer II, you will be an engineer-first member of Axon's Security Operations Center, the team that monitors, investigates, and responds to security events across Axon's corporate, cloud, and regulated SaaS environments, which serve public safety agencies and enterprises around the world. You will respond to alerts, triage incidents, and participate in the on-call rotation, and use what you learn about day-to-day SOC operations to automate the repetitive work that slows response. You will build automation playbooks, tool integrations, and threat detections, and lead incidents from initial findings through root cause analysis and remediation, turning each one into better detections and playbooks. As automation takes over repeat work, more of your time goes to building the capabilities that let the SOC scale with Axon's growth.

Location: Onsite at our Scottsdale, AZ or Seattle, WA office
Reports to: Manager, Information Security Engineering
Direct Reports: None

Your Day-to-Day:

• Investigate and respond to security alerts, security tickets, and user-reported phishing as part of the team's shared queue rotation.

• Participate in the on-call rotation, investigating, containing, and coordinating escalated security events such as exposed credentials, data spillage, suspicious account activity, and cloud account compromise.

• Own incidents through to closure: timeline, root cause, remediation tracking, and a detection or playbook update so the same issue is caught faster next time.

• Identify repetitive, manual work and replace it with automation, such as phishing triage and enrichment, offboarding verification, vulnerability remediation tracking, and bulk ticket handling.

• Write, tune, and document detections against security logs, retire noisy alerts, and write a runbook for every alert you ship.

• Support identity and access operations, including offboarding, access requests, and access reviews, and automate the checks that keep them reliable.

• Produce audit and compliance evidence, and automate its collection wherever possible.

What You’ll Do:

• Design, build, and operate security automation using version control, code review, testing, and CI/CD, including automation playbooks, chat-based workflows, and services that connect security tools.

• Integrate security, identity, IT service management, and cloud platforms through their APIs, handling authentication and secrets securely.

• Own the detection lifecycle: onboard new log sources, write and tune detections, find coverage gaps, and manage detections as code.

• Deploy and maintain the cloud infrastructure behind security tooling using infrastructure-as-code and least-privilege design.

• Build detections and automation that meet strict data-handling and compliance requirements.

• Turn incident lessons into reusable playbooks, templates, and tooling that make response consistent across the team.

• Evaluate new security tooling, including automation platforms and AI-assisted triage, for fit, security, and licensing, and take selected tools into production.

• Measure team workload and the time automation saves, and report metrics that show where to invest next.

• Partner with senior team members on platform design decisions while assisting more junior team members with scripting and automation.

What You Bring:

• 2+ years of experience in security engineering, SOC or detection engineering, or software or infrastructure roles with a security focus.

• Strong skills in python, shell scripting, git, and experience shipping and maintaining production code.

• Hands-on incident response and alert triage experience, and comfort participating in an on-call rotation.

• Experience with a SIEM, log analytics platform, or SOAR or workflow automation platform.

• Working knowledge of cloud platforms, identity providers, endpoint detection and response (EDR), and REST APIs and authentication.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools.

• Experience with Git-based collaborative development, including branching, pull requests, and code review.

• Experience building and maintaining production CI/CD pipelines.

• Understanding of the software development lifecycle and application design, with a habit of writing maintainable, tested code.

• Familiarity with secure development practices such as dependency scanning, secrets scanning, and managing secrets in pipelines.

• Clear written communication for runbooks, incident timelines, and audit evidence.

• Must be able to pass a standard FBI background check for access to Criminal Justice Information Systems.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs

• Emotional & Mental Wellness support

• Learning & Development programs

• Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

jobs.title: BIM Technician I - II
jobs.description:

As a global leader in consulting, engineering, and commissioning services, we specialize in highly technical buildings and the systems that bring them to life. We are seeking a BIM Technician I - II to join our team in Dallas, TX.

Our dynamic work environment provides the optimal setting to take your engineering career to the next level. From our supportive culture, diverse workforce, and competitive compensation to our flexible work schedule Monday to Thursday in the office for 9 hours and Friday for 4 hours remotely at home and fun social events, it is everything you will need for an exciting, challenging, and rewarding career.

Job Responsibilities

As a Senior BIM Technician, you will setup, draft, convert, produce and edit MEP plans using AutoCAD and REVIT. This role will require excellent organizational skills, the ability communicate effectively and prioritize multiple project deadlines.

Additional responsibilities include:

• Produce setup drawings/sheets/views consistent with instruction, guidelines, and CAD/BIM standards.

• Modify Architectural CAD/BIM files for use in MEP design drawings (clean-up, audit, reference, basic troubleshoot)

• Setup new projects, drawings, and models, for use by MEP engineers, prioritize tasks and communicate workflows with design team.

• Work in coordination with external client CAD/BIM Coordinator for modeling and following CAD/BIM formats

• Manage CAD/BIM coordination on projects specific to CAD/BIM skills (Includes working in coordination with external client CAD/BIM Coordinator for modeling and following CAD/BIM formats)

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated proficiency in AutoCAD and MEP tools. You will need effective organizational skills, ability to prioritize workload, and be a team player with strong communication skills.

Additional requirements:

• Proficient at working with drawings and understanding of red marks

• Proficient in reading and understanding floor plans, sections and elevations

jobs.title: Medical Information Representative
jobs.description:
THE POSITION:

Medical Information is a critically important customer-facing function that supports the safe and effective use of pharmaceutical company products by providing timely, scientifically balanced, evidence based, non-promotional information in response to unsolicited requests from healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, and payers. Medical Information also plays an important role in post-marketing managing of adverse events and product complaints. As a functional member of the Medical Information Contact Center (MICC) team, this position delivers industry-leading services, which include Contact Center staffing for responding to product information requests as well as identifying and managing of adverse events and/or product quality issues. This position requires clinical and therapeutic knowledge, critical and analytical thinking, and customer/patient-centric approach. Medical Information Representatives typically support multiple pharmaceutical clients, products, and therapeutic areas.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams.  These results are achieved by:

Medical Information Support

• Independently respond to unsolicited medical information inquiries from physicians, pharmacists, nurses, and other health care professionals, consumers, and payers.
• Utilize medical information and clinical expertise to identify, research, and critically evaluate medical literature to create responses to medical information inquiries.
• Identify & accurately document adverse events and product complaints during customer interactions.
• Perform intake & generate accurate adverse event and product complaint reports in compliance with EVERSANA-MICC and client standard operating procedures.
• Demonstrate knowledge of FDA’s post-marketing adverse event reporting regulations and safety terminology.
• Ability to make accurate assessments regarding level & depth of information required.
• Utilize writing skills for adverse event and product complaint narrative during intake as well as documentation of medical inquiry.
• Independently Handle requests across multiple channels and platforms (phone, email, CRM, chat, etc.)
• Coordinate & support processes necessary for responding to product quality-related complaints. This process may involve collaborating with personnel in the following departments: Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and the complainant.
• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, therapeutic areas, and client specific requirements.
• Ensure accurate documentation, high quality, and excellent customer service.
• Staffing at scientific medical affairs booths.
• On-call responsibilities on an assigned basis.
• Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
• All other duties as assigned.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by an employee with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. If reasonable accommodation is needed to perform the essential functions of your job position, please contact Human Resources.

EXPECTATIONS OF THE JOB:

• Metrics: Independently contribute towards process improvement which positively impacts metrics associated with activities of the Medical Communications l Contact Center; metrics are subject to change annually or more often as deemed necessary.
• Customer Services: Maintain and enhance customer service associated with activities of the Medical Information Contact Center. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with demonstrated ability to engage effectively with healthcare professionals, patients, and caregivers. Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within teams.
• Hours: Able to work full time (40+ hours per week, typically Monday to Friday) and be flexible with work scheduling as required by clients and management.
• Travel: In general, this position does not travel; however, the incumbent may need to be able to travel up to 10%

The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the expectations of the position and shall not be construed as the only expectations that may be assigned for the position.

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the expectations listed above.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

• Education: Associate, Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Nursing or a related healthcare discipline (e.g. allied health, clinical sciences) from an accredited institution.
• Experience and/or Training: Strong clinical and healthcare background with excellent verbal/written communications skills along with the ability to work independently and as part of a team. Strong healthcare or clinical background with the ability to interpret and communicate medical information clearly and accurately.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Education: Advanced healthcare degree or higher in healthcare-related field or equivalent
• Licenses/Certificates: Registered Nurse (RN) or equivalent licensure.
• Experience and/or Training: Minimum 2 years of work experience in medical and healthcare, pharmaceutical industry, or equivalent. Direct clinical or patient-facing healthcare experience is strongly preferred. Experience in a Contact Center.
• Technology/Equipment: Technology proficiency in the areas of telephony, Medical Information database, Microsoft Office, and video conference platforms.
• Knowledge: Therapeutic expertise. Ability to critically evaluate medical literature. Medical Information contact center systems and processes. Experience in Drug Information or a specialty area, particularly in Oncology, Hematology, Immunology, rare disease, Neurology, Cardiology, or other specialties.
• Positive Attitude and Energy: Exhibits an upbeat attitude, a genuine interest in others and a sense of humor. Energizes others and heightens morale through her/his attitude.

Office: While performing the essential functions of this job the employee is frequently required to reach, grasp, stand and/or sit for long periods of time (up to 90% of the shift), walk, talk and hear; occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderately quiet, with frequent interruptions and multiple demands.

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others.

jobs.description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with neffy®, the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you’re motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture.

JOB SUMMARY:

This role is a senior individual contributor role that will work an onsite hybrid schedule at our San Diego corporate office in the Carmel Valley are.  The Associate Director / Director, Quality Assurance owns the systems that keep us inspection-ready: document control, GMP training, and the vendor and supplier qualification and audit program. You will build and scale the Quality Management System for an outsourced manufacturing model, lead cross-functional quality initiatives, and act as a senior quality voice with contract manufacturers, suppliers, and regulators.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Quality leadership

• Serve as a senior QA leader, partnering with the Head of QA to set quality strategy, priorities, and annual objectives.

• Lead cross-functional quality initiatives with Manufacturing/CMC, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Clinical, and Commercial teams.

• Own QA metrics and KPIs; prepare inputs for quarterly Management Review.

• Lead inspection readiness and act as a front-room host or SME during FDA and other regulatory inspections.

• Coach and mentor QA and cross-functional colleagues on GMP expectations; deputize for the Head of QA when needed.

Document management

• Own the document control system (e.g., Veeva Vault QualityDocs): SOPs, work instructions, forms, specifications, and controlled records.

• Manage the document lifecycle: authoring templates, review and approval routing, periodic review, effective dates, and archival.

• Ensure Part 11 and data integrity (ALCOA+) compliance for electronic records and signatures.

• Maintain record retention schedules and inspection-ready retrieval.

Training

• Own the GMP training program: role-based curricula, training matrices, and new-hire onboarding.

• Deliver or oversee annual cGMP, data integrity, and SOP training.

• Track completion and training effectiveness; escalate overdue training and close gaps found in audits.

Vendor and supplier audits

• Own the supplier qualification program: risk-based classification, approved supplier list, and requalification schedule.

• Plan and run the annual audit schedule for CMOs, testing labs, API and excipient suppliers, component and device suppliers, and GxP service providers.

• Lead on-site and remote audits; write reports, approve audit responses, and verify CAPA effectiveness.

• Negotiate and maintain quality agreements; monitor supplier performance and escalate quality issues.

• Support internal audits of QMS processes

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Influence: gets alignment from peers, partners, and executives without line authority.

• Systems thinking: designs quality processes that scale and stay inspection-ready.

• Audit judgment: finds real risk quickly and grades findings in proportion to it.

• Communication: writes clear audit reports and presents confidently to regulators and leadership.

• Office-based in San Diego (preferred), with domestic and international travel up to 25% for audits, including time in GMP manufacturing areas with gowning.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Required

• Bachelor's degree in a scientific or engineering discipline; advanced degree a plus. An acceptable combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered

• Minimum of 10+ years of QA experience

• Progressive QA experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or combination products, including commercial-stage products.

• Hands-on ownership of document control and GMP training systems.

• Lead auditor experience with CMOs and suppliers; strong knowledge of 21 CFR 210/211, Part 11, ICH Q7–Q10, and EU GMP.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional work and influence without direct authority.

• Direct participation in FDA or EU regulatory inspections.

Preferred

• Drug-device combination product experience (21 CFR Part 4, 820 / QMSR, ISO 13485).

• Veeva Vault QMS/QualityDocs administration or implementation.

• ASQ CQA or other lead auditor certification.

• Experience building quality systems at a small, virtual, or growing company.

At ARS, we are proud to offer a highly competitive compensation & benefits package.

The full-time salary range for this posted position is $206,000 to $230,000 and may be eligible for a discretionary annual performance bonus. Actual pay rates are determined by considering multiple factors including qualifications, relevance of experience, education & credentials, subject matter expertise, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

This position is also eligible for Equity, 401k matching, and our excellent benefits package including 100% employer paid Medical, Dental & Vision for employees. View the full package here: ARS Careers Page

jobs.title: Senior Designer - Menswear (Banana Republic)
jobs.description:
Founded in 2000, FAM Brands designs, manufactures, and sells men’s and women’s sportswear and active wear apparel to major retailers, big box stores, and specialty boutiques across the country and throughout the world. Our portfolio of proprietary brands features Marika, Wildfox, Three Dots, and Balance Collection, while a partial list of licensing partners includes Orvis, Jessica Simpson, Eddie Bauer, and Woolrich.

With the capacity to produce over 75 million units per year, our mission continues to be making top-quality apparel accessible to everyone at an impressive value and an irresistible price.

That's the FAM Brands difference.

We're officially moving into our new HQ in Beverly Hills (August 2026)

9242 Beverly Blvd, Beverly Hills, CA 90210

SUMMARY

FAM Brands is a leading apparel company known for combining innovation, quality, and scale. Our Menswear (Banana Republic) division is growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Designer with a strong creative point of view and deep experience designing for elevated lifestyle brands. The Menswear (Banana Republic) Designer will lead the design and development of seasonal collections focused on modern, trend-relevant product with commercial viability. This role requires someone with a refined aesthetic, deep fabric and construction knowledge, and proven experience designing for top-tier retailers and brands.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own the creative direction, design, and execution of menswear (collection)

• Create trend-right concepts, color stories, and line plans aligned to brand/customer expectations

• Sketch detailed flat designs and develop technical design packages using Adobe Illustrator and PLM

• Collaborate cross-functionally with merchandising, tech, PD, and sourcing to ensure brand-right, margin-friendly product

• Present concept, design direction, and seasonal assortments to internal and external stakeholders

• Partner with technical design during fittings to maintain aesthetic and construction quality

• Stay ahead of fashion, cultural, and retail trends relevant to our target customer

ABOUT YOU

• Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Design or equivalent

• 8+ years of experience in menswear design, specifically for elevated, heritage and contemporary brands

• Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite and PLM systems (Centric PLM strongly preferred)

• Experience designing for affordable price points

• Strong communication and presentation skills; able to convey ideas clearly and collaborate cross-functionally

NICE TO HAVES

• A passion for fabric sourcing, sustainable design, or emerging technologies in apparel

jobs.title: Analyst, Privacy (Privacy Assessments)
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Privacy Analyst on the Privacy Operations team within Security, you'll play a central role in how Coinbase identifies and manages privacy risk across its products and platforms. This team partners with Legal, Product, and Engineering to perform privacy assessments, manage privacy issues through the product lifecycle, and continuously improve the frameworks and tooling that keep customer data safe. You'll own the execution of complex privacy assessments for new products and features, drive issue remediation, and build scalable processes that embed privacy by design into how Coinbase ships.

What you'll do:

• Own end-to-end privacy assessments for new products and features, synthesizing findings and driving remediation with cross-functional partners across Legal, Product, and Engineering.

• Perform regulatory requirement mapping against the privacy common controls framework and identify where control updates are needed to address evolving obligations.

• Track privacy requirements and issues throughout the product lifecycle, managing escalations and driving timely resolution with business owners.

• Partner with Product and Engineering teams by embedding into roadmap planning processes and advising on privacy-by-design principles for onchain and web3 products.

• Identify and implement automation and AI-driven process improvements to streamline privacy assessments and issue management workflows.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 3+ years in technology risk management with a focus on privacy or security, including hands-on experience conducting privacy assessments (DPIAs/PIAs, data flow reviews, or equivalent).

• Demonstrated ability to map regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, ePrivacy) to operational controls and validate remediation efforts.

• Proven ability to translate privacy legal guidance and product specs into functional requirements and actionable remediation plans.

• Experience managing a high volume of concurrent assessments while balancing strategic priorities and stakeholder escalations across technical and non-technical audiences.

• Familiarity with applying privacy principles to blockchain, onchain, and web3 products or willingness to develop this expertise rapidly.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer - Core
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About The Role

We are looking for a Staff Platform Engineer to join our Platform team based in the United States. Our team is responsible for providing engineering teams with the platform and tooling responsible for deploying and running the core critical services that power the entire Fanatics business. You will own and lead complex initiatives across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD systems, observability, and internal developer tooling.

As a Staff Platform Engineer, you will be a technical leader on our platform team, helping influence the technical direction and raising the bar for code quality, reliability, and observability. You will lead projects from design through delivery, coordinating across engineers, and partner teams with minimal oversight. You will design complete systems and services that meet business goals and our engineering standards, partner with team leadership on planning and the roadmap, and mentor team members on engineering craft and ownership.

What You’ll Do

• Lead end-to-end execution of complex initiatives, from architecture and design through deployment and continuous refinement.

• Lead the design, maintenance, and implementation of scalable platform services, automation, CI/CD, and infrastructure supporting Fanatics’ technology ecosystem.

• Contribute to observability initiatives, including logging, metrics, and alerting, to improve system reliability and incident response.

• Partner with application and platform teams to improve performance, scalability, and reliability in cloud-native environments.

• Participate in incident response, post-incident reviews, and reliability improvements.

• Advocate for best practices in infrastructure, software delivery, and operational excellence.

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers.

• Continuously learn and apply new technologies and approaches to platform engineering challenges.

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience successfully leading complex initiatives while driving team strategy.

• Track record of breaking down complex work into clear, achievable milestones and delivering predictably using agile practices.

• Strong software engineering background, with experience in backend development and distributed systems.

• Deep understanding of the AWS cloud platform and cloud-native architectures.

• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and automation.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and developer productivity tooling.

• Deep expertise with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production environments.

• Strong knowledge of observability (logging, metrics, tracing) and experience improving system visibility and reliability.

• Experience with incident management and operational best practices for large-scale systems.

• Proficiency in Go or Python.

• Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools.

• Familiarity with platform security concepts.

• Ability to collaborate effectively across teams, communicate complex topics clearly, and influence engineering best practices.

• Outcome-driven mindset with a focus on solving real-world engineering challenges.

• A positive, adaptable attitude suited for a fast-moving environment.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Nice To Have

• Experience scaling services globally

• FinOps or cloud cost management experience

• Regulated or high-availability environment experience

• Experience with Java or Kotlin

• Familiarity with GitHub Actions

• Experience with Kafka and Cassandra

Why Join Us?

• Work on high-impact platform engineering challenges at scale.

• Collaborate with experienced engineers who value technical excellence and innovation.

• Play a key role in shaping the developer experience and operational foundations of Fan Ecosystem.

• Join a culture that encourages learning, growth, and technical leadership.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

#LI-VG1

Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Salary Range

$200,000—$250,000 USD

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here.
