jobs.title: Senior Associate, Fund Administration (Accounting)
jobs.description:
ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/ operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.




ABOUT YOUR ROLE

We are hiring a few Senior Associates to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast paced start-up environment to help build out Juniper Square’s Fund Administration service offering. Juniper Square is on a mission to transform the Fund Administration offering to Private Markets. We are more than a Fund Administrator, we are a Modern Fund Administrator.  As a Senior Fund Accountant you will partner with the customer, other members of the fund accounting team, and Investor Services and Fund Administration Onboarding teams to deliver  fund accounting and reporting services to Juniper Square’s Private Market customers in the Real Estate, Private Equity, and Venture Capital space. You will have a significant opportunity to shape the trajectory of our service offering and in so doing help to deliver a best-in-class experience to our customers. We are a team of values based self-starters with a curious mindset and the motivation to use technology to our advantage so that we are continually iterating and improving on the status quo. This is an opportunity to couple prior education and experience and to learn from some of the best talent in Private Markets.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Support  major decisions regarding team buildout and operational policies and procedures

 - Define and support the implementation of fund administration workflows, applying best practices and process efficiencies

 - Interface directly with clients to deliver an outstanding client experience

 - Serve as a technical accounting expert and key advisor on significant business/accounting decisions for the team

 - Perform accounting, analytical, & financial reporting duties; ensure client and investor reporting is prepared and completed timely and accurately

 - Review waterfall calculations and capital calls and distributions in accordance with clients’ Limited Partnership Agreements

 - Prepare and review asset- and fund-level performance metrics (IRRs, TVPI, etc.)

 - Assist in preparing, compiling, and verifying external client and regulatory reporting

 - Prepare financial information for stockholders/investor reports

 - Assist with annual audits, including preparation of the initial draft of the annual audit report and related schedules and disclosures; assist with PBC list (Prepared By Client) and tax returns

 - Research and assist in interpreting the impact of recent accounting developments




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years of fund accounting or audit experience with exposure to Private Equity, Venture Capital, Private Credit and/or Real Estate funds

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field required. 

 - Investran experience preferred.

 - Exposure to complex fund structures, waterfall calculations, performance metrics (IRRs), distributions and capital calls calculations

 - Experience with annual reporting (audited financial statements) 

 - Passion for technology and a desire to use technology to improve business operations

 - Experience scoping out system requirements and implementing new systems

 - Strategic thinker with the ability to master both the details and the big picture

 - Ability to handle many projects at once without losing track of the details

 - Comfortable with ambiguity, excellent work ethic and likes to take ownership of your work


At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this job sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the qualifications.




COMPENSATION 

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $98,000. The Canadian base salary range for this role is $80,000 - $100,000. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. We are actively hiring for this role in Canada, and offer competitive local pay and benefits. Your recruiter can provide further details.



Benefits include:

 - Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability coverage

 - Mental wellness coverage

 - Fertility and growing family support

 - Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

 - Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

 - 401k retirement savings plan

 - Healthcare FSA and commuter benefits programs

 - Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

 - Annual professional development stipend

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Systems Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
The future of aerospace and defense starts here.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

Ursa is currently seeking a driven Systems Engineering Intern to join our small, fast-paced, solid rocket motor team. As member of the team, you will gain experience in many aspects of systems engineering, including design, development, manufacturing and testing of solid rocket motors. This internship will have a strong focus on requirement development, verification planning, risk analysis, and process building.

In this role, you will engage in both collaborative projects and independent tasks, contributing to our dynamic work environment. You will have the opportunity to work closely with team members across different disciplines, allowing you to gain diverse perspectives and learn from experienced professionals. We value initiative and responsibility; you will have the chance to influence technical decisions and make a real impact.

Key Responsibilities

• Interpret customer needs and evaluate team capability to create detailed and actionable requirements.

• Plan validation and build traceability back to requirements.

• Contribute to reliability assessment, failure mode analysis, and risk mitigation efforts.

• Define and model data flow between subsystems and operational activities.

• Develop and improve system engineering processes and tools.

• Provide flexible support for team projects as need emerges.

Required Qualifications

• Pursing a background in systems engineering, mechanical, electrical, or aerospace engineering.

• Familiarity with systems engineering principles - design reviews, system requirements, verification and validation, and failure and risk assessments.

• Strong communication skills with ability to convey technical information in team settings.

• Confidence in developing processes and ability to work effectively in situations where procedures may not be established.

• Demonstrated commitment to valuing diversity in all its forms as well as contributing to an inclusive working and learning environment

• Demonstrates initiative and adopts a diligent approach to learning.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with solid rocket motor systems.

• Proficiency in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE).

• Proficiency in requirements management tools such as DOORS, or Jama.

Colorado law requires us to tell you the base compensation range of this role, which is $30.00/hour, determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. What we can’t quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy.

jobs.description:
The Food & Beverage Manager is responsible for the daily leadership and operation of The Restaurant and The Bar at Auberge du Soleil, ensuring an exceptional Forbes Five-Star dining experience while fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and genuine hospitality.

This leader oversees all aspects of service, team member engagement, financial performance, operational execution, and guest satisfaction. Working closely with culinary and resort leadership, the Food & Beverage Manager creates memorable guest experiences while developing high-performing teams that embody Auberge Collection's values and service philosophy.

• Oversee the daily operations of The Restaurant and The Bar, ensuring smooth and efficient service.
• Monitor service standards, cleanliness, organization, safety, and overall operational excellence.
• Collaborate with Culinary leadership to ensure seamless communication between front and back of house.
• Maintain compliance with all health department regulations, Responsible Beverage Service (RBS), food safety, and alcohol service standards.
• Ensure opening, closing, and cash handling procedures are consistently followed.
• Maintain inventory controls, equipment standards, and operational readiness.
• Ensure every guest interaction reflects Auberge du Soleil's luxury standards and personalized approach to hospitality.
• Maintain an active presence on the floor, engaging with guests and team members throughout service.
• Resolve guest concerns professionally and proactively, turning service opportunities into memorable experiences.
• Anticipate guest needs while creating a warm, welcoming atmosphere that exceeds expectations.
• Ensure Forbes, Michelin, Relais & Châteaux, and Auberge Resorts Collection service standards are consistently executed.

• Foster a positive, inclusive, and collaborative work environment built on respect, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Monitor labor productivity and scheduling to optimize service while managing payroll expenses.
• Assist in forecasting, budgeting, and financial planning.
• Analyze sales trends, guest feedback, labor reports, and operational metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Maximize revenue through strategic floor management, reservations, upselling, and service efficiency.
• Partner closely with Culinary, Private Dining, Events, Rooms, and Spa teams to deliver exceptional guest experiences across the resort.

• Previous management experience overseeing upscale restaurant operations required.

• Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop high-performing teams.

jobs.description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals

Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.

Please note that this position is based in either San Diego, CA, or Princeton, NJ. Acadia's hybrid model requires this role to work in our office three days per week on average.

Position Summary

The Executive Director, People Business Partnership leads Acadia’s People Business Partner team and serves as a senior advisor to business and People & Performance leadership. The role translates business strategy into clear organization, workforce, leadership and talent priorities that enable Acadia’s growth and performance.

This leader strengthens the quality, consistency and business impact of People Business Partnership across Acadia. Working with business leaders, PBPs and People & Performance Centers of Excellence, the Executive Director anticipates organizational needs, shapes workforce and capability plans, improves leadership effectiveness and enables successful change.

The successful candidate combines strong business judgment with deep expertise in organization, talent, workforce planning and change. This leader raises PBP capability, clarifies ownership, reduces operational burden and focuses the team on the highest-value business and organizational priorities.

Primary Responsibilities

PBP Leadership & Business Partnership

• Lead and develop Acadia’s People Business Partner team, setting clear expectations, building capability and ensuring consistent, high-quality support to leaders.

• Develop a deep understanding of Acadia’s strategy, growth priorities and operating environment, and translate them into workforce, organization, leadership and talent implications.

• Serve as a senior advisor to business and P&P leaders on organization effectiveness, workforce planning, leadership, talent, culture and significant organizational change.

• Guide PBPs in creating focused people plans linked to business priorities and measurable organizational outcomes.

Organization, Workforce & Talent Strategy

• Partner with leaders to identify the capabilities, roles, structures and talent required to deliver current priorities and prepare for future growth.

• Build a forward-looking workforce planning approach that informs where to build, buy, deploy or access critical capabilities.

• Lead organization design and effectiveness work involving structures, roles, governance, decision-making and ways of working.

• Partner with Talent Management and leaders to strengthen succession, talent planning, leadership pipelines and future capabilities.

Leadership Effectiveness & Change

• Strengthen leadership effectiveness through trusted advice, coaching, organizational insights and practical support.

• Enable organizational change by clarifying the business rationale, assessing workforce impacts, building leadership alignment and sustaining adoption.

• Support complex and consequential people matters with Employee Relations, Legal and other specialists to ensure balanced, compliant and business-oriented decisions.

Operating Model, Insights & Enterprise Partnership

• Partner with P&P Centers of Excellence and Operations to create scalable solutions, tools, processes and insights that improve the manager and employee experience.

• Clarify ownership across PBPs, Centers of Excellence, People Operations and business leaders so PBPs can focus on strategic priorities rather than transactional activity.

• Use workforce data, business indicators, market intelligence and organizational insights to identify emerging needs and improve decisions.

• Partner with Total Rewards to inform talent investments and contribute to the evolution of Acadia’s P&P operating model, accountability and business impact.

• Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Measures of Success

• A high-performing PBP team that delivers consistent, strategic and business-focused partnership.

• Clear people plans aligned to enterprise and functional priorities.

• Stronger workforce, organization, leadership and talent decisions supported by trusted insights.

• Reduced transactional burden and clearer accountability across PBPs, Centers of Excellence and People Operations.

• Effective organizational change and stronger leadership capability across the business.

Education, Experience & Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development or a related field, with 15+ years of progressive P&P, Human Resources or related leadership experience, including 8+ years leading teams and enterprise-wide people initiatives. An advanced degree is preferred; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

• Proven experience leading a senior PBP team and advising executive leaders in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare or another highly regulated environment.

• Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to translate strategy into workforce, organization, leadership, talent and change priorities.

• Demonstrated success in organization design, workforce planning, talent and succession planning, leadership development and large-scale change.

• Ability to use workforce data, business indicators, organizational insights and market intelligence to influence decisions and outcomes.

• Experience delivering outcomes through senior business partners, cross-functional teams and Centers of Excellence, while clarifying operating-model accountabilities and shifting transactional work to the appropriate channels.

• Sound judgment in complex people matters, with working knowledge of employment law, employee relations, performance management and organizational risk.

• Exceptional executive communication, coaching, facilitation, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills; demonstrated ability to build accountable, inclusive and collaborative teams.

• Experience supporting geographically dispersed teams in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment. Ability to travel up to 25%, primarily within the United States.

Physical Requirements

This role involves regular standing, walking, sitting, and the use of hands for handling or operating equipment. The employee may also need to reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and maintain visual, verbal and auditory communication in a standard office environment and while working independently from remote locations. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. This position requires the ability to travel independently overnight and/or work after hours as required by travel schedules or business needs.

WHAT WE'RE RESEARCHING

We're hiring medical imaging specialists to evaluate clinical cases and build scoring rubrics for diagnostic benchmarks. This work directly supports the creation of rigorous reference standards for emerging clinical tools. Your expertise ensures that these benchmarks reflect accurate, clinically sound interpretations across various imaging modalities.

You will review a series of de-identified medical images and associated clinical cases through a secure remote platform. jobs.title: Director/Senior Director, Computational Chemistry
jobs.description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Flagship Labs 111 Inc. (FL111) is a privately held, early-stage biotechnology company pioneering a novel platform harnessing innovations in chemistry, computation, and data science to create new therapeutic modalities beyond traditional small molecules. FL111 is backed by Flagship Pioneering, bringing the courage, vision, and resources to guide FL111 from platform validation to patient impact. We are seeking collaborative, creative and relentless problem solvers that share our passion for impact to join us!

THE ROLE

FL111 is seeking a Director/Senior Director, Computational Chemistry to spearhead the design and optimization of heterobifunctional small molecules. This leader will work closely with medicinal chemists, structural biologists, and project teams to develop and apply computational tools to guide molecular design decisions across the design–build–test–learn cycle. The successful candidate will drive molecular ideation, property optimization, and compound prioritization across the portfolio. This is a strategic, high-impact leadership role where the Director/Senior Director will shape computational strategy, drive scientific excellence, and help build and mentor a world-class computational chemistry function.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Molecular Design & Optimization: Define the strategic vision for and drive the design of heterobifunctional small molecules, including ligand selection, attachment vectors, and linker architectures, integrating cross-functional input to balance target engagement, molecular properties, and synthetic efficiency across programs.

• Cheminformatics & Library Exploration: Lead and direct cheminformatics strategy to identify and prioritize chemical series; oversee development of internal computational workflows and data infrastructure to support program needs

• ADME & Developability Assessment: Direct evaluation of key molecular properties (e.g., solubility, permeability, lipophilicity, clearance risk) and lead compound prioritization frameworks that systematically integrate developability considerations across the portfolio.

• Structure-Based & Computational Modeling: Champion and advance structure-based and AI/ML-assisted modeling capabilities (e.g., docking, conformational analysis, FEP) to inform ligand selection, attachment strategy, and linker design; drive adoption of emerging computational methods across the organization.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a strategic scientific partner and computational chemistry leader across chemistry, biology, and in vivo pharmacology teams within the company; align on portfolio priorities, and represent the computational chemistry function in leadership discussions and external scientific forums.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

• PhD in Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, Computational Chemistry, or a related discipline, with 10+ years of relevant industry experience, including demonstrated scientific leadership and people management experience.

• Deep expertise in computational medicinal chemistry and structure-based drug design in the binary and ternary settings, with a track record of driving impactful decisions across multiple drug discovery programs.

• Demonstrated ability to drive and evaluate real, synthetically actionable molecular designs and to mentor and develop scientists to do the same.

• Experience using cheminformatics tools for compound design, analysis and prioritization.

• Proven scientific leadership and communication skills: demonstrated ability to build, lead, and inspire interdisciplinary teams and influence senior stakeholders.

• Prior experience working on heterobifunctional small molecules (e.g., PROTACs) is preferred

• Familiarity with ADME optimization challenges for large, flexible molecules is strongly preferred.

• Prior experience in an early-stage or startup biotech environment is preferred.

Location: Cambridge, MA

About Flagship Pioneering

Flagship Pioneering is a bioplatform innovation company that invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health or sustainability. Since its launch in 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in more than $90 billion in aggregate value. Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.  Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been twice named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Learn more about Flagship at www.flagshippioneering.com.

Flagship Pioneering is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

At Flagship, we recognize there is no perfect candidate. If you have some of the experience listed above but not all, please apply anyway. Experience comes in many forms, skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way. We are dedicated to building diverse and inclusive teams and look forward to learning more about your unique background.

Recruitment & Staffing Agencies: Flagship Pioneering and its affiliated Flagship Lab companies (collectively, “FSP”) do not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to FSP or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Flagship Pioneering’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of FSP, and FSP will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

#LI-TL1

The salary range for this role is $176,000 - $294,300. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. FL111 currently offers healthcare coverage, annual incentive program, retirement benefits and a broad range of other benefits. Compensation and benefits information is based on FL111's good faith estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future.

Privacy Notice for Applicants: When you apply for a role at Flagship Pioneering or one of its portfolio companies, we collect and use personal information you provide (such as your name, contact details, work history, and application materials) to evaluate your application, communicate with you, and comply with legal obligations. Your application data is processed through Greenhouse, our applicant tracking system, and may also be reviewed using AI-assisted screening tools. We do not sell your personal information. California residents have rights under the CCPA/CPRA including to know, delete, and opt out of the sharing of their personal information. If you are located in the EU or UK, we process your data under GDPR and you have rights to access, rectify, and erase your data. To exercise your rights or for questions, contact privacy@flagshippioneering.com.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agentic Commerce
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid)

About the Department

Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.

About the Team

We build the infrastructure that makes the web Payable, powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.

Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the Agentic Internet. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We build tools that make the new internet payable by giving our users the ability to monetize access to their content, data, services, products, and outcomes across the Internet, regardless of where they are hosted.

Building these capabilities requires solving complex engineering problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, usage metering, outcome verification, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols (such as x402, WBA, ACP, and UCP). We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale.

We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.

About the Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Agentic Commerce team to build the core systems, protocols, and customer-facing tools powering machine-to-machine payments, metering, and monetization.

In this role, you will design and ship scalable software across edge infrastructure, transaction engines, protocol layers, and developer tooling (such as our Monetization Gateway). You will work on cutting-edge standards, cryptographic authentication, and commerce controls that enable businesses to define pricing terms, authenticate agents, verify outcomes, and manage agent-generated revenue streams.

What you'll do

• Design and ship production-ready, low-latency services that make web resources Payable for autonomous agents using emerging standards (x402, WBA, ACP, UCP).

• Build high-precision systems for usage metering, pricing definition, outcome verification, and value attribution tailored for agentic workflows.

• Build secure protocols and capabilities for authenticating and authorizing buyers, sellers, and autonomous agents across host-agnostic endpoints.

• Develop capabilities and APIs that give businesses granular visibility, telemetry, and control over agent-generated revenue, billing, and settlement.

• Build resilient bridges between mainstream fiat commerce rails, digital wallets, and decentralized/cryptographic payment protocols for Internet-scale micropayments.

• Write clean, secure, well-tested code, maintain strict accounting/financial precision, and advocate for high reliability, security, and low-latency performance.

• Partner with software engineers, researchers, product managers, design engineers, and cross-Cloudflare stakeholders to take capabilities from concept to production.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Strong software engineering and distributed systems fundamentals.

• Experience building and operating reliable, high-throughput, low-latency production services.

• Solid understanding of HTTP, APIs, payment protocols/rails, web security, or cryptographic authorization.

• Hands-on experience or deep interest in payment systems, usage metering, billing engines, digital wallets, or machine-to-machine interaction protocols.

• Ability to rapidly prototype, evaluate architectural trade-offs, and ship solutions in a fast-moving, emerging technical domain.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Bonus Points

• Fluency in Rust (with a big plus for experience in async Rust) or TypeScript/JavaScript edge runtimes (e.g., Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, KV).

• Experience with emerging agentic payment protocols (x402, A2P, ACP, UCP, Web Bot Auth) or digital wallet architectures.

• Experience building high-precision event metering pipelines, usage-based billing engines, outcome verification systems, or revenue attribution tools.

• Experience with smart contract bridges, cryptography (public-key encryption, signatures, hashes), or hybrid fiat/crypto payment infrastructure.

• Open-source contributions to payment systems, agent protocols, web standards, or distributed systems projects.

• Proven track record of debugging and resolving performance, concurrency, or transactional correctness bottlenecks.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

● For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €54,000 - €75,000.

• The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Banquet Executive Chef
jobs.description:
General Summary Of Duties:

An Executive Banquet Chef is responsible for planning, producing, and executing all banquet food operations—often at massive scale—while maintaining luxury-level quality and strict cost control. This position will oversee banquet kitchens, staff, and event execution.

Role and Responsibilities: (Includes but is not limited to the following)

• Assign, in detail, specific duties to all Banquet staff for efficient operation of kitchen.
• Train and supervise kitchen staff in the proper preparation of menu items.
• Ensure proper receiving, storage (including temperature-setting) and rotation of food products.
• Adhere to control procedures for food cost and quality.
• Provide guest satisfaction through outstanding guest service.
• Write recipes, maintain inventory and order supplies as needed.
• Schedule appropriate number of staff needed for each function – maintaining cost control.
• Ensure department maintains requirements for area sanitation.
• Reports any equipment in need of repair to chef and the engineering department for service.
• Oversee and assist in the production of food served at banquets, business conferences, meetings and social events.
• Schedule staff according to daily and weekly requirements of the kitchen.
• Ensure the food quality served at these functions.
• Supervise and teach cooking procedures to staff.
• Attend menu meetings and make recommendations.
• Responsible for the sanitation of the area.
• Ensure guest satisfaction through outstanding guest service.

Performance Requirements: (Knowledge, skills and abilities)

• Ability to remember, recite and promote the variety of menu items and recipe specifications.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Finance Business Partner
jobs.location: US - Culver City, California, United States
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Finance Manager to join our Finance team, supporting Central & Shared Services in Culver City on a hybrid basis, working 3 days per week from our hub.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

Show us the money! As the Finance team, we’re number crunchers with top-notch analytical and reporting skills. As a shared service, we get to work with all of Scopely's talented studios.

As Senior Finance Manager, Central & Shared Services Finance, you will lead financial planning, analysis, and reporting across a broad portfolio of Scopely's corporate functions.

You'll serve as a trusted finance partner to senior leaders across the COO, CPO, CRO, CLO, and CFO organizations, supporting a global organization of more than 600 employees and an annual expense budget exceeding $200 million.

A key part of your role will be managing and improving the allocation of more than $160 million in shared services costs across our game teams, ensuring financial transparency, accuracy, and a clear understanding of costs.

Beyond managing existing processes, you'll help build scalable financial tools, improve planning and reporting workflows, and develop a team of two finance professionals.

What You Will Do:

• Lead Central & Shared Services FP&A: Manage financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting across corporate functions, including COO/CPO, Business Development, Corporate Development, IT & Facilities, Legal, and other G&A teams.

• Manage shared-cost allocations: Design, maintain, and continuously improve methodologies for allocating more than $160 million in annual shared services costs across game verticals, balancing accuracy, fairness, and transparency.

• Partner with senior leadership: Serve as a trusted finance partner to functional leaders across the COO, CPO, CRO, CLO, and CFO organizations, providing actionable financial insights and recommendations.

• Collaborate across game teams: Work closely with Game team FP&A partners to ensure shared-cost allocations are clearly understood, consistently applied, and supported by reliable financial data.

• Lead and develop your team: Manage two finance professionals, establish priorities, delegate responsibilities, and support their professional growth and development.

• Improve financial processes: Partner with central FinOps and Accounting to strengthen the accuracy, consistency, and efficiency of financial close, reporting, forecasting, and allocation processes.

• Build scalable tools and automation: Identify opportunities to replace manual workflows with repeatable financial models, reporting tools, and automated processes.

• Drive financial clarity and alignment: Communicate complex financial information clearly, proactively identify risks, and build consensus across stakeholders with competing priorities.

What We're Looking For:

• 6+ years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, consulting, investment banking, or a related field, including some people management experience.

• Experience working within large, complex organizations and managing financial priorities across multiple functions and senior stakeholders.

• Strong financial modeling, planning, forecasting, and analytical skills, with experience improving financial tools, models, or reporting processes.

• Demonstrated ability to develop scalable financial processes and introduce automation that reduces repetitive manual work.

• Proven experience partnering with senior executives, influencing decisions, and building consensus across teams without direct reporting authority.

• Experience managing, coaching, and developing finance professionals.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex financial information into clear, actionable recommendations.

• Strong judgment, proactive stakeholder management, and the ability to balance competing priorities while maintaining financial accuracy and accountability.

Bonus Points

• MBA or equivalent advanced degree.

• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning, Oracle, or similar enterprise financial systems.

• Prior experience supporting Legal, IT, or Corporate Development functions from a finance seat.

• Familiarity with AI tools to accelerate modeling, reporting, or analysis.

• Experience in gaming, tech, or other high-growth industries.

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

jobs.description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals

Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.

Please note that this position is based in either San Diego, CA, or Princeton, NJ. Acadia's hybrid model requires this role to work in our office three days per week on average.

Position Summary

The Executive Director, P&P Technology & Operations will define and deliver the future-state blueprint for how P&P operations, technology, data, automation and self-service work together as Acadia grows.

This leader will simplify processes, expand self-service, automate repeatable work and create an integrated technology and service delivery ecosystem. The role will also establish Acadia’s enterprise People Intelligence capability, turning trusted workforce data into actionable insights for leaders.

The successful candidate will operate as a strategist, architect and hands-on transformation leader, translating the future state into a sequenced roadmap and measurable business, employee and operational outcomes.

Primary Responsibilities

P&P Operating Model & Service Delivery

• Define the future-state P&P operations and service delivery model, including self-service, automation, People Operations, specialist teams, PBPs and cross-functional partners.

• Establish a service catalog, delivery tiers, decision rights, handoffs, standards and escalation pathways.

• Build a multiyear roadmap that balances immediate improvements with longer-term transformation.

Process Simplification, Automation & Employee Experience

• Redesign priority employee-lifecycle processes, eliminating unnecessary steps, approvals, handoffs and manual work before applying technology.

• Build and prioritize a portfolio of workflow, automation and AI opportunities based on employee value, business impact, risk and feasibility.

• Create an intuitive front door for P&P information, transactions and support through effective portal, knowledge, case management and workflow capabilities.

• Use employee and manager feedback to continuously improve service quality, cycle time and experience.

P&P Technology Strategy & Governance

• Own the enterprise P&P technology strategy, architecture and roadmap, including Workday and the broader technology ecosystem.

• Establish product governance for prioritization, investment, design standards, releases, security, testing and adoption.

• Partner with IT, Finance, Legal and other functions to deliver integrated, scalable solutions and evaluate emerging technology based on value, risk, user experience and total cost.

People Intelligence & Workforce Insights

• Establish Acadia’s People Intelligence capability by connecting workforce, talent, organization, engagement, performance, recruiting, learning, compensation and planning data.

• Create a scalable data and analytics strategy with clear architecture, definitions, quality standards, ownership and governance.

• Deliver executive and manager insights on workforce trends, organizational health, talent risks and business performance.

• Advance reporting toward predictive and prescriptive insights, applying AI and advanced analytics where they improve decision quality and speed.

• Partner with Finance, IT and business leaders to connect people insights with enterprise planning and investment decisions.

Transformation Execution & Team Leadership

• Translate strategy into a focused portfolio with clear outcomes, milestones, resources, owners and measures of success.

• Lead implementation, change, adoption, testing, training and stabilization for major operational and technology initiatives.

• Manage portfolio tradeoffs, dependencies, risks and investments with transparent governance.

• Build and lead a high-performing P&P Operations, Technology and People Analytics team, while effectively managing vendors and implementation partners.

Measures of Success

• Greater adoption of intuitive employee and manager self-service.

• Reduced manual work, avoidable case volume, process complexity and administrative burden.

• Faster, more consistent and higher-quality P&P service delivery.

• Trusted People Intelligence that improves workforce decisions and anticipates talent and organizational risks.

• Greater business value from Workday and the broader P&P technology ecosystem.

• A clear, prioritized and effectively governed transformation portfolio that redirects P&P capacity to higher-value work.

Education, Experience & Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

• Significant progressive experience leading P&P operations, HR technology, service delivery, people analytics or enterprise transformation, including multidisciplinary teams.

• Demonstrated success transforming an HR operating model, shared-services capability or enterprise service delivery ecosystem and converting a future-state blueprint into a sequenced roadmap.

• Track record simplifying and automating employee-lifecycle processes and implementing workflow, self-service and AI-enabled solutions.

• Deep experience with Workday and related service delivery, knowledge, case management, integration and workflow technologies.

• Demonstrated success building people analytics or workforce intelligence capabilities that integrate multiple data sources into executive-ready insights and support workforce planning.

• Strong product, portfolio and program leadership, with advanced analytical and business acumen and the ability to build business cases and prioritize investments.

• Ability to influence executives and partner across P&P, IT, Finance, Legal and the business; strong vendor, implementation, change and benefit-realization capabilities.

• Comprehensive knowledge of employment compliance, data privacy, information security and governance. Experience in a fast-paced, growing and highly regulated environment preferred.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, see, talk or hear in a standard office environment and independently from remote locations. Employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Ability to travel by car or airplane independently overnight up to 40% of the time and work after hours if required by travel schedule or business issues.

You'll work closely with hiring managers and senior recruiters, run searches end to end, and help improve how our recruiting team operates as we grow.

This role is a good fit for someone who is organized, proactive, and comfortable owning their work. You should enjoy learning a new business quickly, work well with autonomy, and care about giving every candidate a thoughtful experience.

What you'll do

• Own full-cycle recruiting for Account Executive, Sales Development, Relationship Manager, and Account Development roles, from sourcing to close

• Run kickoffs and calibration sessions with hiring managers to define what a strong candidate looks like, and adjust the search as you learn

• Identify and engage strong candidates through sourcing and inbound channels, using funnel data to decide where to spend your time

• Communicate clearly and consistently with stakeholders on pipeline health, progress, blockers, and recruiting timeline

• Represent Mercury to candidates, sharing our mission, culture, and what it's like to join a growing sales organization

• Spot opportunities to improve recruiting processes, tools, and documentation, and share them with the team

• Manage offers and closing for your searches

What you'll need

• 2+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including at least 1 year in-house, ideally with sales roles such as account executives, SDRs, or account management

• Strong organization and attention to detail, with experience managing several searches at once, including at least one high-volume role

• Strong sourcing skills and ability to write compelling outreach

• Ability to work with recruiting data, such as pass-through rates and time to hire, to track your searches and spot where they're getting stuck

• Experience building strong relationships with hiring managers, including giving clear feedback and pushing back when needed

• Experience independently managing searches end to end, and knowing when to ask for help

• Comfort with some ambiguity, and a habit of seeking out feedback and applying it

Nice to have

• Experience recruiting at a fintech, SaaS, or high-growth startup

• Familiarity with Greenhouse, Gem, or similar recruiting tools

jobs.title: Staff Accountant
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is building the connected AI workspace where teams and agents think together, bringing knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools into one place. Joining Corporate Accounting means helping build the financial foundation for a business shaping how work gets done in the AI era.

In this role you’ll be a key player on the Corporate Accounting team, working across global accounting areas with a focus on close activities, related reconciliations, and international statutory reporting. You’ll collaborate with teammates to strengthen the accounting processes that support Notion’s growth into new countries. At Notion, you’ll help build the repeatable operating practices that let a growing global business scale with confidence.

This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Be a key team player across monthly, quarterly, and annual close: Prepare accurate journal entries and adjustments with clear supporting documentation; support AP and cash reconciliations, including flux analysis and commentary; and complete close work on time.

 - Help establish reliable, repeatable global accounting processes as Notion expands into new countries.

 - By your 90th day, contribute meaningfully to close activities and take ownership of clearly defined global reconciliation work.

 - By your 90th day, organize and track open items, requests, and timelines across international statutory audits, coordinating with Tax and cross-functional partners.

 - By your 90th day, use Claude thoughtfully to improve reconciliation analysis, audit support, documentation, or quality checks—while applying appropriate data safeguards.

 - By the end of your first year, become a trusted partner, strengthen controls and accounting processes across your areas, supporting accurate financial statements and statutory filings.

 - By the end of your first year, raise the bar on documentation and process quality so recurring work is easier to execute, review, and build on.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Working knowledge of core corporate accounting processes, including close activities, AP, and cash reconciliations; this is central to the role’s day-to-day work.

 - Foundational knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accrual accounting, with some familiarity with IFRS.

 - Experience in public accounting or audit, or in corporate accounting; candidates early in their careers, including new graduates with relevant experience, are welcome.

 - Ability to organize and track work across multiple international statutory audits with accuracy, clear follow-through, and attention to deadlines.

 - Curiosity to learn country-specific requirements as Notion expands.

 - Familiarity with NetSuite, Oracle, or a similar ERP is a plus; experience with BlackLine, tax, or close management is also helpful.

 - Demonstrated ability to build cross-functional partnerships and communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, including explaining fluctuations and their business drivers.

 - Ownership, sound judgment, and a continuous-improvement mindset: you look for ways to make the work more accurate, scalable, and easier for others to build on.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $105,000 - $125,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Physician - Family Medicine - Sign-On Bonus Available, 4 days in clinic, 1 day remote
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

Employment type:

• Full time

What you’ll be working on:

• Managing a patient panel with a broad array of patient needs; conducting a mix of acute, chronic, and well visits

• Treating patients in-office or in testing centers as well as conducting occasional tele-health visits

• Continuous learning during weekly Clinical Rounds and through other modalities

• Ongoing collaboration with in-office teammates via daily huddles, as well as with virtual clinical teams

• Utilization of your specific clinical training and opportunities to perform in-office procedures

• Supervising one or more NP or PA colleagues

• Willing to obtain additional state licensure and credentialing for One Medical virtual primary care in additional states

Education, licenses, and experiences required for this role:

• Enrolled in, or have completed, an accredited Family Medicine or Medicine/Pediatrics residency program

• Practiced at least 2 of the last 5 years in an outpatient primary care setting seeing all ages (0+)

• Board certified in Family Medicine or Medicine/Pediatrics, or Board Eligible with plans to obtain board certification within 1 year of your One Medical start date

• State licensed in Arizona, obtained before your One Medical start date

One Medical providers also demonstrate:

• A passion for human-centered primary care

• The ability to successfully communicate with and provide care to individuals of all backgrounds

• The ability to effectively use technology to deliver high quality care

• Clinical proficiency in evidence-based primary care

• The desire to be an integral part of a team dedicated to changing healthcare delivery

• An openness to feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into strengths and weaknesses

• The ability to confidently navigate uncertain situations with both patients and colleagues

• Readiness to adapt personal and interpersonal behavior to meet the needs of our patients

This is a full-time role based in Mesa, AZ at our Dana Park Office!

The base salary range for this role is $238,600 to $285,300 on a full-time schedule. Final determination of starting pay may vary based on factors such as practice experience and patient care schedule. Additional pay may be determined for those candidates that exceed these specified qualifications and requirements. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

Business & Data Analysis / Reporting

•      Develop processes to efficiently manage, monitor, and track project deliverables, performing data analysis independently or with cross-functional teams

•      Prepare materials in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint for presentations within and outside the PI team

Broader PI Project & Stakeholder Support

•      Support company-wide system implementation and process improvement projects by evaluating current workflows and executing improvement strategies

•      Manage relationships and expectations of internal and external stakeholders on assigned projects

•      Provide ad-hoc support across other PI team projects, leveraging seniority to take on responsibilities beyond IT expense and N-IRP ownership alone

•      Approximately 4-5 years of experience in business management support, IT expense/vendor management, resource or contract management, data analysis/reporting, or project management

•      Excellent written, verbal, and public-speaking skills, able to communicate project objectives and outcomes — particularly around sales, operations, logistics, systems, and financial functions — to all levels of the organization

•      Organized, detail-oriented, and analytically strong, with a genuine eagerness to learn, grow, take on new challenges, and help others do the same

jobs.title: Relationship Manager (Houston, TX)
jobs.description:
Why Work at Mercer Advisors?

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. jobs.title: Executive Director, Automation Operations
jobs.description:
Eikon Therapeutics is a new biopharmaceutical company employing revolutionary technology at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, computation, and biology to discover novel treatments for life-threatening diseases. Eikon’s discovery platform is built on groundbreaking innovations from its founders (Nobel Prize, 2014), culminating in the creation of microscopes which enable real time, molecular-resolution measurements of protein movement in living cells, thereby unlocking otherwise intractable classes of proteins as drug targets.

Position

As Vice President of Automation Operations, you will lead the organization that builds, operates, and advances Eikon’s integrated discovery platform. You will have responsibility for three teams: Automation Engineering, which develops and deploys the robotic systems that execute Eikon’s high-throughput workflows; Service, which keeps the automated systems running through monitoring, maintenance, and rapid response; and Compound Management, which stewards Eikon’s compound collection and reliably delivers compounds and other research materials to screening and follow-up workflows.

You will sit at the interface between Research and Engineering. Your central mandate is translation: deeply understanding what our scientists are trying to accomplish, and converting those needs into clear, actionable requirements that hardware, software, automation, and systems engineers can build against. Equally important is vision: hearing what scientists ask for today, recognizing the larger need behind the request, and proposing scalable platform solutions that anticipate where the science is going before the scientists have articulated it. A near-term mandate is operationalization: moving validated, scientist-developed assay workflows onto the automated platform as production services, with guaranteed turnaround, equivalent or better data quality, and full sample and data traceability. You will own the phased transition plans that build capability and trust over time, and you will be accountable for demonstrating that the promised efficiency gains are realized.

The platform you will oversee includes integrated systems of liquid handlers (Bravo, Tecan, Hamilton), robotic arms (PF400), automated microscopes (custom in-house imagers, IXMs, etc.), plate readers, incubators, dispensers, Echo acoustic liquid transfer systems, scheduling software, automated compound storage and retrieval systems, and in-house laboratory data systems. These systems operate primarily at Eikon’s Millbrae, California headquarters, with a smaller automation footprint at its New York City site; this role is accountable for automation operations across both. You will be joining a multidisciplinary organization where the integrated platform is central to the science. This position provides the opportunity to shape the strategy of Eikon’s discovery platform, expand the capabilities of our laboratories, and directly influence the speed and quality of drug discovery.

About You

You are equally at home in science and engineering. You have enough scientific depth to engage with biologists and chemists on the substance of their experiments, and enough engineering fluency to specify, challenge, and guide the design of the systems that will run them. You are the person scientists trust to understand what they mean, and the person engineers trust to tell them precisely what to build. You are a platform builder. You have stood up laboratory platforms at biotechnology companies before, and you know the difference between automating a workflow and building a platform: the former solves today’s problem, the latter creates capacity for problems no one has posed yet. You think in terms of architecture, scalability, and operational leverage, and you design systems that outlast their first use case. You are an experienced leader of leaders. You build strong teams, develop managers and senior leaders, set clear priorities across groups with distinct missions, and create an environment of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. You communicate with equal credibility to bench scientists, engineers, vendors, and executive leadership.

What You’ll Do

• Lead, develop, and grow the Platform Integration organization, comprising the Lab Automation, Service, and Compound Management teams, including their managers and technical leads.

• Define and execute a multi-year platform roadmap aligned with Eikon’s scientific strategy, balancing current operational demands against future capability building.

• Partner closely with Research leadership and bench scientists to understand experimental needs, and translate them into requirements that hardware, software, automation, and systems engineers can execute against.

• Propose forward-looking, scalable platform solutions that go beyond the immediate request, anticipating scientific needs before they are articulated.

• Oversee the design, integration, qualification, deployment, and lifecycle management of automated laboratory systems, from liquid handling and robotics to scheduling and orchestration software.

• Ensure platform reliability through the Service team: monitoring, preventive and predictive maintenance, incident response, escalation, root-cause investigation, and corrective action.

• Own the transition of validated assays from Research into automated production operation through phased plans that first demonstrate equivalence, then scale capacity and scope, without disrupting ongoing science.

• Define and meet service-level agreements for operationalized workflows, including guaranteed data turnaround, assay performance equivalence, and complete data traceability, and serve as the accountable scorekeeper for the efficiency gains automation is expected to deliver.

• Oversee Compound Management through its Senior Director, ensuring accurate, timely, and quality-controlled compound registration, storage, tracking, and delivery across Eikon’s sites to screening and follow-up workflows.

• Establish and monitor operational metrics across the platform, such as system uptime, throughput, turnaround time, failure frequency, and mean time to recovery, and use them to drive investment and improvement decisions.

• Set engineering and operational standards for system architecture, equipment integration, software interfaces, error handling, documentation, and acceptance.

• Partner with software and IT teams to integrate platform systems with scheduling, LIMS, inventory, and analytical data pipelines.

• Manage relationships with equipment manufacturers, integrators, and service providers, including service agreements, escalation paths, and vendor performance.

• Develop budgets, capacity models, resource plans, and risk assessments for platform operations and capital investments.

• Evaluate emerging technologies in automation, imaging, and compound management, and recommend investments that expand scientific capability or operational efficiency.

• Communicate platform strategy, operational performance, technical risks, and resource needs to scientific and executive leadership.

• Foster a culture of safety, scientific rigor, accountability, documentation, and continuous improvement across all three teams.

Qualifications

• Postgraduate degree with 15 years of experience, or Bachelor’s degree with 18 years of experience in in laboratory automation, scientific instrumentation, or platform engineering in the life sciences.

• 5+ years leading multidisciplinary technical teams and managing managers, including director-level leaders.

• A demonstrated track record of standing up laboratory platforms at biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or life-science companies, from initial concept through scaled production operation.

• Deep working knowledge of both experimental science and engineering practice, with a demonstrated ability to translate scientific needs into engineering requirements and to represent engineering constraints back to scientists.

• Experience owning laboratory operations at scale, including system reliability, service and maintenance programs, and operational metrics.

• Experience transitioning manual, scientist-run workflows into automated production services, including phased rollout, SLA definition, and stakeholder management across research and engineering.

• Experience with integrated laboratory automation systems, including liquid handlers, robotic arms, plate readers, automated imaging systems, and scheduling or orchestration software.

• Familiarity with compound management operations, including compound registration, automated storage and retrieval, plate production, sample tracking, inventory systems, and quality control across diverse modalities (e.g., small molecules, biologics, peptides, and nucleic acids).

• Strong strategic planning and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance production support against long-horizon platform investments.

• Experience managing budgets, capital equipment planning, and vendor relationships.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with credibility across bench scientists, engineers, and executive leadership.

• Ability to support operations across multiple sites, including periodic travel to Eikon’s New York City laboratory.

• Experience in high-throughput drug discovery, including screening operations and hit-to-lead workflows preferred.

• Familiarity with laboratory informatics, including LIMS, ELN, compound registration databases, scheduling software, inventory systems, and instrument-data pipelines preferred.

• Experience scaling platform organizations through periods of rapid company growth preferred.

• Experience with advanced or automated microscopy, quantitative imaging, or optical instrumentation preferred.

• Experience supporting laboratories operating extended hours or continuously preferred.

At Eikon, employee compensation also includes bonus and equity compensation, in addition to several generous benefit programs, including:​

• 401k plan with company matching​

• Daily subsidized lunch program when on-site​
