Your primary metrics of success will be AI product adoption, AI-specific Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and AI customer referenceability.

Location: Remote with up to 25% Regional Travel

AI Adoption & Enablement

• AI Coaching: Deliver human enablement, teaching users best practices for AI value realization, including workflow configuration and effective prompt engineering.
• Data Contextualization: Assist clients in configuring the AI to properly reflect their specific industry, data schemas, and domain terminology.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Product Feedback: Act as the voice of the customer, capturing user friction points to directly influence the product roadmap.
• Technical Escalations: Partner with Solutions Engineers and Support to quickly resolve complex technical issues or data anomalies.
• Playbook Development: Document successful implementation patterns to scale best practices across the CS organization.

New Product Launch and Customer Onboarding

• Customer Onboarding: Monitor PS-led implementation projects for AI-powered products across the region as go-live milestones approach. Support CSMs and customers through technical onboarding processes to minimize friction points at this critical stage.
• Customer Enablement: Post Go-Live, design and deliver end-user training, tactical playbooks, customer office hours, and workflow integration sessions for regional CS teams and end-users.
• Phase Handoff to CS: Consume handoff briefs to understand customer nuances, edge cases, and field reality before taking operational ownership.
• Early Escalation: Identify and escalate launches falling below baseline metrics to prevent sustained adoption failure.

Sustained AI Operations

• Monitor Adoption Metrics: Develop deep expertise in available AI product metrics. Work with Agent Ops if the customer, the CSM and/or the Agent Ops team identifies issues with agent behavior.
• Ongoing Relationship & Usage Health: Partner with Regional Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to maintain continuous usage and relationship health across established enterprise accounts.
• In-Product & Operational Enablement: Continuously provide end-user guidance, tips, and workflow optimization to ensure long-term retention.
• Field Signal Feedback: Capture ongoing customer feedback and usage signals, feeding them back to Product Operations and Engr to continuously improve the core platform.

Strategic Value Attribution - Capacity Reallocation & Organizational Change

• Capacity Reinvestment Coaching: Partner with customer executive sponsors and operational leaders to track capacity freed by AI agents (e.g., 10,000+ hours annually across buying and AP teams) and establish structured workflows for reinvesting time into strategic projects.
• Behavioral & Process Mindset Shift: Guide customer teams away from manual, reactive tasks (e.g., chasing past-due POs, re-keying ERP data, manual quote entry) toward proactive, exception-based decision making and strategic supplier/customer management.

Adoption Rescue Playbook

• Ownership: Lead the recovery strategy when adoption drops driven by enablement challenges like low AI trust or training gaps.
• Identify Root Causes: Work with Product and Engineering to analyze user feedback, performance scores, and usage data to figure out why adoption dropped.
• Execution & Measurement: Roll out tailored training, workflow updates, and change management initiatives, measuring success at the 30-day checkpoint.

Technical & Analytical Skills

• Manufacturing & Operational Domain Acumen: Solid understanding of strategic sourcing, Sales Ops, supply chain risk management, inventory optimization, and shop-floor/back-office productivity levers.
• AI Literacy: Solid understanding of artificial intelligence concepts, large language models (LLMs), or data analytics infrastructure.
• Data Fluency: Ability to interpret data trends, run basic data queries (e.g., SQL, Excel), and build clear reporting frameworks.
• Product Adaptation: Highly capable of mastering a rapidly evolving, technical product ecosystem.
• Knowledge of CRM Software & CS Platform

Soft Skills & Core Competencies

• Communication: Exceptional presentation skills to translate dense technical AI processes into clear business value.
• Ambiguity Management: High adaptability to navigate shifting requirements in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.
• Relationship Building: Natural ability to build deep customer trust and diffuse escalations empathetically.

Experience & Education

• Professional History: 5+ years in customer-facing or operational roles (e.g., Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Management Consulting, or Operations), ideally within manufacturing, supply chain, or enterprise SaaS environments.
• Domain Exposure: Practical experience with manufacturing/supply chain workflows (e.g., sourcing, AP/procurement, inventory management, Sales Ops) alongside exposure to enterprise AI/ML platforms, developer tools, or business process automation.
• Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Availability and Travel:

Flexible hours that may vary day to day, based on customer needs and milestones.

jobs.title: Configuration Manager
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking a Configuration Manager.  The Configuration Manager is responsible for configuration management and change control activities.  As a Configuration Manager, you will work closely with the leaders of critical Anduril programs to manage a highly dynamic and fast-paced design, engineering, and manufacturing environment. The Configuration Manager will be the focal point for capturing and defining the baseline for a program’s requirements, design, testing, manufacturing, and sustainment data structures (requirements baseline, EBOM, MBOM, SOM, BOP).

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Be an integral partner to Anduril’s Product and Program Teams by:

• Executing configuration management activities based on the configuration management plan defined for the program.

• Ensuring that supported programs have robust and comprehensive configuration identification processes and documentation.

• Managing the end-to-end configuration control process including engineering release, facilitating critical configuration control forums such as CCB and CRB.

• Working with Configuration Management Analysts to build and maintain configuration status accounting dashboards ensure that critical data is captured, recorded and distributed (decisions recorded, ECRs and ECNs populated, implementation checklists written etc.)

• Coordinating and leading configuration audits (functional configuration audits, physical configuration audits etc.)

• Own end-to-end change management for key programs:

• Ensuring that all engineering change requests are appropriately documented, reviewed, approved, and communicated in a timely manner.

• Setting agendas for configuration management meetings (Technical Review Board, Change Control Board etc.) ahead of time.

• Generating, populating, and submitting change requests including manage compilation and synthesis of impact analyses.

• Be responsible for product configuration by:

• Analyzing product baselines (EBOM, MBOMs etc.) in Teamcenter for compliance to industry and organization standards.

• Supporting configuration management reviews and audits, including FCA/PCA and provide direction before, during and after the events to prevent or resolve issues.

• Performing periodic audits of as-built records as product definition data in Teamcenter (EBOM, MBOM etc.)

• Be the expert resource for the Product for Engineering Release and Change Management standards by:

• Modeling the use of Teamcenter software to manage Engineering changes, including part revisions, EBOM/MBOM/SBOM updates, documentation modifications, and associated workflows.

• Providing guidance and support to Engineering teams in configuring the Engineering, Manufacturing and Service Bills of Materials (EBOM, MBOM, SBOM).

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of proven direct product configuration management experience (Product structure, parts, drawings and requirements management).

• 5+ years of demonstrated experience working in high complexity and high-rate production environments (aerospace, automotive, security systems, medical devices, nuclear).

• Familiar with configuration management principles and practices (EIA649/C, MIL-HDBK-61B).

• Experience with product lifecycle management (PLM) and/or data management toolsets for configuration management of complex products

• Possess high attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills – you must have an ability to synthesize complex quantitative data into clear decision statements.

• BA/BS in an engineering discipline (Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Nuclear, Manufacturing)

• Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to our inclusive culture.

• Is able to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Proven experience in aerospace industry

• Proficient in technical writing of processes and procedures

• Experience with Teamcenter, Teamcenter Requirements, Teamcenter Quality, Confluence & JIRA.

• Database skills with SQL queries, etc.

• Certification in CM2 or equivalent configuration management certification.

US Salary Range

$147,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Customer Support Agent - (Bench Team)
jobs.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Customer Support Agent with English fluency to join our Bench Team. In this individual-contributor role, you’ll provide fast, accurate, and personalized support to customers through research, investigation, troubleshooting, and effective resolution.

You’ll work within a fast-paced, structured support environment where clear communication, critical thinking, and consistent performance are essential. Your goal will be to resolve customer needs efficiently while meeting client expectations for service, quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction.

What You'll Do

• Deliver high-quality customer service by following established departmental policies, processes, and support standards.

• Manage and respond to customer-support tickets within established service-level agreements, client standards, and performance guidelines.

• Focus on accurate and efficient first-contact resolution whenever possible.

• Follow established troubleshooting procedures and use approved resources, knowledge documentation, and desktop tools to diagnose and resolve customer issues.

• Work across multiple tools, systems, knowledge bases, and communication channels while applying available information to individual customer situations.

• Assist with creating and updating knowledge-base articles.

• Contribute to team development through active collaboration, knowledge sharing, and issue resolution.

• Coordinate with internal teams to provide feedback, identify trends, report recurring concerns, and resolve customer issues.

• Research and resolve escalated issues within the approved scope of the role.

• Serve as a point of escalation for customer inquiries when assigned.

• Monitor client-facing communication tools, including Mattermost, and remain current on client updates and directives.

• Respond to customer requests escalated by Tier 2 agents and address customer needs, complaints, and account-related concerns.

• Use critical thinking and sound judgment to determine appropriate next steps and support positive outcomes for the client and customer.

• Support managers with onboarding new and existing agents into the Escalated Accounts workflow when assigned.

• Demonstrate Blueprint’s values through daily interactions with customers, clients, and colleagues.

• Provide support across additional ticket queues based on business needs.

• Support additional customer-experience initiatives and projects as assigned.

What You'll Bring

• At least one year of customer-service experience or equivalent relevant experience.

• Associate degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• Written fluency in English.

• Strong written communication skills and the ability to provide clear, accurate, and professional customer responses.

• Experience using computers and working across multiple systems and support tools.

• Ability to perform initial troubleshooting of common computer and network issues.

• Ability to remain composed and professional when handling stressful or complex customer situations.

• Strong customer focus and a genuine interest in helping people resolve problems.

• Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and customer-service skills.

• Strong attention to detail and time-management skills.

• Ability to meet deadlines, client productivity standards, and service expectations.

• Strong critical-thinking, research, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to receive, apply, and grow from constructive feedback.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office or related productivity software.

• Ability to work independently, use sound judgment, and seek guidance when appropriate.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree.

• Knowledge of or interest in online gaming.

• Experience working with account-related support tickets.

• Ability to troubleshoot account-related ticket issues independently and collaboratively.

• Experience working with ticketing systems or customer-support platforms.

Schedule and Work Requirements

This role may require scheduled coverage during weekends and holidays based on business and customer-support needs.

Work schedules may change based on operational requirements.

Time-off availability may be limited during peak business periods to maintain appropriate customer coverage.

Compensation

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.

For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated compensation range is $23.00 to $25.50 USD per hour. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final compensation and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications.

Location and Work Arrangement

Bellevue, Washington

This is a hybrid role that generally requires two days per week in the Bellevue office, with additional flexibility based on Blueprint’s work-from-home policy and business needs.

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• 401(k) retirement plan

• Competitive paid time off

• Parental leave

• Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicant Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@bpcs.com.

jobs.title: Manager, Engineering, Dev AI
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Difference You Will Make:

Our mission is to make every Airbnb engineer's day better by building world-class developer infrastructure that removes friction and provides the tools to unlock their best work. The Dev AI team specifically builds the foundational AI tooling and infrastructure that powers developer productivity across the entire software development lifecycle, also providing the building blocks for teams across the company to quickly and simply create their own domain-specific AI tools. We currently serve as both a platform team and an internal AI consultancy for partner teams building their own internally-facing AI-powered solutions.

In this role, you will help to shape and execute the technical direction of the team's infrastructure and products. You'll work across a range of exciting problem spaces, from agentic coding tools and asynchronous AI workflow platforms, to SDKs for rapid internal AI app development and AI-assisted code migration. At Airbnb, you won't just build AI tools; your work will shape how individuals across the company work every day. The tools you create will directly accelerate the pace of innovation across our entire product surface.

We're a collaborative, low-ego, and highly-visible team that values experimentation, learning, and shipping. We celebrate what works and learn quickly from what doesn't. Given the rapid evolution of AI, we strive to operate with startup-like agility, iterating swiftly to evaluate and incorporate the most recent AI technologies into our developer tooling. If you enjoy building, collaborating across teams, thrive when given high autonomy, and are motivated to make the lives of other developers easier and more enjoyable, we’d love to hear from you.

A Typical Day:

• Help shape and drive our AI for Developers strategy, partnering with Staff and Sr. Staff engineers to assist them in aligning architecture trade-offs and product direction

• Stay current on the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape, and help the team balance innovation with incremental, measurable developer impact

• Serve as a champion, expert, coach, and consultant to empower teams and leaders across the company to adopt and leverage new AI capabilities in their day to day workflows

• Foster relationships with partner teams and stakeholders, as well as crafting working agreements

• Coach and mentor the team with empathy to do their best work while growing in their roles & responsibilities

• Contribute to the broader organization’s culture and processes (with a “first team” mentality)

Your Expertise:

• 2+ years of experience as a full-time manager

• Experience supporting and coaching Staff+ (ideally multiple) and Senior engineers

• Experience managing a remote/distributed team

• Prior experience building developer infrastructure, tooling, or platforms, ideally at scale and with tools, frameworks, or systems commonly used in the industry

• Experience applying AI technologies to real-world software development challenges

• A track record of quickly ramping up in new domains, technologies, or languages — and a genuine excitement for continuous learning

• Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally, with excellent written and verbal communication skills

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$212,000—$265,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Network Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.



If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.





*Note: This position requires presence in our Bellevue or San Francisco office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.



Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.



Every customer workload on Lambda depends on the network, from a single-GPU experiment to a training run spanning thousands of GPUs. When an optic degrades, a link flaps or a switch fails, customers feel it as stalled jobs, restarts and lost compute time. We will operate the existing network flawlessly for all customer workloads while we reinvent how failures are found and fixed, and the automation underneath all of it.



Lambda has 10x'd over the last three years, and the network engineering organization is scaling to match. We're looking for a Senior Director of Network Reliability Engineering to own the health of that network end to end: the break-fix operations that restore service today, and the software that detects, isolates and repairs failures automatically so that most never reach a human or a customer.



You'll lead an organization spanning network SRE and automation engineering, incident management, and break-fix coordination with our data center teams. We're looking for an experienced leader of leaders who treats every repeated failure as a software problem, measures reliability and builds toward a self-healing network where detection, diagnosis and remediation run as automated closed loops. You'll hire and grow a talented team of software and network proficient engineers, shape team culture, and partner with technical leadership to keep reliability ahead of our scale ambitions.



This role will report to the VP of Cloud and AI Networking, working alongside a highly capable and passionate team of engineers. If you'd like to join a great team of customer obsessed engineers building the world's best AI cloud, come join us.


What You'll Do

 - Own the reliability of Lambda's network end to end, from GPU compute fabrics to data center, backbone and edge, and be accountable for availability, time to detect and time to restore

 - Run break-fix operations at scale: fault detection, triage, hardware replacement and RMA, optics and cabling remediation, and coordination with Data Center Operations and remote-hands partners across a growing fleet of data centers

 - Lead the networking ops excellence and incident management program, including on-call, incident command, escalation paths, customer communication and blameless postmortems that turn into engineering fixes

 - Set the multi-year strategy for a self-healing network: automated loops that detect and isolate failing components, shift traffic, drain and restore capacity, and open repair work without human intervention

 - Convert manual break-fix work into durable software. The goal is a network that repairs itself, not a faster set of runbooks. Measure toil, set targets to reduce it, and track the share of failures resolved automatically as a primary outcome for your org

 - Define network SLOs and error budgets with product and customer-facing teams, and use them to prioritize reliability work against feature and capacity work

 - Build automation that is safe to trust, with blast-radius limits, staged rollouts, audit trails and rollback for every automated action, including AI-assisted triage and remediation

 - Own the operational bar for your org: how incidents are detected, handled, reviewed, measured and learned from

 - Build and lead the organization that delivers it: hire, develop and retain engineers and the leaders who manage them, and design the team structure as the network and the org grow

 - Manage through leads and senior ICs, developing both, with regular 1:1s, clear performance feedback, growth planning, and sponsorship of meaningful work

 - Partner with Network Engineering, Network Capacity Automation, Software and Principal Engineers so reliability requirements are designed in from the start and failure data informs architecture, hardware and vendor decisions

 - Partner with Data Center Operations, Supply Chain and vendors on spares strategy, RMA turnaround and hardware failure trends

 - Represent your org's work, reliability metrics and technical direction to senior leadership, and to enterprise customers and partners during major incidents and reviews

 - Contribute to org-wide engineering process improvements: how we plan, how we ship, how we learn from incidents



You

 - Have 8+ years of engineering management experience, including managing managers and directly managing senior individual contributors

 - Proven track record of leading SRE, network reliability or production operations organizations for large-scale cloud or data center networks with 24x7 availability requirements

 - Have a network or software engineering background. You've shipped production systems and can engage credibly on architecture, technical tradeoffs, and code quality

 - Have measurably reduced toil and incident impact through automation, and can show the data, such as lower time to restore or a higher share of incidents remediated automatically

 - Familiarity designing, building, scaling and operating large-scale networks, including routing (BGP), leaf-spine fabrics, optics and hardware failure modes, and network telemetry and monitoring

 - Experience building closed-loop or event-driven remediation systems, and the safety controls that keep automation from causing incidents

 - Have run incident management at scale: incident command, a blameless postmortem culture, and turning lessons into engineering work that ships

 - Foster a data driven, automation first, high velocity organization

 - Have a track record of building high-performing teams in fast-moving, technically demanding environments

 - Are skilled at translating ambiguous business and product goals into clear team priorities and executable engineering plans

 - Show strong judgment about when to go deep technically, when to delegate, and when to escalate

 - Stay calm and decisive during major incidents, and communicate clearly with customers and executives while one is in progress

 - Excellent communicator both written and verbal. You use high quality written artifacts to inform high quality decision making and get approval on problems and solution opportunities



Nice to Have

 - Experience in GPU cloud, HPC, or AI/ML infrastructure environments

 - Experience operating InfiniBand or RoCE fabrics at scale, and understanding how network faults affect distributed training jobs

 - Experience applying ML or LLM-based tooling to operations, such as anomaly detection, alert correlation, automated triage or root-cause analysis

 - Experience with streaming network telemetry at scale (gNMI, OpenConfig or similar)
   

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.




About Lambda

 - Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast

 - Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove

 - We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG

 - Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers

 - We offer generous cash & equity compensation

 - Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

 - Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles

 - 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)

 - Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to join our rapidly growing Air Dominance and Strike team in Costa Mesa, CA. In this role, your primary focus will be full-lifecycle PCB design from concept and schematic capture through board bring-up, test, and debug. In this role you'll also be supporting subsystem cable harnessing, hardware integration, and flight-test operations. If you are a hands-on electrical generalist who thrives in a fast-paced environment supporting new developments, active deployments, and mission-critical flight hardware, we are looking for you.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Full cycle PCB design (primary day-to-day focus) including collecting requirements, schematic design, component selection, supervision or completion of layout, bring-up, test, debug, and system integration

• Conduct bring-up and design work on microcontrollers and microprocessors, ensuring seamless integration within the system

• Perform power design, including the development, simulation, and integration of discrete power supplies, DC-DC converters, and power management systems

• Troubleshoot issues that span electrical and software boundaries, utilizing lab equipment (Oscilloscopes, DMM, logic/spectrum analyzers, electronic loads) and basic software/firmware debugging tools

• Work in a fast-paced environment supporting new developments, deployments, and customer operated flight hardware

• Develop payloads and subsystems (sensors, payload interfaces, power management, and networking)

• Create system interconnect diagrams and define wire harnesses and pinouts that connect electronic equipment within a subsystem

• Support environmental qualification (vibration, thermal) and flight-test operations

• Collaborate closely with other electrical, mechanical, software, firmware, and test engineers to deliver fully functional, mission-critical products

• Conduct peer-level and cross-discipline design reviews

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with 5+ years of experience designing, testing, and troubleshooting complex system designs

• Active, hands-on PCB design experience within the last 5 years (schematic capture, layout execution/supervision, and physical board bring-up in the lab)

• Experience with modern ECAD/EDA design tools (Altium Designer preferred, but open to Cadence Allegro/OrCAD, Mentor Graphics, etc.)

• Solid foundation in power system design, power loading analysis, and power management systems (DC-DC conversion, transient protection, and power distribution)

• High competence using lab test equipment (benchtop power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscopes, DMM, logic/spectrum analyzers, etc.) and basic board-level rework/soldering tools

• Hands-on experience with microcontrollers and digital interfaces (CAN, I2C, SPI, Ethernet, RS232/422, RS485, USB)

• Knowledge of modern analog and digital electronics, mixed-signal board design, grounding topologies, and filtering/EMI mitigation

• Understanding of low-voltage and high-voltage power electronics and control systems to drive cable harness designs and connector selections

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. security clearance

• Exceptional organization and communication skills (both written and oral)

• Open to candidates from fast-paced, high-reliability adjacent industries (Electric Vehicles / Automotive, Medical Devices, Autonomous Systems, or complex Consumer Electronics)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Specialized background in discrete power supply design (high-efficiency topologies, switching regulators, battery management systems)

• Background in defense, missile systems, hypersonics, or aerospace avionics

• Comprehensive understanding of the effects of temperature, shock, and vibration on electrical packaging and designs

• Ability to develop basic low-level firmware or test scripts (C, Python) for hardware bring-up and peripheral validation

US Salary Range

$161,000—$212,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Growth Finance Manager
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.




THE ROLE

Growth Finance owns the economics of how Hadrian wins work. We sit at the front end of every program — pricing the pursuit, shaping the deal, and structuring the partnerships and joint ventures that get new capacity off the ground with our commercial and government customers. The Associate is the analytical center of that work. You'll build the model behind a pursuit from a blank sheet: unit economics, capacity and capex requirements, rate and margin structure, and the returns case that determines whether we bid, at what price, and on what terms. You'll pressure-test your own assumptions before anyone else gets the chance, and you'll be expected to have a view — not just a spreadsheet — on whether a program is worth pursuing.

Beyond the model, you'll help structure the vehicles. That means partnership and JV economics, term sheets, waterfall and downside mechanics, and the diligence behind counterparties we're considering taking risk with. You'll write the memo that goes to leadership, and you'll defend it in the room.

This is a small team with a short path to owning deals outright. The work available to you scales with what you demonstrate rather than with tenure. You will work directly with the executive leadership team at Hadrian on some of the company’s most important strategic initiatives. 

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Drive strategic project work spanning transactions, capital markets activities, market research, new business model evaluations, and other business critical initiatives

 - Develop and own dynamic financial models and analyses

 - Create and present high-quality Exec and Board-facing presentations

 - Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Legal to ensure to ensure alignment on financial goals and performance

 - Serve as a partner to FP&A, aligning Special Projects and M&A models with broader corporate financial and business reporting activities

 - Build complex financial models from a blank page, including cash flow forecasting and scenario analysis

 - Carry ambiguous, cross-functional work all the way to a decision without being managed to it

 - Compress a complex analysis into a recommendation a senior leader can act on immediately

 - Manage several concurrent work streams without letting any of them slip


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or related field

 - 5-8 years in progressive Investment Banking, Private Equity, Corporate Development,  Venture Capital, Hedge Fund experience

 - Familiarity with A&D and advanced-manufacturing markets and the players in them. 

 - Prior PE, banking, corp dev, or VC experience, ideally in industrials, defense, or deep tech, or experience working inside a scaling manufacturing or hardware-focused company. 

 - Technical experience in an engineering capacity working on complex products such as aerospace & defense, medical devices, automotive, oil & gas, power

 - Exposure to project finance and large-scale capital investment analysis (facility buildouts, infrastructure, capex-heavy programs). 

 - Experience drafting materials in deal negotiations (e.g., commercial contracts, term sheets, partnership proposals) with high attention to detail. 

 - Working knowledge of defense contracting and government cost accounting (FAR, CAS, DCAA, contract types) and how they shape deal economics. 

 - Enough understanding of advanced manufacturing technology (e.g., CNC, additive) to evaluate technical targets. 

 - Intermediate accounting knowledge and comfort building lightweight tooling/automation (e.g., VBA, Python, SQL) to scale analytical work. 

 - A network in the defense / space / manufacturing investor and operator ecosystem. 

 - Working knowledge of government contracting processes


WHAT WILL SET YOU APART

 - Experience in Manufacturing, Systems, Automation, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or Industrial Engineering. (Extensive practical technical experience may be considered in lieu of minimum amount of finance experience)

 - Are self-motivated and eager to get hands-on to tackle challenges independently while working collaboratively toward identified objectives

 - Feel passionate about companies that make physical products

 - Are excited to work in a fast-paced environment with high-stakes and quick iteration cycles

 - Are a highly effective communicator when speaking or writing, especially when presenting technical information


COMPENSATION

For this role, the target salary range is $164,000 - $230,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.




BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

 


HADRIAN IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.

jobs.title: Senior Patent Agent
jobs.description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life. 


About the Role
E-Space designs and manufactures low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites for 5G communications, associated ground-based Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and radar systems for space-based and ground-based applications. 
We are seeking a Senior Patent Agent to take substantial ownership of patent preparation and prosecution across these technologies. Working directly with Lead IP Counsel and engineering teams, you will turn complex inventions into high-quality patent applications and pursue commercially meaningful claim coverage. 
This is a hands-on role: approximately 60% of your time will involve drafting applications, with approximately 30–40% devoted to prosecution. You will personally draft most assigned applications and all U.S. Office Action responses for assigned matters, and review outside counsel’s non-U.S. Office Action responses. The role calls for an experienced practitioner who can produce high-quality work with limited supervision and is proficient using AI-based tools effectively.

jobs.title: Head of People Operations
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Head of People Operations to lead our team and build the systems behind a great employee experience. You’ll shape the strategy across People Operations and Total Rewards operations, making everyday work simpler, more reliable, and increasingly agent-enabled.

This is a player-coach role: develop the team, set direction, and stay hands-on—especially as you learn Notion. You’ll combine operational craft with thoughtful automation, keeping care and human judgment at the center of sensitive decisions.

This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Put agents to work thoughtfully. Prototype, test, and scale useful workflows, with trusted information, appropriate access, validation, and human review built in.

 - Lead the team and set the roadmap. Coach and develop team, establish clear ownership, and prioritize improvements across service delivery, systems, and automation.

 - Build reliable lifecycle and support workflows. Design and improve People Operations processes that support Notion as it grows, including onboarding, employee changes, leaves, and offboarding, with clear intake, ownership, documentation, service standards, and escalation paths.

 - Lead Total Rewards operations. Develop and evolve scalable operating frameworks across Total Rewards—including clear ownership, decision rights, controls, and cross-functional handoffs—to improve consistency and enable specialists to focus on strategic work. Own routine compensation and benefits operations and the processes behind them—from cycle readiness and data changes to Payroll handoffs. Partner with specialists on policy, program design, and complex exceptions.

 - Measure and strengthen operations. Use service, quality, and adoption data to improve performance and service delivery while maintaining data integrity, controls, and audit readiness.

 - Make change stick. Partner across People, Finance, Payroll, Legal, IT, and BizTech to resolve handoffs, align decisions, and drive adoption.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience leading a high performing People Operations team in a shared services capacity, building scalable processes in a growing organization, while remaining effective hands-on.

 - Demonstrated success building scalable People programs, infrastructure, and operational processes from the ground up

 - Operational depth in compensation administration and benefits, with sound judgment around accuracy, approvals, and exceptions.

 - Strong systems and process-design skills across HRIS, case management, and lifecycle workflows. Workday and global operations experience are a plus.

 - Practical experience using AI and automation to improve work, with privacy, quality, and human oversight built into the approach.

 - Clear communication, strong judgment, and the ability to lead a team and cross-functional partners through change.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. jobs.title: Facilities Technician
jobs.description:
Stratolaunch is a technology accelerator that engineers operationally realistic testing at Mach 5+. Our air-launched, Talon testbeds are reusable, cost-effective platforms that enable routine access to the hypersonic environment. We deliver flight data critical to validating system performance and achieving rapid technology deployment. Together with our customers, we drive innovations that are imperative to advancing national security.

Stratolaunch is seeking a skilled, independent Facilities Technician with strong experience in Electrical, HVAC, plumbing, mechanical, and general building maintenance. This role is responsible for preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, inspections, emergency response, and vendor coordination. Candidates must be reliable, safety-focused, organized, and able to manage work priorities with minimal supervision.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

• Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on facility systems, equipment, and building infrastructure.

• Diagnose and repair electrical systems, including lighting, outlets, breakers, panels, switches, low-voltage controls, and basic electrical equipment.

• Maintain and troubleshoot HVAC equipment, including air handlers, rooftop units, split systems, thermostats, exhaust systems, filters, belts, motors, and controls.

• Repair and maintain plumbing systems, including sinks, toilets, faucets, drains, water heaters, valves, piping, and fixtures.

• Conduct routine inspections to identify safety hazards, equipment issues, and facility repair needs.

• Perform general building repairs, including carpentry, drywall, painting, flooring, doors, locks, ceilings, and minor concrete or masonry repairs.

• Respond promptly to maintenance requests, service calls, alarms, and facility emergencies.

• Coordinate with outside contractors and vendors when specialized work is required; verify work quality and completion.

• Maintain accurate records of inspections, repairs, preventative maintenance, materials used, and work orders.

• Ensure all work complies with applicable building codes, safety regulations, company policies, and environmental requirements.

• Maintain tools, equipment, inventory, and an organized work area.

• Support facility improvement projects, equipment installations, renovations, and moves as needed.

• Be available for occasional after-hours, weekend, or emergency call-out support, as required.

QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent; technical trade school, apprenticeship, or associate degree preferred.

• 5+ years of facilities maintenance, building engineering, or multi-trade technician experience.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience in:

Electrical troubleshooting and repair

HVAC maintenance and diagnostics

Plumbing repair and installation

Mechanical systems maintenance

General building repair and preventative maintenance

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong troubleshooting, organizational, and time-management skills.

• Ability to read and interpret work orders, equipment manuals, drawings, schematics, and building plans.

• Knowledge of workplace safety practices, including lockout/tagout, PPE, ladder safety, and safe tool operation.

• Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation, if required for the role.

• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, work on ladders, access confined or elevated areas, and perform physical maintenance tasks safely.

• Ability to work with others as a team and different projects not associated with your skilled trade.

Preferred Qualifications, knowledge but certification not required

• EPA Universal Refrigerant Handling Certification.

• Electrical, HVAC, plumbing, boiler, or other trade certifications/licenses.

• Experience with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS), and work-order platforms.

• Experience maintaining commercial, industrial, manufacturing, warehouse, or multi-site facilities.

• Knowledge of fire/life-safety systems, emergency generators, compressors, pumps, and basic controls.

Core Competencies

• Independent and accountable work style

• Strong mechanical aptitude

• Clear communication and customer service skills

• Attention to detail and safety

• Ability to prioritize urgent repairs while completing scheduled maintenance

• Professionalism, reliability, and a proactive approach to facility care

Work Environment

This position works in a variety of indoor and outdoor facility environments and may be exposed to heat, cold, noise, dust, moving equipment, and other typical maintenance conditions. The Facilities Technician must be able to safely use hand tools, power tools, testing equipment, and personal protective equipment.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

• A high school diploma or equivalent is required. An associate degree in electrical or HVAC technology or a related field is preferred. Candidates should have at least 2-3 years of experience in electrical maintenance and repair, preferably in a facilities management setting.

Special remarks regarding work environment, if applicable

• This position is located in Mojave, CA

• 9/80 schedule

• $24.50-$33.77

• Eligible for up to 8% annual bonus

Base salary and leveling are established on a case-by-case basis. We consider several factors to ensure a competitive offer, including your location, educational background, and a comprehensive assessment of the skills and experience demonstrated during your interviews.

Benefits and our location(s):

• Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)

• Paid Maternity and Parental Leave

• 50% company match per contributed dollar into 401(k) savings plan, up to $11,500

• Tuition reimbursement

This position may involve the operation of company vehicles as part of assigned duties.

Mojave Air & Spaceport is located just outside of Lancaster/Palmdale and is only 95 miles north of Los Angeles.  The area offers both affordability and central access to a variety of California's best attractions and landmarks.

Not much for the outdoors and prefer the city life? You’re within a half day’s drive or less of Los Angeles, San Diego, Las Vegas, and San Francisco where you can find a variety of live entertainment, museums, tours, and historical sight-seeing. Theme parks are in abundance, with Six Flags Magic Mountain, Disneyland, and Knotts Berry Farm ready to meet the needs of rollercoaster thrill seekers.

Food and drink fanatics are in a haven of delectable choices. Wine aficionados will also find easy access to some of the state’s best vino in Paso Robles, Santa Ynez, and even more locally in Tehachapi and Agua Dulce. Beer fanatics will find some of the best West Coast IPAs at Bravery and Lucky Luke’s in Lancaster. Any food option you crave is covered, and we always recommend the authentic and fresh Mexican food that you won’t find anywhere else in the United States.

We encourage people from all walks of life to apply, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law. Our management team does not tolerate discrimination or harassment at any point during our employees’ and applicants’ time with us, especially with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities, and general treatment during employment.  For purposes of transparency, U.S. Citizenship may be required for some positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

jobs.title: Manager, Executive Administration
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

Life360’s team of Executive Assistants have a deep understanding of Life360’s cross-functional dynamics with high visibility across the company. These critical team members are viewed as strategic partners who keep the executives and their teams focused on company goals while also finding moments to celebrate our values and culture. This is an opportunity to work alongside individuals who are united by a strong sense of teamwork and collaboration.

About the Job

Our leaders make fast decisions for families around the world, and the EA team keeps their time, priorities, and communications pointed at what matters. As Manager, Executive Administration, you’ll lead a team of five EAs, personally support 2-3 executives, and set the standards, tools, and ways of working for how executive support runs at Life360. You’ll report to the Chief People Officer.

The US-based salary range for this position is $102,500 to $152,000 USD. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

Lead the team

• Manage a team of five Executive Assistants, providing ongoing coaching, feedback, and development through regular 1:1s.

• Build and improve team processes, including shared playbooks, escalation paths, and standards for calendar management, travel, meeting prep, and confidentiality.

• Build and launch our EA career ladder, including how EA level maps to executive scope, and coach each EA on a path to the next level.

• Build an AI-native EA team by setting the standard for how the team uses AI: which tools, for what work, and where human judgment is required.

• Define how coverage works for PTO and peak periods, and how internal requests are triaged and assigned. Set decision rights so EAs act independently on routine calls and escalate by exception.

• Manage hiring, onboarding, and performance for the team across multiple time zones.

jobs.title: Strategic Initiatives Director
jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

The Strategic Initiatives Director will help shape and execute Crunchyroll’s growth agenda by evaluating strategic opportunities, developing clear recommendations for senior leadership, and mobilizing cross-functional teams to move important initiatives forward. The role sits at the intersection of corporate strategy, corporate development, partnerships, operating model design, new business incubation, and enterprise execution.

This is a highly collaborative senior role for a structured thinker who can move comfortably between market analysis, executive communication, financial and strategic assessment, and hands-on program leadership. The portfolio will evolve with business priorities and may include both inorganic and organic growth initiatives.

Reporting to the VP, Corporate Development, the Strategic Initiatives Director will:

• Lead the assessment and prioritization of strategic growth opportunities across Crunchyroll’s businesses, markets, products, and partnerships.

• Translate ambiguous questions into structured analysis, practical options, and clear recommendations.

• Work across Strategy, Corporate Development, Finance, Legal, Product, Content, Marketing, and other business teams to build alignment, drive execution, and spearhead a dynamic range of cross-functional projects.

Areas of responsibility

Strategic opportunity assessments and Build / Buy / Partner decisions

• Monitor market dynamics, competitive activity, emerging business models, and relevant trends; lead target screening, opportunity assessment, and prioritization across sectors, geographies, and business models.

• Build strategic, commercial, and financial frameworks that assess rationale, value-creation potential, risks, dependencies, and execution implications.

• Evaluate strategic partnerships and selected growth capabilities, including fit, economics, feasibility, risks, governance, and recommended path forward.

• Partner with business and functional leaders to shape deal structures, operating requirements, and implementation roadmaps.

Executive decision support and cross-functional alignment

• Prepare concise, decision-useful materials for senior leadership, executive committees, and board discussions, translating complex information into clear recommendations, decision asks, and next steps.

• Coordinate cross-functional workstreams, maintain action logs and decision registers, establish stakeholder cadences, and drive timely follow-through.

• Communicate uncertainty, data gaps, unresolved trade-offs, risks, and dependencies clearly and proactively.

• Where needed, support selected integration-related initiatives by leading or supporting business units in transition, e.g., pre-close planning, milestones, dependencies, and post-closing integration for business continuity.

About you

• You bring 12+ years of experience in corporate strategy, corporate development, management consulting, investment banking, private equity / investing, or a related strategic program leadership role.

• You have a track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from ambiguous problem definition through recommendation and execution.

• You combine strategic judgment with analytical rigor, including market assessment, business cases, financial analysis, scenario evaluation, and prioritization.

• You communicate clearly and credibly with senior executives, business leaders, and functional subject-matter experts, including through polished, executive-ready presentations.

• You create structure, clarify ownership, anticipate dependencies, follow through on commitments, and adapt as priorities change.

• You take pride in excellence, integrity, attention to detail, and an internal sense of urgency; you share our excitement for media, entertainment, and technology.

• A bachelor’s degree is required; an MBA or other advanced degree is preferred but not required.

About the team

Embedded within the broader Strategy organization, the Corporate Development team works closely with senior leadership and across Crunchyroll’s global businesses, spanning subscription video, digital manga, eCommerce, games, theatrical releases, consumer products, and more.

The team evaluates and supports high-profile opportunities across acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, strategic partnerships, and organic growth initiatives. We also partner with stakeholder groups and operating teams across the company to turn strategic priorities into durable execution.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

• Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.

• Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.

• Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance

• Health Saving Account HSA program
