jobs.title: Data Center Technician Manager
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

The Data Center Technician Manager is a first-line people manager responsible for the day-to-day operational performance and development of DC Technician and DC Facilities Engineering staff at the site.

This is the first formal people-management role in the Nebius data center technical career path. It serves as the primary operational and people-management layer between these teams and the Data Center IT Manager.

The role owns performance, development, scheduling, and accountability across the DC Technician and DC Facilities Engineering disciplines. When the Data Center IT Manager is unavailable, this manager acts as the primary on-site operational authority, makes shift-level decisions across both managed disciplines, and coordinates incidents involving other site teams.

The successful candidate brings deep technical credibility in data center technician operations and/or facilities engineering, along with sufficient cross-disciplinary understanding to direct escalations, assess work quality, and represent the managed teams in site-level operational discussions.

The Senior DC Diagnostic & RMA Specialist, Field Network Engineer, and Senior DC Support Engineer report directly to the Data Center IT Manager.

You will work onsite in our Oklahoma data center location.

Core responsibilities

• Own the daily operational performance of DC Technician and DC Facilities Engineering staff. Assign shift coverage, set priorities, balance workloads, and ensure open work is tracked, delegated, and completed to Nebius standards.

• Conduct regular one-on-one meetings with direct reports. Deliver structured performance feedback, set individual development goals aligned with the career framework, track progression, and manage performance concerns in partnership with HR and the Data Center IT Manager.

• Own shift handoff quality across both disciplines. Ensure incoming shifts have full visibility into open incidents, active vendor work, abnormal system conditions, deferred tasks, and escalated items before taking operational ownership.

• Serve as the on-site operational escalation authority during active incidents. Direct the response across managed teams, coordinate with the Lead DC Technician, Senior DC Facilities Engineer, and technical specialists reporting to the Data Center IT Manager, and escalate incidents that exceed site-level decision-making authority.

• Manage vendor and contractor activity on the data center floor and in engineering zones. Verify qualifications, enforce safe working practices, review and approve Methods of Procedure (MOPs) within assigned authority, oversee execution quality, and ensure work meets Nebius standards.

• Drive technical training and development for managed staff. Partner with the Lead DC Technician and Senior DC Facilities Engineer to identify skill gaps, arrange training, validate completion, and support progression within the Nebius career framework.

• Lead hiring activities for DC Technician and DC Facilities Engineering roles. Conduct structured, competency-based interviews, provide hiring recommendations, and partner with recruiting and HR on offers, onboarding, and early-tenure support.

• Maintain a safe, inclusive, and high-performance team culture. Address conduct, attendance, and well-being concerns promptly and in accordance with Nebius policies, safe working requirements, and applicable employment obligations.

• Make recommendations regarding hiring, promotions, disciplinary action, advancement, scheduling, and termination.

• Make routine decisions regarding workflow, staffing, escalation, and corrective actions within assigned management authority.

• Provide ongoing coaching, training, and performance feedback.

Technical work may be performed when needed, but the position’s primary responsibility is managing the assigned team and data center operations.

Expected capabilities

• Proven first-line management ability, including leading, developing, and holding technical teams accountable across shift-based operations in a mission-critical environment.

• Deep technical credibility in data center technician operations and/or facilities engineering, with sufficient cross-disciplinary understanding to direct escalations, assess work quality, and evaluate readiness across both functions.

• Strong operational judgment, including assigning and reprioritizing work, managing incidents across disciplines, and making sound shift-level decisions without requiring approval for routine matters.

• Demonstrated performance-management capability, including delivering structured feedback, managing development plans, addressing underperformance, and supporting career progression and promotions in partnership with HR.

• Clear, structured communication with technicians, facilities engineers, the Data Center IT Manager, global engineering teams, vendors, and senior leadership.

• Proficiency in operational reporting and tracking metrics, with the ability to identify performance trends, surface risks, and recommend improvements to shift execution and team capability.

• Working knowledge of safe working practices, change control, emergency operating procedures, and vendor management, with the ability to learn and apply Nebius-specific requirements.

Core physical requirements

The role requires the ability to perform the following activities, with reasonable accommodation where applicable:

• Stand and remain on your feet for extended periods, typically four or more consecutive hours during active shift operations.

• Safely lift, carry, and position equipment weighing up to 50 pounds independently, using appropriate team-lift protocols or mechanical aids for heavier loads.

• Work at heights, including ascending and descending ladders and using approved elevated work platforms.

• Work in confined spaces, including under raised floors, within rack enclosures, and along cable management pathways.

• Work in environments with variable temperatures, including cold aisle containment zones and areas with active cooling infrastructure.

• Handle small components, precision cabling, and connector installations.

• Read equipment labels, interface indicators, and detailed wiring diagrams in variable lighting conditions.

• Safely push or pull wheeled equipment weighing up to 500 pounds on level surfaces, using appropriate equipment-handling procedures.

On-call requirement

This role carries on-call responsibility as the primary management escalation point for after-hours incidents, team welfare concerns, vendor emergencies, and site-level operational events requiring management authority across both managed disciplines.

Key employee benefits in the US:

• Health insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.

• 401(k) plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.

• Parental leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.

• Remote work reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.

• Disability & life insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range

$125,000—$145,000 USD

Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation

• Career growth and learning opportunities

• Flexibility and ownership

• Collaborative and innovative culture

• Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

• International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.title: CISO
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

Verkada is at a critical stage in its evolution as it scales its global business. With that growth comes an increasingly complex security landscape spanning connected devices, cloud infrastructure, AI and machine learning at the edge, and sensitive customer video and access data.

Building on an established security program and a team of approximately 30, the incoming CISO will have the opportunity to evolve the strategy, technical capabilities, and operating model for Verkada’s next stage of growth. Priorities include strengthening device and product security, advancing detection and response, protecting customer data, and meeting expanding regulatory requirements across global markets.

As part of the engineering leadership team, the CISO will operate as a technical partner to Engineering and Product, embedding security into how Verkada designs, develops, and deploys its technology. This requires a leader who can pair technical depth with the organizational discipline needed to scale the security function while supporting innovation and speed.

For the right leader, this is an opportunity to address a distinctive set of security challenges at the intersection of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world—and to shape a security organization whose impact extends directly to customer trust, product integrity, and Verkada’s readiness for its next chapter.

What You'll Do

The CISO will lead and scale Verkada’s security organization of approximately 30 professionals, evolving its capabilities to support continued growth and readiness for a potential IPO. As a member of the CTO’s engineering leadership team, this leader will partner across engineering, product, legal, and business functions to manage security risk while supporting innovation.

• Security strategy and organizational leadership: Set security priorities, develop talent, and scale the team’s capabilities and responsibilities as the business grows.

• Device and product security: Partner with product and firmware engineering to secure Verkada’s Linux-based device fleet, including AI/ML workloads at the edge and the software update lifecycle.

• Cloud and software security: Lead security across cloud infrastructure and software, embedding security practices into development and operations.

• Detection and response: Oversee security operations, automated threat detection, incident response, and continuous improvement of monitoring and response capabilities.

• Data protection: Strengthen safeguards for customer and company data across devices, applications, and cloud services.

• Global compliance and regulatory readiness: Lead security compliance across jurisdictions, including Europe and Australia, and mature the program for the company’s next stage.

• External security partners: Manage third-party providers supporting penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, and detection capabilities.

• Customer and board engagement: Support complex customer and partner discussions and provide quarterly written security reports to the board, communicating risks, priorities, and progress clearly.

What You Bring

• Technical depth and breadth: Hands-on expertise across hardware/IoT, cloud, software, and AI security, with the ability to engage directly on Linux-based devices, firmware, edge AI/ML workloads, and secure update practices.

• Security organization leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead and scale an approximately 30-person organization spanning product security, detection and response, data protection, and compliance.

• Global regulatory and compliance experience: Strong command of B2B security requirements across jurisdictions, including Europe and Australia, and the ability to translate obligations into practical controls.

• Engineering partnership: Earns credibility with technical teams and collaborates effectively with stakeholders ranging from firmware engineers to lawyers and junior IT staff while maintaining security fundamentals.

• Judgment in ambiguity: Reasons from first principles, evaluates trade-offs, and makes clear, defensible decisions that balance security requirements with business and engineering priorities.

• Executive communication: Credible with customers, partners, and the board; able to explain complex risks and support challenging customer discussions.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager, X
jobs.description:
About Creatify

Creatify is building the AI Platform for Advertising where marketers and agents work together to plan campaigns, create ads, manage budgets, and optimize performance across channels.

We've surpassed $10 million in ARR, serving over 3 million users across 10,000+ teams. Leading brands — including AppLovin, Comcast, Perplexity, Alibaba, HubSpot, Binance, and NewsBreak— use Creatify to produce personalized, high-performing video ads in minutes.

We have raised $24M in funding from leading Silicon Valley firms including WndrCo, Kindred Ventures, Millennium New Horizons, NFDG, Comcast Ventures, Creator Ventures, Leadout Capital, Hat Trick Capital, and many more. Check out our latest coverage by Fast Company, TechCrunch, Bloomberg TV, and our recognition as one of IVP Enterprise AI 55 in 2024.

Based in Mountain View, we are a team of passionate AI researchers, engineers, and advertising veterans. Join us in reinventing the advertising industry with AI.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an AI-native Social Media Manager to own Creatify on X — and to be the creator behind the account, not just the operator of it.

This is a consumer role. Our audience is creators, marketers, founders, and everyday users who discover new AI tools on social. You'll set the strategy and execute it yourself, every day: original posts, threads, replies, memes, product moments, and real conversations with the community. X is the home channel, and you'll extend what works to LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and wherever our audience is moving next.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role for someone who already lives on X, already creates, and already knows how AI companies win attention. You won't wait for a content calendar to tell you what to post.

This is a full-time, in-person position based in Mountain View, CA, or San Francisco, CA.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own X end to end: Define and drive Creatify's X strategy — content pillars, posting cadence, engagement approach, and growth tactics — and publish daily: posts, threads, replies, reposts, and quote posts

 - Be in the conversation, in real time: Monitor trends, launches, and cultural moments as they happen; engage authentically with creators, users, and industry voices, and jump in fast when Creatify has a genuine point of view

 - Create, don't just schedule: Produce original content yourself — short-form video, memes, demos, and hot takes — including appearing on camera when that's what the format calls for

 - Turn product into moments: Partner with product, design, and marketing to turn launches, features, and milestones into X moments people actually share, in the style of the best AI consumer launches

 - Build the creator network: Identify, build, and maintain relationships with creators, influencers, and advocates in the AI, video, and creator-economy space

 - Expand beyond X: Adapt winning content and build Creatify's presence across LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Reddit, and emerging channels

 - Measure and iterate: Track performance (growth, engagement, and signups driven), report what you learn, and use data to double down on what works and kill what doesn't

 - Experiment relentlessly: Test new formats, hooks, and AI tools constantly — find what resonates, then scale it




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Have 1+ years of experience running social for a consumer (B2C) brand, creator, or your own audience — with meaningful, hands-on X experience. This is a B2C role: B2B-only / enterprise marketing backgrounds are not a fit for this position

 - Are a strong creator yourself: you have a personal X presence you're proud of, with posts, threads, or videos that show you can write, hook, and grow an audience — not just manage someone else's

 - Are AI-native: you use AI tools daily in your own creative workflow, you're an active user of products like ours, and you study how leading AI companies do launches and community on social

 - Are active on X and other consumer channels every day because you love it — you understand X's culture, algorithm, and meme language natively, and you have sharp instincts for what takes off and why

 - Are outgoing and energized by people: you love replying, debating, hosting, and building relationships in public, and you're comfortable being a visible face of the brand

 - Write fast and well, with a voice that sounds like a real human — sharp, funny when it should be, and never corporate

 - Work hard and move fast: high daily output, real-time responsiveness, and full ownership without needing to be managed

 - Have sharp editorial judgment about when to engage, when to stay quiet, and when to take a swing


BONUS POINTS IF YOU…

 - Have grown an X account (yours or a brand's) from small to significant, and can show the numbers

 - Have had posts or videos go viral — and can explain exactly why they worked

 - Create short-form video natively on TikTok / Reels / Shorts, not just on X

 - Have experience at a high-growth AI or consumer startup




HOW TO APPLY

 1. Resume

 2. A link to your X profile

 3. Links to your 3 best posts, threads, or videos (yours, or ones you made for brands)

 4. Preferred: One post you would publish from the Creatify account tomorrow, and why

jobs.title: Sr Supplier Engineer – Electronics, Future Forward
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:

Lead Supplier Engineer on a design project. Responsible to influence the design architecture, component specifications, and component manufacturing process based on supplier capabilities.  Responsible for DFM, cost modeling, commodity knowledge, to support supplier selection and BOM cost targets.  Responsible for qualification of all components and launch plan.   Post launch, responsible to drive suppliers to continuously improve business and manufacturing processes.

Essential Job Duties:

• Partner with design engineering to understand the design intent and how it translates to component design. Ensure critical design outputs are clearly documented and measurable on the component specification.
• Influence the Engineering team to select the component technology that will meet requirements for short- and long-term needs from prototype to production, but also meet business objectives for cost and utilizing preferred suppliers.
• Collaborate with Quality Engineering and Design Engineering to support dFMEA reviews and confirm the feasibility of various design risk mitigations.
• Drive changes to Intuitive component specifications to ensure a robust component manufacturing process that can scale by performing Design-For-Manufacturing (DFM) activities.
• Work with design engineering to develop test methods and acceptance criteria for the supplied part or sub-assembly.
• Create strategies to effectively optimize the supply base to reduce the risk of complex sub-tiers suppliers and long lead times.
• Determine risk mitigations for high severity parts, sole suppliers or proprietary materials.
• Complete Design Transfer and component qualification: pFMEA, Special Process Validations, FAI, correlation and Cpk by leading, training and mentoring suppliers through the process.
• Develop supplier ramp readiness plans by judging business risk based on forecast, supplier capacity, quality performance, and process capability.
• Drive corrective actions for supplier process by driving suppliers to true root cause analysis and corrective and Preventive actions.
• Develop and influence using metrics for supplier part cost, delivery, quality, capacity and capability by creating metrics to measure real improvement and judge required intervention or change at the supplier or in a commodity.

Required Skills and Experience:

• Demonstrable knowledge of a wide range of Electronics, motors, cable assembly, and PCBA-related manufacturing processes including understanding of key input variables for quality, supplier testing design, qualification, and capacity.
• General understanding of manufacturing processes including metal fabrication, plastics injection molding, extrusions, and/or contract manufacturing
• Ability to work alongside design engineers and assess supplier capability during the design iteration process
• Demonstrable knowledge in evaluating and challenging supplier technical, quality, and business capabilities
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills including presentations to executive level management
• Excellent Interpersonal skills and team building skills
• Excellent analytical and problem solving skills along with good judgment
• Significant computer experience using Windows, Word, Excel, Access and ERP Information Systems, preferably SAP
• Ability to read and interpret detailed mechanical drawings and communicate technical information

• BS degree in Engineering or equivalent.

• Knowledge of cutting-edge technologies used in motor controls (incremental, absolute encoders) is a plus
• Knowledge of cutting-edge technologies used in cable connections is a plus

• Experience with tolerance stack and CAD experience with 3D modeling tools is a plus

You build and execute strategic sales plans, develop trusted relationships with senior executives and key stakeholders, and identify opportunities to expand Rithum's value across complex client organizations. You are accountable for meeting or exceeding financial targets by leading consultative, value-based sales engagements and securing high-value, multi-year software and services agreements.

Rithum empowers employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to work smarter, move faster, and create scalable ways of working. In this role, you will use AI and data-driven insights to strengthen account strategy, identify opportunities, improve sales effectiveness, and deliver more relevant and impactful client engagement.

Strategic Account Growth

• Develop and execute account plans aligned to client priorities, commerce strategies, and growth objectives.

• Meet or exceed sales targets by identifying, developing, and closing software and services opportunities.

• Expand Rithum’s footprint across client brands, business units, geographies, channels, marketplaces, and capabilities.

• Build qualified pipeline by identifying whitespace and new opportunities within assigned accounts.

Executive & Value-Based Selling

• Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with senior executives and key stakeholders.

• Understand client priorities and position Rithum’s capabilities against business outcomes.

• Lead consultative, value-based conversations and develop compelling business cases.

• Navigate complex buying groups and build consensus across decision-makers.

Deal Execution

• Lead complex sales opportunities from discovery through negotiation and close.

• Develop deal strategies that address client priorities, competitive dynamics, commercial considerations, and barriers to close.

• Lead negotiations across pricing, terms, procurement, legal, security, and other stakeholders.

• Apply the Rithum Way of Selling to opportunity strategy, qualification, progression, and close.

Pipeline, Forecasting & AI

• Maintain a disciplined pipeline and deliver accurate, timely forecasts.

• Maintain high-quality CRM data and use insights to prioritize accounts and opportunities.

Cross-Functional Leadership

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, Cost and Manufacturing Accounting
jobs.description:
About Neuralink:

We are creating devices that enable a bi-directional interface with the brain. These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world.

Team Description:

The Finance Team at Neuralink plays an important role in fueling our mission to develop groundbreaking brain-machine interfaces that restore autonomy to individuals with unmet medical needs. The Accounting Team oversees the Company’s core financial operations, including the preparation of financial statements, corporate tax filings, equity administration, insurance management, and treasury functions. The team also plays an important role in handling technical accounting issues from identification, research, and implementation to monitoring and revision.

Job Description and Responsibilities:

Build the foundation of Neuralink’s cost accounting function in a complex, vertically integrated manufacturing environment. We design and build our own brain implants, including micron-scale electrode threads and the needle cartridges that insert them, along with the surgical robot that places them. As the first dedicated owner of cost accounting, you will establish how we capture, allocate, and report manufacturing costs, then own and improve these processes as our manufacturing capabilities scale.

This role combines hands-on cost accounting, technical accounting judgment, and meaningful ownership of systems design. You will work directly with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and Software teams to shape the accounting requirements of our internally developed ERP and manufacturing systems and how they evolve. You will also support the Company’s external audit and help design, document, and test internal controls over financial reporting. The processes and systems you build will connect how our products are manufactured with how their costs are measured and reported. This function is built on disciplined execution: accurate costing, traceability, and controls designed to support manufacturing as it scales.

Key responsibilities include:

• Building and owning the cost accounting function, including cost centers, allocation and absorption methodologies, and standard versus actual cost treatment across implant and surgical robot manufacturing

• Partnering directly with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and Software teams to translate how our products are built into practical accounting processes, including tracking materials, inventory movements, labor, equipment time, and manufacturing overhead

• Serving as a key accounting stakeholder in the design and evolution of our internally developed ERP and manufacturing systems, defining requirements for inventory valuation, manufacturing cost capture, and the flow of financial data into the ledger

• Researching complex U.S. GAAP matters and preparing clear technical memoranda and accounting policies, including inventory and manufacturing costs, internal-use software and cloud computing capitalization, and revenue recognition as commercial arrangements develop

• Designing and documenting internal controls over financial reporting across manufacturing and related processes, and performing management testing of controls independent of activities you prepare or execute

• Establishing and maintaining standard costs, analyzing manufacturing cost variances, and owning product costing, inventory valuation, and cost of goods sold reporting as manufacturing scales

• Building audit-ready documentation, supporting the Company’s external audit, and serving as a technical contact for the auditors on manufacturing costs and other accounting matters

• Testing controls over month-end close, reconciliations, and supporting schedules, and using cost analysis to improve cost visibility, data quality, and accounting processes

Required Qualifications:

• 7+ years of accounting experience, including technical accounting research and documentation

• Bachelor's degree or above in accounting

• Experience with inventory, product costing, and cost of goods sold

• Accounting experience in manufacturing, hardware, medical device, or other physical-product businesses

• Ability to research an unsettled question, reach a position under U.S. GAAP, and document the analysis and supporting evidence clearly for audit review

• Ability to work independently and partner fluently with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations and Software, translating how the product is built into cost centers and cost data

• Willingness to perform detailed accounting work while building scalable processes, with the ability and desire to navigate ambiguity at a high-growth company

Preferred Qualifications:

• CPA or CMA designation

• Big Four, public accounting, or formal technical accounting group experience

• Experience preparing audit-ready documentation and supporting external audits

• Experience defining accounting requirements for ERP implementation, configuration, or in-house development, particularly inventory and costing functionality, and an understanding of how data flows from BOM to PO to receipt to the ledger

• Experience in complex or vertically integrated manufacturing environments, including robotics, medical devices, or advanced hardware

• Experience designing, documenting, or testing internal controls over financial reporting, including management testing of controls

• Experience at a company transitioning from development to commercial manufacturing

• Experience with standard costing, variance analysis, or absorption costing

• Technical accounting experience with internal-use software and cloud computing capitalization or revenue recognition

• Intermediate to advanced Excel skills

Expected Compensation:

The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the following range. Your actual base pay will be determined by your job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. We also believe in aligning our employees’ success with the company's long-term growth. As such, in addition to base salary, Neuralink offers equity compensation (in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSU)) for all full-time employees.

Base Salary Range:

$95,000—$177,000 USD

What We Offer:

Full-time employees are eligible for the following benefits listed below.

• An opportunity to change the world and work with some of the smartest and most talented experts from different fields

• Growth potential; we rapidly advance team members who have an outsized impact

• Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance through a PPO plan

• Paid holidays

• Commuter benefits

• Meals provided

• Equity (RSUs) *Temporary Employees & Interns excluded

• 401(k) plan *Interns initially excluded until they work 1,000 hours

• Parental leave *Temporary Employees & Interns excluded

• Flexible time off *Temporary Employees & Interns excluded

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure AI
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

About the Team

Airwallex’s Infrastructure & Productivity team is on a mission to turn everyday software engineers into superheroes. The team builds and maintains the internal platforms, tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure that power Airwallex’s global engineering organization, serving hundreds of engineers across multiple offices and time zones.



The team is now pioneering a bold new direction: an AI agent ecosystem where goal-oriented agents continuously operate across every repository — automating infrastructure operations, incident response, database management, and DevOps workflows. Built on Quartermaster, our internal agent platform, these agents autonomously plan, reason, and execute multi-step tasks against real infrastructure. You will be joining at the ground floor of this initiative, building the intelligent systems that fundamentally change how infrastructure work gets done at Airwallex.



What You’ll Do

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Infrastructure AI team, you will design, build, and operate goal-oriented AI agents that automate SRE, DevOps, and DBA workflows across Airwallex’s global infrastructure. You won’t be doing operations work yourself — you’ll be building the AI systems that do it. Your agents will autonomously investigate incidents, provision infrastructure, manage databases, execute deployments, and handle the operational tasks that traditionally require human intervention.

You will work on top of Quartermaster, Airwallex’s internal agent platform, building domain-specific agents that interact with real infrastructure tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, cloud APIs, databases, monitoring systems). This role requires you to think deeply about agent architecture — planning and reasoning loops, tool selection and execution, safety guardrails, human-in-the-loop escalation, and how to make autonomous systems reliable in production infrastructure environments.



This hybrid role is based in Seattle, WA. 



Responsibilities

 - Build goal-oriented infrastructure AI agents: Design and implement autonomous agents on the Quartermaster platform that handle SRE, DevOps, and DBA workflows — including incident investigation and remediation, infrastructure provisioning, deployment orchestration, database operations, and capacity management.

 - Design agent architectures for safety and reliability: Build robust agent loops with planning, reasoning, tool-use, error recovery, and human-in-the-loop escalation. Infrastructure agents touch production systems — they must be safe, auditable, and predictable.

 - Integrate agents with infrastructure tooling: Give agents the ability to interact with real systems — Kubernetes, Terraform, cloud APIs (AWS, GCP, Aliyun), monitoring/observability platforms, databases, and CI/CD pipelines — through well-designed tool interfaces.

 - Evaluate and improve agent performance: Define metrics for agent effectiveness (task completion rate, accuracy, time-to-resolution, escalation rate). Build evaluation frameworks to measure whether agents reliably achieve their goals.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with SRE, DevOps, and platform engineering teams to identify the highest-value workflows for agent automation. Understand real operational pain points and translate them into agent capabilities.

 - Shape the future of infrastructure AI at Airwallex: Contribute to the technical vision for how AI agents will transform infrastructure operations. Stay at the forefront of agentic AI developments and bring new ideas into the team.



Who You Are:

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory:

 - 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in backend languages such as Python, Go, Java, or Kotlin.

 - Infrastructure and cloud knowledge: Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Aliyun), container orchestration (Kubernetes), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), and CI/CD systems. You understand the domain the agents will operate in.

 - Strong system design skills with the ability to architect reliable, safe, and scalable agent systems that interact with production infrastructure.

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working effectively across cross-functional teams in a global environment.



Preferred Qualifications:

 - Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems: You have designed and built AI agents that autonomously plan, reason, and execute multi-step tasks using LLMs. This includes agent loop design, tool-use orchestration, and managing agent state and memory. This is a core requirement, not a nice-to-have.

 - Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom agent frameworks) and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).

 - Experience with observability and monitoring systems (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, ELK stack) — either building them or building agents that interact with them.

 - Experience with database administration or automation (schema migrations, query optimization, backup/recovery) — knowledge that helps build effective DBA agents.

 - Understanding of SRE practices: incident response, runbooks, postmortems, SLOs/SLIs — the operational domain these agents will automate.

 - A forward-thinking mindset about where AI agents are headed. You have opinions on agent reliability, safety, evaluation, and the path toward increasingly autonomous infrastructure systems.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Assistant Teacher (Float) (Part-time): Louisville, KY
jobs.description:
As a part-time Assistant Teacher (Float) at Bezos Academy (internally titled Assistant Teacher I), you share our passion for early childhood education and commitment to creating nurturing, high-quality learning environments for all children. While exact responsibilities will vary from school to school, you may assist in classrooms, serve and supervise mealtimes, and support the overall operations of the school. Drawing on your organizational skills, professionalism, and commitment to children, you will support a multi-state network of schools in under-resourced communities, offering quality Montessori-inspired preschool at no cost to families.

LOCATION

We are actively hiring for part-time Assistant Teachers (Float) to support our preschools in Louisville, Kentucky:

• Louisville – Okolona (7525 Jefferson Green Way, Louisville, KY 40219)

• Louisville – Russell (3026 River Park Dr, Louisville, KY 40211)

SCHEDULES, BENEFITS, AND COMPENSATION

• This is a part-time, non-exempt/hourly position requiring a minimum of 25 hours per week, with occasional opportunities to work additional hours based on school needs.

• You will work a five-hour shift, Monday through Friday, totaling 25 hours per week. Specific school schedules are determined by school leaders when considering all staff, classroom, and community needs. Please indicate which shift(s) you are interested in on your application. Okolona: 25 hours per week (expected daily shift 8:30am-1:30pm) Russell: 25 hours per week (expected daily shift 9:30am-2:30pm)

• The full compensation range for this position is $18-$20 per hour. The starting pay for all new employees is $18 per hour.

• Benefits include paid sick (care) time, accrued based on hours worked, and a 401(k) plan with a 4% employer contribution match.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Age 18 with high school diploma or GED

• Ability to pass background checks, clear tuberculosis screenings, and (upon hire) successfully complete trainings required by the state of Kentucky to supervise children independently

• Ability to independently supervise, communicate effectively with, and care for young children safely, including ability to lift a minimum of 40 lbs

• Access to reliable transportation to and from work and ability to consistently attend work as scheduled to ensure proper staff-to-child classroom ratios and support smooth school operations

• Must have a valid Food Handler’s Permit or be willing to obtain one upon hire

• Ability to complete 20 hours of onboarding by your seventh day of employment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior experience supporting or teaching children ages 3–5 in a Montessori or early childhood classroom setting

• Experience working effectively across lines of difference and fostering an inclusive, welcoming environment for all children and families

• Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage daily operational tasks such as classroom setup, safety checks, and basic clerical responsibilities

• Demonstrated reliability and flexibility in supporting school operations, including meal service, playground supervision, assisting with classroom coverage as needed, and lead after-school activities

RESPONSIBILITIES

*NOTE: The combination of responsibilities may vary based on the needs of the school site, students, and prior experiences of the Assistant Teacher.

Instructional

• Serve as a floating assistant teacher, providing support wherever and however the school most needs it each day

• As needed, independently supervise children throughout the day in classrooms and a variety of other situations, including but not limited to arrival/departure, transitions, outside time, rest/nap time, and (if offered) extended hours

• Assist in maintaining accurate child and family records

• Complete Montessori basics training and credentialing/licensing requirements within seven days of hire

Operational

• Support Bezos Academy classrooms by following regulations and guidelines in the day-to-day operation of the classroom and school (e.g. cleaning/preparing materials, meal prep and cleanup, nap time transitions, laundry, bathroom supervision, etc.)

• Support school leadership and teachers to foster a nurturing, safe, and stimulating, non-competitive school environment

• Support children’s increasing independence with daily living skills (i.e., washing hands, using the bathroom, eating meals and snacks, cleaning up, etc.)

• Maintain licensing and credentialing requirements and complete required ongoing professional development trainings in a timely manner

• Attend staff meetings and family events as schedule allows

• Assume postures at low levels (e.g., kneeling, stooping, bending, and sitting on the floor) as needed to communicate effectively with children

• Provide support to nearby Bezos Academy schools, as needed, at the direction of your Head of School or District School Leader

Other

• Attend staff meetings and family events as schedule allows

Beyond the kitchen, you will assist school staff and administration with a variety of tasks including inventory checks, laundry, and other ad hoc duties. You will become an integral part of your school team working to improve processes and provide an excellent preschool experience where we nurture every child’s full potential.

We are actively hiring for a part-time Food Service Assistant at our Renton - North Highlands (3000 NE 16th Street, Renton, WA 98056).

The upper third of the compensation range is typically reserved for existing employees who have been in the role for multiple years and demonstrate strong performance over time. Starting compensation will vary by qualifications and prior experience.

• Age 18 with high school diploma or GED

• Ability to pass background checks and complete all trainings required by the Washington Department of Children, Youth, and Families upon hire

• Knowledge of cooking methods and procedures, including various types of preparation

• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, stand for long periods of time, and perform a variety of repetitive tasks to prepare and serve food safely

• Experience working in an institutional or highly regulated kitchen/food setting with a clear understanding of food preparation best practices and protocols

• Active and current food worker card

• Ability to speak, read, and write English fluently

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Scientist, Medicinal Chemistry
jobs.description:
Senior/Principal Scientist, Medicinal Chemistry

About the Position

We are seeking a talented and highly motivated individual with a strong background in synthetic organic chemistry to join our medicinal chemistry group in the pursuit of degrader-based small molecules to treat patients with unmet medical needs. This individual will design and synthesize novel chemical entities optimized for potency, selectivity, pharmacokinetics and in vivo efficacy, and will engage in rational structure-based drug discovery enabled by our computational and structural biology groups. As a member of a dynamic multi-disciplinary team, this person will collaborate with a broad group of scientists within Nurix and with external collaborators. Additionally, they will contribute to patent, report and scientific publication writing. Furthermore, they will initiate and/or lead process improvements within the chemistry department or cross-functionally.

Qualifications

• Ph.D. in synthetic organic chemistry with 8 – 10+ years pharmaceutical medicinal chemistry industrial experience.

• Track record of delivering advanced leads/ development candidates.

• Excellent knowledge of medicinal chemistry principles with a solid understanding of the biology and pharmacology of programs, ADME concepts, and series SAR. Able to effectively integrate this knowledge to direct drug discovery programs to phase transitions or series go/no go decisions.

• Strong working knowledge of protein-ligand interactions, conformational and structural analysis. Experienced in partnering closely with computational chemists in the use of computational tools, models and visualization applications.

• Expert in organic synthesis, knowledgeable of the current literature, with strong synthetic problem-solving skills.

• Proven leadership capability in a cross-functional team setting, either as project team leader or co-lead.

• Ability to make inventive contributions towards new chemical target structures or templates for programs and evaluate early screening or literature hits.

• Strong skills in gathering, documenting, and analyzing information from competitive sources such as patents and meetings and using this information to guide program strategy.

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to present rationale, key data, issues and accomplishments to the company.

• Experience supervising direct reports to a high level of productivity and mentoring for career development is a plus.

• Ability to manage priorities and advance multiple projects simultaneously.

• Strong evidence of conceptual thinking and active follow through, recognized by establishing new projects or new directions within projects, new strategies and/or enabling technologies for drug discovery.

Fit with Nurix Culture and Values

• Strong team orientation; highly collaborative

• Ability to function in a dynamic environment

• Solutions and results-oriented focus

• Hands-on approach; resourceful and open to diverse points of view

About Nurix Therapeutics

Nurix Therapeutics is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of targeted protein degradation medicines, the next frontier in innovative drug design aimed at improving treatment options for patients with cancer and inflammatory diseases. Powered by a fully AI-integrated discovery engine capable of tackling any protein class, and coupled with unparalleled ligase expertise, Nurix’s dedicated team has built a formidable advantage in translating the science of targeted protein degradation into clinical advancements. Nurix aims to establish degrader-based treatments at the forefront of patient care, writing medicine’s next chapter with a new script to outmatch disease.

jobs.title: Member of Data Staff (Data Acceleration)
jobs.description:
Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. This role brings that same standard to how our data team works, with AI at the center of everything we do.

We're looking for someone who's been a great data scientist, analytics engineer, or data engineer: the kind of person who knows which metric actually matters, can design an A/B test that answers the real question, has gone deep on a data model because something didn't add up, and has decided that the highest-leverage thing they can do next is build AI systems that fundamentally change how data science gets done.

You'll build AI agents and internal systems that can increasingly handle end-to-end analysis workflows: forming hypotheses, writing and running queries, interpreting results, and drafting recommendations with the right evaluation, review, and guardrails. You'll build the retrieval infrastructure and evaluation loops that let AI systems query the warehouse reliably. You'll create workflows that detect, diagnose, and help fix data issues before they become company-wide problems. You'll build the infrastructure that multiplies what a small data team can ship.

You'll join a data team that's already using AI across its work. The next step is turning those individual workflows into scalable systems, shared tools, and an AI-native operating model that becomes a benchmark for how modern data teams work.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build AI agents that do data science - not just SQL copilots, but systems that can safely explore data, form hypotheses, run queries, interpret results, and generate actionable recommendations with clear evaluation and human review loops.

 - Make AI systems query the warehouse reliably - build the retrieval infrastructure and evaluation loops that let agents use our semantic context and metadata accurately.

 - Accelerate the AI-native data workflow - turn the best existing AI-assisted workflows into repeatable systems, reusable tools, and patterns the whole data team can adopt.

 - Automate the data lifecycle - build self-healing pipelines, automated dbt model generation and validation, data quality agents, and diagnosis workflows that reduce manual firefighting.

 - Ship AI-powered experiment analysis - build agents that interpret A/B test results, flag statistical issues, identify likely drivers, and draft ship/no-ship recommendations.

 - Turn the data team into a product team - build internal data products that stakeholders use every day, replacing ad hoc requests with self-serve AI interfaces.

 - Own the full lifecycle - identify high-leverage problems, prototype with LLMs, evaluate accuracy, design the UX, ship to production, and monitor quality over time.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 6+ years in data science, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role. You've been close enough to real data work to know what should and should not be automated.

 - Deep SQL and analytics judgment - you can reason through metrics, experiments, data models, and messy warehouse reality without relying on a tool to think for you.

 - Strong product sense - you understand what stakeholders actually need, what makes a workflow adoptable, and how to turn a prototype into a product people use.

 - Hands-on LLM experience - you've built with frontier models, agents, RAG systems, evals, or AI-powered workflows and have opinions about where they work and where they fail.

 - Pipeline and modeling fluency - you've worked with dbt, warehouse schemas, data quality issues, and the practical tradeoffs behind durable data systems.

 - Builder mentality - you see a manual process and immediately think about how to systematize it. You ship fast, measure quality, and iterate.

 - Autonomy - this is a new function. You'll help define the roadmap as much as execute it.


BONUS

 - Experience building production AI agents or agent evaluation systems.

 - Experience with Snowflake, semantic layers, or metadata systems.

 - Experience building internal tools, Slack bots, CLIs, or developer productivity products that people actually used.

 - Strong experimentation background, including metric design and statistical interpretation.

 - Experience with BI tools and the judgment to know what should be automated versus kept human-reviewed.

 - Early-stage startup experience.


WHY THIS ROLE

 - Set the standard for the industry - Perplexity's data team is already using AI across its work. You'll turn that into something other data teams look to as the benchmark.

 - Build AI with AI - Perplexity builds AI for people who expect more. You'll bring that same level of ambition to how the company works with data.

 - Frontier models, day one - you're at an AI company with access to frontier infrastructure and people who deeply understand what's possible.

 - Massive leverage - the systems you build will multiply the output of every data team member and every stakeholder who needs data.

 - Direct impact - small team, no layers of approval. Idea to shipped system in days, not quarters.

jobs.title: Research Communications, Models & Frontier AI
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Product & Research Communications team helps people understand our technology, what it makes possible, and how to use it. We work closely with teams across the company to bring new products and research to the world, tell stories grounded in real experiences, and build trusted relationships with journalists.



About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on communications leader to own the launch strategy and storytelling for OpenAI’s frontier AI models across ChatGPT and the API. You’ll turn advances in model capabilities into clear, compelling stories for research, developer, customer, and consumer audiences.

You’ll get into the details with researchers, engineers, and product teams to understand what has changed, what the evidence shows, and what people can do with it. That means working through evaluations, exploring model behavior, and finding concrete examples that make an advance clear without losing its limitations.

This role calls for technical curiosity and strong editorial judgment. You should be as comfortable working through an evaluation with a researcher as writing a launch blog, shaping a media strategy, or preparing a leader for an interview.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.



In this role, you will:

 - Lead model launches end to end across ChatGPT and the API, owning positioning, messaging, media strategy, spokesperson preparation, rollout, and follow-through.

 - Work with researchers, engineers, and product teams from the earliest stages of a release. Dig into capability changes, evaluations, model behavior, and limitations to identify what is new and why it matters.

 - Develop distinct stories for research, developer, customer, and consumer audiences, explaining the technical advance, what developers can build, how customers can apply it, and what it makes possible in everyday life.

 - Partner closely with the head of B2B communications to translate frontier AI advances, including changes in model cost and efficiency, into clear, evidence-backed stories about customer use cases and business value.

 - Find and develop compelling demonstrations, use cases, and proof points with research and product teams. Test claims against the evidence and make clear where a result does and does not generalize.

 - Write and edit launch blogs, messaging, FAQs, pitches, and briefings, staying close to the work from the first technical discussion through final materials.

 - Build trusted relationships with journalists across technology, science, business, and consumer media. Prepare researchers and leaders for substantive briefings, interviews, and public engagements.

 - Lead communications and editorial work on model system cards with safety researchers and safety communications colleagues, keeping evaluations, safeguards, and limitations clear and consistent with the launch.

 - Bring together consumer, developer, B2B, safety, and regional communications partners, alongside Marketing and Legal, to align stories, reviews, timing, and responsibilities.

 - Build a sustained story about model progress between launches. Use audience questions, media coverage, and real-world feedback to identify follow-up stories and sharpen future communications.



You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a strong track record leading major launches for technically complex products or research, with clear ownership of both strategy and execution.

 - Enjoy getting into the details with researchers and engineers. You can work through evaluations, ask precise questions, and identify the story in a capability change.

 - Are an excellent writer and editor who can make the same technical advance meaningful to researchers, developers, business customers, and everyday users.

 - Know how to build a story from evidence, demonstrations, and real use cases, and can distinguish a meaningful advance from a result that needs more context.

 - Bring strong media judgment and trusted relationships with journalists, and can prepare technical and executive spokespeople for demanding questions.

 - Can lead a complex launch across teams, make sound calls as plans change, and take responsibility for the details as well as the big picture.

 - Have sound judgment about public claims, sensitive information, and timing. You know when to challenge an assumption, seek expert review, or explain uncertainty.

 - Build strong partnerships across functions, give clear editorial feedback, and bring genuine curiosity about AI and how people use it.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.title: Practice Operations Associate
jobs.description:
We are seeking a dynamic and highly organized Operations Associate to support the Strategic Advisory Group across business operations, marketing and business development, financial administration, and other practice defining activities. This is a highly visible, service-oriented role for someone who can move comfortably between detailed execution and higher-level coordination, interface professionally with colleagues at every level, and respond quickly as priorities change.

The successful candidate will bring an ownership mindset to every assignment, with the judgment to recognize what is urgent, the discipline to track commitments through completion, and the flexibility to take on work of any size and have the mentality of nothing is too big or small to jump in and take care of. This person will serve as a dependable team member who uses technology, organization, and clear communication to keep initiatives moving and ensure important details do not fall through the cracks.

Job Responsibilities

• Provide responsive day-to-day operational support to SAG leaders and team members, shifting focus as business needs and deadlines evolve.
• Coordinate work across senior leadership, practitioners, corporate functions, and external contacts while maintaining a polished and professional approach.
• Support marketing and business development activities, including opportunity tracking, meeting preparation, follow-up actions, event support, and maintenance of marketing materials.
• Create, update, and quality-check pitch decks, qualifications packages, presentations, and other client-facing materials in collaboration with subject-matter experts.
• Administer CRM data and processes, including new opportunity entry, contact and account updates, pipeline hygiene, activity tracking, reporting, and follow-up reminders.
• Monitor accounts receivable, work in process, billing status, collections follow-up, and related reporting; coordinate with project teams and Finance to resolve issues promptly.
• Prepare and support client invoicing, including gathering backup, confirming billing details, tracking approvals, monitoring invoice status, and maintaining accurate records.
• Develop and maintain trackers, dashboards, templates, shared workspaces, and process documentation that improve visibility, consistency, and accountability.
• Coordinate recurring and ad hoc meetings, prepare agendas and materials, capture decisions and action items, and follow through with owners until items are closed.
• Assist with onboarding, system access, internal requests, team communications, and other administrative or operational needs that help colleagues work effectively.
• Use Microsoft 365 and other business systems to streamline routine tasks, improve data quality, and identify practical opportunities for automation and process improvement.
• Handle confidential and sensitive information with care, sound judgment, and appropriate discretion.
• Anticipate needs, identify risks or missing information early, and escalate appropriately while offering practical solutions.
• Take on additional priorities as needed with a service mentality and a willingness to contribute wherever the team needs support.

The successful candidate will demonstrate the following professional abilities and experience:

• Experience in operations, project coordination, team support, marketing and business development support, finance administration, or a comparable client-service environment.
• Exceptional organization and follow-through, with a reliable system for managing multiple deadlines, requests, stakeholders, and recurring responsibilities.
• Ability to shift between strategic, analytical, administrative, and hands-on tasks without losing visibility into existing commitments.
• Strong service orientation and a consistent willingness to handle both high-profile assignments and routine details with equal care.
• Professional presence and communication skills, with the confidence and judgment to work effectively across all organizational levels and with external contacts.
• Working knowledge of marketing and business development workflows, presentation development, CRM administration, AR/WIP/billing management, and invoicing, or the ability to learn these areas quickly.
• Advanced proficiency or strong aptitude with Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint; interest in using technology and automation to improve work.
• Ability to produce accurate, polished, and client-ready work products, including presentations, trackers, reports, and written communications.
• Sound judgment, discretion, and accountability when handling financial, client, personnel, or other confidential information.
• Proactive problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to learn unfamiliar systems, processes, and subject matter.
• Ability to work independently, ask effective questions, collaborate across functions, and keep stakeholders informed.
• Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities may change and timely execution is essential.

This role requires regular computer-based work, participation in virtual and in-person meetings, and the ability to manage time-sensitive priorities. Flexibility may be needed outside standard business hours when business or client needs require it. jobs.title: Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Remote- Eligible US Locations

About the role and about You:

Great support starts with great training. When our members hit a snag, our Community Support team gets them back into Watopia and helps them make the most of their Zwift experience. To help support our frontline agents, we’re hiring a hands-on Training Specialist to build and maintain the training they rely on.

Our training program already has a strong foundation: a structured new hire curriculum, an established design framework, and experienced subject matter expert trainers who facilitate instructor-led training. In this role, you’ll keep that program accurate and effective as Zwift evolves. When products, processes, or policies change, you’ll revise new hire training and build and deploy update training to match. When the team identifies a need for refresh training, you’ll build it. When something new and complex launches, you’ll be a crucial part of supporting it.

You’ll be a part of our Content & Learning team, who own training, user-facing self-service content, and the internal knowledge enabling Zwift’s support team. In this role, you’ll also be the subject-matter expert in Seismic, our learning management system, ensuring we’re maximizing the benefits of the tool, keeping groups and enrollments clean, tracking completion and assessment results, and partnering with our BPO partners to close gaps.

You’re organized, dependable, and easy to work with. You take direction well, own your work from start to finish, and partner effectively with your teammates. You know when to hold firm on accuracy and when to flex on format or timing. You’re comfortable working outside a defined box: you pick up new tools, figure things out on your own, take on new work as the team’s needs change, and handle shifting priorities with ease. You use AI thoughtfully, knowing where it speeds up work and where human validation is essential.

What you’ll do:

• Develop new eLearning and instructor-led training (including exams and certifications) to support product launches and updated policies and procedures, while keeping existing training current.

• Build and deploy refresh training when the team identifies a need, indicated by QA results, Customer Effort Scores, or related performance data.

• Host train-the-trainer sessions to prepare subject matter expert (SME) trainers for seasonal new hire classes and update training rollouts.

• Run regular audits of training materials with SMEs to catch inaccurate, outdated, or missing information.

• Build and sustain strong working relationships with SME trainers, partner teams, and BPO leaders, rooting feedback in curiosity and respect while openly receiving it in return.

• Own Seismic (our LMS): managing distribution groups, reporting on completion and assessment results, and working with BPO leaders to close gaps. Explore unused and emerging features, while recommending ones worth adopting.

What we’re looking for:

• 2+ years of instructional design, training, or learning and development experience.

• Experience building eLearning, instructor-led training, and assessments using ADDIE or a similar model, with tools such as Articulate or Camtasia.

• Familiar with Kirkpatrick or a similar model for measuring training effectiveness.

• Experience as an LMS administrator using tools like Seismic (formerly Lessonly), Docebo, or equivalent, including user groups, enrollments, and reporting.

• Experience facilitating virtual training, including train-the-trainer sessions, ideally with globally distributed or BPO teams.

• Flexibility with an eagerness to support your team beyond training when priorities shift, whether for a short-term need or a longer-term change in focus.

Bonus points:

• A passion for cycling, running, or fitness.

• Experience supporting both internal and BPO (outsourced) contact center teams.

• Familiarity with Zwift, gaming, the software industry, or fitness technology.

If Zwift determines in any stage of our interviews that any AI tools are being used without disclosure or citation, your candidacy will be disqualified.

For All US Based Full-Time Positions:

The base salary for this position ranges between $56,500- $88,500. The base salary will be based on a number of factors including the role offered, the individual's job-related knowledge, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, Zwift is proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package for all eligible employees which also includes performance bonuses, equity, and a full range of medical, financial, and other perks and benefits.

How to stand out among the rest:

Your resume/CV is enough to show off your skills, accomplishments, and experience. However, if you choose to include a cover letter introducing us to your awesome personality, we will read that too.

We strongly believe that different backgrounds and ideas are a competitive advantage; we hire candidates of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, Veteran status, and any other status. Zwift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by emailing careers@zwift.com.

Zwift, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

Location: This is an onsite role based at Nextiva’s Scottsdale headquarters (9451 E. Via de Ventura, Scottsdale, AZ 85256). Working together onsite strengthens how we operate, enabling faster decisions, clearer communication, and stronger execution, so you can make a greater impact and move work forward with speed and clarity.

In-Office Expectation: This role is expected to work onsite four days per week. Specific scheduling and flexibility will be guided by your leader to support both team collaboration and individual productivity.

Nextiva is expanding our Mid-Market Sales team to support growing demand from customers in the 21–400 employee segment. As a Commercial / Mid-Market Sales Account Executive, you will execute a high-velocity, full-cycle sales motion across multiple lead sources, including inbound inquiries, XDR hot transfers, channel-sourced opportunities, chat, and outbound prospecting.

This role is designed for sales professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and excel at managing a high volume of opportunities. Success requires strong pipeline discipline, efficient qualification skills, and the ability to quickly identify customer needs and position Nextiva's Unified-CXM platform. You will guide prospects through a streamlined sales process with an average deal cycle of less than 30 days.

What You'll Do

• Manage multiple lead channels simultaneously, including inbound, XDR hot transfers, chat-generated leads, and channel opportunities.

• Conduct efficient discovery conversations to identify customer needs, business challenges, and decision-making criteria.

• Deliver tailored product demonstrations focused on business outcomes and customer value.

• Apply structured qualification methodologies to maintain pipeline quality and accelerate deal progression.

• Manage a high-velocity pipeline with consistent movement and timely follow-up across all stages in Salesforce.

• Create urgency and maintain momentum throughout a streamlined sales cycle.

• Build and maintain an active target account list within the 21–400 employee segment.

• Generate additional pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting and account engagement.

• Collaborate closely with XDRs, channel partners, and cross-functional teams to maximize conversion opportunities.

• Maintain accurate opportunity data and forecasting through disciplined Salesforce management.

• Achieve monthly performance expectations tied to pipeline generation, conversion rates, and closed revenue.

What You Need to Have

• 2+ years of full-cycle sales experience, including discovery, demonstrations, negotiation, and closing.

• Experience selling into SMB organizations or businesses within the 21–400 employee range.

• Ability to manage a high volume of opportunities while maintaining responsiveness and attention to detail.

• Experience working within short sales cycles, ideally less than 30 days.

• Proficiency using Salesforce for pipeline management, forecasting, and sales execution.

• Strong qualification and objection-handling skills.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building abilities.

• Self-motivated with the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

• Ability to thrive in a collaborative onsite sales culture.

Strong Preferences

• Experience selling UCaaS, CCaaS, SaaS, PaaS, or similar technology solutions.

• Experience balancing inbound and outbound sales motions simultaneously.

• Familiarity working with channel-generated opportunities.

• Comfort using AI-supported sales tools to prepare, personalize outreach, and improve sales performance.

• Track record of success in a high-velocity sales environment with monthly revenue targets.

Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies)

Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:

• Drives Results: Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.

• Critical Thinker: Data-driven, forward-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work.

• Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates.

Total Rewards

Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office.

Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary and/or hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses.

• 💰 Financial Security: 401(k) with company match, Health Savings Accounts with company contributions, Dependent Care FSA
