jobs.title: Sr DataOps Engineer (R14334)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior DataOps Engineer to help operate, scale, and improve the data platforms that support Oportun’s analytics, engineering, and business teams. This role will focus on Databricks, AWS, data pipelines, databases, observability, automation, and production support.

You’ll be responsible for keeping critical data-platform services reliable, secure, performant, and cost-effective while partnering closely with Data Engineering, Analytics, Security, Cloud Infrastructure, Database, and application teams. Success in this role means improving platform reliability, reducing operational friction, strengthening automation, and helping teams resolve issues quickly and sustainably.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

• You’ll administer and support Databricks workspaces, cluster policies, compute configurations, jobs, workflows, libraries, service principals, permissions, and platform integrations.

• You’ll support Unity Catalog, including access governance, catalog and schema permissions, and secure data sharing.

• You’ll monitor and troubleshoot Delta Live Tables, Spark jobs, Delta Lake workloads, and data pipelines, including failures, performance issues, recovery, and data-quality concerns.

• You’ll maintain secure and reliable integrations between Databricks and AWS services, including S3, IAM, networking, VPC connectivity, and external data sources.

• You’ll support AWS infrastructure used by the data platform, including EC2, VPC, IAM, security groups, networking, patching, and operational access.

• You’ll support MariaDB/MySQL and MongoDB environments, including availability, monitoring, connectivity, backup coordination, performance troubleshooting, and recovery.

• You’ll build and maintain monitoring, dashboards, logs, metrics, and alerts across Databricks, pipelines, databases, infrastructure, and integrations.

• You’ll participate in on-call support and lead investigation, mitigation, recovery, communication, and root-cause analysis for production incidents.

• You’ll build and maintain infrastructure and automation using Terraform, Terraform Enterprise, Git, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting.

• You’ll automate repeatable operational activities such as provisioning, access configuration, monitoring deployment, recovery, and platform changes.

• You’ll manage secure access controls, secrets, certificates, TLS configuration, service accounts, and IAM roles across platform services.

• You’ll improve operational readiness through runbooks, recovery procedures, architecture diagrams, standards, escalation paths, and technical documentation.

• You’ll partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to improve capacity planning, platform performance, cost visibility, and resource optimization.

• You’ll look for practical ways to use AI and automation to improve troubleshooting, documentation, incident response, and operational efficiency.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a hands-on platform engineer who enjoys solving complex production problems and improving the systems behind critical data workloads. You think beyond the immediate issue, look for root causes, and build solutions that make the platform more reliable and easier to operate.

You’re comfortable working across cloud infrastructure, data platforms, databases, automation, and security. You communicate clearly during incidents, take ownership through resolution, and consistently look for ways to reduce repetitive work and improve operational maturity.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

• Strong experience supporting production data platforms, cloud infrastructure, or DataOps environments.

• Hands-on experience administering and supporting Databricks, including workspaces, jobs, workflows, compute, cluster policies, and access controls.

• Experience supporting Spark, Delta Lake, and Delta Live Tables workloads.

• Strong experience with AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, security groups, CloudWatch, and networking.

• Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform and Terraform Enterprise or similar tools.

• Experience supporting MariaDB/MySQL and MongoDB in production environments.

• Strong understanding of monitoring, observability, alerting, and incident-management practices.

• Experience with CI/CD, Git, GitHub Actions, and automation using Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages.

• Experience troubleshooting platform performance, connectivity, permissions, certificates, TLS, and integration issues.

• Experience with production support, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and on-call operations.

• Strong understanding of security and access concepts such as IAM, RBAC, secrets management, certificates, and secure connectivity.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across Data Engineering, Analytics, Security, Infrastructure, Database, and application teams.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Databricks CLI, REST APIs, and Databricks asset or deployment bundles.

• Experience with Kubernetes administration and production troubleshooting.

• Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar platforms.

• Experience with Rootly or similar incident-management platforms.

• Experience with MongoDB Atlas, Ops Manager, or comparable MongoDB tooling.

• Experience with MariaDB/MySQL replication, schema migrations, indexing, backup validation, and restore procedures.

• Experience with capacity planning, cloud cost optimization, and workload performance tuning.

• Experience implementing or improving data governance, compliance controls, or audit processes.

• Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve operations, troubleshooting, documentation, or automation.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

Mexico Benefits:

Medical Insurance
Savings Fund
Life Insurance
Internet and Electricity Allowance
Paid time off such as vacation and parental leave

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers   #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:  https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/.

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. jobs.title: Logistic Transportation Pricing Analyst (Bilingual in Korean/ English)
jobs.description:

In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end procurement lifecycle for air freight, including sourcing forwarders and airlines, managing RFQs, negotiating competitive rates, and securing strategic capacity.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management

• Identify, evaluate, qualify, and register new logistics suppliers, including:AirlinesFreight ForwardersGSA (General Sales Agents)CFS (Container Freight Stations)Air Cargo Handling AgentsDrayage and Intermodal Carriers
• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with logistics service providers.
• Conduct supplier capability assessments, performance evaluations, and risk analysis.
• Maintain supplier database and vendor qualification records.

Airline Procurement & Contract Management

• Source and negotiate direct agreements with airlines, including:Block Space Agreements (BSA)General Sales Agent (GSA) AgreementsSpecial Rate Agreements (SPA) where applicable
• Negotiate transportation rates, capacity allocations, service commitments, payment terms, and contractual conditions.

RFQ/RFP Management

Pricing & Cost Analysis

Procurement Strategy

• Develop procurement strategies to improve competitiveness and achieve cost savings.
• Identify sourcing opportunities through market research and industry benchmarking.

Business Development Support

• Partner with Sales to develop competitive logistics solutions for customers.

Procurement Systems & Reporting

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Education & Experience

• 4+ years of experience in freight forwarding, 3PL, or logistics sourcing/operations, with a strict focus on Air Freight.
• Proven, hands-on experience managing RFP/RFQ processes and conducting financial data analysis.

Technical & Professional Skills

• Strong problem-solving mindset and sharp negotiation tactics.
• Excellent collaboration, communication, and interpersonal skills to work effectively with cross-functional global teams.

Work Adaptability & Travel

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience working directly within a major Freight Forwarder, Broker Company, or 3PL.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Assistant Teacher (Float) (Part-time): Renton, WA
jobs.description:
As a part-time Assistant Teacher (Float) at Bezos Academy (internally titled Assistant Teacher I), you share our passion for early childhood education and commitment to creating nurturing, high-quality learning environments for all children. While exact responsibilities will vary from school to school, you may assist in classrooms, serve and supervise mealtimes, and support the overall operations of the school. Drawing on your organizational skills, professionalism, and commitment to children, you will support a multi-state network of schools in under-resourced communities, offering quality Montessori-inspired preschool at no cost to families.

LOCATION

We are actively hiring for a part-time Assistant Teacher (Float) to support our preschool in Renton - North Highlands (3000 NE 16th Street, Renton, WA 98056).

SCHEDULES, BENEFITS, AND COMPENSATION

• This is a part-time, non-exempt/hourly position requiring a minimum of 25 hours per week, with occasional opportunities to work additional hours based on school needs.

• You will work a five-hour shift, Monday through Friday, totaling 25 hours per week. Specific school schedules are determined by school leaders when considering all staff, classroom, and community needs, but is expected to be 9:00am-2:00pm.

• This role includes paid care (sick) time, accrued based on hours worked, and a 401(k) plan with a 4% employer contribution match.

• The full compensation range for this position is $26-$29 per hour. The starting pay for all new employees is $26 per hour.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Age 18 with high school diploma or GED

• Ability to pass background checks, clear tuberculosis screenings, and (upon hire) successfully complete trainings required by the state of Washington to supervise children independently

• Ability to independently supervise, communicate effectively with, and care for young children safely, including ability to lift a minimum of 40 lbs

• Access to reliable transportation to and from work and ability to consistently attend work as scheduled to ensure proper staff-to-child classroom ratios and support smooth school operations

• Must have a valid Food Handler’s Permit or be willing to obtain one upon hire

• Ability to complete 20 hours of onboarding by your seventh day of employment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior experience supporting or teaching children ages 3–5 in a Montessori or early childhood classroom setting

• Experience working effectively across lines of difference and fostering an inclusive, welcoming environment for all children and families

• Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage daily operational tasks such as classroom setup, safety checks, and basic clerical responsibilities

• Demonstrated reliability and flexibility in supporting school operations, including meal service, playground supervision, assisting with classroom coverage as needed, and lead after-school activities

RESPONSIBILITIES

*NOTE: The combination of responsibilities may vary based on the needs of the school site, students, and prior experiences of the Assistant Teacher.

Instructional

• Serve as a floating assistant teacher, providing support wherever and however the school most needs it each day

• As needed, independently supervise children throughout the day in classrooms and a variety of other situations, including but not limited to arrival/departure, transitions, outside time, rest/nap time, and (if offered) extended hours

• Assist in maintaining accurate child and family records

• Complete Montessori basics training and credentialing/licensing requirements within seven days of hire

Operational

• Support Bezos Academy classrooms by following regulations and guidelines in the day-to-day operation of the classroom and school (e.g. cleaning/preparing materials, meal prep and cleanup, nap time transitions, laundry, bathroom supervision, etc.)

• Support school leadership and teachers to foster a nurturing, safe, and stimulating, non-competitive school environment

• Support children’s increasing independence with daily living skills (i.e., washing hands, using the bathroom, eating meals and snacks, cleaning up, etc.)

• Maintain licensing and credentialing requirements and complete required ongoing professional development trainings in a timely manner

• Attend staff meetings and family events as schedule allows

• Assume postures at low levels (e.g., kneeling, stooping, bending, and sitting on the floor) as needed to communicate effectively with children

• Provide support to nearby Bezos Academy schools, as needed, at the direction of your Head of School or District School Leader

Other

• Attend staff meetings and family events as schedule allows

jobs.title: Behavior Technician
jobs.description:
We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Behavior Technicians. As a Behavior Technician, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of children with autism.

In this role, you will work one-on-one with children, implementing individualized behavior intervention plans under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). You will use evidence-based techniques to teach communication, social, and daily living skills while reducing interfering behaviors.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about helping children with autism reach their full potential. You will need to be patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team environment. We will provide comprehensive training so that you are equipped and empowered to help each child, even if you don’t currently have experience. Children can be unpredictable and potentially confrontational, so this role is not for the weak of spirit, mind, or body. Part of the joy of working with kids is exercise! Our clients move, so you need to be comfortable standing, walking, sitting, grasping, reaching, bending, kneeling, crouching, squatting, lifting, and at times carrying children or objects that weigh up to 50 pounds.

At the end of each day, you will go home knowing that you have made a meaningful impact on the life of a child and their family. Join us and become a part of a dedicated team that is changing lives for the better. Apply now to start your journey as a Behavior Technician with us!

Pay Range: $17 - $23

Requirements:

• Passionate about helping children with autism.

• Patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team.

• 18+ years of age

• High school diploma or GED

• Ability to obtain a CPR, First Aid Certification and Tuberculosis test (if you haven’t had one in the last year)

• Ability to pass a pre employment background check

jobs.title: Business Development, Healthcare
jobs.description:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.



About the Role

Decagon is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a healthcare leader to join the Founder's Office and drive our expansion across Payer, Provider, Life Sciences, and Health Tech. You'll help shape our healthcare strategy, build trusted relationships with senior industry leaders, and translate those relationships into strategic partnerships and commercial growth.

Working closely with Decagon's founders, executive team, and healthcare go-to-market leaders, you'll identify where AI agents can deliver the greatest value across healthcare. You'll bring a strong understanding of healthcare economics, organizational structures, and operational challenges, from claims and contact centers to patient access, pharmacy, and care management. 

This role combines industry strategy, executive relationship development, and commercial execution, requiring the judgment and credibility to navigate complex healthcare organizations and position AI solutions in a highly regulated environment.



In this role, you will

 - Shape our healthcare growth. Identify priority segments, accounts, use cases, and partnerships to accelerate Decagon's expansion across the U.S. healthcare market.

 - Build executive relationships. Develop trusted relationships with C-suite executives, senior decision-makers, and industry leaders across Payer, Provider, Life Sciences, and Health Tech.

 - Advance strategic opportunities. Partner with Decagon's founders and healthcare go-to-market teams to originate and accelerate enterprise opportunities, navigate complex buying processes, and build alignment across business, clinical, technology, and compliance stakeholders.

 - Connect technology to business outcomes. Identify high-value applications for AI agents across healthcare operations, balancing business impact with clinical safety, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

 - Develop strategic partnerships. Build relationships with consulting firms, systems integrators, EHR and health-tech platforms, contact center and BPO partners, and industry associations to expand Decagon's reach.

 - Activate our investor and advisor networks. Leverage existing relationships to open doors, deepen executive engagement, and advance strategic opportunities.

 - Represent Decagon in the market. Engage healthcare leaders through executive briefings, industry conferences, private events, and partner meetings.

 - Bring market insight into Decagon. Translate customer and partner feedback into recommendations for positioning, product priorities, and healthcare-specific trust and compliance requirements.



Your background looks something like this

 - 8–10 years of experience in healthcare, health technology, strategic growth, business development, or partnerships, with a track record of driving commercial outcomes.

 - Strong understanding of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem, including healthcare economics, operational challenges, and enterprise technology buying processes, with meaningful expertise in one or more of Payer, Provider, Life Sciences, or Health Tech.

 - Established relationships with senior healthcare executives, operators, and industry partners, with the credibility to engage C-suite leaders and key decision-makers.

 - Demonstrated ability to develop executive relationships and translate them into strategic partnerships, enterprise opportunities, and measurable business growth.

 - Familiarity with healthcare regulatory, privacy, and security requirements, including HIPAA, PHI, and BAAs, and the ability to navigate conversations with clinical, legal, and technology stakeholders.

 - Strong executive presence, commercial judgment, and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across business, clinical, and technical functions.

 - An entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to set priorities, operate independently, and execute in a fast-moving environment.

 - Willingness to travel for executive meetings, industry events, and strategic opportunities.



Benefits

jobs.title: Identity Operations Engineer Consultant - Access Lifecycle & Automation
jobs.description:
ABOUT KALLES GROUP:

Everyone deserves to be secure. Our mission at Kalles Group is to help secure the future for companies of all shapes and sizes.

While our expertise spans multiple disciplines, our method remains consistent: building trust and relationship with people -- whether you are a client, a consultant, or--in this case--a candidate.

No matter what role you come from--whether you're an executive or just starting your career-you can expect our highest level of attention and respect. We want to find the right fit for each role, but we also want you to find the right fit for your career.

We believe the best way to show you what our team is like is to treat you like you're already a part of it. We hope you'll consider joining our team of experienced professionals who are building their careers at Kalles Group—and having fun while doing it.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

As an Identity Operations Engineer with Kalles Group, you’ll be on assignment with one of our enterprise clients, supporting workforce, partner and contractor access across Microsoft Entra ID and SailPoint Identity Security Cloud while the client moves application authentication from a legacy identity provider to Entra. This is a hands-on operations role. Most of your time will go to working the identity ticket queue: joiner/mover/leaver events, access requests, provisioning and hybrid sync failures, privileged access, access certifications, and audit evidence for SOX and PCI. The rest of your time you’ll spend automating repeat work with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, SailPoint ISC APIs and workflow tools such as Logic Apps, Power Automate and Azure Automation/Functions, all integrated with the ITSM platform. When access breaks, you’ll be the go-to escalation point, working closely with Identity Architecture, HR, ITSM, application owners and Security Operations to resolve issues quickly and prevent repeats. This is a hybrid role in Seattle, with after-hours support as needed.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

IDENTITY LIFECYCLE OPERATIONS (Joiner / Mover / Leaver)

• Fulfill JML requests from the ITSM queue within SLA – account creation, baseline/role-based access, transfers & promotions, timely deprovisioning (terms, contractors, leaves).

• Operate SailPoint ISC day to day – access requests, provisioning failures, aggregations & identity refreshes, attribute/source-data fixes, role & access profile assignments.

• Administer Entra ID – users, groups (incl. dynamic), licensing, enterprise app role assignments, guests, Lifecycle Workflows and Entitlement Management requests.

• Troubleshoot HR-to-identity provisioning and hybrid sync (Entra Connect / Cloud Sync) – attribute mismatches, duplicate/conflicting accounts.

• Handle privileged/elevated access (PIM eligible assignments, role-assignable groups) with approvals and audit trail.

• Support app access – SSO (SAML/OIDC) assignments, SCIM errors, onboarding apps/connectors to established patterns.

• Run access certification / review campaigns operationally and produce audit evidence (SOX, PCI).

• Ongoing account hygiene – orphaned/dormant/stale accounts, guest cleanup, service account inventory, Entra/SailPoint/AD reconciliation.

AUTOMATION & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

• Build lifecycle/access automation with PowerShell, Graph API / Graph PowerShell SDK, Python, SailPoint ISC APIs, workflows and rules.

• Event-driven/scheduled workflows (Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Power Automate, Azure Functions) with ITSM ticket auto-fulfillment and closure.

• Analyze ticket volume, SLAs and failure patterns to target automation; track tickets eliminated, time saved, error reduction.

• Treat automation as production code – source control, peer review, testing, logging, error handling. Use AI tooling to speed scripting and troubleshooting.

ACROSS THE ROLE

• Write runbooks, SOPs and KB articles; serve as escalation point for service desk and app teams.

• Partner with HR/HRIS, ITSM and SecOps on data quality, lifecycle timing and identity signals.

• Participate in identity incident response, including after-hours support as needed.

ABOUT YOU:

Your values:

• Integrity: You believe in doing the right thing, even when it's uncomfortable, seemingly inefficient, or costly. Purposefulness: You have a desire to serve others with your skillset and an openness to continuous learning and growth. Ownership: You stick to your commitments, follow up with action, and seek clarity in communication & expectations.

YOUR EXPERIENCE:

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's/master's in CS, Cybersecurity, IT, or equivalent experience.

• 3+ years in IAM, IAM operations, or systems/security engineering, including hands-on JML processes.

• Hands-on Entra ID user/group/app admin; working knowledge of Conditional Access, PIM, and Entra ID Governance (Lifecycle Workflows, Entitlement Management, Access Reviews).

• Hands-on enterprise IGA operations – SailPoint ISC/IdentityNow preferred (comparable IGA considered): access requests, provisioning, source connectors, troubleshooting.

• PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API / Graph PowerShell SDK required; Python and REST API integration strongly valued.

• Working knowledge of SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM sufficient to troubleshoot SSO/provisioning.

• Hybrid identity – on-prem AD, Entra Connect / Cloud Sync; sync and attribute troubleshooting.

• ITSM ticketing (e.g., ServiceNow), managing queues against SLAs, documenting to audit standards.

• Strong troubleshooting, attention to detail, clear communication with technical and non-technical partners.

Preferred Qualifications

• Certifications: SC-300, SailPoint ISC, AZ-500, Security+, or CISSP.

• ITSM-integrated automation (e.g., ServiceNow → SailPoint or Entra fulfillment).

• Low-code automation (Power Automate, Logic Apps) and IaC/config-as-code (Terraform, Bicep).

• HRIS-driven provisioning (e.g., Workday) and source-of-truth data quality.

• PAM familiarity (e.g., BeyondTrust) and PAM/PIM interplay.

• Audit/compliance support (SOX, PCI) for access controls and evidence.

• ITDR exposure; identity signals into SIEM/SOAR.

• Large-scale retail, ecommerce, or high-transaction enterprise experience.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• The annual salary range for this role is $120,000-$140,000.

• We offer Medical, Dental, Vision plans, 401K with matching, and PTO for salaried employees.

• Work/life balance – we know there’s more to life than work! We encourage our team to pursue other passions, get outside, and spend time with family. We work with clients and consultants to set expectations for a manageable workload.

LOCATION:

This role is hybrid with onsite requirements at our client's location in Seattle, WA.  Therefore, we are currently only considering candidates that are already living in the Seattle area.

HOW TO APPLY:

Please fill out the form below (including uploading your most recent resume) and we'll be in touch! We know imposter syndrome can be a barrier to many great applicants. We hope you'll still consider applying. That's why we've made the application process as short and simple as possible.

Even if you're not a fit for the role, you can expect to hear back from us! We want you to have the best experience as a candidate, so please feel free to share feedback at any stage of the process to talent@kallesgroup.com.

Kalles Group is an equal-opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of creed, nationality, race, ethnicity, disability, gender, or other protected class.

jobs.title: M&A Accouting and Integration Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR



Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.



About the Role



Mercor expands via strategic acquisitions, where critical financial risks surface within due diligence findings, transaction structures, and post-closing operational timelines. As Strategic Transactions Lead, you will spearhead the accounting workstream across every transaction, managing processes from post-LOI confirmatory diligence through the initial post-close annual audit.



Serving as the Controller team's representative on deal execution pods, you will partner closely with Corporate Finance, Legal, Business Operations, and Integration leads to ensure seamless financial consolidation. This key foundational role requires an operational builder who will construct robust diligence frameworks, establish key performance metrics, and scale M&A infrastructure alongside rapid acquisition velocity.



What You'll Do





CONFIRMATORY DILIGENCE

 - Direct post-LOI accounting due diligence, evaluating historical quality of earnings, revenue recognition policies, cap table structures, tax liabilities, and vendor obligations.

 - Construct scalable diligence playbooks tailored across diverse transaction types, including acquihires, IP assets, and complex business combinations.

 - Deliver comprehensive accounting readiness evaluations prior to execution, highlighting material risks and structuring implications.

 - Analyze definitive transaction documentation and settlement flows, advising leadership on earnouts, working capital adjustments, escrow holdbacks, and equity rollovers.
   
   


DEAL ACCOUNTING

 - Oversee third-party valuation specialists on purchase price allocations, intangible asset valuations, and contingent consideration models.

 - Evaluate financial statement impacts for proposed deal mechanics and talent retention structures to guide executive decision-making.

 - Coordinate Day 1 close readiness across financial systems, payroll platforms, banking structures, and internal governance controls.
   
   


POST-MERGER INTEGRATION

 - Lead the end-to-end accounting integration roadmap, including opening balance sheets, general ledger mappings, ERP migrations, policy alignment, and intercompany settlements.

 - Translate purchase terms into actionable operational milestones, aligning dependencies closely with the broader Corporate Development integration team.

 - Manage concurrent integration tracks across multiple acquired entities, maintaining delivery timelines and resolving operational blockers.

 - Transition acquired business units into Mercor's internal control environment and SOX-compliant reporting frameworks.

 - Serve as the main financial liaison for target leadership teams throughout the post-acquisition transition period.
   
   


PROGRAM GOVERNANCE

 - Manage measurement-period adjustments, earnout tracking, intangible asset amortization schedules, and annual goodwill impairment testing.

 - Represent Mercor as the lead contact for external audit partners regarding complex M&A transactions.

 - Develop standardized M&A accounting toolkits, standardized templates, and cross-functional decision trees.

 - Conduct deal retrospectives while tracking performance metrics like close-cycle duration and post-close audit adjustments.

 - Mentor junior team members and review technical deliverables to build team capability.



What We're Looking For



 - 6+ years of combined experience across technical accounting, Big 4 audit, or transaction advisory services

 - 2+ years of in-house financeops experience within high-growth, venture-backed technology environments

 - Proven track record leading M&A accounting end-to-end across multiple closed acquisitions

 - Deep expertise in US GAAP technical frameworks, including ASC 805, ASC 606, ASC 718, and ASC 820

 - Strong operational execution skills, you convert transaction terms into clear, actionable integration workstreams

 - Exceptional communication skills, ability to translate technical accounting positions to cross-functional executives, legal counsel, and auditors

 - Active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license
   
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Direct experience accounting for acquihires, including retention vs. consideration evaluation

 - Background in Big 4 financial due diligence (FDD) or deal advisory practices

 - Experience establishing an M&A accounting practice, playbooks, and governance frameworks from scratch

 - Demonstrated capability managing multiple concurrent transaction integrations under tight timelines

 - Familiarity with cross-border acquisition structures and foreign subsidiary integration

 - Experience working in fast-paced AI or hyper-growth technology environments




Compensation

 - Base cash comp from $175K - $210k

 - Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

 - Up to $15k Relocation bonus

 - $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Free Equinox membership

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

 - Health, Dental, Vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Enterprise AI solutions - Automotive
jobs.description:
At Podium, we bring AI Employees to local businesses that turn every conversation into revenue. Trusted by 60,000+ businesses across Auto, Home Services, and Aesthetics, Podium captures and converts leads 24/7, driving both new business and repeat customers.

In under 24 months, we crossed $100M in AI Agent ARR, scaling 300% year-over-year. During this time, we’ve deployed 10,000 AI employees to empower real business outcomes for our customers. Podium is building what we believe will be the most impactful AI employee ecosystem for local business.

Podium has been recognized as the Best AI Implementation by Inc. Magazine, highlighted by OpenAI for building revenue-driving AI Agents, and awarded the #1 AI Agent for Business Operations by G2.

Our growth is fueled by hiring exceptional people, holding them to high standards, and creating opportunities for them to grow and make an impact. Our operating principles guide daily behavior and ensure we hire people who will thrive at Podium. If you're hungry for growth, aligned to our operating principles, and ready to get to work, you won't find a better place to learn and accelerate your career.

At Podium, our mission is to arm every local business with a complete platform and outcome-driven AI employees that convert leads into real, paying customers. Every day, millions of workers use our AI lead conversion and communication platform to help them get more leads and make more money.

Help enterprise automotive groups turn AI into a better way to run their businesses. At Podium, you will lead the team responsible for helping strategic automotive customers deploy AI, change how their teams work, and deliver measurable results across sales and service.

You will work directly with dealer group executives and dealership leaders to identify opportunities, build an AI adoption roadmap, and turn that roadmap into operational change across multiple locations. This role combines executive advisory work with people leadership and accountability for customer retention and growth.

We are looking for someone who can structure an ambiguous business problem, earn the trust of senior leaders, and stay close to execution. You could come from management consulting, technology transformation, enterprise solutions, or customer success; what matters is your ability to lead teams and deliver business outcomes.

What you will do

• Lead and develop a team serving Podium’s enterprise automotive customers. Set clear priorities, coach executive communication and problem solving, and hold the team accountable for adoption, customer outcomes, retention, and growth.

• Advise dealer group executives, owners, and general managers on where AI can improve their operations. Translate business priorities into practical plans with clear milestones, owners, and measures of success.

• Lead discovery into sales and service workflows. Identify where processes, employee roles, handoffs, and human oversight need to change for AI to deliver value.

• Oversee AI deployments and adoption across multiple locations, partnering with onboarding and technical teams on readiness, rollout, training, and ongoing improvement.

• Build the business case for AI and demonstrate results through executive reviews. Use performance data to explain what is working, diagnose gaps, and recommend specific actions.

• Own retention and growth across the portfolio. Identify risks early, lead recovery plans, and partner with Sales on expansion opportunities grounded in proven customer value.

• Bring customer insights to Product and Engineering. Help prioritize recurring problems and opportunities, coordinate resolution of critical issues, and close the loop with customers.

• Build repeatable discovery methods, rollout playbooks, and reporting that allow the team to scale effective practices across automotive groups.

• Travel 15% to 20% of the time for customer engagements, onsite working sessions, and executive meetings.

What you will bring

• Experience leading enterprise client engagements in management consulting, technology transformation, enterprise solutions, professional services, or customer success. Experience at a leading consulting firm is a plus.

• A track record of managing and developing high-performing teams, with clear accountability for customer or business results.

• Strong executive presence and communication skills. You can lead a working session, challenge assumptions constructively, and make a clear recommendation to senior decision makers.

• Strong analytical and commercial judgment. You can build a business case, assess ROI, and connect product adoption to operational performance, retention, and growth.

• Practical understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, with experience applying AI to business workflows. You can translate between business stakeholders and technical teams.

• Experience delivering complex programs across multiple stakeholders or locations, including the process changes and employee adoption required to sustain results.

• An interest in automotive and a willingness to learn dealership operations in depth. Experience working with dealerships or other distributed, multi-location businesses is a plus.

• Ownership and sound judgment in a fast-moving environment. You can move from strategic recommendations to detailed execution and help your team do the same.

Benefits

• Open and transparent culture

• Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage

• Paid maternity and paternity leave

• Fertility Benefits

• Generous vacation time, plus three 4-day summer holiday weekends

• Excellent medical, dental, and vision benefits

• 401k Plan

• Bi-annual swag drops with cool Podium gear and apparel

• A stellar HQ (Utah) gym with local professional coaches and classes offered

• Onsite HQ (Utah) child care center, subsidized for employees

Podium is an equal opportunity employer. Podium provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Global Payroll Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR



Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.



About the Role



Mercor is seeking a high-execution payroll leader to spearhead global payroll delivery while scaling our underlying operational infrastructure. In this role, you will hold end-to-end accountability for payroll execution schedules, vendor governance, internal controls, general ledger reconciliations, and complex issue resolution, all while driving high-impact automation initiatives. Additionally, you will orchestrate the seamless transition of acquired talent onto Mercor's unified payroll architecture.




Working cross-functionally, you will collaborate closely with Accounting, People Ops, Finance Systems, Legal, and international payroll partners. This position demands a mix of strategic oversight and hands-on execution—diving deep into operational mechanics, driving swift decision-making within structured framework guidelines, and proactively flagging operational bottlenecks to executive leadership.



What You'll Do


 - Run employee payroll cycles across assigned countries, coordinating inputs, validations, approvals, funding deadlines, and provider processing so employees are paid accurately and on time.

 -  Review new hires, departures, compensation changes, bonuses, benefits, deductions, and equity-related payroll inputs with functional owners; investigate exceptions before approval.

 -  Reconcile payroll outputs to approved inputs, funding, and accounting records. Partner with Accounting on journals, accruals, balance sheet reconciliations, and month-end close.

 - Maintain country calendars and evidence of required filings and remittances, working with providers and local advisers to resolve issues and complete year-end activities.

 - Lead payroll workstreams for acquisitions and new-country launches, including data mapping, cutover planning, testing, parallel runs where appropriate, and post-launch reconciliation.

 -  Improve HRIS-to-payroll data flows, approval workflows, and reporting. Deliver scoped implementations and vendor transitions with documented requirements and acceptance criteria.

 -  Build operating procedures, backup coverage, access controls, and audit evidence, maintaining separate preparation and approval responsibilities for payroll and payments.

 -  Resolve employee pay questions clearly and promptly. Track accuracy, on-time delivery, reconciliation aging, and issue resolution, and address recurring causes.

 - Automate repeatable checks and reporting using approved tools, with validation, human review, and appropriate protection of employee data.



What We're Looking For


 -  7+ years of progressive payroll experience in high-growth tech startups

 - Hands-on ownership of US payroll and experience delivering payroll in additional countries through local teams or providers.

 - Strong understanding of payroll processing, reconciliations, statutory deadlines, controls, and year-end reporting, with judgment about when to involve local tax or legal specialists.

 - Experience delivering a payroll optimization, vendor transition, acquisition integration, or new-country launch from planning through stabilization.

 - Practical experience with an enterprise HRIS and payroll platform, including data validation, reporting, testing, and troubleshooting. Rippling or comparable systems experience is valuable.

 - Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing deadlines and influence partners without direct authority.

 - Clear communication, sound judgment with confidential information, and willingness to stay close to operational work.

 -  A degree in Accounting, Finance, HR, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.



NICE TO HAVE

 - EMEA or APAC payroll

 - Equity or mobility payroll

 - Hourly payroll and timekeeping

 - CPP or comparable certification




Compensation

 - Base cash comp from $160K - $185k

 - Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

 - Up to $15k Relocation bonus

 - $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Free Equinox membership

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

 - Health, Dental, Vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

The Solutions Consulting team is responsible for knowing the intimate details of all Upstart’s products and the associated economics. Members of this team must turn that knowledge into solutions and partnership models for prospective lending partners, able to simply explain and educate partners.

As a Solutions Consultant at Upstart, you will drive adoption of lending partners to the Upstart platform.

How you’ll make an impact

• Function as a solutions consultant, translating ambiguous questions into structured analyses with proven ability to communicate complex analyses clearly and concisely to external stakeholders

• Serve as the owner for deal-related analyses, supporting new and existing LP partnerships across all Upstart products

• Analyze deal economics, performance tradeoffs, risk/return profiles, and product configurations across Upstart’s offering

• Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations that inform deal structuring, pricing, and strategic decisions

• Act as business partner to Capital Markets, Sales, Product, and Finance teams

Minimum Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience in solutions consulting, strategy, analytics or a related role

• SQL/Python proficiency and comfort working directly with data

• Experience building dashboards or recurring reporting (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, or similar tools)

• Strong stakeholder management skills and comfort operating in cross-functional environments

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Staff/Principal Design Systems Lead
jobs.description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.




APPLYING TO RENDER

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

How we build software is changing. Designers are prototyping in code, engineers are shipping polished interfaces, and agents are starting to build directly into the product. More people and more things can create software than ever before. That makes design judgment more important, not less.

We're looking for a Staff/Principal Founding Design Systems Lead to build that judgment into Render's foundations.

This isn't about maintaining a component library. It's about enabling designers, engineers, and agents to build experiences that look, feel, and work like Render, without a designer making every decision or the design systems team reviewing every change. At a company whose whole promise is a platform that just works, the design system is how we keep craft scaling as the product and the team grows.

This role starts hands-on. You're a designer first, with the technical depth to get into the code. You'll partner with the Head of Design to set the vision, then do the foundational work yourself: decide where or whether our Figma library lives and how it operates, get deep into what an AI-ready design system really means, and prototype, test, and ship the system in code. As the function grows, you'll build and lead the team around it. You're energized by building from the ground up, not inheriting something finished.

Here's what makes this role urgent and specific to us: our users are developers, and they're increasingly building with AI agents. That cuts both ways. Inside Render, teams reach for an agent before they check the docs — so a system that isn't legible to AI quietly gets bypassed, and quality drifts toward generic output. And externally, we're building the platform where developers deploy AI-native apps and agents. The person in this role treats the design system as infrastructure for humans, machines, and velocity and has a point of view on what that takes: machine-readable documentation, system rules exposed where agents can read them, an architecture that keeps the brand and accessibility layers ours, and evaluations that catch drift before it ships.

This role reports to the Head of Design.




THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF YOU'RE EXCITED BY:

Making great design reproducible, by people and agents. Raise the quality of Render's product and encode what makes it good, so a designer, an engineer, or an agent can produce coherent, usable experiences by default. The system should make excellent work easier, not make every experience look the same.

Reimagining what a design system can be. Build beyond components and tokens into composition rules, interaction patterns, agent-readable guidance, and evaluations, so the fastest way to build is also a path to great quality.

Building and leading a team that multiplies everyone else's impact. Start hands-on, then create the direction, ambitious goals, and caring-but-demanding environment that let a team do the best work of their careers.

The opportunity is to raise the floor for everyone building at Render, human or agent, while giving designers more room to make the most important experiences extraordinary.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Set the system's vision and direction. Decide what to preserve, evolve, simplify, or replace based on what builders and customers need — and turn that into focused work, much of which you'll do yourself at first.

 - Build the foundations hands-on. Early on, you are the team: setting the architecture, shipping the components, writing the guidance, and establishing the quality bar through your own work before there's anyone to delegate to.

 - Build and lead the team that owns the system. As the function grows, hire and develop it — set priorities and ownership, give direct feedback, hold a high bar, and help people do the best work of their careers.

 - Elevate Render's visual and interaction design. Raise the bar for typography, hierarchy, density, motion, responsive behavior, accessibility — and the states beyond the happy path, which is where developer tools earn their reputation.

 - Make the system legible to AI, not just humans. Lead the work to make Render's design system AI-ready: machine-readable documentation, system rules and tokens exposed where agents can reach them (e.g. via MCP), and an architecture that shrinks the context an agent needs while keeping the brand and accessibility layers ours. The goal: agents building on Render produce on-brand, compliant work by default.

 - Guide technical architecture with engineering. Shape everything from components and tokens to how agents discover guidance and check their work. Make sound tradeoffs between flexibility, coherence, performance, and ease of use — layered and headless where that scales better than rigid bundles.

 - Define and measure quality, including AI output. Build repeatable evaluations grounded in real tasks — testing generated output against the system's standard, not just whether people use the tools.

 - Earn adoption. Work alongside product teams, teach through examples, and turn recurring questions and exceptions into improvements. A system lives or dies on whether people, and their agents, reach for it.

 - Keep moving as the ground shifts. Experiment as models and tools evolve, share what you learn, and change direction when the evidence calls for it.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - A track record of setting direction and delivering outcomes in design systems or design engineering — and the appetite to build a function from the ground up before leading a team. You create clarity in ambiguity, make decisions, give difficult feedback, and keep momentum without dropping the quality bar. Experience leading or developing designers/design engineers is a strong plus, as this role grows in that area.

 - Exceptional visual and interaction design skills. Your work shows a clear point of view, detail that borders on obsessive, and an ability to make complex experiences feel simple — the kind of craft other practitioners admire.

 - Deep systems thinking, and experience building systems other teams actually adopt. You can show how your work improved both their speed and the quality of what shipped — not just that it existed.

 - Strong technical fluency. You can prototype and build in code, understand front-end architecture (component API design, tokens, theming, layered/headless patterns), and work through implementation tradeoffs with engineers — not just hand off specs.

 - Hands-on use of AI in your work, and a real point of view on AI-ready design systems. You understand where AI helps and where it fails, how to improve its output rather than accept it, and what it takes for a system to serve machines as well as humans. You don't need to have shipped all of it, but you should be able to say where you'd start and why.

 - Strong product judgment and developer empathy. You stay close to the people who use what you build and connect system decisions to real workflows and outcomes. Fluency with developers and technical products is a strong plus — our users are engineers, and the system has to serve them and the agents they build with.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience building developer tools, cloud platforms, or infrastructure products where UX is a competitive advantage.

 - Hands-on experience making a design system AI-ready: machine-readable documentation, MCP or similar agent access, layered/headless architecture, or evaluation frameworks for AI-generated output.

 - Experience building developer or designer tools that became part of other teams' daily workflow.

 - Experience leading a major design-system migration or a company-wide change in how teams build.

 - Experience evolving a system across platforms, or connecting product and brand experiences.

 - Founder or early-stage startup experience.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.




BENEFITS

 - 4 weeks of paid vacation.

 - 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

 - Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

 - 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

 - Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

 - Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

 - Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

 - Continuous learning benefits & related support.

jobs.title: Principal, Marketing Insights
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About the role

The Principal of Marketing Insights sits at the intersection of growth strategy, investment planning, and performance analytics. You’ll partner with the office of CMO, marketing leadership, and cross-functional analytics teams to determine where we invest, how we improve performance, and what it will take to achieve our growth targets. You’ll translate business goals and performance insights into clear priorities, resource decisions, and coordinated action across Marketing. This includes shaping pipeline strategy, evaluating investment tradeoffs, and identifying opportunities to improve conversion, velocity, and efficiency across regions, segments, and growth motions. This is a high-visibility leadership role during a period of significant organizational change. We’re looking for someone who brings structure to ambiguity, challenges assumptions with sound business judgment, and drives decisions through to measurable results. You’ll work closely with marketing leaders, Finance, GTM Operations, Technical Marketing Ops, and Central Analytics to connect strategy, investment, and execution.

What you’ll do

Growth strategy & planning: Translate company growth targets into marketing plans with clear priorities, investment requirements, and performance assumptions. Lead the analytical foundation for annual and quarterly planning, developing scenarios that evaluate growth opportunities, resource needs, and tradeoffs. Own marketing’s pipeline planning models and assumptions, coordinating inputs across regions, segments, channels, and motions. Identify the highest-impact opportunities to improve pipeline generation, conversion, and velocity; partner with functional leaders to turn those opportunities into action.
Investment strategy & efficiency: Shape recommendations for allocating resources across programs, channels, regions, and segments based on expected business impact. Evaluate tradeoffs between headcount and program investment, partnering with Finance and marketing leaders to improve resource productivity. Identify where to scale, reduce, or reallocate spend, and measure whether those decisions improve pipeline yield and marketing efficiency. Develop models that connect marketing investment to pipeline and revenue outcomes, making assumptions and uncertainties clear.

Program management & accountability: Lead weekly and monthly marketing performance reviews, focusing leadership on the decisions and actions needed to achieve targets. Proactively identify performance risks, diagnose root causes, and align leaders on corrective actions, owners, and timelines. Track actions and assess their impact, adjusting the approach when results fall short. Lead cross-functional initiatives across Marketing, XDR, Sales, Finance, and Analytics, resolving dependencies and escalating decisions when needed.

Insights & measurement: Set the strategic analysis agenda around the business questions most consequential to marketing growth and efficiency. Define the metrics, scorecards, and decision tools marketing leaders need to manage performance. Partner with Analytics to deliver scalable reporting and with Marketing Ops to ensure consistent definitions, reliable tracking, and data quality. Translate complex analysis into clear executive narratives that explain what is happening, why it matters, and what action to take.

Skills we’re looking for

• 8+ years experience in marketing strategy, GTM analytics, or business performance within B2B SaaS, with scope and impact consistent with director-level leadership.

• A demonstrated record of influencing investment decisions and delivering measurable improvements in pipeline, conversion, or marketing efficiency.

• Experience developing growth plans, pipeline models, investment scenarios, and performance assumptions.

• Strong business judgment and a clear point of view, with the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders constructively and build alignment around difficult tradeoffs.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive recommendations through to execution and results.

• Ability to independently structure ambiguous problems and balance speed with analytical rigor.

• Deep understanding of B2B SaaS metrics, including pipeline, ARR, conversion, velocity, acquisition costs, and attribution.

• Hands-on fluency with SQL and BI tools such as Looker, enabling independent investigation and effective partnership with Analytics.

• Working knowledge of Salesforce and marketing automation platforms such as Marketo.

• Clear executive communication, with the ability to connect detailed analysis to business decisions.

Bonus Skills

• Experience navigating a merger, organizational integration, or significant GTM transformation.

• Experience with experiment design, incrementality measurement, predictive modeling, or cohort analysis.

• Familiarity with the modern data stack, including Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, and Looker.

• Background in data infrastructure, developer tools, or analytics software.

Simply Put, A Great Place to Work

Benesch is a growing, multi-disciplined planning, engineering, and professional services firm. We enhance infrastructure and communities across the country – creating spaces and providing connections in ways that make a difference.

We pride ourselves on being nimble enough to remain responsive to client needs yet large enough to offer exceptional bench strength. As a member of our team, you’ll have an opportunity to draw from those resources when you need them and, likewise, contribute your expertise when you have something to share.

At Benesch, we are looking for candidates with varied backgrounds and worldviews. We are committed to offering an inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and respected. Statistics show that women and underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a position if they don’t meet 100% of the qualifications. If this statement resonates with you, don’t be so hard on yourself—apply for the job!

Structural Designer

Benesch is hiring a Structural Designer to join our Franklin or Nashville office. As a Structural Designer, you will have the opportunity to design various types of vehicular and pedestrian bridges – from simple to complex bridges.

Location

This position will work out of our Franklin or Nashville office on a hybrid work schedule.

The Impact You Will Have

• Performing basic analysis of project elements

• Performing load development and designing calculations of project elements and checking work

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff — Agent Post-Training
jobs.description:
Introducing Moonlake, AI for creating world simulations.


ABOUT MOONLAKE

Moonlake is building the frontier of interactive world models: systems that generate, simulate, and reason over 3D environments for robotics, embodied AI, and interactive applications.

We develop the infrastructure that enables intelligent systems to learn, evaluate, and interact within realistic virtual environments before operating in the physical world.

Our work sits at the intersection of:

 - Robotics

 - Embodied AI

 - Interactive 3D Worlds

 - World Models

 - Simulation Infrastructure

 - Physical AI

Moonlake is building the next generation of AI infrastructure for interactive digital worlds. Our mission is to enable anyone to create, simulate, and interact with rich environments using natural language and multimodal inputs, turning simple ideas into worlds with structure, physics, and intelligent behavior.

Our team has raised $50M in seed funding from NVIDIA Ventures, Threshold Ventures, AIX Ventures, and notable angels including Naval Ravikant and Jeff Dean to build the foundational layer for the future of AI—powering everything from robotics training and simulation to digital twins and interactive environments.

We are looking for exceptional engineers to help build the simulation systems that will power the next generation of robotics and embodied intelligence.


THE ROLE

We are hiring a Member of Technical Staff to lead reinforcement learning infrastructure and model post-training.

You will work closely with Qi and the research team to improve large vision-language and code-generating agents through fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, trajectory data, and scalable evaluation.

Moonlake already has deep expertise in 3D and world-building. This role adds the model-training experience needed to systematically improve agent performance and prepare the company for larger-scale RL across both digital and physical environments.

We are looking for a full-stack researcher and engineer who understands the complete training system and can make strong judgments about when training is necessary, which methods are likely to work, and what not to pursue.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build RL and post-training pipelines for multimodal, vision-language, and code-generating agents

 - Develop infrastructure for supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, reward modeling, and reinforcement learning

 - Create systems for collecting, filtering, replaying, and learning from agent trajectories

 - Design rewards, verifiers, and evaluations for long-horizon agent tasks

 - Improve agents’ ability to plan, write and execute code, use tools, recover from errors, and complete complex workflows

 - Scale distributed training and high-throughput rollout generation across multi-GPU environments

 - Improve training reliability, reproducibility, observability, and cost efficiency

 - Help define Moonlake’s long-term strategy for agent, robotics, and embodied-model training


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Real-world experience training large language, vision-language, multimodal, or code models

 - Strong experience in reinforcement learning, post-training, or large-scale fine-tuning

 - Experience building distributed training or high-throughput inference systems

 - Familiarity with supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, reward modeling, and agentic RL

 - Experience with code-generation agents, long-horizon evaluation, or tool-using systems

 - Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, JAX, or similar frameworks

 - Ability to work across data, models, environments, rewards, evaluation, and infrastructure

 - Strong research judgment and a bias toward building reliable systems


PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Experience at a frontier AI lab or organization operating large-scale training systems

 - Experience with code-model post-training or autonomous coding agents

 - Experience with multimodal models, robotics, simulation, or embodied AI

 - Experience designing verifiable rewards or outcome-based training systems

 - Experience scaling RL workloads across large GPU clusters


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first year, you will have:

 - Built Moonlake’s core post-training and RL infrastructure

 - Created scalable systems for learning from agent trajectories

 - Delivered measurable improvements in agent quality and task completion

 - Helped the team determine which problems require training and which do not

 - Established a reliable foundation for larger-scale agent and embodied-model training


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Moonlake’s agents must do more than generate content. They must understand complex requests, reason across vision and language, write and execute code, operate tools, build interactive worlds, and recover from mistakes.

This role will build the training systems that allow those agents to continuously improve.

We are committed to being an on-site, in-person team currently based in San Francisco.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff — RL & Agentic Model Training
jobs.description:
Introducing Moonlake, AI for creating world simulations.


ABOUT MOONLAKE

Moonlake is building the frontier of interactive world models: systems that generate, simulate, and reason over 3D environments for robotics, embodied AI, and interactive applications.

We develop the infrastructure that enables intelligent systems to learn, evaluate, and interact within realistic virtual environments before operating in the physical world.

Our work sits at the intersection of:

 - Robotics

 - Embodied AI

 - Interactive 3D Worlds

 - World Models

 - Simulation Infrastructure

 - Physical AI

Moonlake is building the next generation of AI infrastructure for interactive digital worlds. Our mission is to enable anyone to create, simulate, and interact with rich environments using natural language and multimodal inputs, turning simple ideas into worlds with structure, physics, and intelligent behavior.

Our team has raised $50M in seed funding from NVIDIA Ventures, Threshold Ventures, AIX Ventures, and notable angels including Naval Ravikant and Jeff Dean to build the foundational layer for the future of AI—powering everything from robotics training and simulation to digital twins and interactive environments.

We are looking for exceptional engineers to help build the simulation systems that will power the next generation of robotics and embodied intelligence.


THE ROLE

We are hiring a Member of Technical Staff to lead reinforcement learning infrastructure and agentic model post-training.

You will work closely with Qi and the research team to improve large vision-language and code-generating agents through fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, trajectory data, and scalable evaluation.

Moonlake already has deep expertise in 3D and world-building. This role adds the model-training experience needed to systematically improve agent performance and prepare the company for larger-scale RL across both digital and physical environments.

We are looking for a full-stack researcher and engineer who understands the complete training system and can make strong judgments about when training is necessary, which methods are likely to work, and what not to pursue.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build RL and post-training pipelines for multimodal, vision-language, and code-generating agents

 - Develop infrastructure for supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, reward modeling, and reinforcement learning

 - Create systems for collecting, filtering, replaying, and learning from agent trajectories

 - Design rewards, verifiers, and evaluations for long-horizon agent tasks

 - Improve agents’ ability to plan, write and execute code, use tools, recover from errors, and complete complex workflows

 - Scale distributed training and high-throughput rollout generation across multi-GPU environments

 - Improve training reliability, reproducibility, observability, and cost efficiency

 - Help define Moonlake’s long-term strategy for agent, robotics, and embodied-model training


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Real-world experience training large language, vision-language, multimodal, or code models

 - Strong experience in reinforcement learning, post-training, or large-scale fine-tuning

 - Experience building distributed training or high-throughput inference systems

 - Familiarity with supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, reward modeling, and agentic RL

 - Experience with code-generation agents, long-horizon evaluation, or tool-using systems

 - Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, JAX, or similar frameworks

 - Ability to work across data, models, environments, rewards, evaluation, and infrastructure

 - Strong research judgment and a bias toward building reliable systems


PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Experience at a frontier AI lab or organization operating large-scale training systems

 - Experience with code-model post-training or autonomous coding agents

 - Experience with multimodal models, robotics, simulation, or embodied AI

 - Experience designing verifiable rewards or outcome-based training systems

 - Experience scaling RL workloads across large GPU clusters


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first year, you will have:

 - Built Moonlake’s core post-training and RL infrastructure

 - Created scalable systems for learning from agent trajectories

 - Delivered measurable improvements in agent quality and task completion

 - Helped the team determine which problems require training and which do not

 - Established a reliable foundation for larger-scale agent and embodied-model training


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Moonlake’s agents must do more than generate content. They must understand complex requests, reason across vision and language, write and execute code, operate tools, build interactive worlds, and recover from mistakes.

This role will build the training systems that allow those agents to continuously improve.

We are committed to being an on-site, in-person team currently based in San Francisco.
