jobs.title: Pharmacy Technician III-OR Pharmacies, Full-time Rotating Shifts
jobs.description:
The Pharmacy Technician III reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Under the direction of a registered pharmacist, performs all technical duties associated with the daily operation of the dispensing areas; performs prescription related, unit dose related, and sterile product related functions; performs manufacturing procedures that have been documented in the Department records.

Schedule:

• This position is regularly scheduled to work full-time, 40 hours weekly. Shift times are subject to change based upon departmental/patient care needs. Currently this position is anticipated to work rotating shifts (AM and PM shifts) with rotating weekends and holidays.
• The primary work locations for this position are the OR Pharmacies. However, this position could rotate to other pharmacies within Northwestern Medicine subject to the needs of the work group.

Responsibilities:

• Prepares medication orders for inpatients.
• Prepares prescriptions for outpatients.
• Picks up orders and delivers medications to nursing units.
• Schedules intravenous admixture solutions according to the patient’s medical record. Reports any variance from the record to a pharmacist.
• Answers the telephone according to hospital policy. Screens the call to determine if the call should be handled by a pharmacist or a technician.
• Enters new drug orders and renewal/refill information into the computerized patient medication profile.
• Uses the computer system to assist in all dispensing and inquiry functions.
• Compares the patient medication bin with the pharmacy and nursing record. Returns unnecessary and/or outdated medication to the pharmacy. Reconciles use records and reports any discrepancies to a pharmacist.
• Receives, prepares, and distributes floor stock requisitions and requisitions for other clinical locations.
• Compounds dosage forms needed for dispensing to patients.
• Assists in maintaining adequate inventory levels in the dispensing areas.
• Packages extemporaneous and STAT single doses of medications under the supervision of a pharmacist.
• Prepares and maintains the emergency medication systems.
• Prepares sterile products for administration to patients. Selects proper diluents and vehicles and determines the appropriate stability.
• Prepares cytotoxic agents for administration employing hospital and department aseptic and protective procedures.
• Plans and performs the daily tasks required to provide department services under the direction of a pharmacist.
• Prepares and delivers narcotics and narcotic admixtures. Conducts narcotic perpetual inventories as directed.
• Meets quality and quantity requirements for new orders, unit doses, and IV admixtures.
• Ensures compliance with hazardous waste collection and disposal procedures.

Quality Management Responsibilities

• This position assists in maintaining emergency carts, inventory, and controlled substances records. Accurate completion of responsibilities is essential to an efficient, error free drug distribution system.

Required:

• High School Diploma
• Illinois Pharmacy Technician License (IDFPR).
• Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) certification through PTCB or ExCPT through NHA required for all those licensed after 2008.Newly licensed Technicians have 2 years from license effective date to obtain their certification.

Preferred:

• Completion of a Technician Training Program
• Previous experience as a Pharmacy Technician

#NMH1

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

You play a key role in the day-to-day leadership of the store, supporting sales growth, operational excellence, and luxury brand standards. Through coaching, motivation, and leading by example, you foster a high-performing, client-focused culture aligned to the brand. You support talent development through ongoing feedback, training, and succession planning, while driving client engagement, clilenteling initiatives and long-term relationship building to strengthen brand loyalty. In partnership with the Store Manager, you analyze key performance indicators, identify growth opportunities, and ensure a seamless omnichannel experience with strong execution across visual merchandising, operations, and service excellence.

Sales & Client Experience

• Support and drive store performance, consistently meeting and exceeding sales goals and KPI targets

• Lead by example on the floor delivering a welcoming, elevated, and personalized client experience while modeling strong selling, wardrobing, and client engagement

• Support the overall health of the store by driving organic traffic, conversion

• Build and maintain a strong client base through consistent outreach and follow-up

• In the absence of the Store Manager, serve as Manager on Duty, ensuring the store runs optimally and the team is fully supported throughout the day

• Ensure customer engagement across all relevant platforms; i.e. Enrollment in Jenni Kayne Rewards, Social Media Channels, etc.

Team Leadership & Development

• Support hiring, onboarding, and training of new team members in partnership with the Store Manager and Director of Training and Development to foster team consistency and readiness

• Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and performance support

• Help foster a positive, collaborative, and inclusive team environment

• Lead by example in upholding company values, policies, and expectations

• Step in as Manager on Duty (MOD) when Store Manager is not present

Operations & Inventory Management

• Assist in overseeing daily store operations, including opening and closing procedures, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance across all operational standards

• Maintain operational excellence across POS transactions, cash handling, loss prevention, and adherence to company policies

• Support inventory management through accurate stock control, efficient stockroom organization, and coordination with Stock Associates to ensure timely processing of deliveries and seamless product flow

• Assist with scheduling, payroll tracking, and time-off coordination in line with business needs, ensuring optimal staffing and operational efficiency

Visual Merchandising & Brand Standards

• Partner with Store Manager and Visuals Lead to maintain store presentation and merchandising standards

• Support execution of floor sets, window displays, and seasonal updates

• Ensure the store environment reflects the Jenni Kayne brand at all times

• Assist with in-store events and visual execution to drive traffic and sales

Business & Communication

• Communicate daily business insights, sales performance, and team feedback to Store Manager

• Assist with implementing company initiatives and directives to drive results

• Support local community outreach and store events to build brand awareness

• Maintain clear, professional communication with cross-functional partners

• 2+ years of retail experience, preferably in a leadership or key holder role

• Strong understanding of retail operations, sales, and customer experience

• Proven ability to coach and support team development

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and a proactive mindset

• Ability to work a flexible schedule including weekends, holidays, and peak periods

• Experience with POS and inventory management systems; Microsoft Word and Excel preferred

• Ability to lift and move objects (20+ pounds) and perform physical retail tasks as needed

Additional Notes:
This job description is not all inclusive. In addition, Kayne LLC dba Jenni Kayne reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Kayne LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

The hourly rate for this position is $28–$30 per hour. The base salary is determined by experience, education, skills, and location.

jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

Employment type:

• Full time

What you’ll be working on:

• Managing a patient panel with a broad array of patient needs; conducting a mix of acute, chronic, and well visits

• Treating patients in-office or in testing centers as well as conducting occasional tele-health visits

• Continuous learning during weekly Clinical Rounds and through other modalities

• Ongoing collaboration with in-office teammates via daily huddles, as well as with virtual clinical teams

• Utilization of your specific clinical training and opportunities to perform in-office procedures

• Supervising one or more NP or PA colleagues

• Willing to obtain additional state licensure and credentialing for One Medical virtual primary care in additional states

Education, licenses, and experiences required for this role:

• Enrolled in, or have completed, an accredited Family Medicine or Internal Medicine residency program

• Practiced at least 2 of the last 5 years in an outpatient primary care setting seeing all ages (0+)

• Board certified in Family Medicine or Internal Medicine, or Board Eligible with plans to obtain board certification within 1 year of your One Medical start date

• State licensed in Washington, obtained before your One Medical start date

One Medical providers also demonstrate:

• A passion for human-centered primary care

• The ability to successfully communicate with and provide care to individuals of all backgrounds

• The ability to effectively use technology to deliver high quality care

• Clinical proficiency in evidence-based primary care

• The desire to be an integral part of a team dedicated to changing healthcare delivery

• An openness to feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into strengths and weaknesses

• The ability to confidently navigate uncertain situations with both patients and colleagues

• Readiness to adapt personal and interpersonal behavior to meet the needs of our patients

This is a full-time role based in Seattle (Fremont), WA.

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The base salary range for this role is $274,900 - $328,600 based on a full-time schedule. Final determination of starting pay may vary based on factors such as practice experience and patient care schedule. Additional pay may be determined for those candidates that exceed these specified qualifications and requirements. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

Scientist, IVD BioDevelopment

Position Summary

Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing. We measure tumor-derived cfDNA at the molecular level to help inform personalized health care decisions with a non-invasive test.

Natera R&D is seeking a highly motivated Scientist to join the rapidly growing assay development team to help build the future of Natera. In this position, you will work with high-performing cross-functional teams to develop laboratory tests that benefit our patients and the business. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of molecular biology, strong scientific curiosity, demonstrated experience in developing Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) technologies and proven experience developing and validating assays through the product development cycle. You will plan, execute, and lead scientific studies under design control in a regulated environment, helping to improve and expand Natera’s oncology product portfolio.

Primary Responsibilities

• Leads in-laboratory efforts and performs duties largely independent from manager

• Plan, execute, analyze, and present data from moderate- to high-complexity experiments, including hands-on troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for development, verification and validation studies.

• Coordinate study design, sample size justification, acceptance criteria, and analysis with biostatistics and bioinformatics; perform basic data analysis (e.g., Excel, JMP)

• Characterize analytical performance studies following CLSI guidance

• Author and review SOPs, protocols, study reports, and transfer documents for production implementation; contribute to design control deliverables (design inputs/outputs, risk assessments per ISO 14971) in line with CLIA, CAP, 21 CFR Part 820/QMSR, and ISO 13485

• Communicates progress directly with colleagues and senior management. Provides regular updates, outcomes, risks, and next steps at laboratory and department meetings

• Documents research progress under an Electronic Quality Management System

• Train junior team members on new SOPs and laboratory workflows, and provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to laboratory operations

• Be flexible to lead multiple studies and laboratory priorities while maintaining targeted timelines; perform other duties as assigned

• Employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.

• Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements

Qualifications

• Requires a university bachelor's degree (molecular biology, cellular biology, immunology, or a related) and a minimum of 5-8 years of related experience or a MS degree and 4+ years of related experience or a PhD and 2+ years of related experience

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Knowledge of high-throughput NGS workflows or other clinical genetic testing applications, required

• Hands-on expertise in Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) workflows such as DNA extraction, whole exome or whole genome library preparation and/or expertise with various DNA molecular biology techniques such as PCR, qPCR and multiplex PCR, preferred

• Experience developing and validating molecular assays for IVD and CLIA laboratory testing strongly preferred

• Strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• Exceptional communication and presentation skills with meticulous attention to detail

• A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and demonstrated success in both collaborative and individual projects

• Knowledge of design verification/validation processes compliant with the U.S. and E.U. regulatory standards (FDA, IVDR), including ISO 13485 and ISO 14971

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. OUR OPPORTUNITY

Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. jobs.title: Director, Strategic Digital Technology
jobs.description:
Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Archer is a leader in the next-gen aerospace sector building an end-to-end advanced air mobility platform that delivers air taxis, unmanned aircraft systems (“UAS”), aviation-related physical artificial intelligence (“AI”) solutions, and other technologies to customers worldwide across the commercial aerospace and defense sectors.

Our sights are set high and our problems are hard, and we believe that diversity in the workplace is what makes us smarter, drives better insights, and will ultimately lift us all to success. We are dedicated to cultivating an equitable and inclusive environment that embraces our differences, and supports and celebrates all of our team members.

About The Role

The Digital Technology Office builds and runs the enterprise systems, data, AI, infrastructure, and security capabilities that Archer depends on as it grows from development into production and commercial operations. We are looking for a Director, Strategic Digital Technology to serve as a trusted strategic partner and operating leader for the Chief Digital Officer.

In this role, you will turn the Chief Digital Officer's priorities into plans, decisions, and measurable results across the Digital Technology Office and its partner teams. You will run the operating rhythm of the organization, lead cross-functional initiatives that do not belong to a single team, and make sure the Chief Digital Officer and the leadership team have what they need to decide well and decide on time.

This is a high-trust, high-ownership position with daily access to senior leaders. It calls for sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to lead through influence as well as authority.

What You'll Do

Strategy and Planning

• Partner with the Chief Digital Officer to turn digital strategy into a multi-year roadmap, an annual operating plan, and quarterly objectives and key results (OKRs), each with a named owner, milestones, and success measures.

• Lead the annual and quarterly planning cycles, including budget, headcount, and investment prioritization, in close coordination with Finance and People.

• Frame decisions for the Chief Digital Officer with clear options, trade-offs, and recommendations backed by data.

Operating Rhythm and Governance

• Own the cadence of leadership meetings, business reviews, steering forums, and decision logs for the Digital Technology Office, and make sure decisions lead to follow-through.

• Build scorecards and executive dashboards that cover delivery, spend, risk, and organizational health, and turn them into insights and actions.

• Set up lightweight governance that keeps speed high while meeting the demands of a regulated aerospace company.

Cross-Functional Initiatives

• Lead strategic initiatives that span engineering, manufacturing, operations, finance, legal, security, and people teams. Clear blockers, keep dependencies visible, and hold work to its commitments.

• Work with the Digital Technology program management team so that portfolio priorities match enterprise priorities.

• Support major platform, vendor, and integration decisions as they arise.

AI and Digital Enablement

• Help lead company-wide adoption of AI tools and workflows, including training, change management, and measurement of business impact.

• Track emerging technologies, vendors, and market trends, and recommend where Archer should lead.

Executive and Board Communication

• Prepare briefings, executive updates, and board-level materials for the Chief Digital Officer, and represent the Chief Digital Officer in meetings when needed.

• Plan and run leadership offsites, all-hands meetings, and organization-wide communications for the Digital Technology Office.

• Handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and good judgment.

People and Culture

• Partner with People on workforce planning, hiring priorities, succession, and leadership development.

• Coach leaders, build team capability, and help create a culture of accountability, curiosity, and candor.

Success In the First 12 Months

• A documented operating rhythm for the Digital Technology Office that every member of the leadership team uses.

• One prioritized digital roadmap with OKRs tied to company goals, reviewed every quarter.

• Executive scorecards covering delivery, spend, and risk, with a clear owner for each measure.

• Cross-functional initiatives that previously had no single owner now have one and are moving on schedule.

• A repeatable approach to AI enablement, with adoption and impact metrics reported to leadership.

What You'll Need

• 12+ years of progressive experience in strategy, technology operations, program or portfolio management, digital transformation, or management consulting.

• 5+ years leading teams, portfolios, or great cross-functional efforts at the manager level or above.

• A record of turning executive strategy into plans, OKRs, and measurable results in a complex organization.

• Experience running executive operating rhythms, such as planning cycles, business reviews, and governance forums.

• Strong financial skills, including budgeting, forecasting, and investment prioritization.

• Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly to executives and boards.

• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead without direct authority.

• Working knowledge of enterprise technology, such as ERP, PLM, MES, data platforms, cloud infrastructure, or AI, enough to challenge assumptions and discuss trade-offs with technical leaders.

• Experience in a regulated, safety-critical, or high-reliability environment, such as aerospace, defense, financial services, healthcare, or advanced manufacturing.

• A bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• The ability to work on-site at our San Jose headquarters.

Bonus Qualifications

• An MBA or other master's degree in a related field.

• Experience in an executive office, transformation office, or strategic business partner role that supported a C-level leader.

• Experience leading enterprise AI adoption, training, or enablement programs.

• A background in human-centered design, product management, or user experience.

• Executive coaching or leadership development credentials, such as an International Coaching Federation (ICF) certification.

• Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ITAR, CMMC, or NIST 800-171.

• Certifications such as PMP, Prosci, or SAFe.

• Experience in a high-growth or scale-up company.

Please note that this job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position and does not include an exhaustive list of responsibilities and qualifications.

At Archer we aim to attract, retain, and motivate talent that possess the skills and leadership necessary to grow our business. We drive a pay-for-performance culture and reward performance that supports the Company's business strategy. For this position we are targeting a base pay between $248,800 - $311,000. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Robinhood Advisor Products team is bringing Trade PMR, Robinhood's newly acquired registered investment advisor platform, into the Robinhood product suite. Our multiyear mission is to connect Robinhood's growing retail customers with Trade PMR's financial advisors, while bringing together two sets of technology and user experiences into one coherent product. You'll work alongside engineers, product managers, and partners in marketing and finance who care about getting this integration right for customers on both sides. We're energized by the scope of this work and the chance to shape how two strong businesses come together!

As a Staff Web Engineer on this team, you'll build and scale full-stack systems, spanning backend services and web applications that support Advisors and Investors. You'll take on system design work, reasoning through tradeoffs to produce architecture that holds up as the integration between Trade PMR and Robinhood grows, and you'll stay hands-on, writing code while also setting technical direction. You'll partner with product, marketing, and finance stakeholders to turn open-ended requirements into concrete technical plans, and you'll coach and review other engineers' work to raise the bar on quality and process across the team. You'll have an initial focus on integrating "growing good" retail customers with Trade PMR advisors.

This role is based in our New York, NY office(s), with in-person hybrid attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

• Design and build full-stack web systems, backend services and user-facing web applications.

• Strong communication skills for working with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

• Nice to have: experience building with AI-assisted workflows and shipping AI-powered features, and iOS or Android development experience.

What we offer

jobs.title: Development Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE CONSTRUCTION TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Put gigawatts in the ground, faster than anyone has. We're delivering one of the largest data center buildouts of its kind, with many sites running at once. Traditional construction management breaks at this scale, so we're building the model that replaces it.

 - Throw out traditional construction and invent how gigawatts get built. Tons of tools, layers of process, and administrative drag don't get you there. You'll strip all of that out and win by solving the real problem and beating the goal, not by managing toward it.

 - Productize the data center so we can build it a thousand times. You'll turn one-off construction into a repeatable, modular build, where the hundredth site goes up faster and cleaner than the first. That repeatability is the only way to reach the scale we're targeting.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Productivity
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Connector Ecosystem team builds the platform and product experiences that let people extend ChatGPT and Codex. We work on plugins, skills, connectors, interactive apps, and open standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We make plugins easy to discover, install, and use, ensure they’re invoked at the right time, and help people find new ways to get value from them.

We want anyone to be able to turn a useful workflow into a plugin, share it, and have other people use it. A plugin can package instructions and skills with connections to the tools and data it needs. Our work spans creation and publishing, reliable execution across our products, clear permissions and approvals, and the controls admins need to bring plugins to their organizations. We work closely with research to improve tool quality as models evolve.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a product-minded Principal Software Engineer to set technical direction, build the systems behind plugins, and improve how models use them. Depending on your focus, you may scale generalist infrastructure and identity-related integrations across products, improve plugin quality at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI, or work on the product experience itself to drive plugin usage. You’ll lead complex initiatives across teams and own problems from diagnosis and design through implementation and release.

You’ll remain hands-on while driving product and design decisions alongside Product, Design, Research, and engineering partners. You’ll help shape what we build and how it works, translate user and developer needs into clear priorities, and guide technical decisions that balance rapid iteration with long-term reliability and maintainability.

This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Set technical direction and lead complex initiatives across the Plugin Ecosystem, aligning architecture and execution across teams.

 - Drive product and design decisions with cross-functional partners, helping define priorities and shape intuitive experiences for users and developers.

 - Design and ship APIs, SDKs, and services that developers use to extend ChatGPT and Codex.

 - Build intuitive experiences that help users discover, install, and use plugins to get more done.

 - Make plugins easier to create, test, publish, update, and share.

 - Improve when and how models use plugins, from choosing the right plugin to completing a task. Work with Research to diagnose failures and measure improvements as models evolve.

 - Improve plugin reliability and interaction quality across ChatGPT and Codex, including interactive apps, with clear error messages and recovery paths.

 - Build consistent permissions, approvals, and admin controls that help individuals and organizations confidently adopt plugins.

 - Work with developers and partners to turn recurring problems into improvements to the platform, tooling, and documentation.

 - Collaborate across engineering, Product, Research, Security, and Trust & Safety to scale plugin infrastructure and deliver safe, reliable execution.

 - Raise the engineering bar through mentorship, thoughtful code reviews, and clear technical guidance.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of building and shipping products or platforms that people and developers rely on.

 - Have led complex technical initiatives across teams and driven product and design decisions in close partnership with product managers and designers.

 - Care about product quality and can make complex capabilities feel intuitive, from discovering a useful plugin to completing a task with it.

 - Have strong opinions about APIs and abstractions, and can explain the tradeoffs behind your decisions. Experience with identity, permissions, or integration-heavy systems is especially valuable.

 - Enjoy talking with users and developers, understanding what they’re trying to accomplish, and turning recurring problems into product and platform improvements.

 - Can move between product questions and technical details, collaborate across teams, and take an ambiguous problem through to production.

 - Are comfortable working across web interfaces and backend systems. Experience building applied AI systems, diagnosing model–tool interactions, and measuring reliability and quality is especially valuable.

jobs.title: VP of Growth Content
jobs.location: US: San Mateo (1875 South Grant Street)
jobs.description:
ABOUT XERO

At Xero, we’re here to supercharge small businesses. By making small businesses more efficient every day, connecting them with big business technology, and empowering a community behind them, their potential is limitless.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Xero is looking for a GM/VP of Growth Content to lead the next chapter of our global growth content function.

We have redefined how growth content is delivered at Xero from the ground up. Our growth content team uses an AI-powered approach to deliver high performing and always on-brand content at scale. We are looking for an individual who will lead a global team (including design, creative optimization and content automation) tasked with turning data-driven insights into a high-velocity, compounding content engine with automation at its core. This leader will develop and own our global content strategy across the funnel, they will champion a strict "test-and-learn" creative framework across all global growth channels, deeply analyzing audience signals and performance metrics to architect native content experiences that drive growth across paid advertising, lifecycle marketing, web, and sales assets.

The successful candidate will oversee the deployment of tailored, native content across all core channels—from high-impact visual hooks for paid ads to search-optimized web assets and high-converting lifecycle and sales collateral. This leader will need to constantly strike the right balance between delivering high performing content at scale and maintaining and elevating our brand consistency, in partnership with our internal agency ‘the foundry’.

This role requires someone who can operate at multiple altitudes. You need to be able to set direction at enterprise scale, work effectively in a complex global matrix, influence without always being the final decision-maker, and go deep into the executional details when the work demands it.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO


UNITE, DESIGN & BUILD THE CONTENT OPERATING MODEL FOR AN AI-NATIVE FUTURE

 - Deliver the end-to-end content system, from inputs and briefs through creation, review, distribution, reuse, and performance optimization to unite siloed work streams.

 - Build an AI-native operating model that improves speed, quality and scalability, not just efficiency on the current workflow. This will include the automation of atomization of flagship content across channels/funnel/audiences to scale distribution and expand impact.

 - Simplify decision-making and review flows so the right people are involved at the right moments, with less drag and more accountability to exponentially improve output speed while raising the bar on content quality.

 - Create repeatable ways to turn strategic inputs such as claims, positioning, customer insight, proprietary data, product truth, and channel learnings into effective content outputs.

 - Maintain total brand consistency across all content touchpoints, aligned with our core principles and ambitions.

 - Be hands on tools to lead the evolution and expansion of our content system, training the team and cross-functional partners on how to use most effectively.


RAISE THE BAR ON BUSINESS IMPACT AND MEASUREMENT

 - Build a measurement approach that connects content performance to real business outcomes, not just activity or engagement metrics.

 - Partner with analytics, product, performance marketing, regional marketing, and customer teams to understand what content is actually driving impact.

 - Use data to shape investment decisions, optimization, channel mix, and content priorities.

 - Create visibility for senior leaders into what is working, what is not, and where we should change course & how to get there.

 - Build a culture that seeks the truth on content effectiveness and continuously improves from it.


IMPROVE CONTENT QUALITY, JUDGMENT, AND CHANNEL FIT

 - Raise the standard of what great content and processes looks like at Xero and create calibration mechanisms so teams apply that standard consistently.

 - Improve how we match message, format, and depth to audience need and channel context.

 - Partner closely with Product Marketing, Communications, Performance Marketing, SEO, regional teams, and Sales Enablement to create more effective content across the funnel.


LEAD THE ORGANIZATION AND BUILD CAPABILITY

 - Lead, coach, and develop a global content organization spanning multiple disciplines, markets, and seniority levels.

 - Raise the bar on capability, performance, and leadership across the team and ensure the structure supports the organizational needs and is built for the future.

 - Build a team culture that values clarity, quality, learning, strong judgment, and accountability for outcomes.

 - Know when to stay at the strategic level and when to get into the details to unblock, improve, or accelerate the work.


OPERATE EFFECTIVELY IN A COMPLEX GLOBAL MATRIX

 - Build strong partnerships across global, regional, and functional teams to scale impact through influence.

 - Work effectively in an environment where ownership is shared, decisions are distributed, and progress depends on alignment as much as authority.

 - Balance global consistency with regional relevance, especially in markets with different levels of maturity, capability, and need.

 - Help cross-functional teams make better content decisions by bringing clarity, structure, and strong point of view.


SUCCESS IN THE ROLE LOOKS LIKE

 - The content operating model has been materially redesigned for an AI-native future, with simpler workflows, stronger systems, and better use of human judgment.

 - Content is on brand and inline with our brand principles and guidelines.

 - There is an effective and  continuous “test and learn” system and culture.

 - Content performance is measured in a rigorous way, with strong links to business outcomes, adoption, utilization, and expansion.

 - The quality bar is visibly higher, and teams have clearer standards for what good looks like.

 - The team is stronger, with sharper talent, clearer roles, and a structure better suited to where the business is going.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING


CORE REQUIREMENTS

 - SaaS & Fintech Expertise: Deep leadership experience in SaaS, fintech, or complex B2B/B2B2C subscription ecosystem environments.

 - Operating Model Transformation: Proven track record of redesigning operating models, not just optimizing existing workflows.

 - AI Operational Integration: Demonstrated success using AI to rethink content systems, workflows, governance, and production economics at scale.

 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Strong partnership experience with Product Marketing, Communications, Performance Marketing, SEO, and Sales Enablement.

 - Business Impact & Measurement: Strong evidence of driving measurable business impact through content across multiple stages of the funnel and customer lifecycle.

 - Global Matrix Leadership: Experience working in a large global matrix, with the ability to influence across teams and functions without relying on formal authority alone.

 - Strategic & Operational Agility: Ability to move between strategy and execution, including comfort getting into the operational details when needed.

 - People Leadership: Experience leading and upgrading teams through change, including talent assessment, coaching, organizational design, and raising standards.

 - Navigating Ambiguity: High comfort with ambiguity, complexity, and building structure where it does not yet exist.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience serving small business and partner audiences such as accountants, bookkeepers, or channel ecosystems.

 - Experience building growth content systems that use proprietary data, customer insight, and research as differentiated inputs.

 - Strong judgment on channel strategy, editorial and design quality, audience needs, and content effectiveness.

Compensation & Total Rewards

At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We don’t just hire for a role; we invest in people. We believe in a Total Package philosophy - which means your value isn't just a single number on a paycheck. While base salary is a core component, we look at your compensation through a holistic lens that includes equity, performance incentives, and world-class benefits.

The expected base salary range for this role in:

 - California and Washington: $229,300 to $315,300 USD  

 - Oregon: $208,800 to $287,800 USD 

 - Individual pay is determined by various factors, including geography, level of experience, and the specific skills you bring to the role.

In addition to base pay, Xero’s roles are eligible for the following forms of variable compensation:

 - Variable Pay: Permanent employees are eligible to participate in our annual bonus and equity (RSU) programs. You may also be eligible for performance-based cash or equity (RSUs) incentives depending on your role level, and company performance.

 - Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and 21 days PTO, 10 days of Wellbeing leave, 5 days of Xtra Leave, 1 volunteer day, 12 paid holidays, paid parental leave. Further information included on our Xero Perks https://careers.xero.com/inside-xero/benefits-wellbeing/ page.

jobs.title: Talent Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Why Rogo

Our mission is to transform global finance by empowering professionals at the world's top investment banks, private equity funds, and investment firms with AI that delivers unparalleled speed, accuracy, and insight. We're not just improving financial workflows; we're redefining them.

This is a unique opportunity to join a generational company driving transformation in one of the most important industries in the world. With a rapidly growing, global client base, proven product-market fit, and backing from world-class investors, we are scaling quickly and defining a new category of enterprise AI.

Our team is sharp, motivated, and deeply committed to Rogo’s mission. We take ownership of complex problems and stay relentlessly focused on our users. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, demand excellence, and want to help build the future of finance, we invite you to join us.


THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Talent Operations Manager to build the infrastructure behind how we hire. You’ll own the systems, data and workflows that help our Talent team operate effectively and give leaders a clear view of hiring progress, capacity and trade-offs.

This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll move between configuring Ashby, diagnosing a funnel bottleneck, modeling recruiting capacity and rolling out a better process with hiring managers. You won’t just produce reports or document workflows - you’ll use them to change how we work.

You’ll partner closely with Talent, Finance and People to make hiring more predictable, keep our data trustworthy and deliver a consistently strong candidate experience.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own our recruiting systems. Manage and improve Ashby, including workflows, integrations, reporting, permissions and data quality. Make our tools easier to use and ensure they reflect how we actually hire.

 - Build AI and automation into how we hire. Identify high-impact opportunities across sourcing, candidate communications, interview preparation, feedback collection and reporting, then design, test and roll out workflows that reduce manual work and give recruiters more time with candidates. And measure whether they improve speed, quality and candidate experience - not just generate more activity.

 - Turn hiring data into decisions. Build dashboards and analyses covering funnel conversion, time-to-hire, sourcing effectiveness, offer acceptance and recruiter throughput. Identify what’s slowing us down and recommend what to change.

 - Build recruiting capacity models. Translate hiring plans into realistic resourcing recommendations, accounting for role complexity, recruiter capacity, backfills and shifting priorities.

 - Connect hiring plans to the business. Partner with Finance and People to reconcile approved roles, hiring progress and expected start dates, surfacing gaps and trade-offs early.

 - Improve the hiring process end to end. Build clear, practical workflows for opening roles, running interviews, collecting feedback, approving offers and handing accepted candidates over to People.

 - Make great execution repeatable. Create useful documentation and training for recruiters and hiring managers, with clear ownership and a way to handle exceptions.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 4+ years in talent operations, recruiting operations or a related role, with experience building systems and processes in a fast-growing company.

 - Hands-on ATS ownership, ideally Ashby, including configuration, reporting and workflow design - not just experience using it as a recruiter.

 - Strong analytical skills, including experience building forecasts or capacity models from imperfect data.

 - The ability to turn an ambiguous question into a clear analysis, explain the implications and recommend a practical next step.

 - Strong operational judgment: you know when a process needs more structure and when it needs to be simpler.

 - The ability to work across Talent, Finance, People and hiring teams, build alignment and follow through on changes.

 - Attention to detail, discretion with sensitive information and a genuine interest in making hiring better for candidates and interviewers.


WHO YOU ARE

 - You thrive in fast-paced environments. You are high-intensity and care a lot about what you do, and you're ecstatic to work at a startup. 

 - You are ambitious. You have fun solving problems that others think are impossible. 

 - You are curious.  You find joy in learning about AI, technology, and finance.

 - You are an owner. You are autonomous, self-directed, and comfortable working with ambiguity.

 - You are collaborative, organized, thoughtful, and kind.


WHY JOIN ROGO?

 - Up and to the right: Rogo has strong product adoption with the world's leading financial institutions, and we are still early. The upside is enormous.

 - Extraordinary team: we take talent density seriously. You'll do the best work of your career alongside some of the sharpest people in AI and finance.

 - A one-of-one problem: bringing AI to the core of how Wall Street works is one of the most ambitious, technically demanding, and consequential problems today. There is nowhere else you can work on it at this scale.

 - Real ownership: You'll own real surface area and watch the world's most sophisticated users rely on your work.

 - Always at the frontier: we work at the edge of what the best models can do and turn it into products people trust. If you're obsessed with AI, this is where it's happening.

Compounding gives us the tools to do that. Every formulation we prepare is built to the specific needs of a specific person, and every interaction we have is guided by that same commitment to personalized care.

We put the human element at the center of everything: every formulation, every patient interaction, every provider partnership. We're not just a compounding pharmacy. The Quality Assurance Technician ensures site-specific compliance in accordance with Strive Pharmacy’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and specifications. This role involves the quality review of documentation, label control, product inspections, and assisting with product release activities.

• Product & Process Inspection: Perform product inspections for defects, leaks, and particulates. Assist in media fill process validations, including the inspection of filled units.

• Records & Maintenance: Maintain organized quality records (e.g., equipment calibration, maintenance files, training logs, cleanroom certifications, and Certificates of Analysis).

• Audit & Team Support: Support internal and external audits and actively participate in Quality Manager staff meetings.

Required Qualifications

• Education: Minimum of a High School Diploma or GED with relevant work experience.

• Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience in a quality or manufacturing department within a highly regulated industry (Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, or Allied Health Science preferred).

• SOP Proficiency: Proven experience reading, understanding, following, and reporting on Standard Operating Procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

• Education: Associate’s degree or higher in a technical or scientific discipline (Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry, or Pharmacy).

• Technical Knowledge: Experience in aseptic operations and familiarity with Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance practices.

• Soft Skills: Strong organizational skills, sharp attention to detail, and the ability to effectively troubleshoot issues.

Work Environment

• This position is primarily based in an onsite work environment. The role requires regular periods of sitting, standing, and computer use, with occasional lifting as needed. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

• Comfortable working in a cleanroom environment, which includes wearing protective cleanroom attire, working in restricted or small areas, tolerating controlled temperatures, and enduring moderate to loud noise levels.

• Frequently required to sit, stand, walk, talk, listen, and use hands to handle or feel objects.

While our expertise spans multiple disciplines, our method remains consistent: building trust and relationship with people -- whether you are a client, a consultant, or--in this case--a candidate.

We believe the best way to show you what our team is like is to treat you like you're already a part of it. We hope you'll consider joining our team of experienced professionals who are building their careers at Kalles Group—and having fun while doing it.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

As a Senior Microsoft Entra ID Engineer, you’ll be on assignment with one of our enterprise clients, helping lead a large workforce identity migration. Authentication for thousands of applications, including many complex SAML integrations, is moving from a legacy identity provider to Microsoft Entra ID. You’ll own the design, build and operation of access management and identity governance in Entra, and you’ll have a lot of autonomy. Your work will include Conditional Access and authentication strategy (phishing-resistant MFA and passwordless), Privileged Identity Management, application SSO and provisioning, B2B access, and the full Entra ID Governance suite: entitlement management, access reviews and lifecycle workflows. You’ll make Entra-native governance work cleanly alongside SailPoint Identity Security Cloud and hybrid Active Directory, and you’ll automate with Microsoft Graph, PowerShell and Infrastructure as Code. You’ll also set engineering standards and mentor other engineers on the team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

ACCESS MANAGEMENT (Entra ID)

• Design and maintain Conditional Access architecture – persona/risk-based policies, device & location conditions, session controls, Authentication Strengths for phishing-resistant MFA.

• Own authentication methods strategy and rollout – passwordless/FIDO2/passkeys, Windows Hello for Business, certificate-based auth; retire weaker methods.

• Administer Privileged Identity Management (PIM) – eligible assignments, JIT activation, approvals, privileged role & PIM-for-groups reviews.

• Manage application access – enterprise app SSO (SAML/OIDC), app role assignments, SCIM provisioning.

• Design external identity / B2B controls – cross-tenant access settings, guest governance, partner access patterns.

IDENTITY GOVERNANCE (Entra ID Governance)

• Build and operate Entitlement Management – access packages, catalogs, policies, approval/expiration workflows, separation-of-duties checks.

• Design and run Access Reviews across groups, apps, privileged roles and guests, including recurring/automated reviews with auto-remediation.

• Implement Lifecycle Workflows – HR-driven joiner/mover/leaver and scheduled governance tasks.

• Configure HR-driven inbound provisioning and outbound SCIM app provisioning.

• Integrate Entra-native governance with SailPoint ISC and hybrid AD, defining ownership boundaries and avoiding duplicate controls.

ACROSS THE ROLE

• Automation and config-as-code (PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API / Graph PowerShell SDK, Terraform/Bicep).

• Produce reference designs, standards and documentation; review other engineers' designs/configs.

• Partner with SecOps so identity telemetry supports threat detection.

• Mentor engineers; act as Entra access/governance SME. Use AI tooling to accelerate design and documentation.

ABOUT YOU:

Your values:

• Integrity: You believe in doing the right thing, even when it's uncomfortable, seemingly inefficient, or costly. Purposefulness: You have a desire to serve others with your skillset and an openness to continuous learning and growth. Ownership: You stick to your commitments, follow up with action, and seek clarity in communication & expectations.

YOUR EXPERIENCE:

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's/master's in CS, Cybersecurity, IT, or equivalent experience.

• 4+ years in IAM or security engineering with a track record leading technical projects.

• Deep hands-on Microsoft Entra ID: Conditional Access, authentication methods, PIM, Entra ID Protection.

• Hands-on Entra ID Governance: entitlement management (access packages), access reviews, lifecycle workflows.

• Expert knowledge of SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM and their security implications.

• Hybrid identity: Entra Connect / Cloud Sync with on-prem AD; governing access across both.

• Automating Entra via Microsoft Graph API / Graph PowerShell SDK; PowerShell, Python; Terraform or Bicep.

• System-level design thinking; able to set standards others build against.

• Clear communication with engineers and stakeholders; operates autonomously in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Certifications: SC-300, SC-100, AZ-500, CISSP, or SailPoint.

• Entra governance alongside an enterprise IGA (SailPoint IdentityNow / ISC).

• PAM familiarity (e.g., BeyondTrust) and how PAM and PIM complement each other.

• External/B2B identity at scale, cross-tenant collaboration, guest governance.

• ITDR exposure; feeding identity signals into SIEM/SOAR.

• Entra Verified ID, Permissions Management, or Global Secure Access.

• Large-scale retail, ecommerce, or high-transaction enterprise experience.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• The annual salary range for this role is $135,000-$155,000.

• We offer Medical, Dental, Vision plans, 401K with matching, and PTO for salaried employees.

• Work/life balance – we know there’s more to life than work! We encourage our team to pursue other passions, get outside, and spend time with family. We work with clients and consultants to set expectations for a manageable workload.

LOCATION:

This role is hybrid with onsite requirements at our client's location in Seattle, WA.  Therefore, we are currently only considering candidates that are already living in the Seattle area.

HOW TO APPLY:

Please fill out the form below (including uploading your most recent resume) and we'll be in touch! We know imposter syndrome can be a barrier to many great applicants. We hope you'll still consider applying. That's why we've made the application process as short and simple as possible.

Even if you're not a fit for the role, you can expect to hear back from us! We want you to have the best experience as a candidate, so please feel free to share feedback at any stage of the process to talent@kallesgroup.com.

Kalles Group is an equal-opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of creed, nationality, race, ethnicity, disability, gender, or other protected class.

jobs.title: Social Media Community Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIN CAN

Here at Tin Can, we're working to give kids the social independence we had growing up. We've built a modern remix of the classic home phone, running on a private network with safety-first features, thoughtful design, and a few delightful surprises along the way.

As we gear up to scale even more to thousands of families, we're ready to bring on a Social Media Community Manager to help make it happen.




THE ROLE

For a lot of parents, a DM or a comment is the first real conversation they have with Tin Can outside the box itself, and during the holiday rush, that conversation happens a lot more often. A slow reply, a missed comment, or a tone that doesn't sound like us isn't just a missed engagement metric, it's a family we didn't get to reassure. The Social Media Community Manager owns that conversation end to end, everywhere it happens.

You'll live in Sprout Social and Meta Business Suite, working across Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, and Facebook, and you'll sit close to the Social Media Specialist and the Customer Support Specialists, reporting into the Head of Brand Strategy & Communications. Your job is to make sure DMs and comments never go stale when volume spikes and coverage thins out. You'll know when to answer something yourself, when to hand it to support, and when to flag it up, and you'll never let a family wonder if anyone's listening.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Monitor and respond to DMs and comments across Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, and Facebook

 - Work inside Sprout Social and Meta Business Suite to manage volume, tag conversations for reporting, and reply to threads

 - Triage inbound conversations by severity, routing sensitive or escalation-worthy threads to support or leadership

 - Partner with the Customer Support Specialist to hand off order, shipping, and account issues cleanly

 - Coordinate with the Social Media Specialist so replies match what's live on the content calendar

 - Track response time, volume, and sentiment trends, and flag spikes before they become a backlog

 - Keep every reply in Tin Can's voice

 - Report weekly volume and trend summaries to the Head of Brand Strategy & Communications




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Prior experience in community management, social customer care, or social-support experience

 - Comfortable owning high-volume DMs and ad comments across Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, and Facebook without letting anything go unanswered

 - A clear, on-brand writer who can hold a brand voice under pressure

 - Able to tell the difference between something to answer, something to escalate, and something to hand off

 - Comfortable working potential weekends and holiday-season surges, with PTO coverage

 - Collaborative; happy to loop in support or social when something's outside your lane

 - Bonus: experience with Sprout Social and/or Meta Business Suite

 - Extra bonus: you already know Tin Can, and you're the type who'd rather pick up the phone than text
   
   


WHY JOIN TIN CAN

 - We're building tech that protects childhood: We're on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.

 - Build something from (almost) nothing: most lifecycle roles ask you to optimize an existing program. This one is yours to shape from the ground up, with the freedom to define what good looks like and real ownership over the results.

 - A seat with real reach: your work touches nearly every part of the customer journey - giving you outsized influence over retention and revenue, not just one narrow slice of it.

 - Small, high-trust team: Every company says "team," but at Tin Can it means something different. We're a small, mission-driven group that genuinely has each other's backs — professionally and personally. Your ideas and instincts matter from day one.

If you're excited by the idea of shaping how thousands of families experience something simpler and better for their kids, please reach out. We can't wait to meet someone who's ready to jump in, set the bar, and help us grow.

jobs.title: Head of Product Design
jobs.description:
About Crexi

Commercial real estate is one of the largest asset classes on earth and one of the last to go digital. Deals still get done over email threads, PDFs, and relationships nobody can search for. Crexi is the exchange betting that doesn't have to be true anymore: we're building the platform where an entire industry finds, evaluates, and closes deals, and we're betting hard on AI to get there faster than anyone thought this industry could move. Who You Are:

• An effective collaborator and team player who builds strong cross-functional working relationships.

• A self-starter who owns their own success, takes strong initiative, and is responsive and proactive in identifying and resolving issues.

• Excellent at organizing and prioritizing across multiple competing deadlines.

• Handles sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

Why Crexi?

• Real impact, fast. Join a rapidly scaling startup where your work moves the needle from day one.

• Real ownership. Equity in Crexi's growth story.

• Time that is yours. Discretionary PTO - take what you need, when you need it.

We believe in rewarding great work — the anticipated base range for candidates in our Playa Vista, California location is $220,000 to $285,000, and that's just the starting point. You'll also be eligible for annual bonus and generous equity grant, giving you real ownership in Crexi's growth and serious upside as we scale. The package offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors, which may include, but are not limited to, the type and length of experience applicable to the role and within the industry, education, geographic location, etc. Commercial Real Estate Exchange, Inc (“Crexi”) is a multi-state employer, and this salary range may not reflect positions that work in other states.

Crexi is an EEO Employer. Crexi will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.description:
Job Title: General Laborer

Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: Fabrication Shop
Location: Casper, WY
Reports to:  Foreman/Asst Fabrication Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Classification: Non-Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary

Loenbro is seeking a dependable and motivated Fabrication Shop Laborer to support daily fabrication shop operations. The ideal candidate will assist fabricators, welders, and shop personnel with material handling, equipment setup, shop organization, and general labor activities to ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, and to quality standards. This position requires a strong work ethic, attention to safety, and the ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing and fabrication environment.

Essential Job Responsibilities

• Assist fabricators, welders, and shop personnel with daily fabrication activities.

• Load, unload, move, and stage raw materials, fabricated components, and equipment within the shop.

• Operate hand tools, power tools, grinders, and other shop equipment under supervision.

• Prepare materials for fabrication by cleaning, organizing, measuring, and marking components.

• Support cutting, fitting, and assembly operations as directed by shop supervision.

• Maintain shop cleanliness through housekeeping, debris removal, and organization of work areas.

• Assist with receiving, inventory, and storage of materials and supplies.

• Safely operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and material handling equipment when properly trained and authorized.

• Inspect tools and equipment for safe operation and report maintenance concerns.

• Follow fabrication drawings, work instructions, and supervisor direction.

• Adhere to all company safety policies, job hazard analyses (JHAs), and PPE requirements.

• Perform other duties as assigned to support fabrication shop operations.

Minimum Qualifications

Required:

• GED or High School Diploma.

• Ability to safely use hand and power tools.

• Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull materials and equipment of varying weights.

• Ability to work in a physically demanding environment and remain on feet for extended periods.

• Ability to follow verbal and written instructions and work effectively as part of a team.

Preferred:

• Previous experience in a fabrication shop, manufacturing facility, or industrial construction environment.

• Forklift certification or experience operating material handling equipment.

• Basic knowledge of fabrication tools, equipment, and shop safety practices.

• Skilled in basic math, including measurements, fractions, and reading a tape measure.

• Able to pass preliminary and periodic drug testing.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment:

• Indoor fabrication and manufacturing shop environment.

• Frequent lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling of materials and equipment.

• Standing, walking, bending, kneeling, crouching, climbing, and reaching throughout the workday.

• Exposure to welding operations, sparks, grinding dust, metal shavings, and moving machinery.

• Exposure to noise levels above 85 decibels.

• Potential exposure to hot and cold temperatures depending on shop conditions.

• Operation around overhead cranes, forklifts, and other material handling equipment.

• Work performed around steel, piping, structural components, and fabricated assemblies.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee assistance program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities.  If you’re ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

• Acting with Urgency

• Delivering Excellence

…we want to hear from you.

Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Product
jobs.description:
ENGINEERING MANAGER, PRODUCT


DOCTRONIC | NEW YORK CITY OR SAN FRANCISCO (HYBRID) | FULL TIME




THE ROLE

Doctronic gives people free, private access to AI health guidance and affordable visits with human physicians. Millions of consultations already flow through the product. 

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead a team building Doctronic’s products and the AI systems behind them. You will develop engineers, shape technical direction, and turn ambiguous product needs into software that works reliably in production.

This is a hands-on management role. You will work in the codebase, guide architecture, review changes, debug production issues, and ship alongside your team. You will be accountable for team health, technical quality, delivery, and the impact of what you build.

We expect engineering leaders to work AI-natively. Coding agents are part of daily delivery across planning, implementation, testing, review, and debugging. You should have strong opinions grounded in practice about how to direct agents, validate their work, and help a team accomplish more with them. You remain responsible for the decisions and correctness of what ships.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Lead and grow a team of product engineers through clear expectations, coaching, direct feedback, and high standards.

 - Partner with product, design, clinical, AI, and operations teams to understand problems, set priorities, and define what success looks like.

 - Turn incomplete requirements into focused projects, make technical tradeoffs, and keep the team shipping through short planning cycles.

 - Contribute production code, lead technical investigations, review changes, and help resolve difficult implementation and production problems.

 - Guide work across user experiences, backend services, data models integrations, and AI workflows. Help engineers own complete solutions across those boundaries.

 - Turn AI capabilities into useful product behavior, with clear interfaces, reliable orchestration, appropriate safeguards, and evaluations that reflect real use.

 - Make coding agents and automation effective across the team. Improve how work is scoped, context is supplied, results are verified, and repeated work becomes reusable tooling.

 - Own the operation of the services your team ships, partnering with Platform on shared infrastructure, tooling, and standards.

 - Review product usage, user feedback, AI evaluations, and production performance after launch. Use what you learn to improve the product and the team’s decisions.

 - Hire strong engineers and build a team that can take on broader scope as Doctronic grows.




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience managing and developing engineers who build and operate user-facing products or the systems behind them.

 - A strong software engineering background and the current ability to contribute production code and work through difficult technical problems.

 - Experience shipping across frontend and backend systems, with depth in at least one area and the ability to lead work across the rest.

 - Good product judgment: you can clarify the problem, challenge assumptions, choose an appropriate scope, and connect engineering decisions to user outcomes.

 - Daily experience directing coding agents and evidence that you have improved how a team builds software with them.

 - Practical judgment about AI systems, including where to use models and agents, how to evaluate their behavior, and where explicit controls and human judgment are needed.

 - A record of improving engineering throughput while maintaining quality, reliability, and maintainability.

 - Experience hiring, coaching, giving direct feedback, and helping engineers grow.

 - Sound decisions about patient safety, privacy, security, accessibility, and production reliability.

 - Clear communication across engineering and company leadership, including the ability to explain tradeoffs and surface risks early.

Many candidates will have eight or more years of engineering experience, including two or more years managing engineers. We care more about the products you shipped, the engineers you developed, and your contribution to both than a specific degree, title, or exact tool match. Experience with AI products, agent orchestration, evaluation systems, healthcare, or another regulated field is useful but not required.




PRODUCTION STACK

Our product includes a Next.js, React, and TypeScript web application; native iOS and Android apps written in Swift and Kotlin; and Python and FastAPI services. Backend systems use MariaDB, SQLAlchemy, Redis, and Celery. Services run in Docker on AWS ECS and integrate with AI providers, telehealth systems, healthcare APIs, and FHIR-based workflows. You do not need experience with every part of the stack, but you should be comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and contributing across product and backend code.




HOW WE WORK

 - A small, senior engineering team with high autonomy.

 - Managers stay close to the work and ship alongside their teams.

 - Teams own projects from initial definition through launch, iteration, and production support.

 - Short planning cycles and frequent releases.

 - High standards for patient safety, privacy, reliability, and code quality.




COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - New York City and San Francisco base salary: $200,000 to $300,000, plus equity.

 - Benefits & 401k 




ABOUT DOCTRONIC

At doctronic.ai http://doctronic.ai, people can receive free, private AI health guidance and connect with human physicians for affordable visits. We build products for patients, clinicians, and healthcare partners to help people move from questions about their health to care.
