jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Intuitial)
jobs.description:
About Intuitial

Intuitial is a people-first, remote-friendly digital services company serving shoulder-to-shoulder with U.S. federal agencies to deliver innovative, human-centered solutions. We build modern, secure products the right way: with empowered teams, strong delivery discipline, and deep respect for the people who use—and operate—what we ship.

We’re guided by values like Kindness, Grit, Growth Mindset, and Radical Candor, and we aim to create a culture where people can do their best work with trust, autonomy, and support. We value clear communication, healthy collaboration, and continuous learning—because mission impact and excellent engineering both come from teams who feel safe, accountable, and energized.

Our work spans human-centered design, agile delivery, mobile and cloud-native engineering, and practical, responsible use of AI. We’re here to help government services work better for the public—and we believe that starts by building an environment where our teammates can thrive.

The role

Intuitial is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead a cross-functional agile team supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs' Travel Pay product. The role sits within Intuitial Six, Intuitial's joint venture delivering a larger VA program serving Veterans. This role owns both product and delivery for the team: running the team's agile practice, managing the roadmap and backlog, coordinating releases with other VA teams, and keeping work moving when priorities shift. The Senior Product Manager will present upcoming and completed work to stakeholders and lead working sessions across teams.

We look for Product Managers who lead with confidence and bring structure to a team, and who also embrace empowerment and a growth mindset. If you care deeply not just about your own aptitude, but about supporting others' growth, we'd love to hear from you. We look for people who are both tactical and strategic, and who are energized by delivering in complex environments with many moving parts. Most importantly, we look for folks who are passionate about solving problems that impact millions of users. We are here to make a difference in government, and Product Managers are the primary champions of our cause!

Contract Timeline

The current contract period ends February 16, 2027. We expect VA to extend the work through June 2027, ahead of a planned recompete. These plans have not been finalized, and the timeline is subject to change. We welcome questions and will share what we know as transparently as we can throughout the hiring process.

Responsibilities

• Team Leadership and Delivery Lead the team's agile practice day to day: plan and facilitate sprint ceremonies, run meetings, and keep the team on track Help the team establish and refine how it works best, including norms, rituals, and ways of collaborating Own release planning, dependency tracking, and status reporting for the team

• Cross-Team Collaboration Coordinate with other VA teams, product managers, and partners whose work the team depends on, and who depend on the team Facilitate cross-team discussions and negotiate release timing and scope across teams Raise and resolve blockers with dependent teams, escalating when needed so the team can keep delivering

• Product Direction and Communication Partner with VA stakeholders who set product direction, translating their priorities into a clear, iterative plan the team can deliver Shape and communicate the roadmap as priorities shift, keeping stakeholders and the team aligned on tradeoffs Bring ideas and recommendations to stakeholders with confidence, grounded in user needs and delivery realities

• Agile Delivery Manage and prioritize the product backlog, and lead regular backlog refinement with the team Break down problems so value can be delivered iteratively and incrementally. Lead the team to early validation of risky assumptions, and early and continuous delivery of value Write user stories and acceptance criteria that convey the what and why, leaving room for the team to determine the how

• Discovery Partner with UX research and design on the team to understand users and prioritize the needs that deliver the most value Establish a healthy, trust-based rapport with teammates and stakeholders Collaboratively identify and work to understand stakeholder constraints. Develop solutions that address diverse and sometimes conflicting stakeholder needs We expect the responsibilities of this position to shift and grow organically over time, in response to considerations such as the unique strengths and interests of the selected candidate and other team members and an evolving understanding of the delivery environment

Basic Qualifications

• 3+ years of product management or product ownership experience, plus relevant experience in technology delivery or project management

• Experience leading a team's agile practice, including facilitating ceremonies, without a dedicated scrum master or delivery manager

• Experience delivering products that depend on multiple teams or external stakeholders, including coordinating and negotiating releases

• Effective communicator, leader, and motivator

• In-depth knowledge and application of Agile principles and practices

• Proven track record of launching products from conception to production, and managing clients and key stakeholders

• High level cross-disciplinary understanding of the software development process, including research, design, development, testing, and deployment

• Comfort and familiarity working in GitHub, including issues, project boards, and pull request workflows

• Openness to AI tools and good judgment about where they improve outcomes

• Has lived and worked in the United States for 3 of the last 5 years

• Some of our clients may request or require travel from time to time. If this is a concern for you, we encourage you to apply and discuss it with us at your initial interview

• Able to start within 2 to 4 weeks of an offer. The team is working against near-term deadlines, so we’re looking for someone who can join and ramp up quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with government agencies. Familiarity with VA OIT or a similar federal IT environment, including platform governance processes such as VA's collaboration cycle, is a strong plus

• Experience using AI-powered prototyping tools or IDEs (such as Vercel V0, Lovable, Replit, Copilot, or Cursor) or enabling technologies such as MCP servers to prototype solutions and support delivery, retaining oversight over all work produced

• You are a U.S. Veteran. As a service-disabled veteran-owned small business, Intuitial recognizes the transition to civilian life can be tricky, and welcomes and encourages Veterans to apply.

At Intuitial, we are committed to building teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We’re eager to meet people who believe in our mission and who can contribute to our team in a variety of ways.

Salary and Benefits

As a small and growing government contractor, our open roles are tied to the contracts we support and the funding available. We aim to offer compensation that’s competitive and fair, reflecting the scope of the role, your experience, and the market.

The salary for this position is: $158,804.

Our benefits are designed to support sustainable, high-quality work and a healthy life outside of it. We value autonomy and trust, and we encourage teammates to take the time they need to rest, recharge, and show up at their best.

Benefits include:

• Competitive salary

• 401(k) with employer matching

• 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees

• Flexible PTO

• Paid federal holidays

• Paid parental leave

• Sick time and wellness days

jobs.title: Customer Security Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, TX; New York City

About the team

You will join the Customer Compliance Team, which is focused on building trust with customers through sharing information about Cloudflare’s security program and policies. We assist our Customers, Sales teams, and Legal teams in understanding Cloudflare’s security posture. In this role, you will develop into an SME across Cloudflare’s products, infrastructure, and controls.

As part of this mission, you will actively build with and leverage Cloudflare’s proprietary, in-house AI platforms and developer tooling to eliminate manual bottlenecks, scale compliance operations, and dramatically accelerate our response times to customer inquiries.

What you'll do

• Security Questionnaires & RFPs: Take ownership of filling out complex customer security questionnaires, RFPs, and technical assessments. You will do this by orchestrating our internal AI generation pipelines to draft responses, paired with your own expert human-in-the-loop validation to ensure high accuracy.

• Engage with Customers on Security Topics: Act as a trusted security advisor by engaging directly with enterprise customers on security topics. You will meet with customer security teams to resolve deep architectural inquiries, answer specific security questions, and assist legal teams with security terms in contract negotiations.

• Facilitate Customer Audits: Host, coordinate, and facilitate both on-site and virtual customer audits when customers execute their right to audit, guiding them through our security controls, processes, and compliance evidence.

• Build with In-House AI Tools: Design, configure, and iterate on custom workflows and compliance assistants using Cloudflare’s internally built AI platforms to automate questionnaire triage and security evidence retrieval.

• Curate AI-Ready Ground Truth Data: Structure, audit, and maintain authoritative knowledge repositories covering SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and global security regulations, ensuring our in-house AI models retrieve verified, up-to-date compliance data.

• Public Enablement & Trust Portal: Collaborate with marketing and engineering to mature our customer Trust Portal and self-service resources, making it easy for prospects and enterprise customers to evaluate our security posture independently.

• Author Public Security Content: Research, write, and maintain public-facing white papers, security blogs, and compliance mappings aligned with Cloudflare’s evolving product suite and global regulatory shifts.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

• 5–10 years of experience in security compliance, GRC, technical audit management, IT risk consulting, or customer-facing security assurance.

• Demonstrated ability to build with AI: A hands-on builder mindset with proven experience experimenting with, building on, or configuring AI workflows (e.g., prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation concepts, API-based automations, or internal agent configurations) rather than relying solely on packaged third-party software.

• Control frameworks: Solid understanding of security risk and compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and NIST SP 800-53

• Technical writing & translation: Strong written communication skills with the ability to translate complex networking, infrastructure, and cryptographic concepts into clear, plain-language customer responses and white papers.

• Customer-facing communication: Highly comfortable and articulate when presenting to or answering questions from external customers, sales executives, and legal counsel.

• Cross-functional leadership: Comfort partnering across Sales, Product, Legal, and internal Platform/AI Engineering teams to drive projects forward.

• Technical curiosity: Familiarity with data structures, markdown, APIs, or basic scripting (e.g., Python, SQL, or shell) to prototype solutions and inspect model outputs effectively.

• Bonus points: Practical cloud/network engineering experience, deep familiarity with global privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA), or experience establishing automated operational metrics.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For New York City based hires: estimated annual salary of $125,000 - $172,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

Material Handler

Full-Time • Hourly • On-Site (San Bernardino, CA) • Day Shift (7:00 AM - 3:30 PM Monday-Friday, Overtime on Saturdays as Needed)

Multiquip is seeking a dependable and safety-focused Material Handler to support our manufacturing operations by ensuring materials are delivered efficiently to production areas, maintaining inventory accuracy, and supporting shipping, receiving, and yard operations. In this hands-on role, you'll play a critical part in keeping production moving while operating material handling equipment and maintaining a safe, organized work environment.

If you thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, enjoy operating equipment, and take pride in accuracy and teamwork, we encourage you to apply.

What You'll Do

• Load and unload materials onto pallets, racks, shelves, trays, and flatbed trucks.

• Transport materials between storage locations, production lines, and designated work areas using scan guns and warehouse management systems (WMS).

• Count, weigh, verify, and document materials handled throughout the shift.

• Tag, label, and identify materials and containers for inventory control and traceability.

• Stack, bundle, band, and stage materials for storage and shipment.

• Safely operate forklifts (sit-down and stand-up), hoists, and other material-handling equipment.

• Locate, distribute, and stage pallets and temporary storage containers for production needs.

• Empty cardboard bins and dispose of materials in designated recycling and waste containers.

• Perform and document daily forklift inspections.

• Read and interpret part tags to determine storage locations and next processing steps.

• Communicate effectively with leads, supervisors, and team members regarding material needs and inventory status.

• Maintain equipment responsibly while adhering to all safety policies and procedures.

• Support general warehouse and production activities as assigned.

• Maintain regular and reliable attendance.

Education & Experience

• Ability to successfully obtain and maintain Multiquip Forklift Certification.

• Previous warehouse, manufacturing, or material handling experience preferred.

Communication & Interpersonal Skills

• Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with coworkers, leads, and supervisors.

• Strong teamwork skills and willingness to support production operations.

• Ability to follow written and verbal instructions accurately.

Technical & Operational Skills

• Ability to read and interpret safety rules, operating instructions, inventory tags, and procedure manuals.

• Experience operating forklifts, hoists, and material handling equipment.

• Ability to interpret bar graphs, diagrams, and workflow instructions.

• Understanding of inventory control and material flow processes.

Math & Problem-Solving Skills

• Ability to count, verify, and document inventory accurately.

Physical Requirements

jobs.title: Machine Vision Applications Engineer, San Francisco
jobs.description:
Machine Vision Applications Engineer
San Francisco, CA · Applications · Full-time, in office



ABOUT OVERVIEW.AI http://OVERVIEW.AI

Overview.ai http://Overview.ai is bringing the cutting edge of AI computer vision to manufacturing, solving inspection problems that were previously not solvable with traditional machine vision. We’re a full-stack company: we deploy GPU-powered cameras on production lines, run inference on the edge, and operate a platform that supports large fleets of devices deployed across the world.

We’re growing extremely fast. Our customers love the product because it works: high accuracy, fast deployment, and an operator-friendly experience that makes real factory rollouts possible, not just pilots.



THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for a Machine Vision Applications Engineer to own imaging feasibility in our San Francisco lab.

Customer samples arrive here before anything gets deployed. Your job is to make the defect visible: work out the lighting, the lens, the camera, the geometry, and prove the imaging holds up repeatably. That work is what every successful deployment is built on, and right now it is the bottleneck between a customer’s hardest inspection problem and a system that solves it.

This is a hands-on role. You will spend your days with real parts, real optics, and real lighting, running trials and documenting what works and why. If you have been doing this inside a vision vendor, a distributor, or an integrator and want the same work with more ownership and a harder class of problem, this is that job.



WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

 - You own the lab: The SF lab is yours to run, from testing standards to hardware evaluation to how we decide an application is feasible.

 - Hard problems, by design: Customers come to us with inspections that defeated traditional machine vision for years. The easy imaging problems never reach your bench.

 - Volume and variety: A growing stream of customer samples across automotive, aerospace, and consumer manufacturing means you see more imaging problems in a year here than most engineers see in five.

 - Your findings travel: What you learn in the lab shapes hardware decisions, deployment approaches, and what we tell customers is possible.

 - Room to grow into it: This is a mid-level role with a clear path to becoming the technical voice on imaging as the lab and the team scale.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Imaging feasibility: Run trials on incoming customer samples to determine whether and how an inspection can be imaged reliably.

 - Lighting and optics selection: Choose and configure lighting, lenses, cameras, filters, and geometry for each application, including the parts that fight back.

 - Lab ownership: Set up and run the SF lab: test standards, hardware inventory, sample handling, and how results get recorded.

 - Proof-of-concept testing: Build and document POCs that give Sales and Applications a defensible answer on what the system can and cannot do.

 - Image quality troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve image quality problems that drive false rejects, missed defects, and inconsistent results.

 - Hardware evaluation: Test new cameras, lenses, and lighting and recommend what belongs in our stack.

 - Findings and documentation: Write up what worked, what did not, and why, so the next engineer facing the same part does not start over.



WHO YOU ARE

Required

 - Hands-on experience selecting and configuring lighting, lenses, and cameras to image parts for inspection or measurement.

 - Experience running imaging trials, feasibility studies, or proof-of-concept testing on customer or production samples in a lab or demo environment.

 - Working knowledge of optical trade-offs: lens selection, field of view, working distance, depth of field, and resolution.

 - Comfortable working directly with hardware, running your own experiments, and solving problems independently.

 - Able to document findings clearly and explain technical trade-offs to customers and internal teams.

 - Based in the San Francisco Bay Area or willing to relocate, and able to work primarily from our SF office.

Strong Preferences

 - Experience imaging difficult parts: reflective, specular, transparent, dark, or low-contrast surfaces.

 - Experience with advanced lighting techniques: dome, dark field, backlight, coaxial, polarized, or structured lighting.

jobs.title: VP, Product Management
jobs.description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is the runtime control plane for the AI software development lifecycle (AI-SDLC). Thousands of engineering organizations, including more than a quarter of the Fortune 500, use LaunchDarkly to ship, measure, and control every change that reaches production, whether it is written by people or by AI. Feature management built the company. The next chapter is bigger: as the cost of writing code falls and the volume of change outpaces human review, the constraint is moving from writing software to controlling it. LaunchDarkly is building the critical infrastructure for the AI-SDLC. Customers build their own software factories. We build the rails they run on.

We are hiring the leader of Product Management for LaunchDarkly. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you will own the product management organization end to end: the people, operating system, roadmap commitments, and commercial outcomes across every product pillar. You will sit at the technology leadership table as the Product Management peer to the heads of Engineering and Product Design.

The CPO sets the company’s product vision and strategic direction. You will build and run the product organization that turns that direction into a coherent portfolio, shipped outcomes, customer adoption, and revenue growth. This is a hands-on operating role for a product leader who knows how to build the machine, make the tradeoffs, and finish the work.

Responsibilities:

• Lead cross-functional product leadership. Serve as the product counterpart to Engineering, Product Design, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance. Resolve cross-functional tradeoffs, establish shared commitments, and ensure LaunchDarkly presents one coherent product strategy to customers and the market.

• Build and lead the product management organization. Design the organization intentionally, allocate resources effectively, maintain a high talent bar, build succession plans, and establish clear ownership for every product surface a customer or sales representative may ask about.

• Own the product operating system. Establish the cadence that turns strategy into shipped software and met goals, including quarterly commitments, leadership reviews, squad-level inspection, launch briefs, new product introduction (NPI), and the product-to-field handoff. Make execution predictable enough that the executive team does not have to ask whether something shipped.

• Drive roadmap delivery across every product pillar. Lead execution across Enterprise, Foundation, Observability, Experimentation, Agent Control, Automation, and the platform beneath them. Build a culture of doing what we say we are going to do.

• Create portfolio discipline without slowing the company down. Ensure new bets enter the portfolio through explicit decisions rather than hallway conversations, while preserving the flexibility to respond to market changes. Marketing dates should be commitments the product organization can confidently support.

• Drive finishing. A product is not done when version one ships; it is done when the team has iterated based on learning. A launch is not done when it ships; it is done when the field is amplifying it. A process is not done when it is written; it is done when it creates leverage for the team.

• Own packaging execution and commercial outcomes. Lead how pricing and packaging land in the product and in the field so every representative can sell the full platform and every pillar contributes to its commercial goals.

• Stay close to customers and the field. Spend time with the largest customers and most demanding evaluators, translate what you learn into product decisions, and build a process that brings customer and field insight into the roadmap at scale.

• Use AI to increase product and engineering leverage. Help the organization adopt AI-assisted development and product practices in ways that increase delivery speed while maintaining quality and judgment.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year:

• The organization is complete. The leadership model is in place, product lines have the right pillar leadership, spans and layers are intentional, decision rights are clear, succession risks are understood, and the organization can continue to scale.

• Delivery increases every quarter. Shipped output per team rises quarter over quarter as AI-assisted development compounds, with quality holding.

• The operating system runs without the CPO driving it. Reviews, check-ins, launch briefs, and NPI happen on cadence and at a consistent bar.

• The portfolio is staffed. Every initiative in flight has an explicit staffing decision and plan behind it.

• The numbers move. Activation, attach, activity, and expansion targets for each pillar respond to the organization’s inputs.

• The team is stronger than you found it. Product managers have more leverage, complementary strengths are valued over a uniform mold, and every hire raises the bar.

About You:

• You are direct, decisive, and high-agency. You identify a problem, propose a fix, and act unless someone tells you not to.

• You are a relentless simplifier, not a caretaker. When you find friction, your instinct is to remove process rather than add it. You know how to run a company of this size like a small company that ships.

• You are a builder of people and move quickly on people problems. Product leaders who have worked for you say you made them better and would work for you again. You raise the bar clearly, promote based on evidence, and do not allow known performance problems to persist.

• You are comfortable challenging a strategy and turning it into a sequenced portfolio. You can tell the story of an idea you pushed back on, how you used evidence to make the call, and how you maintained the relationship.

• You write clearly and make decisions. You use written argument to create alignment, expect strong writing from your team, and end meetings with a decision.

• You are customer-oriented and commercially grounded. You can move from a conversation with a developer or data scientist to a discussion with an executive buyer or sales leader without losing the thread.

Qualifications:

• Minimum of 15+ years of experience in Product Management, including 7+ years leading Product Managers and product leaders across a multi-product B2B platform.

• Experience leading Product Management at the VP, SVP, or equivalent level across a multi-product B2B platform.

• Experience leading a product management organization of 20 or more product managers at a company with approximately $100M to $500M in revenue.

jobs.title: Facility Security Officer 1
jobs.description:
Work Arrangement

This is an onsite position that may require working irregular hours when applicable.

Job Overview

The Facility Security Officer (FSO) is responsible for the day-to-day administration, implementation, and oversight of the company's industrial security program in accordance with the National Industrial Security Program (NISP), 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM), applicable Department of War (DoW) security requirements, and other applicable U.S. Government security regulations and contractual requirements. The FSO serves as a point of contact for industrial security matters and advises management and employees on requirements for safeguarding classified information. The FSO establishes and maintains security processes, provides security training, manages personnel security requirements, coordinates security reporting, conducts self-inspections, and supports DCSA assessments and reviews. The position requires sound judgment, discretion, attention to detail, and the ability to interpret and apply NISPOM requirements to the company's specific operations. The FSO 1 works under established procedures and supervision while developing practical knowledge of NISPOM Requirements.

Essential Functions

• Administer and maintain the company's facility security program in accordance with 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM) and applicable government security requirements.

• Serve as the primary advisor to company management regarding industrial security requirements, risks, vulnerabilities, and corrective actions.

• Maintain, and implement security policies, procedures, and Standard Practice Procedures (SPP) applicable to the facility's classified operations.

• Maintain appropriate controls to protect classified information from unauthorized access, disclosure, loss, theft, or compromise.

• Manage personnel security requirements, including security clearance eligibility, access authorization, nondisclosure agreements, security briefings, debriefings, and applicable personnel reporting requirements.

• Conduct required initial, refresher, special, and termination/debriefing security briefings.

• Manage, track, and maintain industrial security records, personnel security actions, training, visit requests, classified information accountability, and other security program requirements. Identify, document, and report security incidents, adverse information, suspicious contacts, and other reportable matters in accordance with applicable requirements.

• Coordinate classified visits, meetings, information transfers, and other security-related activities.

• Maintain appropriate procedures for the handling, safeguarding, transmission, storage, reproduction, destruction, and accountability of classified information, as applicable to the facility.

• Conduct and document the required annual self-inspection and track corrective actions to closure.

• Prepare the organization for DCSA security reviews, assessments, inspections, and other government engagements.

• Monitor changes to NISPOM requirements and assess their impact on the company's security program.

• Coordinate with DCSA Industrial Security Representatives and other government security officials as appropriate.

• Work closely with Insider Threat, Information System Security, export control, physical security, human resources, contracts, legal, and program personnel when security requirements overlap.

• Recognize potential security issues and escalates them appropriately.

• Support COMSEC activities, including accountability, safeguarding, training, and documentation.

• Support OPSEC activities, training, and implementation of established protective measures.

• Work with team when interpreting unusual or complex NIPSOM requirements.

• Maintain required FSO training and professional knowledge of NISPOM requirements and related security policies.

• Promote a strong security culture and ensure employees understand their individual responsibilities for protecting classified information.

• Perform other industrial security duties necessary to maintain the facility's Facility Clearance (FCL) and classified operations.

• Perform other duties as required.

Standard Essential Functions

• Regular and reliable attendance on a full time basis [or in accordance with posted schedule].

• Responsible for exhibiting professional behavior with both internal and external business associates that reflects positively on the company and is consistent with the company's policies and practices.

• Embodies AEVEX’s cultural values and aligns daily actions with department goals and company culture.

Qualifications and Competencies

• Basic understanding of:

• 32 CFR Part 117, National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM)

• National Industrial Security Program (NISP) requirements

• DCSA industrial security processes and expectations

• Personnel security and classified access requirements

• Classified information safeguarding requirements

• Security incident and adverse information reporting

• Security education and training requirements

• Facility security procedures and security-in-depth concepts

• Classified visits, information transmission, and handling requirements

• Security self-inspection and corrective-action processes

• Familiarity with applicable DoD security policies, Security Executive Agent Directives (SEADs), and other government security requirements

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Familiar with Microsoft Products, including Word, Excel, and Access

• Proficient procedural documentation skills

Education / Certifications

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

• Associate's or Bachelor's degree in security management, criminal justice, business, or a related field is preferred

• Substituted with relevant security experience.

• Industrial Security Professional (ISP®) Certificate preferred.

Experience

• 0-2+ years of relevant industrial security experience with progressively increasing responsibility.

• Experience supporting a cleared contractor, government security program, military security program, or comparable regulated security environment is preferred.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties the employee is:

Frequently required to sit, and to reach to use computers and other office equipment
For the purpose of this summary, occasionally is used to represent up to 1/3 of the time given to the work day, frequently represents 1/3 to 2/3 of the time and constantly represents 2/3 or more of the time.

Security Clearance

• Ability to obtain/maintain a Top Secret/SCI DoD clearance, U.S. Citizenship required.

About AEVEX

AEVEX, headquartered in Solana Beach, California, supports the U.S. national security mission and partner nation needs around the world by providing full-spectrum aviation, remote sensing, and analysis solutions. The company's capabilities include custom design and engineering; rapid prototyping; sensor integration and sustainment; aircraft modification and certification; flight test instrumentation and support; mission operations service; advanced intelligence data processing, exploitation, and dissemination solutions; and tailored hardware and software mission-system tools. AEVEX uses agile and customized approaches to rapidly define, develop, and deliver specialized solutions for airborne special mission needs for the U.S. Government, partner nations, and commercial businesses. AEVEX has major offices in California, Florida, North Carolina, Ohio, and Virginia.

AEVEX provides a full suite of comprehensive benefits, including a 401(k)-retirement plan, comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability and Life insurance group coverage with a portion of the premiums paid by the company, professional development funds, and an Employee Assistance Plan (EAP) with counseling, legal help, child and elder care support, among other benefits for qualified employees.

Recruitment Communication Notice: All official correspondence regarding your application, application status, interviews, or the AEVEX hiring process will come directly from an AEVEX representative using an @aevex.com email address or through Greenhouse, our applicant tracking system. Please use caution with communications claiming to represent AEVEX from other email domains, and always verify the sender before responding or providing personal information.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, sex (including pregnancy, breast feeding and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, military and veteran status, marital status, age, protected medical condition, genetic information, physical disability, mental disability, or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable federal, state and local laws.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin

About the role

Our primary focus is attracting top talent and empowering them to excel. We are seeking a motivated and collaborative Senior Recruiter to support the growth of our Tech teams. We value solution-oriented self- starters who thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment and are passionate about making a meaningful impact. Your role will involve partnering strategically with hiring managers to design and implement tailored recruitment strategies, ensuring the successful acquisition of exceptional candidates, primarily through active sourcing. You'll collaborate closely with our People Business Partners, Coordinators, and various business leaders to drive the growth and success of our Tech Teams.

What you'll do

• Strategic Partnership: Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, offering guidance, market insights, and best practices to shape effective hiring strategies.

• Full-Cycle Recruiting: Own the end-to-end recruitment process, from developing customized hiring plans with your stakeholders to sourcing, interviewing, and closing top talent.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Work closely with hiring teams to enhance the attraction and hiring of a diverse range of candidates, championing inclusive processes at every step.

• Creative Sourcing: Utilize creative sourcing techniques, with a heavy emphasis on direct outreach via LinkedIn and other platforms, to identify and engage highly qualified candidates for our cybersecurity and network security sales teams.

• Pipeline Management: Proactively manage and maintain a healthy candidate pipeline, ensuring data integrity in our ATS (Greenhouse) and providing regular, insightful updates to internal stakeholders.

• Project Leadership: Collaborate with the wider recruiting team on key initiatives and hiring projects, contributing to the continuous improvement of our talent acquisition function.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

• A minimum of 5 years of end-to-end recruiting experience, ideally within a high-growth tech or SaaS company.

• Direct experience hiring for Tech roles, with a strong preference for experience in the network security or cybersecurity sales domain.

• Proven expertise in active sourcing and candidate engagement using tools like LinkedIn Recruiter.

• Demonstrated experience driving diversity and inclusion initiatives within the recruiting process and helping to build diverse, high-performing teams.

• Strong influencing skills and a solution-oriented, results-driven mindset. The ability to be proactive and resourceful, identifying and addressing potential hiring bottlenecks before they arise.

• Excellent organizational skills and a keen eye for detail.

• A highly collaborative nature and the ability to thrive in a team-based environment.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For Austin based hires: Estimated annual salary of $102,000 - $160,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

Financial Benefits

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Kapitus has helped small and midsize businesses access capital for two decades, funding roughly $2 billion to date and building toward $6 billion and beyond. We originate, decision, fund, and service financing every day across a growing set of products and partner channels. As we scale, we are investing in the technology and quality foundation that growth depends on.

We are building an automated regression capability that lets us release faster with higher confidence, and we are hiring senior QE engineers to design and build the automated suites that make it real. You will work across the product with cross-functional teams, writing and maintaining scalable Playwright and TypeScript automation that runs in our pipelines and catches problems before customers do, and you will help convert today's manual regression into reliable, reusable automation.

What You Will Do:

• Partner with the team: Work with developers, product managers, and business analysts to understand requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

• Automate across layers: Design and implement automated coverage for functional, API, integration, regression, and end-to-end scenarios.

• Build and maintain the framework: Design, develop, maintain, and optimize scalable automated frameworks and scripts using Playwright with TypeScript.

• Validate API:. Develop and execute automated API tests to validate system functionality, integrations, and reliability.

• Troubleshoot with developers: Work closely with developers to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues, providing timely feedback.

• Engage in Agile ceremonies: Take part in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

• Harden regression suites: Build and maintain reliable automated regression suites that validate software stability and release readiness.

• Integrate into CI/CD. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, monitor results, and improve reliability and feedback speed.

• Convert manual to automated: Convert existing manual test cases into automated coverage, capturing domain knowledge so nothing is lost as automation grows.

• Stay current: Track fintech industry trends, emerging tools, and best practices in QA and the financial domain.

What We’re Looking For:

• 5-7+ years as a QA or QE engineer, with substantial hands-on test-automation experience.

• Demonstrated ability to write, debug, and review automated test scripts using Playwright with TypeScript.

• Strong understanding of automation framework architecture, test design patterns, maintainability, and quality-engineering best practices.

• Experience with API testing tools such as Postman and Swagger.

• Experience testing Salesforce solutions and full-stack applications across UI, API, integration, and data layers.

• Experience with version control including GitHub, Bitbucket, and SourceTree.

• Experience with Jira for project and bug tracking, and Confluence and Zephyr Scale for documentation.

• Solid understanding of Agile and Scrum and experience working in Agile environments.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, working effectively within a cross-functional team.

• Experience in the financial services industry is a plus.

• Test automation: functional, regression, API, integration, and end-to-end automated testing.

• Automation framework: advanced hands-on Playwright and TypeScript, or comparable modern automation technologies.

jobs.title: VP & Compliance Officer - Full Time - Wolf River
jobs.description:
Job Title: VP & Compliance Officer

About Us

At West Cancer Center, we are committed to providing exceptional, patient-centered cancer care while maintaining the highest standards of integrity, accountability, and regulatory compliance. Our leadership team works collaboratively to promote ethical conduct, identify and address compliance risks, and support an effective compliance program throughout the organization.

Position Overview

The VP & Compliance Officer is a key member of West Cancer Center’s leadership team and provides independent and objective leadership of the organization’s healthcare compliance program. This position is primarily responsible for the establishment, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the compliance program and is accountable for its effectiveness.

The VP & Compliance Officer oversees the identification, assessment, monitoring, investigation, and remediation of compliance risks and serves as a resource and advisor to the Chief Executive Officer, senior leadership, providers, employees, and other stakeholders regarding compliance matters. This position also serves as West Cancer Center’s primary HIPAA Privacy Officer and oversees the privacy compliance program.

Key Responsibilities

Compliance Program

• Serve as the primary leader and accountable owner of West Cancer Center’s healthcare compliance program

• Establish, maintain, and continuously improve an effective compliance program consistent with applicable laws, regulations, regulatory guidance, and recognized compliance practices

• Conduct or oversee annual compliance risk assessments and develop risk-based compliance work plans

• Identify compliance risks and recommend appropriate controls, education, monitoring, and risk mitigation strategies

• Establish compliance metrics and reporting processes to evaluate program effectiveness

Policies, Education, Auditing & Monitoring

• Develop, review, implement, and maintain compliance policies and procedures in collaboration with appropriate leaders and subject matter experts

• Oversee compliance education and training and promote ethical conduct, regulatory awareness, and non-retaliation

• Develop and oversee risk-based compliance auditing and monitoring, including billing, coding, documentation, reimbursement, medical necessity, provider arrangements, privacy, and other identified risk areas

• Coordinate responses to governmental, regulatory, accreditation, payer, and other external audits or inquiries

• Evaluate audit and monitoring results and oversee appropriate compliance remediation

Investigations & Remediation

• Receive and evaluate reports indicating potential violations of healthcare laws, regulations, regulatory requirements, or conduct that may create significant compliance risk

• Conduct or oversee compliance investigations and coordinate with Human Resources, operational leadership, or other appropriate parties as needed

• Evaluate the scope, root cause, and potential impact of substantiated compliance concerns

• Develop and monitor compliance remediation plans addressing regulatory violations, process deficiencies, control weaknesses, and systemic risks

• Recommend improvements to policies, procedures, controls, workflows, education, and monitoring to mitigate risk and prevent recurrence

• Escalate significant or unresolved compliance concerns to the Chief Executive Officer

• Coordinate with Human Resources when a compliance investigation identifies employee misconduct directly related to the compliance concern; Human Resources retains responsibility for determining and administering disciplinary or other employment action

Regulatory Compliance, Fraud, Waste & Abuse

• Monitor and communicate changes in applicable healthcare laws, regulations, regulatory guidance, and enforcement priorities

• Provide compliance guidance to leadership, providers, and departments regarding regulatory requirements and identified risks

• Oversee compliance activities related to fraud, waste, and abuse, including applicable requirements under the False Claims Act, Anti-Kickback Statute, Stark Law, Civil Monetary Penalties Law, and Medicare and Medicaid programs

• Coordinate appropriate investigation, remediation, reporting, disclosure, and repayment activities when potential fraud, waste, or abuse is identified

HIPAA Privacy

• Serve as West Cancer Center’s primary HIPAA Privacy Officer and oversee the privacy compliance program

• Monitor compliance with HIPAA Privacy, Security, and Breach Notification requirements

• Oversee privacy complaints, suspected unauthorized access, use or disclosure of protected health information, and potential breaches

• Provide guidance regarding the appropriate use and disclosure of protected health information and coordinate investigation, mitigation, documentation, and required reporting of privacy incidents

Leadership & Governance

• Provide regular reports to the Chief Executive Officer, senior leadership, and/or applicable Board committee regarding significant compliance risks, investigations, audit findings, remediation, and program effectiveness

• Provide independent and objective advice regarding significant compliance risks and emerging regulatory issues

• Participate in appropriate leadership, governance, risk, privacy, quality, and other committees

• Maintain appropriate independence and access to records, systems, personnel, and information necessary to fulfill compliance responsibilities

• Foster a culture in which compliance concerns are identified, reported, investigated, and appropriately addressed

Qualifications

Education & Experience

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Compliance, or a similar field

• Minimum of five (5) years of progressive healthcare compliance or related experience

• Experience administering a healthcare compliance program, including risk assessment, auditing, monitoring, investigations, and remediation

• Experience working with physicians, executive leadership, employees, and governing bodies

Preferred:

Master’s degree, JD, or other relevant master’s degree

Credential/Licensure

Preferred:

• Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC), CHPC, CHRC, CCEP, CIA, CPC, or other compliance, auditing, or privacy credential

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Strong knowledge of healthcare laws, regulations, regulatory requirements, compliance principles, HIPAA, and fraud, waste, and abuse requirements

• Knowledge of healthcare billing, coding, documentation, reimbursement, medical necessity, and related regulatory risks

• Strong analytical, investigative, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex regulatory requirements to diverse audiences

• Demonstrated integrity, sound judgment, discretion, independence, and objectivity

• Ability to identify and appropriately address compliance risks and challenge practices when warranted

• Ability to manage confidential and sensitive information

• Ability to work effectively with physicians, providers, executives, managers, employees, and external regulatory and oversight entities

Work Environment & Physical Demands

• Physical activities may include climbing, pushing, standing, hearing, walking, reaching, grasping, kneeling, stooping, and repetitive motion

• Must have good balance and coordination

• Light work requiring exertion of up to 25 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently

• Close visual acuity is required for activities such as preparing and analyzing data and figures, transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, and extensive reading

• The position is not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions; job functions are typically performed under conditions such as those found in general office or administrative work

Why West Cancer Center is a Great Place to Work

• Meaningful Impact: Play a direct role in supporting patients through one of the most challenging times of their lives.

• Collaborative Culture: Work alongside a multidisciplinary team of dedicated professionals committed to improving cancer care.

• Professional Development: Benefit from ongoing training, educational resources, and growth opportunities.

• Mission-Driven Environment: Be part of an organization guided by compassion, integrity, and innovation.

No nights, weekends, or holidays. Comprehensive benefits package.

Join Us

If you are an experienced healthcare compliance professional with a strong background in compliance program leadership, regulatory oversight, auditing, investigations, risk assessment, and privacy compliance, we encourage you to apply for the VP & Compliance Officer position at West Cancer Center.

The Job

• You are the change-enabler for the Customer Fulfillment team and its dedicated technical partner. You own our operations NetSuite capabilities, automate manual processes, define requirements for new tools, and implement them into our daily workflows so the team can scale sustainably.

• You take a growing role in our warehouse integrations, working with our systems team to keep data flowing cleanly between NetSuite, Shopify, and our 3PL partners. You help identify and resolve discrepancies between physical 3PL stock and system inventory records.

• You own key fulfillment dashboards in Looker, including inventory and lead time reporting. This means managing them day to day and rebuilding them on more robust, automated foundations as our needs grow.

• You help move the team from manual reporting to live, automated tracking of performance metrics like order-to-delivery time and on-time delivery, pulling together data from BigQuery, NetSuite, and carrier sources.

• You work closely with the global Customer Fulfillment team, the wider Global Operations team, technical systems teams, and company leadership. The role has real room to grow and can be shaped around your strengths and interests.

You:

• 2 to 3 years of experience in operations systems, business systems, or a similar technical role, with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering field.

• NetSuite Admin Certification and experience across Warehouse Management, Inventory, Procurement & Supply Chain, and Finance & Accounting. You can build and optimize workflows, saved searches, and reports, and implement scripts as well as make modifications to the ERP production infrastructure.

• SQL skills, ideally in BigQuery, including connecting BigQuery to Google Sheets to deliver reporting. Basic proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript, plus strong Google Workspace and Excel skills.

• Proven ability to work cross-functionally and translate business needs into technical requirements and SOPs, with clear, professional communication in English.

• Work autonomously, own projects end to end, and manage competing priorities across time zones.

Bonus Skills:

• Background in global logistics, fulfillment, or with a third-party logistics provider, including familiarity with carrier management, order routing, international shipping, and on-time delivery performance.

• Familiarity with NetSuite SuiteScript, Google Apps Script, or Shopify’s API, using tools like GitHub and Visual Studio Code, and a track record of using AI tools to automate real workflows.

• Comfort building dashboards in Looker, ideally in a fast-growing or startup environment.

• Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• Low cost fund options in our 401K and access to advisors

• Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)

• Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it

• Ample free on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits

• Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats

• Regular sponsored professional development opportunities

• Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community

• And of course… unlimited 3D prints

Every Formlabs employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. You’ll have the opportunity to share financially in the value we create together, with a shared incentive to build a business that succeeds over the long term. Equity will be a significant portion of your total compensation, and will increase over time in proportion to your impact. $85,000—$105,000 USD

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Hims & Hers is looking for a Warehouse Lead to help power our pharmacy fulfillment operations in Ontario. You'll oversee the day-to-day flow of prescription and over-the-counter product through our facility — receiving, storage, picking, packing, and shipping — while making sure everything meets Health Canada and Ontario pharmacy regulatory standards. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment and cares about getting orders right for real customers.




HOURS: MONDAY-THURSDAY 8:00AM-6:00PM




YOU WILL:

 - Lead daily warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, picking, packing, and shipping of pharmaceutical and personal care products

 - Ensure compliance with Health Canada regulations, the Ontario College of Pharmacists (OCP) standards.

 - Maintain accurate inventory records using the warehouse management system (WMS); conduct regular cycle counts and resolve discrepancies

Business Growth & New Opportunities

Mindset, Ownership & Leadership Style

• Deep understanding of social platforms, audience behavior and content best practices across organic, paid and influencer-led programs.

• Experience building strategic plans, channel recommendations, paid social approaches and insight-led performance narratives for senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: Regional Director, Solutions Engineering, Enterprise
jobs.description:
ABOUT FACTORY



Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).




ABOUT THE ROLE



Factory is hiring a Solutions Engineering Manager to build the Enterprise Solutions Engineering team. Our Enterprise Solutions Engineers own the full customer lifecycle, pre-sales and post-sales: discovery, demos, proofs of concept, security and architecture reviews, pilot delivery, and the ongoing adoption and expansion of Factory once a customer is live. You will help build out the team, define how it runs, and own both the technical win and the production outcome for our fastest-growing Enterprise accounts.

You will hire and coach the people who do this work, set the standard for how it is done, and stay close enough to the accounts to do it yourself when it matters. You will work directly with Enterprise Sales leadership, and closely with Product and Engineering. This is a hands-on, zero-to-one leadership role at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering. It suits someone who combines real technical fluency, strong people leadership, and sound judgment under deal pressure.




WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

 - Build the Enterprise Solutions Engineering team: define the hiring profile, recruit and close the founding Solutions Engineers, and grow the team with the Enterprise pipeline

 - Design and iterate the team's operating playbook across the full lifecycle: discovery, pilot scoping, success metrics, security and compliance reviews, production rollout, and ongoing adoption and expansion

 - Own the team's technical win rate, time-to-technical-win, pilot-to-production conversion, and post-sales adoption and expansion; report them to GTM leadership and use them to coach the team

 - Partner with Sales leadership and Account Executives to run high-quality technical discovery, demos, and proofs of concept that tie directly to customer outcomes

 - Carry accounts directly while the team ramps, and serve as the escalation point for complex evaluations, at-risk deployments, and high-stakes Enterprise deals, including CTO, VP Engineering, and Security stakeholders

 - Onboard, coach, and develop Solutions Engineers; set clear expectations, career paths, and performance standards, and shorten ramp time with structured enablement

 - Act as the voice of the field internally, feeding customer and prospect insight back to Product and Engineering
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS



You do not need to meet every requirement to be a strong candidate. If this role excites you and you have related experience, we encourage you to apply.

 - 4+ years leading Enterprise Solutions Engineering, Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or customer engineering teams in enterprise software, spanning pre-sales and post-sales, including at least one team you built or scaled from a small starting point

 - A strong hiring track record: you know how to source, assess, and close senior technical customer-facing talent

 - A strong technical foundation and fluency in modern software development workflows, developer tooling, CI/CD, and AI coding tools

 - Proven ability to partner with Sales while protecting technical integrity and customer trust

 - Comfort in high-pressure, customer-facing environments; you can take over a stalled evaluation or a struggling deployment and move it forward

 - Operational discipline: you track technical win rates and pilot outcomes and run a team on the numbers, not on anecdotes

 - Executive presence and clear communication with developers, architects, and CTOs alike

 - A builder and player-coach mindset: you thrive in a fast-moving startup and create structure where little exists

Nice to have

 - Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools, LLM-based products, or developer platform sales

 - Background as a software engineer or in a technical consulting role

 - Experience standing up a new team or function for a high-growth company
   
   

This is an in-office position (5 days/week) in San Francisco (walking distance to Caltrain)

The Pharmacist works closely with nurses, physicians, and research teams to support optimal patient care.

• Enter drug orders into pharmacy computer systems

• Monitor and manage drug inventory, including ordering and restocking

• Provide clinical drug information to healthcare teams regarding dosing, interactions, and stability

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer III, Shield
jobs.description:
WHAT IS BOX?

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU

Box Shield is an add-on security layer that protects the flow of information and reduces content-centric risk without adding friction. It uses classification-based controls to prevent data loss and AI-powered, context-aware alerts to detect malware, compromised accounts, and malicious behavior at scale.

Shield’s mission is to secure enterprise content while delivering a seamless user experience, ensuring Box remains the platform of choice for secure Intelligent Content Management. Shield keeps customer content safe by surfacing malware, compromised accounts, and anomalous behavior early, giving administrators the context they need to take proactive action before incidents escalate.

The Shield team is hiring Machine Learning engineers to build and scale ML systems that safeguard millions of users and billions of files from ransomware, data exfiltration, insider threats, and emerging AI-based attacks. As part of a fast-paced backend/core team, you’ll collaborate across Box to ship future-proof security capabilities for high-demand use cases.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Build Threat Detection Models: Design, train, and deploy ML models for ransomware detection, suspicious session identification, and user behavior analytics

• Scale Data Pipelines: Own end-to-end ML pipelines that process high-volume security event streams using Apache Spark, GCP Dataflow, and Vertex AI

• Feature Engineering: Create and maintain feature stores that power real-time and batch anomaly detection systems

• Production ML Systems: Deploy, monitor, and iterate on ML models in production, serving enterprise customers at scale

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Platform, Application Engineering, and Product teams to translate security requirements into ML solutions

• Participate in our on-call rotation, available at all times while on-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise.

WHO YOU ARE

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

Must Have Experience

• 3+ years of experience in applied machine learning

• Strong programming skills in Python

• Deployed and maintained ML models serving real traffic

• Experience with GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow) or equivalent (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML)

• Deep understanding of feature engineering, model evaluation, and MLOps

• Strong communication skills with ability to explain complex ML concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Nice To Have Experience

• Experience in security/threat detection, anomaly detection, or fraud detection

• Experience with sequential data, anomaly detection, or behavioral modeling (time-series forecasting, LSTM, Transformers, or similar)

• Knowledge of LLMs and AI safety (prompt injection, guardrails, red-teaming)

• Experience with streaming/real-time ML systems

• Familiarity with Java for service integrations

• Publications or contributions in ML security

Tech Stack You’ll Work With

• Languages: Python, Scala, Java

• ML/Data: Apache Spark, Vertex AI, BigQuery, TensorFlow/PyTorch

• Infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes

• Domains: User Behavior Analytics, Time-Series Anomaly Detection, AI Security, Content classification, Ransomware Detection

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week.Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

• Warm, clear communication: You connect easily with clients and internal teams using thoughtful language and standard templates.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LEAD VIDEO & VOICE SYSTEMS ENGINEER

SpaceX is looking for a Lead Video & Voice Systems Engineer that will lead a team of administrators and engineers to design, install, maintain, and fully own the video and voice communications systems at our launch and test facilities. You’ll be tightly integrated with the engineering teams that design our rockets and spacecraft as well as with our Emmy award-winning webcast team on the launch and event broadcasts for the company. This role requires excellent leadership skills, hands-on technical contribution, an action-oriented disposition, flexibility, and the propensity to flourish in a fast-paced and challenging environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Manage the day-to-day activities/priorities of the team.

• Provide primary input for hiring, termination, promotion, performance, and reward decisions for direct reports.

• Lead a team of highly skilled IT professionals responsible for implementing and maintaining IT infrastructure that directly supports SpaceX’s launch operations.

• Provide coaching and mentorship to other members of the SpaceX team, fostering team cohesion, knowledge redundancy and professional growth.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to distill requirements and design effective IT solutions that support the entire launch lifecycle from pre-flight preparations to post-launch analysis and recovery operations.

• Closely collaborate with stakeholders and engineers across programs to create highly operable, scalable, and maintainable products.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, electrical engineering, or other STEM discipline and 5+ years professional video, voice and/or networking engineering experience OR 7+ years professional video, voice and/or networking engineering experience without a degree.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience leading or managing direct/indirect reports in a team environment.

• Expertise with video broadcast equipment such as video routers, IP video, cameras, audio mixers, voice matrices, video switchers, and wireless two-way radios.

• Understanding and experience with broadcast networking transports such as SMPTE ST 2110, AES67, Dante, SRT, RTSP, SIP, and WebRTC.

• Advanced knowledge of OSI model and network standards.

• Hands on networking experience with the following: Arista and Cisco Catalyst data center class switches. Fiber optics and wave division multiplexing. DNS, DHCP, PTP, SNMP, LACP, IGMP, PIM-SM.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Valid driver’s license.

• Ability to work in tight quarters and physical dexterity is necessary to preform job functions.

• Availability for extended hours and/or weekends, as the schedule varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility is required.

• Ability to provide 24x7 on-call support in emergency situations.

• Availability for occasional travel, as required (<25%).

• Position is subject to pre-employment and (as applicable) periodic background, drug, and alcohol testing.

• Ability to pass Air Force background check for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg Space Force Base.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.
