EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $18.25 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Thermal Fluids Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.



The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.

About the Team

As an analyst at Antares your primary responsibility will be building and running thermal-fluids models of components and subsystems throughout the reactor core and power conversion system to ensure our designs will meet thermal, mechanical, operational, and performance requirements within the extreme environments of our R1 micro-reactor. Design engineers will rely on your modeling and technical expertise for iterative design feedback and optimization, while adhering to best practices for DFM (design for manufacturing) and maintaining a rapid pace of development. Antares aims to maintain close collaboration between testing and analysis teams, and to this end you may often be asked to provide technical support before, during, and after test campaigns. This may take the form of cooperative planning of testing goals, instrumentation requests, root cause analysis in the event of failures, post-test data review, and model validation/anchoring.

 

Roles and Responsibilities:

 - Assess subcomponent designs for pressure drop, heat transfer capabilities, and other performance characteristics using a combination of hand-calcs, in-house tools, and CFD

 - Collaborate with designers and responsible engineers to provide guidance on initial sizing, material selection, and design feedback based on analytical results

 - Compile detailed documentation of analytical results and communicate key results, assumptions, and limitations to stakeholders throughout the company and external customers

 - Provide support to test engineers in the form of collaborative test design, instrumentation selection, and data review to ensure test campaigns provide the necessary data to validate our models

 - Develop internal tools and calculators to enable other engineers to quickly and independently perform analytical assessments of their designs without the need for detailed finite element models

 - Provide technical mentorship and guidance to other engineers and across teams 

 

Basic Qualifications:

 - Bachelor's in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering or similar technical discipline

 - 5+ years' experience performing thermal-fluid analysis

 - Experience building and running CFD models using commercial codes such as Fluent, CFX, and Star-CCM+, including conjugate heat transfer models and compressible equations of state

 - Experience using Computer Aided Design (CAD) software for design modification and model defeaturing (Siemens NX or similar)

 - Experience in Python, MatLab, VBA, or other scripting language to build and maintain tools and calculators 

 

Preferred Skills & Experience:

 - Master's in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering or similar technical discipline

 - Familiarity with 1-D fluid network tools such as Flownex, Sinda-Fluint, or RELAP5

 - Participation in regulatory qualification or certification programs for safety-critical systems in the aerospace or nuclear industry

 - Understanding and experience of implementing numerical methods to solve fluid-dynamic and thermodynamic systems

 - Experience working with multiphase fluid & heat transport systems (Heat Pipes, Rankine Cycle Engines, Saturated Cryogenic Storage)

 - Familiar with ASME BPVC Section III Div 5

 - Experience building and running Finite Element Analysis (FEA) models

 - Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with rapid design iteration loops

 

Additional Requirements:

 - Ability to work long hours and weekends as necessary to support critical milestones

Location

 - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises.



Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

 - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

 - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption
   
   

Equal Opportunity

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At Rocketship Public Schools, we believe in the infinite possibility of human potential. We believe that every student deserves the right to dream, to discover, and to develop their unique potential and it is our responsibility and our privilege to unleash the potential inside every Rocketeer we serve. Our non-profit network of public elementary charter schools propels student achievement, develops exceptional educators, and partners with parents who enable high-quality public schools to thrive in their community. We are a collective of parents, teachers, leaders, and students working together to transform the future for underserved communities across our country. At Rocketship Public Schools, we are unleashing potential.


Rocketship school leadership teams each include a Principal and Assistant Principals focused on instruction, an Office Manager focused on student information and family engagement, and a school leader focused on all other operations aspects of running the school -- what some might call an “AP of Operations,” though we at Rocketship call it a Business Operations Manager (BOM). The BOM reports directly to the Principal and manages a team of hourly Operations Specialists. As the Operations leader, the BOM is responsible for all aspects of student meals, recess, arrival, dismissal, physical space, and safety at their campus.  Thus, the role requires not only the ability to manage “business” topics like logistics and compliance, but also a deep understanding of behavior management, culture-setting, and behavior management coaching. The BOM helps ensure the school has a consistent culture across spaces, keeps our students safe, and ultimately enables instructional staff to focus on teaching and learning. This means BOMs are multi-talented leaders who can build systems, own processes like procurement and facilities maintenance, and partner with all adults on campus to support our students. The BOM role is an excellent opportunity for operationally-minded teachers and school leaders who want to grow and develop through an operational school leadership position.

ABOUT ROCKET MONEY 🔮

Rocket Money’s mission is to empower people to live their best financial lives. Rocket Money offers members a unique understanding of their finances and a suite of valuable services that save them time and money – ultimately giving them a leg up on their financial journey.

ABOUT THE TEAM 🤝

The Rocket Money Data Analytics team is comprised of data analysts who are passionate about using data to drive business decisions and improve user experiences. Analysts work within a semi-embedded organizational structure to independently build data analytics tooling, drive strategy with data, and assess experiments within cross-functional product vertical aligned teams. Analysts also work closely with other members of the analytics engineering and data science teams to further our product delivery, operations, finance, and marketing goals.

We’re growing the team and hiring a Data Analyst to deepen our partnership with Operations and Customer Support teams. In this role you’ll bring a strong analytic point of view to concrete operational problems — shaping measurement and reporting, leading ad hoc investigations, and delivering actionable insights—while helping raise the bar for how we use data to improve member outcomes.

Tech Stack: BigQuery, dbt, Looker, Amplitude, Deepnote

IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL 🤹

• Partner semi-embedded with operations and customer support management teams to own complex analytic work end-to-end: framing questions, defining measurement, and delivering narratives that influence roadmap decisions with a clear point of view grounded in evidence.

• Build trusted relationships with operations leadership and relevant cross-functional partners, communicating tradeoffs managing expectations through ambiguity, and ensuring analytics engagement lands at the right moments.

• Lead high-impact ad hoc analyses that surface non-obvious opportunities or trends in operations data; proactively follow insights through to recommendations which will directly impact customer outcomes.

• Be a force multiplier for the team via creating self-service analytics: contributing dashboards, metric definitions, reusable queries/notebooks, and documentation so recurring questions scale.

• Proactively seek out creative ways to apply data analytics methods and tools within the operations space. Guide and educate stakeholders and partners in the usage of these tools to support their decision-making process.

• Mentor and uplift teammates through high-quality reviews, feedback, and collaboration while modeling pragmatic prioritization: balancing rigor with speed and escalating when scope or risk requires broader alignment.

• Own commitments for your initiatives with predictable communication: clarify scope, document methods/limitations, communicate impact, and reprioritize when new information changes what “most impactful” means.

ABOUT YOU 🦄

• You have deep expertise in data analytics and a strong understanding of data systems and processes, especially delivery of scalable, repeatable self service analytics.

• You have 4+ years of experience data analytics and proven experience working with operations teams to drive meaningful product improvements.

• You have advanced SQL skills and experience in a BI tool like Looker (preferred), Tableau, Databricks or PowerBI. Experience with light work in DBT or Airflow is a plus.

• You excel at stakeholder management and can build effective relationships across the organization. You self-organize a peer group to gain feedback.

• You are focused on making sure that analytics tools are accurate, complete, and timely. Analytics is a strategic asset but also a strategic risk if numbers are wrong.

• You are proactively involved with your internal clients in a strategic manner. You are not a ticket taker.

• You want to continue to grow and learn. You are excited by hard problems and big challenges.

• You are looking forward to an AI-first world and regularly use AI to assist you in your work, but you also understand the trade-offs of using AI and know when to use your brain cells over your tokens.

jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

jobs.description:

JOIN US ON OUR MISSION TO BECOME THE #1 RETAIL TRADING PLATFORM IN THE WORLD

Welcome to the dynamic world of NinjaTrader! As an industry-leading trading platform and futures broker, we're empowering traders to take control of their financial destiny. How do we do it? We provide cutting-edge products and services that enhance the trading journey. Whether a seasoned pro or just starting out, NinjaTrader equips traders with award-winning software and brokerage services to navigate the world's leading financial markets with confidence.

Our growth story is nothing short of exhilarating. Since 2003, NinjaTrader has been dedicated to understanding and supporting traders on their journey toward trading triumph. Through those efforts, our user base has grown to over 2 million users and we have become the number one rated futures brokerage worldwide.

But we're not stopping there. We're constantly evolving, pushing boundaries, and modernizing the futures industry. Our commitment to innovation means users will always have access to dynamic tools, real-time support, and a community of like-minded traders.

So, why work at NinjaTrader? Here, you're not just part of a team; you're part of a movement. We empower employees to reach new heights in their careers by providing a dynamic culture focused on social connection, professional development, and employee recognition initiatives. Sounds too good to be true? Take it from our employees.

Join us as we redefine what's possible in trading, advocate for our customers, and continue our journey toward becoming the world's top retail-focused trading platform in the world.

What you'll do:

NinjaTrader's Social Media team builds our brand's voice and community across every channel. As Social Media Manager, NT Tech, you'll own and grow NinjaTrader Tech's social presence, with a focus on our Prop business, one of our fastest-growing segments, which gives funded traders the capital and tools they need to scale. This is a senior individual contributor role: you'll own strategy and deliver measurable results, working day-to-day with the Social Media team and reporting to the Sr. Manager, Content Marketing.

In this role you will:

• Own the strategy for NinjaTrader Prop and Ecosystem business accounts across X/Twitter, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Facebook, ideating, creating, and publishing content

• Manage the Prop social content roadmap and calendar from concept to publishing

• Develop and maintain a strong, social-first, company-approved brand voice and visual identity that stays consistent across all channels, adapting content natively for each platform

• Monitor platform algorithm changes, trending formats, and emerging channels to maximize reach and engagement

• Design your own social assets, work with the creative team and other designers to request additional assets and ensure cohesive visual identity across platforms, and oversee copywriting, caption development, and asset coordination for campaigns and product launches

• Manage relationships with influencers, creators, and agency partners on post scheduling and asset sharing across our channels

• Support our Video Producer on Prop business projects by repurposing long-form video into short-form clips for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts, and writing captions, subtitles, and on-screen text

• Own community management across all NinjaTrader brand accounts by setting community guidelines, response standards, and escalation paths, directing day-to-day responses to comments, DMs, mentions, and tags, cultivating an engaged and loyal trading community, and monitoring brand mentions and sentiment to flag emerging issues

• Lead cross-functional initiatives with content, product, and growth teams, driving alignment without formal authority, and represent the social media function in cross-functional forums while advising other business units and building relationships with Manager- and Director-level stakeholders

• Track and analyze performance across channels, turning insights into data-driven recommendations and business cases that shape content strategy and influence resourcing and budget decisions, and design and document the processes that ensure all published content meets regulatory and brand standards

What you'll need:

• Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on experience) and 6+ years of related experience (or 4+ years with a master's degree) in social media, content creation, or digital marketing (agency or in-house)

• Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a major social or content program, including setting strategy, managing the roadmap, and delivering measurable results, with a proven track record growing social for a financial brand, media company, or creator

• Deep knowledge of the futures, prop trading, or crypto space, including its audiences, communities, and culture

• Proven experience building and leading community management programs, including owning a brand's community strategy and representing a voice publicly

• Ability to thrive in a fast-moving content environment, with a deep understanding of short-form video and X content ecosystems

• Strong graphic design skills, with experience turning a brief into scroll-stopping visuals both independently and in collaboration with other designers, and comfort with video editing software (Adobe Premiere or similar)

• Experience with Sprout Social, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, and project management tools (e.g., Jira, ClickUp, or Monday.com), plus experience using AI tools in your marketing workflow (Claude and ChatGPT preferred) for ideation, copywriting, research, or asset creation

• Experience adapting long-form content into short-form, social-first formats by finding the hook and cutting to what matters, and a fluency in meme culture and internet humor that you use strategically without forcing it

• Strong writing skills with sharp hooks and concise, engaging captions, a knack for adapting tone across platforms and audiences, and the ability to communicate recommendations clearly in writing and in meetings

• Highly organized, with experience managing vendors, agencies, or contractors alongside multiple content streams and cross-functional workstreams, and a proven ability to align stakeholders (content, product, growth) without formal authority, including at the Manager and Director level

Bonus Points for:

• Comfort on camera for short-form video content (TikTok, Reels), a strong differentiator

• Basic familiarity with paid social, including knowing how organic and paid work together

• Familiarity with Social SEO, including optimizing captions, hashtags, and scripts to improve discoverability on TikTok, YouTube, and beyond

Compensation:

The salary range for this role will be $85,000 - $100,000 USD. In addition, this position will also receive an annual target bonus of [BONUS %]%. Bonus pay at NinjaTrader is based on
individual performance (50%) as well as company/team performance (50%). Salary and bonus earnings are only two components of the total compensation package offered by NinjaTrader.

NinjaTrader offers a 401(k) plan through ADP under which the company will match up to 3.5% of employee contributions. Annual paid time off allowance accrues at a rate of 18 days per year plus seven paid holidays.

Location:

This role is based in Chicago, IL. We are not open to remote candidates for this role

Hybrid:

For Chicago-based employees, we follow a hybrid work schedule: In-office Tuesday through Thursday, with remote work on Mondays and Fridays. In addition to these weekly remote days, we offer:

• 20 additional flex remote days annually

jobs.title: Director of Accounting
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Cambium is a growth stage company modernizing the trillion dollar wood supply chain. It's an industry still run by thousands of small, disconnected suppliers, where most wood is pushed out in the hope it finds a buyer. We start with what the customer needs and build the supply chain back from there. We pair our own physical operations with software that removes waste and gives buyers visibility from forest to finished product. Customers like Amazon, Equinox and Room & Board rely on us, Fast Company named us one of its Most Innovative Companies, and we're growing both organically and through acquisitions. We're looking for ambitious, energetic people to help build it.



ABOUT THIS ROLE

We're hiring a Director of Accounting to own Cambium's accounting function. You'll take books that moved from QuickBooks and Sage into NetSuite and make them clean, structured and audit ready. You'll run a reliable monthly close across the parent company and acquired subsidiaries, and lead the accounting integration of each company we acquire. This is a hands on leadership role: you do the work, and you lead the offshore accounting team that does it with you.



WHAT YOU'RE WALKING INTO

This is a build role. The first six months are heavy on cleanup, but nothing is missing: all the data is there, it's just unstructured. Your job is to give it structure and get it to sing, while running the close and integrating the acquired companies. You report to the VP Finance, with room to grow the team as we scale.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE: FIRST 12 MONTHS

 - The historical books are clean (first six months). Every balance sheet account is reconciled and supported, the QuickBooks and Sage history ties out in NetSuite, and deferred revenue runs on a method that ties to shipments.

 - The close is reliable. The chart of accounts is redesigned, and the close lands in under 10 business days every month, with consistent coding by business unit and revenue center. Budget versus actuals pulls straight from NetSuite with no rework. Budgeting and FP&A analysis sit elsewhere on the team.

 - The subsidiaries are in. Acquired entities are on NetSuite OneWorld, and intercompany and consolidation run as part of the monthly close.

 - The offshore team works to your standard. Routine reconciliations and entries are right the first time, and you review rather than redo.

 - The books are audit ready. Accounting policies and controls are written down and followed.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE: BEYOND 12 MONTHS

 - A five day close.

 - A clean audit. You lead Cambium through its external audit and own the auditor relationship.

 - Acquisitions plug in on a playbook. Each new company is on our chart of accounts and in the consolidated close within 90 days of closing.

 - A team you built. You hire and develop in house accountants as we grow. How far the seat goes is up to you.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the month end close across the parent company and subsidiaries, completing within 10 business days.

 - Reconcile and clean up historical balances, and bring legacy QuickBooks and Sage data into a consistent structure in NetSuite.

 - Redesign and own the chart of accounts and segment structure across business units and revenue centers.

 - Fix deferred revenue, and decide whether NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management is the right long term tool.

 - Lead the accounting integration of acquired subsidiaries into NetSuite OneWorld, including intercompany and consolidation.

 - Lead our offshore accounting team day to day: assign the work, review it and hold the quality bar.

 - Own accounting policies and controls, keep the books audit ready, and own the external auditor relationship.

 - Own the accuracy of inventory, WIP, COGS and project costing.

 - Partner with the Finance Operations Manager on AP, AR, billing and project costing.

 - Partner with our NetSuite owner on configuration, and keep NetSuite as the system of record rather than spreadsheets.


QUALIFICATIONS (MUST HAVES)

 - 6 to 10 years of accounting experience, including owning a month end close end to end.

 - Has personally cleaned up or rebuilt messy books, ideally a QuickBooks or Sage migration into NetSuite.

 - Has managed accountants, including outsourced or offshore teams in other time zones.

 - Multi entity accounting: intercompany, consolidation, and folding acquired companies into an existing chart of accounts.

 - Inventory and COGS accounting at a company that moves physical product.

 - Deferred revenue and revenue recognition for product or project businesses.

 - Hands on NetSuite experience across parent and subsidiaries.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - CPA, active or previously held.

 - Has led or participated in a financial audit.

 - Has integrated acquired companies into an existing accounting system.

 - Experience with NetSuite OneWorld or Advanced Revenue Management.

 - Experience with Sage or Great Plains.


THE DETAILS

 - Reports to: VP Finance

 - Salary range: $140K to $195K

 - When: We're looking to fill this role immediately

 - Where: Remote within the US, with periodic travel to San Francisco (roughly monthly at first). SF Bay Area, Duluth MN, Baltimore MD or New London CT a plus.


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Equity options package

 - Unlimited PTO and a flexible schedule

 - 401k matching

 - Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance

 - A smart, diverse team driven by a climate mission

 - An opportunity to play a core role in defining a fast growing company

 - Volunteer tree planting days
   

Cambium is committed to building an inclusive organization that reflects the diverse communities our team works to serve. We believe that diversity in all its forms (gender, race, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, veteran's status, disability and more) is essential to imagining and actively building a more just and sustainable future for all. We hope you feel welcome here. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.location: 665 Clyde Avenue, Mountain View,  CA, USA
jobs.description:
Lab Summary:

The Robot Intelligence Lab at Samsung Research America is a new facility dedicated to advancing the field of robotics through cutting-edge research and development. The lab’s mission is to develop advanced technologies to power intelligent robotic systems capable of manipulation, navigation, and complex reasoning for a variety of high-impact application areas. To achieve this mission, the lab collaborates closely with external entities such as universities, startups, and government labs, as well as with several Samsung Product and Advanced Research labs.

Position Summary:

The Robot Intelligence Lab at Samsung Research America (SRA) is building the foundational "brains" for the next generation of intelligent, physical robots. We are looking for a Senior Simulation Software Engineer to design and scale our cloud-hosted, high-performance simulation pipeline.

In this role, you will act as the critical engineering pillar of our lab—collaborating closely with world-class AI researchers to transition cutting-edge algorithms (manipulation, locomotion, and VLA models) from mathematical concepts into robust, physical-world realities. If you are passionate about optimizing GPU-accelerated simulators (like IsaacSim/MuJoCo), building robust C++/Rust/Python components, and deploying massive cloud-based training workflows to close the simulation-to-reality gap, this is your playground.

Position Responsibilities:

• Develop Python, C++ and Rust components of a robotics simulation pipeline including asset conversion, asset management, simulation harness, cloud deployment, telemetry, replay, evaluations and comprehensive tests

• Own developed software components through entire lifecycle from concept to prototype to general internal availability

• Profile and optimize code performance to improve simulation latency and throughput

• Collaborate with researchers and research engineers to develop cutting edge robotics algorithms across various embodiments in simulation

• Collaborate on engineering roadmap development for the overall Robot Intelligence Lab

• Maintain release workflow and regular release cadence for partner teams

• Support reproducible AI development environments and cloud-based training workflows in collaboration with researchers

Required Skills:

• MS degree in CS/EE/Robotics, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

• 5+ years of experience conducting state-of-the-art robotics R&D

• Proficiency in Python and C++, with experience developing and maintaining Linux-based software

• Experience with robotics simulation frameworks such as IsaacSim, Gazebo, PyBullet or MuJoCo

• Familiarity with scene description formats such as URDF, SDFormat or USD

• Experience designing software components and defining clear interfaces within complex systems

• Experience developing or integrating with cloud-hosted services and data pipelines

• Practical experience with Docker, Git, CI/CD, and automated testing

• Ability to establish maintainable engineering practices while supporting fast-moving research

• Strong troubleshooting, collaboration, and documentation skills

Preferred Skills:

• Developed robotic manipulation or locomotion simulation environments, tasks and controllers or policies

jobs.title: Director of Retail Sales
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Director of Retail Sales to own revenue production for Lakeshore’s retail channel. You’ll spend about 75% of your time on the road with our stores. Working in close partnership with the Vice President of Stores, you’ll be accountable for total retail revenue, setting the sales strategy for assigned goals and driving the programs and selling behaviors that generate conversion, basket growth, institutional sales and outstanding customer engagement.

You’ll be the revenue leader for our stores. Together with the Vice President of Stores, you’ll set the selling strategies, priorities and recovery plans, and our Retail Territory Managers will lead the teams that bring them to life in every location. You’ll lead through the quality of your plan, the strength of your programs, the clarity of your insight and close partnership with the field.

You’ll translate company priorities into a clear, measurable sales plan for every store. We’re looking for a commercially sharp leader who brings a clear point of view and a recommendation backed by evidence. It’s meaningful work: every program you launch helps more teachers, families and schools find what they need in our stores.

A day on the job looks like this:

• Driving total retail revenue with the Vice President of Stores, including the annual sales plan, the rolling forecast and executive updates that lead with a clear recommendation
• Leading chain-wide selling programs, such as customer outreach, educator partnerships, community events, loyalty and four-wall conversion, and scaling what works
• Defining recovery plans for at-risk stores with the Vice President of Stores and Territory Managers, using store visits to diagnose root causes and tracking results against KPIs
• Leading the retail B2B and outreach strategy across educator, school, childcare and community segments, and connecting stores with Inside and Institutional Sales so no lead gets lost
• Evolving the Lakeshore selling model and standards, along with the playbooks and training that help store leaders deliver it
• Optimizing performance through data, setting the two or three highest priorities each period with the Vice President of Stores
• Providing one of the retail channel’s voices with Marketing and Merchandising on promotions, pricing tests and launches, and measuring the sales lift

Got the skills and experience? Here’s what we’re looking for:

Required:

• 7+ years of progressive retail sales leadership, including chain-wide or multi-region sales strategy ownership
• 3+ years carrying a revenue number or P&L line with demonstrated delivery against it
• Proven record designing sales programs and scaling them across a multi-unit fleet with measurable revenue results
• Strong financial fluency, including budgeting, forecasting, opportunity sizing and margin impact
• Candidates should ideally reside in the Mid-West area. The role requires overnight stays 3 times per week, with 75% of the time spent traveling

Preferred:

• Experience building B2B, institutional or community outreach sales within a multi-unit retail business

What Sets You Apart

• You have sharp commercial judgment and know which revenue opportunities are real and which are noise
• You build the case from data and can defend it with executives
• You effectively influence peers, executives and field leaders without direct authority.
• You communicate concisely, lead with a recommendation and back it with evidence
• You bring program design and project management discipline from concept through measured outcome

And here’s our end of the bargain!

• Salary: $120,000-$140,000
• Bonus eligible
• Paid leave for new parents to support work/life balance and family bonding
• Excellent medical/dental and vision coverage — EPO, PPO and HSA
• 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution (because you will retire someday)
• Flexible benefits — choose what you like, ignore the rest
• On-site preschool for our employees' children
• On-site employee gym for all levels/fitness needs
• Generous employee discount
• Casual dress…and we really mean it

At Lakeshore, we know our diversity makes us stronger, and when everyone feels included and valued, we all win. We strive to embrace our differences and create an intentionally diverse and inclusive community that is representative of the teachers, families and children we serve.

We know we couldn't do the extraordinary things we're doing without the people on our team. Thanks to the passion and enthusiasm of this spectacular group, Lakeshore is more than a great place to work—it's a great experience to be part of. jobs.title: Affiliate Marketing & AI Discovery Consultant
jobs.description:
Here at Ooma we empower people to connect in smarter ways. We do this by creating powerful communication experiences through our cloud-based platform to bring people together at work and at home. Our solutions help small business owners stay connected with their customers and manage their businesses from anywhere. For larger companies we provide customized unified communications solutions to meet their unique needs. At home, we help our customers connect with their loved ones by providing the #1 rated VoIP phone service available. We also provide them with peace of mind through our innovative smart home security solution. At Ooma, all our products and services are priced competitively, because we believe advanced technology should be accessible to all.

About the Role:

Ooma is seeking an experienced Affiliate Marketing & AI Discovery Consultant to support and advance our B2B affiliate marketing program during a maternity leave coverage period.

During this engagement, you’ll manage and optimize ongoing affiliate initiatives while helping Ooma prepare for the growing impact of AI-powered search and large language models (LLMs) on B2B buyer behavior. You’ll develop strategies to improve Ooma’s visibility and likelihood of being recommended across AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and emerging AI-driven discovery experiences.

You’ll bring hands-on affiliate marketing expertise and a strong understanding of how AI-generated answers, review sites, comparison platforms, and authoritative third-party content influence B2B purchase decisions.

**Contract length: 4-6 months

What You’ll Do:

• Manage and optimize Ooma’s B2B affiliate marketing program during maternity leave coverage, keeping ongoing initiatives on track and identifying opportunities to improve lead generation, pipeline contribution, and return on investment.

• Maintain relationships with affiliates, publishers, review sites, comparison platforms, and strategic referral partners, and explore opportunities to strengthen and expand these partnerships.

• Assess how AI-powered search platforms and large language models (LLMs) influence how buyers discover and evaluate business communications providers.

• Identify high-value third-party publishers, review sites, directories, forums, and industry resources where a stronger Ooma presence could support visibility in traditional search and AI-generated answers.

• Recommend content, partnership, and affiliate strategies to improve discovery across business communications, UCaaS, cloud phone systems, POTS replacement, and related solution categories, and advance agreed-upon initiatives during the engagement.

• Create a practical, prioritized roadmap for evolving Ooma’s affiliate, content, and partner marketing strategy as AI-driven search and buying behaviors develop, including recommended next steps and measures of progress.

• Monitor performance and provide regular reporting, insights, and actionable recommendations.

• Document key relationships, ongoing initiatives, and strategic recommendations to support a smooth handoff at the end of the engagement.

Experience We’re Looking For:

• 5+ years of experience in B2B affiliate, partnership, referral, or performance marketing; 8+ years total work experience required.

• Hands-on experience managing affiliate programs and relationships with publishers, review sites, comparison platforms, or referral partners.

• Experience marketing SaaS, telecommunications, UCaaS, CCaaS, business communications, or related technology solutions.

• An understanding of how third-party content and recommendations influence B2B purchase decisions.

• Familiarity with AI-powered search and discovery, along with experience developing content or partnership strategies that support visibility across traditional search and emerging AI channels.

• Experience translating performance data and market insights into clear, actionable recommendations.

• Strong communication, analytical, and project management skills, with the ability to get up to speed quickly and balance ongoing program needs with focused strategic projects.

**The anticipated monthly consulting stipend for this engagement is $10,000 - 12,000, subject to adjustment based on qualifications and agreed-upon deliverables.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Investments
jobs.description:
With a strong commitment to delivering exceptional investment returns, we are dedicated to optimizing the performance of our multifamily portfolio. The successful candidate will have a comprehensive understanding of market conditions and trends, operational value-add possibilities, valuations, and best practices for executing a successful disposition.

What you will do:

jobs.title: Animal Caretaker I
jobs.description:
We are looking for talented professionals to be a part of a dynamic team. We place a focus on professionalism, kindness, integrity, and a high level of confidentiality, with the goal to deliver best in class service while providing a positive working experience for its staff.

Job Summary:

The Animal Caretaker is responsible for the domesticated animals on a private estate. As directed by the Manager, Land Operations, the Animal Caretaker will perform all aspects of care for the Farm, including but not limited to feeding, watering, grooming and cleaning the animals, maintaining the Farm area in a clean and sanitary condition, coordinating veterinary treatments and other animal services as needed, and working with the Owners and/or their guests during visits to the Farm.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Feeding, watering and general care of the animals (50%)

• Cleaning, organization and sanitation of the Farm area and facilities (30%)

• Facilitating Owner/guest visits to the Farm (10%)

• Coordinating veterinarian services and/or outside vendors (5%)

• Managing supply inventories and communicating purchase needs to Supervisor (5%)

Responsibilities & Duties

• Feeds and waters animals according to feeding instructions and established schedules

• Cleans and organizes animals living areas such as stables, pens, cages, and yards

• Cleans and disinfects animal equipment

• Observes animals to identify signs of injury, illness, or disease

• Provides general treatment for animals, contacts veterinarian for more advance treatment

• Grooms animals, which includes washing, brushing, trimming coats, cutting nails, and cleaning ears; coordinates 3rd-party grooming services (i.e. semiannual shearing, farrier services)

• Maintains records of information such as weight, physical condition, diet, feeding schedule, and medications given

• Provides enrichment to animals daily to maintain their health and well-being

• Unloads and stores feed and supplies

• Answers general questions about the animals such as behavior and habitat, facilitates Owner/guest visits to the Farm (i.e. teaching children proper handling techniques)

• Takes phone calls and schedules appointments

• Oversees the ordering of supplies needed for operation; makes recommendations to the Supervisor

• Builds and maintains positive working relationships with coworkers

• Provides first aid to wounded animals

• Administers vaccinations and medications to animals, as directed by the Veterinarian

• Maintenance of grounds in and around farm

• Assist with veterinary care, administering medication.

• Performs related duties as assigned

JOB SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

• Ability to work with animals and to remain calm in strenuous circumstances.

• Excellent problem-solving skills

• Ability to follow instructions.

• Excellent time management skills.

• Must be able to work independently, make common sense decisions in potentially critical situations.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORKING CONDITIONS

• Must be able to lift and carry 50 pounds at a time.

• Must be able to work outdoors, with frequent exposure to extreme hot temperatures, wet/rainy, windy conditions for one hour plus.

• Physical abilities include lifting/carrying up to 50 lbs. multiple times per shift, pushing, pulling, stooping/crouching, reaching/handling, balancing, sitting, standing, walking, climbing off and on equipment, squatting/kneeling, grasping.

COMPETENCIES

• Communication: Communicates clearly and concisely, both written and verbal. Able to communicate insights and understanding of issues or problems in a skillful way. Communicates important information to coworkers, supervisors, and managers.

• Trustworthiness and integrity, always acting in the best interests of the owner

• Ability to work independently and in a team setting.

• Critical Thinking: Asks the right questions to obtain the information needed to size up a situation properly. Anticipates and responds to problems quickly. Finds ways to get projects accomplished efficiently. Positively impacts the team by managing time effectively.

• Dependable

• Attention to detail: The ability to listen to, and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.

• Takes initiative

• Works well under time constraints

• Proactive: Goes above and beyond what needs to be done. Has the confidence to initiate action independently; addresses unexpected problems or opportunities without prompting

• Team Player: Connects with coworkers, leaders, and external vendors in an effective manner. Considers how his/her actions affect other groups or team members. Models a spirit of cooperation with other members of the work group. Works effectively and cooperatively across groups.

Salary Range

$30—$34 USD

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to equal employment opportunities for all employees as well as providing them with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the various locations where we operate.  We encourage applicants from all ages and backgrounds.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer — Identity & Automation
jobs.description:
ABOUT STUUT

Stuut is the AI coworker that runs order-to-cash for the world’s leading enterprises. Across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, Stuut does the work end to end and keeps going until the cash hits the bank.


Over 150 companies, spanning the mid-market to the Fortune 50, including Honeywell, ZoomInfo and PerkinElmer, use Stuut to unlock up to 40% more cash flow and cut DSO by 47%. More than $3 billion has moved through the platform to date.


Founded in New York by Tarek Alaruri and Ben Winter, Stuut has raised $93 million from Insight Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund, and others. Learn more at stuut.ai http://stuut.ai. 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Stuut is growing quickly, and our employee technology needs to keep pace. We’re looking for a hands-on IT Systems Engineer who can make joining the company, getting access, changing roles, and leaving the company smooth, secure, and predictable.

Your priority will be the employee lifecycle: making sure people have a working laptop and the right access when they start, resolving issues quickly, and building integrations and automation that prevent the same problems from recurring. You’ll connect our people systems, identity services, business applications, and device management into reliable workflows—not just work through a queue of manual requests.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role combining systems administration, integration troubleshooting, automation, and thoughtful employee support. You’ll partner closely with People Operations, Security, Engineering, and team managers. You won’t be expected to own production infrastructure or be the expert in every application.

You’ll also own the day-to-day IT controls that support SOC 2 and our broader security and compliance program. That means building secure practices into everyday operations and keeping evidence current—not scrambling before an audit. You’ll partner with Security on requirements and priorities, rather than being expected to run the entire compliance program.



What You'll Do 

 - Own onboarding, role changes, and offboarding end to end. Coordinate equipment, accounts, group memberships, application access, and employee communication. Verify that new hires can actually work—not simply that an account was created.

 - Build and maintain identity and application integrations. Configure and troubleshoot SCIM provisioning, single sign-on, attribute mappings, and role-based access across our HR, identity, and SaaS platforms.

 - Make provisioning dependable. Identify failed syncs, account mismatches, timing dependencies, expired integration credentials, and licensing blockers. Build clear exception handling for last-minute hires and applications that don’t support automated provisioning.

 - Automate repetitive IT work. Use native integrations, workflow tools, APIs, webhooks, and practical scripting to reduce manual steps. Make automation documented, observable, and maintainable by someone other than you.

 - Deliver responsive, approachable support. Help employees with access, laptops, collaboration tools, and everyday office technology. Communicate clearly, follow issues through to resolution, and turn recurring requests into lasting fixes.

 - Manage the device lifecycle. Coordinate purchasing, enrollment, configuration, security updates, inventory, replacements, and returns, with an emphasis on a low-friction experience in a Mac-centric environment.

 - Keep access secure and accountable. Apply least-privilege access, support access reviews, and verify timely deprovisioning, session revocation, data ownership transfers, and equipment recovery in partnership with the appropriate owners.

 - Operate IT security and compliance controls. Maintain device encryption, endpoint protection, patch compliance, MFA coverage, and appropriate administrative access. Track gaps and exceptions through remediation with Security, without creating unnecessary friction for employees.

 - Support SOC 2 audit readiness year-round. Maintain accurate asset and access records, document onboarding and offboarding completion, carry out periodic access reviews, and provide evidence that controls are operating consistently. Investigate failed compliance checks and resolve the underlying issues—not just clear dashboard alerts.

 - Support security response and employee awareness. Help triage suspected phishing, lost devices, and compromised accounts; follow established response procedures and escalate promptly. Partner with People Operations and Security on security training and policy acknowledgments.

 - Build lightweight processes that scale. Maintain practical runbooks, self-service guidance, application ownership records, and support expectations. Work with People Operations on reliable handoffs and with vendors when integrations break.
   

What You Bring

 - Typically 3–6 years of relevant experience in corporate IT, IT systems engineering, or SaaS administration, or equivalent hands-on experience. You’ve taken ownership of systems and improved how they operate.

 - Strong, hands-on SCIM and identity lifecycle experience. You’ve implemented or repaired provisioning and deprovisioning integrations—not just administered users through a console. You understand the difference between signing in, creating an account, and granting access.

 - Experience with SSO and modern identity standards, including SAML and OAuth/OIDC, and with group-based access, MFA, and troubleshooting authentication failures.

 - Experience connecting HR systems, identity providers, collaboration suites, and business applications. Our environment includes Rippling and Google Workspace; comparable experience matters more than knowing every vendor we use.

 - The ability to read API documentation, investigate logs, and write or adapt scripts to solve operational problems. You don’t need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable working beyond an admin UI.

 - Practical experience with endpoint management and laptop deployment, especially macOS, alongside sound security and asset-management practices.

 - Experience supporting SOC 2 or a comparable security compliance program, including operating IT controls, collecting audit evidence, completing access reviews, and resolving findings. You understand how to turn a policy requirement into a repeatable, verifiable process.

 - A service-minded approach: you respond with urgency, explain things without jargon, handle sensitive information carefully, and close the loop without repeated follow-up.

 - Comfort in a rapidly growing company, where priorities change and you need to balance getting someone unblocked today with preventing tomorrow’s issue.

Especially Useful

 - Experience improving onboarding during rapid hiring or supporting employees across multiple offices.

 - Experience with compliance automation platforms, automated evidence collection, and SaaS license management.

 - Experience using AI-assisted tools and secure integrations to improve IT operations, with good judgment about permissions and employee data.

What Success Look Like

 - New hires arrive with equipment ready and the access they need, with clear ownership of any exceptions.

 - Departures and role changes trigger timely, verified access changes—not a collection of unchecked tasks.

 - Provisioning failures are caught and resolved before employees have to chase them.

 - Repeated manual work and avoidable support requests decline as automation and documentation improve.

 - Employees know where to get help and trust IT to follow through.

 - IT security controls operate consistently, audit evidence stays current, and compliance gaps have clear owners and are resolved on time.

US Compensation

 - Top-of-market salary and equity package

 - Benefits (for U.S.-based full-time employees)

 - Medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you

 - 401(k) & Match

 - Equity

 - Flexible PTO

 - Parental Leave

Stuut is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and interview process. If you need any accommodations, please do not hesitate to reach out.

jobs.title: Senior Service Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose:

Honesty, Reliability, Curiosity, Collaboration, and Passion.

About the role and what you'll be doing:

The Senior Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is the primary operational advocate and advisor for assigned clients. Working across Ensono delivery, support, and account teams, the SDM ensures contracted services meet client expectations, service commitments, and desired business outcomes. This role leads service governance, performance management, escalations, risk management, and continuous improvement across complex, multi-service environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end service delivery for assigned complex, multi-service accounts, ensuring SLAs, SLOs, KPIs, and contractual commitments are met.

• Serve as the primary operational contact and trusted advisor for client stakeholders, partnering with the Client Executive and delivery teams.

• Lead weekly operational reviews, MBRs, QBRs, and executive briefings; translate service data into clear business insights and recommendations.

• Lead major incident governance, escalations, root cause reviews, and corrective action plans with timely, audience-appropriate communication.

• Oversee change, release, and maintenance coordination, representing the client perspective and minimizing business disruption.

• Maintain governance artifacts, risk registers, Service Improvement Plans, audit readiness, and compliance with Ensono and client requirements.

• Manage account financial activities, including budget tracking, forecasting, billing validation, consumption reporting, cost optimization, and identification of growth opportunities.

• Use performance trends, client feedback, and Ensono Portal insights to prioritize continuous improvement, automation, resilience, security, and cost-efficiency initiatives.

• Coordinate resources and cross-functional dependencies, resolving delivery blockers and aligning skills to account needs.

• Support client onboarding and service transitions, ensuring knowledge transfer and operational readiness.

• Mentor SDM colleagues, share best practices, and contribute to consistent service delivery standards across the practice.

We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree and at least seven years of related experience, or equivalent work experience, with demonstrated progression in service delivery management.

• Experience managing strategic client accounts in an MSP or complex, multi-tower IT environment.

• Strong knowledge of ITIL service management principles; ITIL certification is preferred.

• Proven ability to build trusted relationships, lead governance forums and escalations independently, and communicate effectively with Director-level stakeholders.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to anticipate risks and turn operational data into business-relevant recommendations.

• Financial and commercial acumen, including budget management, consumption reporting, billing validation, and identification of growth opportunities.

• Working knowledge of ServiceNow and hybrid technology environments, such as mainframe, infrastructure, cloud, databases, middleware, virtualization, and networking.

• Proficient use of AI tools, prompting, and agents to improve productivity and client insights.

• Strong executive presentation and public-speaking skills, with the ability to communicate technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Ability to mentor colleagues and contribute to service delivery best practices.

• Willingness to travel as required and participate in structured on-call escalation coverage.

Preferred Qualifications

• ITIL certification and experience supporting client onboarding or service transitions.

• Knowledge of client industry practices, trends, and regulatory considerations.

Why Ensono?

Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. You can do great things through innovation or collaboration, by learning or volunteering, or to promote diversity and inclusion. You can do great things for your own health or for a healthier planet. Whatever it means to you to do great things, we want Ensono to be the place you can do it.

We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices.

Some of our benefits include:

• Unlimited Paid Days Off

• Three health plan options

• 401k with company match

• Eligibility for dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life and AD&D coverage, and flexible spending accounts

• Family Forming Benefit including fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy reimbursement

• Paid childbearing and paternal leave

• Education Reimbursement, Student Loan Assistance or 529 College Funding

• Sabbatical leave

• Wellness program

• Flexible work schedule

jobs.title: Director, Content Analytics
jobs.location: New York, NEW YORK, United States
jobs.description:
The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

The Director, Content Analytics & Insights, will sit on the NBC/Bravo Cross-Platform Analytics team within NBCU Media Group Decision Sciences and serve as a key leader overseeing content performance and forecasting for entertainment series across NBC and Bravo, including linear and Peacock performance. This role acts as a strategic authority on content and audience intelligence, managing a high-performing team responsible for delivering actionable insights, scalable analytical frameworks, and self-service data solutions for a wide range of NBCU stakeholders and clients.

This leader will partner closely with Content Programming, Scheduling, Marketing, Ad Sales/Finance, Communications, and Strategy while integrating with other groups across Decision Sciences to translate first- and third-party Nielsen data into clear recommendations that inform business decision-making. The role will have a direct and measurable impact on the success of NBC and Bravo entertainment series in the linear and streaming landscape.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop deep expertise for NBC Entertainment and Bravo content performance and audiences across linear and Peacock, serving as a trusted thought partner to senior stakeholders across Programming, Scheduling, Comms/PR, Strategy, Marketing, and Finance
• Leverage Nielsen data and first-party data to create impactful cross-platform insights with the ability to translate different methodologies, a variety of linear/streaming KPIs and complex analyses into clear, compelling written/verbal narratives and internal presentations tailored to diverse audiences, including senior creative executives and external partners
• Develop and oversee linear ratings forecasts and audience projections, leveraging historical performance, marketplace trends, and viewing behaviors to deliver actionable guidance for Ad Sales, Finance, and Scheduling stakeholders
• Partner closely with Consumer Insights to shape research agendas and deliver integrated, holistic perspectives on content performance and audience engagement via comprehensive End of Season reports
• Translate audience data to provide strategic consultation and research support to Programming, Marketing, Finance, and Strategy stakeholders (often thru ad-hoc and urgent requests), helping inform decisions related to content development, scheduling, promotion, audience growth, and franchise expansion
• Identify emerging audience trends and changes in viewing behavior across the broader linear and streaming landscape, proactively surfacing competitive intel, implications and strategic opportunities for NBCUniversal's entertainment portfolio
• Collaborate with Operations & Technology teams to oversee the data requirements, design, development, and ongoing maintenance of data products that enable scalable, self-service access to insights across NBCU
• Own projects end-to-end, from framing and planning through execution and delivery, ensuring outputs are timely, accurate and aligned with business objectives
• Champion data democratization, performance storytelling, and data-driven decision-making across the organization
• Harness AI solution to accelerate analysis, surface patterns and trends, and deepen actionable insight
• Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing, high-output analytics team while fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and equitable culture within NBCUniversal

Basic Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in the media and entertainment industry, with a strong track record of working with large, complex datasets (Nielsen and first-party) and advanced analytical tools
• Expertise in Nielsen measurement methodology, data and reporting systems (NPower, NNTV) with experience running complex segmentation analyses for both linear/traditional and streaming content/platforms
• Proven ability to communicate effectively, confidently, and persuasively with stakeholders at all levels, especially executive leadership, and comfort presenting and speaking extemporaneously in senior forums
• Strong working knowledge of the streaming/media landscape and a love and appreciation for great unscripted and scripted content
• Strategic, outcome-oriented thinker with the ability to derive insights, conclusions, and recommendations from ambiguous or unstructured data from disparate sources

jobs.title: Data Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Public Storage is seeking a Data Analytics Manager to lead analytics capabilities for our Real Estate Finance organization. This role will drive the modernization of our financial reporting infrastructure, develop advanced analytical models, and build self-service analytics capabilities that empower Finance teams with timely, accurate insights for strategic decision-making.

As a key individual contributor in a management capacity, this position will play a critical role in supporting our evolving analytics and reporting capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Reporting & Data Infrastructure

• Develop and maintain Real Estate Finance BI reports and dashboards.
• Design and build Power BI dashboards from the ground up, including data modeling, report development, visualization design, and end-user reporting experiences.
• Ensure data accuracy and integrity through enhanced validation and reconciliation processes.
• Support ongoing analytics platform improvements and enterprise initiatives.
• Apply a strong understanding of financial statements, including the ability to read, interpret, and help build P&L models that support business performance analysis and reporting.

Advanced Analytics & Strategic Insights

• Develop advanced analytical models, including forecasting, variance analysis, and portfolio performance assessments, using Python, statistical methods, and Excel.
• Create executive-level dashboards that surface actionable insights for portfolio strategy and investment decisions.
• Deliver regular insights briefings to Real Estate Finance leadership with data-driven strategic recommendations.
• Maintain high stakeholder satisfaction with quality and timeliness of analytics deliverables.
• Translate financial and operational data into insights by leveraging a solid understanding of profit and loss drivers, budgeting logic, and financial modeling principles.

Technology & Platform Development

• Support cloud-based analytics platform adoption and implementation.
• Bring an understanding of and exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, to support scalable data workflows and modern analytics solutions.
• Develop production-grade solutions to support data infrastructure and analytics automation.
• Contribute to enterprise data governance framework and analytics standards.

Self-Service Analytics & Team Enablement

• Empower stakeholders to self-serve via various tools.
• Reduce ad-hoc report requests through proactive dashboard development and user enablement.
• Partner with Finance leadership to define KPIs and metrics framework for Real Estate portfolio performance tracking.
• Build reporting solutions that align financial metrics, portfolio performance indicators, and business planning needs.

Strategic Collaboration & Innovation

• Directly present results & insights while being able to elaborate on data logic to executives and stakeholders.
• Partner closely with Finance, IT, and business stakeholders on strategic initiatives.
• Participate in cross-functional knowledge-sharing and continuous improvement efforts.
• Investigate and evaluate emerging analytics opportunities including AI/ML applications.

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field

7+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or financial analysis

Have worked with LLMs to develop AI Agents and/or leveraged AI to develop Python tools to automate data analysis, and production-grade business solutions

Strong SQL and data modeling capabilities, including the ability to develop and govern the foundational data assets that support semantic layers, and business intelligence solutions such as Power BI. Must be able to create trusted, reusable datasets that bridge business requirements with reporting and decision-making needs

Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery, including the ability to work with cloud-based analytics environments and modern data platforms

In depth understanding of financial reporting cycles, portfolio analysis, P&L modeling, and industry knowledge, including the ability to read, interpret, and help build profit and loss models

Experience with data warehouse architecture, data integration concepts, ETL processes, and data preparation tools

Exceptional communication skills which will be a key component of simplifying complex data concepts while empowering business users on self-service analytics

Collaborative approach with the ability to partner effectively across Finance, IT, and business units

Demonstrated ability to work independently in a fast-paced, frequently changing environment, with a proactive, accountable, “own it” attitude

Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to evolving business needs

jobs.title: Medical Receptionist - Primary Care
jobs.description:
At ConvenientMD, we’re on a mission to make good health more convenient for all – working to improve how patients and providers experience healthcare in New England. To support this belief, we’re building a team of dedicated professionals who genuinely care about improving lives, are passionate about work that can make a difference, and are driven to learn from one another.

The Opportunity

Medical Receptionists play a vital role in creating a welcoming, home-like environment within our primary care clinics. This position ensures a smooth and efficient check-in and check-out experience, maintains accurate and complete patient medical records, and provides essential administrative support to keep clinic operations running seamlessly.

The right individual for this role l is eager to learn, self-motivated, and genuinely enjoys engaging with patients, staff, and vendors. Our clinics are fast-paced and constantly evolving, requiring flexibility, adaptability, and a solutions-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate embraces collaboration over avoidance, steps in wherever support is needed, champions our care model and vision, and brings professionalism to the team each day.

• Patient Experience & Value-Based Care Create a warm, welcoming, and professional experience for every patient, serving as the first point of contact and introductory face of value-based care. Lead the check-in process and educate patients on the program’s goals, vision, and shared responsibility model. Provide primary phone support, including answering inbound calls, scheduling and canceling appointments, returning messages, and documenting patient interactions in the EMR. Conduct periodic patient satisfaction outreach and identify solutions to continuously enhance the patient experience. • Administrative & Operational Excellence Maintain strong working knowledge of the EMR to manage scheduling, documentation, and task routing, and demonstrate initiative in continuously improving system proficiency. Oversee non-clinical supply inventory, manage mail distribution, and provide general administrative support using Microsoft Office tools. Maintain a clean, organized, and fully stocked front desk and lobby environment that reflects a high standard of professionalism.

• Medical Records & Care Coordination Ensure patient charts are complete and accurate by obtaining, scanning, uploading, and organizing medical records in a timely manner. Review incoming documentation daily and support MAs and the Population Health team with pre-visit chart preparation and record retrieval. Perform additional duties as assigned to support clinic operations and high-quality patient care.

Who You Are

• Detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills: Ability to juggle and prioritize multiple high-priority tasks and handle a fast-paced work environment.
