jobs.title: AI-Enabled Outbound Sales Rep (Independent Contractor, Flexible Hours)
jobs.description:
Remote · Independent contractor (1099) · Built for college students and anyone starting in tech sales



Represent companies like FreshBooks, Squire and Baton, learn the phone skills AI can't replace, and get paid while you do it, on your own schedule.



At Sellfire, our mission is to help the next generation of sales professionals build great sales careers in a world of AI. This role is where that starts.

What you'll do

 - Make live outbound calls for fast-growing B2B tech companies, reaching gatekeepers and decision-makers

 - Use Sellfire's AI-enabled platform. It handles lead lists, call prep, dialing and coaching insights, so your time goes into real conversations

 - Book qualified meetings for our customers' sales teams

 - Get call-by-call feedback and coaching from Logic-Based Selling, our proven calling methodology

Why this beats a typical side job

 - Earn real money. You're paid for results: Commission for every qualified meeting that you set that the prospect attends. The better you get, the more you make.

 - Control your hours. Work around your classes during US business hours. No shifts and no minimum schedule.

 - Choose your accounts. Pick which customer programs you call for.

 - Work with brands that are going places. You'll call on behalf of fast-growing companies like FreshBooks, Squire, OnRamp Funds, Edge, Pocketflows, Mia and Baton. That's real experience with venture-backed startups and brands hiring managers recognize.

 - Build a résumé recruiters notice. Entry-level SDR roles are among the most common first jobs in tech sales, and they usually ask for experience you can't get in a classroom. You'll graduate with real numbers like dials, connects and meetings booked.

 - Train like a pro before you dial. Learn through short video lessons, test what you know with quizzes, and practice live calls with AI prospects that act like real gatekeepers and decision-makers.

Your first step on the sales career ladder

In tech, the SDR (sales development rep) role is the most common way into sales. Many of today's top account executives, sales leaders and founders started there. A typical path looks like this:

 - SDR / BDR. Open conversations, qualify prospects and book meetings. This is where you start.

 - Account Executive. Run demos, manage deals and close revenue, often after a year or two as an SDR.

 - Senior AE, Sales Manager or Sales Leader. Bigger deals, a team of your own, or a seat in leadership.

The hardest part is getting that first SDR job without experience. This role gives you the opportunity to learn and gain experience before you graduate.

Why build a career in sales

 - High earning potential. Sales pay is tied directly to results, so strong performers can out-earn their peers early in their careers.

 - Fast, merit-based growth. Your numbers speak for themselves, so promotions come from performance, not tenure.

 - Skills that transfer anywhere. Persuasion, listening, resilience and handling objections help in any job, or in starting your own company.

 - Demand in every industry. Every company needs revenue, so good salespeople are needed everywhere.

 - A path to leadership and entrepreneurship. Many founders and executives got their start in sales.

 - Skills AI can't easily replace. As AI takes over routine work, the ability to build trust in a live conversation becomes more valuable.

Who we're looking for

 - Current college student or recent grad in Texas

 - Sales professionals looking to refine their skills and make extra money

 - Anyone looking to start their sales career

 - Competitive, coachable, and comfortable hearing "no"

 - Clear, confident speaker

 - A quiet place to work, a reliable computer, a headset, and stable internet (you'll pass a short equipment check)

About the contractor role

This is an independent contractor (1099) position, not employment with Sellfire. As a contractor:

 - You set your own hours during US business hours and decide how much you work

 - You provide and maintain your own equipment

 - You choose which customer programs to work on

 - You're paid 100% commission for results, not hourly, and you're responsible for your own taxes

 - You don't receive employee benefits such as health insurance or paid time off

The only things we require: pass screening and the equipment check, complete certification, and meet our quality standards on every call, including sticking to each customer's approved script.

How it works

 1. Apply (5 minutes)

 2. Complete a short screening and equipment check

 3. Finish Sellfire training and certification

 4. Start calling on your own schedule

jobs.title: Staff Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.


THE ROLE

Mariana Minerals is seeking a highly motivated Staff Mechanical Engineer to support our next-generation minerals processing pilot plant in Houston. You will lead the design, integration, and deployment of pilot-scale mechanical systems and processing equipment used to demonstrate and scale innovative refining technologies for critical minerals. This role is highly hands-on and will play a key role in building and maintaining a first-of-its-kind pilot plant. You will work closely with process engineers, technicians, and cross-functional teams to design, install, commission, and improve pilot-scale equipment while ensuring systems are reliable, safe, and scalable to commercial production.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design, specify, and deploy mechanical systems and equipment for pilot-scale mineral processing operations

 - Work closely with process engineers to translate process requirements into practical mechanical and plant designs

 - Support installation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of pilot plant equipment including pumps, piping systems, reactors, separators, filtration systems, and material handling equipment

 - Develop and maintain mechanical design documentation including equipment specifications, layout drawings, piping schematics, and CAD models

 - Identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability, maintainability, and operational performance

 - Coordinate with vendors, fabricators, and contractors during equipment procurement and installation

 - Support safe plant operations by contributing to hazard reviews, equipment safety design, and mechanical integrity programs
   
   


DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - B.S., M.S., or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or a related field

 - 9+ years of experience in operations, process scale-up, or plant design in minerals processing, chemicals, specialty materials, oil & gas, or related industries

 - Demonstrated experience driving equipment design, commissioning, operations, and reliability

 - Experience designing and maintaining furnaces, pumps and fluid handling systems, pressure vessels and reactors, piping systems and valves, filtration and separation equipment, and materials handling systems

 - Ability to work closely with cross-functional teams including process engineering, operations, and project execution

 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in hands-on plant environments

 - Strong commitment to Health, Safety, and Environmental compliance and mechanical integrity standards

 - Excellent technical writing, communication, and teamwork skills

 - Comfortable working in fast-paced environments, wearing multiple hats, and managing ambiguity
   
   


OUR CULTURE IS BUILT ON FOUR PRINCIPLES:



Everyone Gets Home Safe. We never put speed or cost ahead of people.

Extreme Ownership. We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions.

Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate. We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale.

Share Your Legos. We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions.



Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
Privacy is the virtual card platform giving consumers and small businesses complete control over their online payments.

Our virtual cards protect 250,000+ users across the U.S., processing over $3 billion in transactions with bank-level security and encryption. From merchant-locked cards that can't be used anywhere else if stolen, to spending limits that block unauthorized charges, to one-click pausing that stops subscriptions instantly, Privacy puts financial control back in users' hands.

We're building a future where every online payment is secure by default, free from data breaches, unauthorized charges, and hidden fees. We're proud to have been named one of Forbes' "Top 100 Most Customer-Centric Companies" and featured in The Wall Street Journal, TechCrunch, and Wirecutter.

Privacy is the product that started it all. What began as Privacy.com grew into Lithic, now a Series C company backed by world-class investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. Our dedicated team of 35 sits at the heart of Lithic's 170+ person organization, spanning 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.

Privacy operates a dedicated compliance program with its own policies, procedures, monitoring workstreams, and bank partner reporting obligations. We are hiring a Compliance Analyst to own day-to-day compliance operations — KYC/KYB reviews, sanctions screening dispositions, transaction monitoring investigations, and Unusual Activity Report (UAR) preparation — enabling compliance leadership to focus on strategic program development and bank partner relationship management.

This is a hands-on operational seat with real ownership. You will work across the full BSA/AML lifecycle and contribute to policy development, process improvement, and compliance technology projects as the program scales.

What You’ll Do:

• Conduct KYC and KYB reviews — perform identity verification, beneficial ownership analysis, and use-case-driven risk assessment for consumer and business customers, documenting clearance rationale to an examination-ready standard.

• Disposition sanctions screening alerts — review and disposition OFAC/sanctions, PEP, and adverse media alerts with appropriate escalation, maintaining complete case documentation and monthly reporting logs.

• Investigate transaction monitoring alerts — work Privacy-specific alert queues, conduct investigations, and prepare UARs for submission to our partner bank within established SLAs.

• Execute Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) — manage reviews for high-risk customers, including trigger-based and periodic reviews aligned to customer risk tier.

• Own regulatory and bank partner reporting — prepare and submit recurring bank partner reporting deliverables, including monthly OFAC/sanctions logs, complaint reporting, CIP reporting, and fraud, dispute, and support metrics, meeting submission deadlines and quality standards.

• Process 314(a) and law enforcement requests — execute FinCEN 314(a) list searches under Privacy's dedicated procedure, document results, and support law enforcement inquiry responses.

• Track and report program metrics — maintain compliance metrics, tracking logs, and KPI reporting (alert volumes, UAR timeliness, review turnaround) for internal governance and bank partner review.

• Support bank partner and audit requests — support responses to partner bank RFIs, audit inquiries, and examination requests with well-organized, contemporaneous documentation.

• Contribute to policy and procedure development — draft and refine SOPs based on operational experience; flag gaps between documented procedure and actual practice.

• Advance compliance technology projects — support integration and optimization of our IDV, screening, case management, and workflow automation stack, including quality assurance on AI-assisted review workflows.

What You’ll Bring:

Need to Have

• 2+ years of BSA/AML compliance experience in fintech, payments, or a bank-partnered environment (3–5 years preferred)

• Hands-on KYC/KYB review experience, including CIP decisioning and documentation of clearance rationale

• Transaction monitoring and investigation experience, including narrative writing for UARs or SARs

• Working knowledge of BSA/AML regulatory requirements, including CIP (31 CFR 1020.220), the CDD Rule (31 CFR 1010.230), and OFAC sanctions obligations

• Experience preparing regulatory or bank partner reporting deliverables (e.g., OFAC logs, complaint reports, compliance metrics) on recurring submission cadences

• Strong analytical skills and exceptional written documentation — your case records need to hold up to bank partner and examiner scrutiny

• Self-starter who works independently in a remote environment and knows when to escalate

Nice to Have

• CAMS certification or actively working toward it

• Direct UAR preparation experience in a sponsor bank / program manager environment

• Experience with modern IDV and case management platforms (e.g., Persona) and internal tooling (e.g., Retool)

• Exposure to Enhanced Due Diligence programs and customer risk rating methodologies

• SQL or data analysis skills applicable to alert investigation and metrics reporting

• Experience documenting and defending AI-assisted compliance decisions

The annual US salary range for this role is $100,000 - $135,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

Benefits for US Employees:

• Unlimited PTO

• 12-weeks fully paid parental leave

• 4-Week Fully Paid Sabbatical (earned at your 5-year anniversary)

• Work From Anywhere: work from anywhere in the world 4-weeks each year

• 3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary Privacy.com employee account

• Health, vision, and dental insurance; HSA Contribution Match

• 401(k) match

• Voluntary Life Insurance and STD/LTD

jobs.title: Power Systems Project Manager, Data Center Focus
jobs.description:
Your new role

As our new Power Systems Project Manager, Data Center Focus, you will take full ownership of project planning, execution, and delivery for a growing portfolio of data center, mission-critical, and pre-investment infrastructure clients. You will manage scope, schedule, and budget across multi-disciplinary engagements spanning substation design, generation and load interconnection, and early-stage site feasibility, serving as the primary point of contact for clients who often have limited in-house experience navigating energy infrastructure development.

You will work closely with our technical leads across substation engineering, protection and control, and interconnection to keep integrated, constructible designs on track, while also representing Ramboll directly with investors, property developers, and economic development agencies evaluating pre-investment opportunities.

Your key responsibilities will be:

Own project plans, schedules, and budgets for data center and mission-critical power engagements, tracking performance against milestones and financial targets and driving corrective action when needed

Serve as the primary client contact for data center developers, investors, property developers, and economic development agencies, translating client objectives into actionable project scope and guiding clients with limited energy-infrastructure experience through the development pathway

Lead multi-disciplinary coordination across substation design, protection and control, civil/structural, power generation, and interconnection disciplines to ensure integrated, constructible project delivery

Manage subconsultants, vendors, and contract administration in support of assigned projects

Support early-stage feasibility studies, power availability assessments, and preliminary master planning for pre-investment and greenfield data center site opportunities

Identify and manage project risks, developing and tracking mitigation strategies in coordination with technical leads

Lead preparation of proposals, fee estimates, and client presentations, contributing to business development for the data center and mission-critical client segment

Ensure compliance with Ramboll QA/QC procedures and applicable industry standards throughout project execution

Mentor Assistant Project Managers and early-career staff supporting your projects

Coordinate with our Interconnection and Substation Engineering teams to ensure client-facing commitments are technically grounded and deliverable

Your new team

You will be part of an elite team of power system engineers and play a pivotal role in delivering advanced solutions for a wide variety of clients, including energy-intensive industries like semiconductor manufacturing, municipal entities, data center mega campuses, and pioneers in renewable energy. With our substantial growth, seize the opportunity to shape our strategy and contribute to our agile team's rich pipeline of projects.

With growth horizons in cutting-edge domains like HVDC, solar photovoltaics, and offshore wind, our energetic and inventive team, bolstered by global specialists, is committed to advancing Ramboll's reach across the US, notably in states championing progressive climate objectives and sustainability measures. At the heart of our mission is the conviction that electricity is the cornerstone of the green transition toward a carbon-neutral future. Join us in our unwavering pursuit to realize this vision.

About you

From the moment you start at Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you can continue to grow with the company. While we look forward to supporting your continued learning and development, for this role we have identified some qualifications, skills, and capabilities that will set you up for success.

These include:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a closely related field

7+ years of experience in power systems or electrical infrastructure project delivery, with demonstrated ownership of project scope, schedule, and budget

Experience supporting data center, mission-critical, or large-load client engagements is strongly preferred

Working knowledge of substation design, power generation, generation/load interconnection processes, and transmission planning fundamentals

Familiarity with ISO/RTO interconnection queue processes (e.g., ISO-NE, NYISO, PJM) and their implications for project schedule and risk is a plus

Demonstrated ability to manage multi-disciplinary teams and subconsultants on complex infrastructure projects

PMP certification, or active pursuit of PMP, is a plus

Professional Engineering (PE) license is a plus but not required

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to advise clients who have limited energy-infrastructure development experience

Proven track record contributing to proposals, fee estimation, and business development

What we can offer you

Flexible work environment

Investment in your development

Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles

Be valued for the unique person you are

Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects

The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Direct exposure to Ramboll's fastest-growing client segment: data centers, mission-critical power, and pre-investment infrastructure development

Ready to join us?

​Please submit your application. Be sure to include all relevant documents including your CV, cover letter, etc.

Work at the heart of sustainable change

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realize their full potential.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $120,000 to $145,000 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

​ Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.​

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: SDR Manager
jobs.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical SDR Manager to lead our growing SDR team. This individual will be responsible for managing and scaling our outbound pipeline generation efforts while coaching and developing a high-performing team of SDRs.

This is a high-impact role that will sit at the center of our go-to-market motion. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to refine our outbound strategy, improve conversion rates, and ensure the SDR team consistently generates qualified pipeline as we continue expanding our presence.

This role requires 3 days in our NYC office




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on. You will:

 - Manage, coach, and develop a global team of SDRs responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline

 - Build and optimize outbound prospecting strategies across target accounts, regions and verticals, including signal-based programs driven by market events and 9fin content

 - Partner closely with AEs to create targeted outbound campaigns and define the SDR-to-AE handoff, including qualification standards (MEDDPICC-aligned), SLAs and meeting quality feedback

 - Work closely with Marketing, ABM and Demand Generation to plan and execute campaigns (content, events, webinars, and market-driven outreach)

 - Develop and refine SDR playbooks, messaging frameworks, and outreach cadences, and test what works by region

 - Design and scale AI-enabled prospecting and account research workflows (Claude, ChatGPT, Clay) across the team

 - Manage account tiering, territory and coverage models

 - Monitor and improve key SDR performance metrics including activity levels, meeting conversion rates, and pipeline generated, and work with RevOps to build reporting, forecasting, and performance dashboards

 - Own SDR hiring, onboarding and ramp

 - Build in-role career development plans and milestones for SDRs, with clear paths into AE and other GTM roles

 - Support SDR career development through training, Gong call reviews, role-plays, and regular coaching

 - Evaluate and manage the external tech tools used across Sales and Marketing teams (Clay, Gong Engage, LinkedIn Sales Navigator), and stay up to date with the key dynamics shaping the global Leveraged Finance, Private Credit, and Structured Finance markets
   
   


ABOUT YOU

This role will be a great fit if you have:

 - Prior experience managing SDR/BDR team(s) or leading sales development functions, ideally 2+ years management experience, including distributed or multi-region teams

 - 4+ years of experience in sales development, pipeline generation, or related go-to-market roles

 - Strong experience with outbound prospecting strategies and pipeline generation, including ABM-aligned and signal-based outbound

 - Experience working with Salesforce (or other CRM systems), Gong (Engage or other sales engagement platforms), Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Hubspot, lead generation platforms, and Excel/G Suite

 - AI fluency, with hands-on experience using Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools to build end-to-end workflows and skills for prospecting and account research

 - Strong history of working cross-functionally across Sales, Marketing, RevOps and Product

 - Demonstrated ability to coach and develop high-performing SDRs, with a track record of hiring, ramping and promoting them

 - Working knowledge of MEDDIC/MEDDPICC and how to coach SDRs to it

 - Ability to analyze large volumes of data, run structured tests, draw insights, and present clear recommendations

 - Excellent organizational and time management skills with strong attention to detail

 - High level of initiative and a strong desire to build and improve scalable processes in a fast-scaling environment

 - Interest in capital markets, credit or financial data





OUR BENEFITS

We’re a scaling start up and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people.  We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

 - Competitive Salary: $105,000-$147,000

 - 401(k) (9fin pay 3%, employee contributions are uncapped)

 - Private Health Insurance, with Dental and Vision

 - Paid sick leave

 - Disability Insurance (New York)

 - Commuter Benefit

Time off

 - 25 vacation days per year

 - Local public holidays

 - Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

 - 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

 - Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

 - Professional learning and development budget

 - AI experimentation budget of $1,000 per employee to trial AI tools

 - Bi-annual team socials

 - Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.



9fin is an equal opportunities employer 

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Talent Acquisition (Product & Design)
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Talent Acquisition is central to how Airwallex builds and scales its global teams. In this role, you'll lead recruiting across Product and Design, combining strategic workforce planning with hands-on team leadership and trusted partnership with senior leaders.

 - Lead and develop a global team of recruiters across Product and Design, setting a high standard for performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.

 - Serve as a trusted talent partner to senior Product and Design leaders, shaping hiring strategy and aligning recruiting plans with business priorities and headcount goals.

 - Own market intelligence, candidate insights, and data-driven recommendations that inform executive-level workforce planning and hiring decisions.

 - Design and improve recruiting processes, interview frameworks, and assessment standards to raise hiring quality, speed, and candidate experience.

 - Use recruiting metrics, pipeline data, and competitive insights to identify bottlenecks, measure team effectiveness, and drive operational improvements.

 - Partner with Employer Branding, People Partners, and Total Rewards to position Airwallex as an employer of choice for Product and Design talent globally.

You'll work from our San Francisco office on Mondays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


ESSENTIALS

 - 12+ years of experience in recruiting, including 5+ years leading global recruiting teams and a track record of building high-performing teams.

 - Deep experience recruiting for Product Management, Product Strategy, Design, or related disciplines in a technology or fintech environment.

 - Demonstrated ability to partner with and influence C-level and senior leaders on talent acquisition strategy, hiring standards, and workforce planning.

 - Strong analytical skills, with experience using recruiting data, ATS reporting such as Ashby or Greenhouse, and pipeline metrics to drive decisions and process improvements.

 - Proven ability to design and implement structured interview frameworks, calibration processes, and candidate assessment standards at scale.


PREFERRED

 - Experience in a high-growth, global fintech or payments company, with familiarity navigating multi-regional hiring across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas.

 - Comfort operating in environments with high standards, fast iteration cycles, and evolving priorities.

 - An entrepreneurial mindset with a bias toward action and continuous improvement.

 - Curiosity to learn quickly, adapt fast, and grow through stretch opportunities, with a genuine passion for building teams that shape the future of financial technology.


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You're consistently looking to take on new and diverse challenges, expand your knowledge beyond your current areas of expertise, and are comfortable stepping outside your comfort zone to do it.

 - You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

 - You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability.

 - You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Talent Acquisition sits at the frontier of company building. Talent is the ultimate driver of our global growth, which means the decisions we make don't just fill roles, they shape where Airwallex goes next. You'll operate as a trusted advisor to leaders across the business, bringing market insight and judgment to the table when it matters most. We hold ourselves to a high standard because it's the only way to attract exceptional people. By challenging assumptions, influencing outcomes, and consistently raising the bar, you'll build trusted relationships with top-tier candidates who understand both the opportunity and expectations that come with joining Airwallex. If you want to help build a generational company, you'll find no shortage of ways to make your mark.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. jobs.title: Skilled Auto Body Repair Tech
jobs.description:

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

• Entry-Level Prepper (min 1 year professional experience): perform light bodywork, including prepping, sanding, and buffing vehicles, removing and installing bumpers, single panel repair (including Bondo repair), and minor plastic welding

• Mid-Level Prepper (min 3-5 years professional experience): perform bodywork on multiple panels, including heavy plastic welding, minor metal pulling, roof and rocker panel repair, stud welding, and large area heavy bodywork (including Bondo repair)

• Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles

• Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

• Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

• Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

jobs.title: Corporate Counsel
jobs.location: El Segundo, California, Washington, District of Columbia, San Francisco, California,
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

CHAOS Industries, Inc. is seeking a versatile corporate attorney to support our growing, privately held defense technology business. You will own day-to-day corporate legal matters, help manage our domestic and international entity structure, and support M&A, financing, and other strategic transactions.

You will also work across the broader Legal team on commercial deals, disputes, and other business needs. This role is suited to someone with a strong corporate foundation who enjoys taking ownership, learning new areas, and helping a fast-moving company solve practical problems.

You will partner closely with Finance, People, business leadership, and outside counsel.

Responsibilities:

• Be the subject matter expert on acquisitions, investments, strategic transactions, financing, securities, tax matters, and corporate governance.

• Manage domestic corporate governance matters, including board and stockholder actions, resolutions, delegations of authority, corporate records, and international subsidiary governance, managing local filings and administering corporate records.

• Support the formation, maintenance, restructuring, and dissolution of domestic and international entities, coordinating with Finance, Tax, and local counsel.

• Support M&A and other strategic transactions from initial evaluation through closing and integration, including diligence, transaction documents, and coordination with internal stakeholders.

• Advise on financing transactions, capitalization matters, equity issuances, and investor rights and obligations in partnership with Finance.

• Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements and support customer, supplier, and partnership transactions as business needs require.

• Provide practical advice on legal issues across the business, independently handling matters within your expertise.

• Manage outside counsel on assigned matters, including scope, budget, and work product.

• Travel occasionally to company locations and business meetings, as needed.

Minimum Requirements:

• J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar, with eligibility to practice in the role’s location.

• 5-8 years of experience as both a law firm and in-house attorney, having practiced corporate transactions, M&A, or capital markets at a major law firm.

• Substantial experience advising companies on corporate governance, entity management, and general corporate matters.

• Experience handling M&A or other significant corporate transactions, including diligence, drafting and negotiating transaction documents, and managing closing processes.

• Ability to independently draft and negotiate commercial agreements and resolve legal issues with business stakeholders.

• Experience supporting matters beyond a core corporate practice, such as commercial transactions, disputes, litigation, or other general business legal issues.

• Sound judgment about legal and business risk, including when to resolve an issue directly and when to involve specialist counsel.

• Ability to manage competing priorities, take ownership of projects, and communicate clear recommendations to technical and nonlegal audiences.

• A practical, collaborative approach and willingness to work across disciplines as the company’s needs evolve.

Preferred Requirements:

• Experience supporting a growing technology company, either in-house or through a law firm practice.

• Hands-on experience with at least one IPO or equivalent public-company securities offering, including SEC disclosure and reporting.

• Experience managing international subsidiaries and coordinating with counsel across jurisdictions.

• Experience advising privately held companies on financing transactions, stockholder agreements, capitalization tables, equity compensation, or secondary transactions.

• Experience managing litigation, discovery, investigations, or pre-litigation disputes.

• Familiarity with defense technology, government contracting, or other regulated industries.

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary Range: $165,000 - $209,000

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. We're building the infrastructure for quantum super intelligence.

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager, Quality Assurance
jobs.description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with neffy®, the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you’re motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture.

This is a hands-on role that will work an onsite hybrid schedule at our San Diego corporate office in the Carmel Valley area. The Manager / Senior Manager Quality Assurance owns batch disposition and product complaint management for products made at our contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs). You will review executed batch records, drive deviations and investigations to closure, and run the complaint process end to end so that every lot released meets cGMP and regulatory requirements. This is a hands-on role working daily with CMO quality teams, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Medical Affairs.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Batch record review and disposition

• Review executed batch records, packaging records, and certificates of analysis from CMOs for accuracy, completeness, and cGMP compliance.

• Verify that deviations, OOS/OOT results, and change controls tied to each lot are closed or properly assessed before release.

• Prepare lot disposition packages and recommend release, rejection, or quarantine; act as QA approver per delegation.

• Review master batch records and specifications for new and revised products.

• Track batch release timelines and partner with Supply Chain to meet commercial and clinical supply needs.

Product complaint management

• Own the product complaint process: intake, triage, CMO investigation requests, trending, and closure within defined timelines.

• Assess complaints for reportability (e.g., Field Alert Reports, MDRs for combination products) with Regulatory and Pharmacovigilance.

• Lead or support root cause investigations and confirm CAPAs are effective.

• Prepare complaint trend reports for management review and Annual Product Reviews.

CMO Quality Oversight

• Serve as day-to-day QA contact for assigned CMOs and testing labs.

• Review and approve CMO deviations, investigations, change controls, and CAPAs affecting our products.

• Manage quality agreements and quality metrics; join business reviews and person-in-plant visits as needed.

• Support CMO audits and regulatory inspections.

GMP compliance and quality systems

• Maintain compliance with 21 CFR Parts 210/211, 21 CFR Part 4 (combination products), ICH Q7–Q10, and EU GMP as applicable.

• Author and revise SOPs for batch disposition and complaint handling.

• Contribute to Annual Product Reviews, recall readiness, and inspection readiness.

• Lead process improvements, and represent QA on cross-functional project teams.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Quality judgment: makes sound, documented release and reportability decisions under time pressure.

• Partner management: holds CMOs to standards while keeping relationships productive.

• Communication: writes clear investigation summaries and explains risk to non-QA colleagues.

• Ownership: tracks open items to closure without being chased.

• Primarily office-based work with occasional travel to CMO sites, including time in GMP manufacturing areas with gowning. Occasional after-hours support for urgent complaints or release needs.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Required

• Preferred Bachelor's degree in chemistry, biology, pharmacy, engineering, or related science. An acceptable combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered

• Minimum of 6+ years of QA experience

• Hands-on batch record review and lot disposition for commercial pharmaceutical or combination products.

• Direct experience managing product complaints, deviations, and CAPAs.

• Working knowledge of cGMP (21 CFR 210/211), ICH guidelines, and FDA expectations.

• Experience overseeing CMOs or external testing labs in a virtual or outsourced model.

• Strong technical writing and attention to detail.

Preferred

• Drug-device combination product experience (21 CFR Part 4, 820 / QMSR).

• Sterile, nasal, or inhalation dosage form experience.

• Electronic QMS experience (e.g., Veeva Vault QualityDocs/QMS, MasterControl).

• ASQ certification (CQA, CQE, or CPGP).

At ARS, we are proud to offer a highly competitive compensation & benefits package.

The full-time salary range for this posted position is $145,000 to $185,000 and may be eligible for a discretionary annual performance bonus. Actual pay rates are determined by considering multiple factors including qualifications, relevance of experience, education & credentials, subject matter expertise, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

This position is also eligible for Equity, 401k matching, and our excellent benefits package including 100% employer paid Medical, Dental & Vision for employees. View the full package here: ARS Careers Page

jobs.title: External Art Intern, Characters [Spring 2027]
jobs.description:
Crystal Dynamics is constantly seeking the best gaming talent worldwide to add to our 30-plus year legacy of game development creating new and iconic franchises. We are committed to making great games with great people and living the dream while doing it.

Benefits for our regular full-time positions include, but are not limited to, a competitive regional salary, 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance options, professional development reimbursement, flexible hybrid on-site/off-site work opportunities, company paid holidays, plus additional paid days in December when the studio is closed for holiday break, and the ability to accrue additional paid time-off.

Join us and help shape an amazing studio culture, where we’re building award-winning franchises like Tomb Raider and more!

Crystal Dynamics is now accepting applications for a remote spring internship, open to candidates across most U.S. states. As part of this 12-week program, you will take part in meaningful, hands-on work that contributes directly to active AAA projects. Throughout the program, you will step into a professional development environment where ongoing projects, experienced mentors, and collaborative teams give you a direct view into AAA game creation. This internship is designed to help you build industry ready skills, form strong professional relationships, and deepen your understanding of how world class games are made!

Eligibility Criteria:

• Graduated from a college or university program in 2026 (Spring, Summer, Fall, or Winter).

• Degree in Animation, Art, Game Art, Technical Art, Game Design, Game Development, Engineering, or related fields.

• Availability to work full-time (40 hrs / week), during core business hours, for the duration of the program (February 1st – April 23rd, 2027), including the first week onsite at our studio in San Carlos, CA for onboarding.

• Legal eligibility to work in the United States.

• Submission of a complete application that includes a resume, cover letter, and a link to your portfolio.

What You Will Gain:

• Practical Project Involvement: Contribute to active game development efforts while learning production scope, workflows, and the advanced tools used across modern AAA pipelines.

• Professional Mentorship: Receive guidance from experienced professionals with deep industry knowledge.

• Skill Development: Expand your skill set, establishing a solid foundation for your professional journey.

• Team Collaboration: Work alongside our dedicated onsite and remote teams including fellow interns, building valuable professional relationships within the gaming industry.

What You Will Do:

• Acquire essential skills using industry-standard tools and software such as Unreal Engine, ZBrush, Maya and Substance Designer & Painter.

• Participate in external game development aspects by helping review incoming character and prop assets, checking for quality, consistency, and technical compliance.

• Support mid, senior, and lead artists by polishing external character assets, helping fix issues, and any other tasks assigned.

• Enhance your understanding of advanced game development technology, focusing on Unreal Engine.

What Makes You Stand Out:

• Portfolio demonstrating foundational character art skills, including one or more of the following: Character art examples that showcase understanding of anatomy, silhouette or proportion. Understanding color theory and PBR. Hard-surface experience, such as creating armor, weapons, vehicles, or other cleanly modeled assets.

• Industry involvement outside classroom curriculum such as game jams, personal projects and/or contributions to group projects that show going above and beyond.

• Exposure to industry-standard development software tools and engines.

• Willingness to tackle challenges, learn from feedback, and adapt to new tools or workflows.

• Ability to communicate your ideas with eagerness to learn and put feedback into action.

Compensation & Benefits:
Compensation for this internship is $20-23/hr. Compensation is location-based and will be aligned to the intern’s confirmed work location during the program. Interns are also eligible for a medical, dental, and vision benefits package. Your recruiter can provide more information about total compensation.

Check out our Crystal Dynamics Internship FAQ page for additional questions.
Thank you for your interest in an internship at Crystal Dynamics. We can't wait to see what you bring to our world of game development!

The pay for this internship role includes the base hourly rate, and does not include the medical, dental and vision benefits package that interns will also be eligible for.

Your recruiter will be able to share more information about total compensation.

$20—$23 USD

jobs.title: Global Lead, Commercial Risk Strategy
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You'll build and lead Airwallex's first-line commercial risk function globally, reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer and shaping how we originate, structure and grow the commercial book. You'll define the frameworks, guidance and governance that help the business pursue sustainable growth while making sound risk decisions.

 - Own the commercial risk strategy and supportability frameworks for the customers and use cases Airwallex backs.

 - Drive structured guidance for complex or high-risk merchant opportunities, helping commercial teams move the right opportunities forward while escalating appropriately.

 - Translate second-line risk appetite and policies into practical commercial playbooks, controls and operating processes.

 - Build continuous portfolio monitoring that brings together risk tiers, fraud or loss rates, revenue concentration and risk-adjusted commercial performance.

 - Lead incident post-mortems, root-cause analysis, remediation and governance across multiple lines of defense.

 - Partner with Sales, Partnerships, Account Management, Revenue Strategy & Operations, Data, Legal, Risk and Compliance to strengthen commercial risk capability and scale global coverage.

You'll work from our San Francisco office on Mondays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


ESSENTIALS

 - 10–12 years of risk management experience within financial services, including significant experience in first-line or business-aligned roles interfacing directly with front-office or Sales teams.

 - Deep expertise in at least two of the following areas: credit and portfolio risk, payments or merchant risk, operational and conduct risk, or enterprise risk.

 - A track record of designing and implementing practical risk frameworks that materially influence commercial strategy within a Three Lines of Defense model.

 - Strong analytical and data literacy, with the ability to define KPIs, interrogate dashboards, and balance quantitative metrics with qualitative business judgment.

 - Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to translate complex risk concepts into clear commercial language and navigate challenging risk-versus-revenue discussions with senior stakeholders.

 - Experience defining commercial risk strategy and supportability frameworks for complex or high-risk customers or use cases.

 - Experience translating risk appetite and policies into practical playbooks, controls and operating processes for commercial teams.

 - Experience designing portfolio monitoring frameworks and tracking indicators such as risk tiers, fraud or loss rates, revenue concentration and risk-adjusted commercial performance.

 - Experience leading incident post-mortems, root-cause analysis, remediation and governance across multiple lines of defense.

 - Experience partnering with senior commercial, revenue operations, data, legal, risk and compliance stakeholders.


PREFERRED

 - Experience in a high-growth, product-led fintech environment, particularly in payments, issuing, FX or modern banking.

 - Familiarity with global regulatory and scheme frameworks relevant to B2B fintech, including KYC/AML, sanctions, card network rules and data privacy.

 - Experience designing portfolio early-warning indicators, concentration limits and stress testing.

 - Experience recruiting and developing a high-impact risk team with global coverage.


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You've operated in a compliance-heavy environment and know how to move fast without cutting the corners that matter.

 - You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

The Commercial Risk Control team sits in the first line of defense within the Commercial organization and partners directly with Sales, Partnerships, Account Management, Revenue Strategy & Operations and other Legal, Risk and Compliance teams across Airwallex. Our mandate is to embed risk discipline into how we originate, structure and grow our commercial book so that revenue is sustainable and commensurate with the risk we take. We help the business win the right customers faster, avoid the wrong ones earlier, and build a culture where every commercial leader thinks like an owner of our risk profile. You will join at a moment where we are formalising our first line commercial risk function globally, with strong sponsorship from our Chief Revenue Officer (“CRO”), Chief Regulatory and Compliance Officer (“CRCO”) and senior commercial leadership


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Bauer: Directeur développement de produits – Patins/ Director, Product Development- Skates
jobs.description:
COÉQUIPIERS RECHERCHÉS

Travailler chez Bauer, c'est comme jouer dans une équipe de hockey. Nous nous autonomisons pour donner le meilleur de nous-mêmes. Chaque membre de l'équipe a un rôle important à jouer; que vous dirigez ou collaborez avec des coéquipiers sur un projet d’envergure. Quel que soit votre titre, vous faites partie de quelque chose de plus grand que vous.

Fondée en 1927, Bauer Hockey a développé le premier patin. Depuis, notre passion pour le jeu, notre volonté d'innover et notre engagement envers la communauté du hockey ont fait de nous la marque la plus digne de confiance l’industrie.

Objectif et valeurs fondamentales:

Chez Bauer Hockey, notre raison d’être est d’enrichir les expériences de vie par le sport. Nous avons la responsabilité de cultiver l’avenir de nos marques. Nous agissons toujours en équipe — jamais en solo. Nous aimons ce que nous faisons. Nous croyons que tout est possible et nous nous efforçons de donner le meilleur de nous-mêmes. Nous visons constamment à redéfinir les standards d’excellence dans tout ce que nous entreprenons.

Vous souhaitez rejoindre notre équipe en tant que Directeur développement de produits – Patins?

Le Directeur développement de produits dirigera l’équipe responsable du développement des patins de hockey. Ce rôle est chargé de stimuler l’innovation, de gérer la collaboration interfonctionnelle et de veiller à ce que la fonction de recherche et développement (R&D) apporte une valeur stratégique à Bauer Hockey.

*Veuillez fournir votre curriculum vitae en français et en anglais.*

Fonctions et responsabilités essentielles de l’emploi:

• Superviser le cycle de vie complet du développement des produits pour la catégorie des patins, de la conception à l'emballage final.

• Définir, planifier et coordonner les projets conformément à la feuille de route d'innovation sur 4 ans.

• Créer et exploiter un écosystème innovant avec des instituts de recherche, des fournisseurs de matières premières et des partenaires industriels.

• Gérer les budgets d'exploitation et d'investissement pour la catégorie.

• Collaborer avec la direction de la marque pour s'assurer que les gammes de produits répondent aux besoins du marché et aux attentes des consommateurs.

• S'associer avec les parties prenantes internes et les fournisseurs externes pour mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'approvisionnement.

• Établir et affiner les critères de performance des produits en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie et de conception.

• Prendre des décisions stratégiques et formuler des recommandations sur tous les aspects de l'ingénierie des produits.

• Être disposé et apte à voyager à l'étranger au moins 25 % du temps.

Exigences:

• BS ou BA en ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe - ou années équivalentes d'expérience pertinente et connexe.

• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle, y compris dans des fonctions administratives.

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la direction d'équipes dans un environnement de R&D.

• Excellente compréhension des processus de conception, d'ingénierie et de fabrication des patins, des articles chaussants techniques ou des articles de sport composites et moulés par injection.

• Réseau bien établi dans les industries des composites, des polymères et de la chaussure (centres de recherche, fournisseurs, usines, etc.).

• Expérience avérée dans la gestion de projets complexes de développement de produits.

• Excellentes compétences en communication en français et en anglais (écrit et oral).

• Capacité à gérer simultanément plusieurs projets à fort impact.

• La maîtrise des logiciels de CAO tels que Creo ou SolidWorks est un atout.

• Capacité avérée à travailler en collaboration avec des équipes et des disciplines diverses.

• Une expérience dans l'industrie des articles de sport est un atout majeur.

• Déplacements nécessaires et/ou requis par les fonctions essentielles du poste.

Intéressé(e) ? C'est une bonne chose. Nous le sommes aussi. Nous sommes sûrs que vous voudrez savoir que ce poste est éligible pour participer au plan d'incitation de l'entreprise. Nous offrons également l'un des avantages les plus généreux qui soient, notamment un régime d'épargne-retraite avec contrepartie de l'employeur, un programme de rabais pour les employés sur les vêtements et l'équipement, un environnement de travail décontracté et hybride ainsi qu'une foule d'autres avantages que nous n'avons pas la place de mentionner ici.

Nous nous engageons à employer une main-d’œuvre diversifiée et souscrivons au principe de l’accès à l’égalité en emploi.

Nous utilisons des outils assistés par l'IA pendant certaines étapes de notre processus de recrutement afin de garantir l'équité et l'efficacité. Toutes les décisions finales d'embauche sont prises par notre équipe de recrutement humaine.

***********************************************************

TEAMMATES WANTED

Working at Bauer is like playing on a hockey team. We empower each other to be our best. Everyone on the team has an important role to play. You might be leading others or collaborating with teammates on a big project. Whatever your title, you are part of something bigger than yourself.

Founded in 1927, Bauer Hockey developed the first skate. Since then, our passion for the game, drive for innovation, and commitment to the hockey community have made us the most trusted brand in hockey.

Purpose & Core Values:

Our purpose at Bauer Hockey/ Cascade Maverik Lacrosse, is to enrich life experiences through sports. We have the responsibility to cultivate the future of our brands. We are always “we” and never “I”.  We love what we do. We believe anything is possible and work to be our best. We strive to always redefine the standard of excellence in all that we do.

Want to join our team as a Director, Product Development- Skates?

The Director, Product Development will lead the hockey skate development team and report to the Vice-President, Product Development. This role is responsible for driving innovation, managing cross-functional collaboration, and ensuring that the Research & Development (R&D) function delivers strategic value to Bauer Hockey.

*Please provide your resume in French + English*

Essential Job Functions & Responsibilities:

• Oversee the end-to-end product development lifecycle for the skate category—from concept to final packaging.

• Define, schedule, and coordinate projects aligned with the 4-year innovation roadmap.

• Build and leverage an innovative ecosystem with research institutions, raw material suppliers, and manufacturing partners.

• Manage the operating and capital expenditure budgets for the category.

• Collaborate with brand management to ensure product lines meet market needs and consumer expectations.

• Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors to implement sourcing strategies.

• Establish and refine product performance criteria in collaboration with engineering and design teams.

• Make strategic decisions and recommendations across all aspects of product engineering.

• Willingness and ability to travel internationally at least 25% of the time.

Qualifications:

• BS or BA in Engineering or related field- or equivalent years of relevant and related experience.

jobs.description:
The Sr. Director, Business Development will own the strategy and commercial growth of Nexxen’s self-serve deals platform business for publishers, as well as adoption of other Nexxen products. This leader will turn the platform into a scalable, differentiated growth engine by defining the market opportunity, building executive-level publisher relationships, developing repeatable go-to-market motions, and partnering across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Legal.

The role combines strategic business development, enterprise sales leadership, ecosystem development, and operating discipline. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable setting a multi-year vision, influencing product priorities, and personally advancing high-value opportunities from origination through launch and expansion.

What You Will Own

• Set and execute the global business plan for the self-serve deals platform, with clear priorities, investment cases, revenue targets, and market milestones.

• Build a durable two-sided ecosystem of premium publishers, CTV/OTT platforms, broadcasters, agencies, brands, and demand partners that increases deal velocity and platform value.

• Partner closely with sales to identify Upfront and Scatter opportunities for our premium publishers.

• Create the enterprise go-to-market strategy, including segmentation, ideal customer profiles, positioning, packaging, pricing, pipeline coverage, and partner/channel motions.

• Lead the most strategic opportunities and negotiations, including executive alignment, commercial structure, contractual terms, implementation planning, and expansion strategy.

• Establish a scalable operating model for self-serve deals—from prospecting and qualification through technical onboarding, activation, optimization, renewal, and cross-sell.

• Serve as the senior internal voice of the publisher, translating market feedback into product requirements and roadmap recommendations.

• Build the business case for resources, partnerships, and product investments; communicate performance, risks, and decisions to senior leadership

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Market Development

• Define the platform’s category strategy and differentiated value proposition across publisher monetization, curated supply, PMPs, and self-serve deal execution.

• Assess market trends, competitive offerings, partner economics, and customer needs to identify high-conviction growth opportunities.

• Develop annual and quarterly operating plans, including revenue forecasts, pipeline targets, adoption goals, unit economics, and strategic initiatives.

• Identify opportunities to extend the platform into CTV, smart TV, premium video, data-enabled deals, and other high-growth supply segments.

Business Development & Partnerships

• Originate, qualify, and close strategic partnerships with enterprise publishers, broadcasters, CTV platforms, OEM/TV operating systems, and technology providers.

• Develop executive relationships and multi-year account plans in tandem with Strategic Accounts teams for the highest-value partners, ensuring alignment on commercial goals and joint roadmaps.

• Design and negotiate partnership structures that balance growth, margin, transparency, supply quality, data rights, service levels, and long-term strategic value.

• Create joint business plans, launch plans, and executive business reviews that turn signed agreements into measurable adoption and revenue.

Go-to-Market & Revenue Leadership

• Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to build repeatable messaging, sales plays, enablement, case studies, and demand-generation programs.

• Create a disciplined pipeline-management process, including stage definitions, qualification standards, deal reviews, forecast accuracy, and close plans.

• Establish the metrics and dashboards needed to manage bookings, revenue, take rate, publisher activation, deal creation, spend, retention, and expansion.

• Coordinate with buy-side

As an Afternoon Assistant Guide, you’ll support a mixed-age Montessori classroom (Infant, Toddler, and Children’s House ages 3–6), helping create a calm, engaging environment where children are empowered to explore, learn, and grow at their own pace.

In a Montessori classroom, the environment and the guide work together to support each child’s development. You’ll assist in preparing beautiful, intentional learning spaces and support children through individualized and small-group activities—always with respect, patience, and care.

Most importantly, you’ll help children build confidence in themselves and discover what they’re capable of achieving.

• A genuine love for working with young children

• Interest in learning and growing within the Montessori approach (prior Montessori experience is welcome but not required)

jobs.title: Director of Operational Finance
jobs.description:
At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

Job Overview

We are building a dedicated finance presence inside each of our business divisions, and this role is one of them. As Director, Operational Finance, you will be the embedded finance partner to a division’s CEO and leadership team: the person who knows the division’s numbers, helps leaders make better decisions with them, and makes sure what happens in the division is reflected accurately in company-wide planning.

You will report to the SVP of Finance, with a dotted-line relationship with your division’s CEO & the Head of FP&A, and you will be working alongside the Corporate Finance team that runs central processes. This is an individual contributor role with significant visibility and a clear path to growth within the organization.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

• Partner with divisional leadership. Serve as the primary corporate finance and financial operations contact for your assigned division, working closely with the division CEO and the division executive team.

• Drive consistency across divisions. Translate corporate FP&A reporting standards into division-specific execution, so that definitions and metrics (for example, bookings standardization, ARR-related metrics, and margin expansion) are applied the same way in every division.

• Shape the plan. Bring divisional context, assumptions, and priorities into the annual budget run by Corporate Finance, and keep the division aligned with company-wide planning cycles.

• Assist with forecasting. Assist division leadership on forecasting updates, performance tracking, and operational improvement. Act as financial chief of staff to the division CEO while staying closely aligned with Corporate Finance and overall company goals.

• Flag risks early. Identify and escalate critical items, risks, and variances across bookings, retention, and costs to both divisional leadership and the central FP&A organization and support the work to resolve them.

• Find the efficiencies. Identify and drive operational efficiencies and develop topline cost-savings and upside ideas in partnership with divisional leaders.

• Own adjustment tracking. Own tracking of below-the-line (BTL) adjustment realization for your division, and report progress to Corporate Finance to support lender and board reporting.

• Support the close and reporting cycle. Provide divisional input to the monthly and quarterly close, perform variance analysis, and prepare divisional commentary for management and board reporting. Deliver ad hoc analysis for division and corporate leadership as needs arise.

• Partner Across the Organization. In addition to working with finance, partner with and influence other shared services roles such as Deal Desk, Operations, AR, Sales Operations, and Sales Compensation to drive the division forward and reduce friction.

• Support M&A. Lead synergy identification and tracking for acquisitions that land in your division and provide divisional input to Corporate Finance on diligence and integration into company financials.

Requirements & Skills:

• 7–10 years of progressive experience in FP&A, business finance, or finance partnering, including time in a SaaS business.

• Working knowledge of SaaS metrics, including ARR, bookings, retention, and margin, and the ability to explain what is driving them.

• Strong financial modeling and variance analysis skills, with the judgment to know which numbers matter to an executive audience.

• Experience partnering directly with senior business leaders, such as a CEO, GM, or head of sales, and influencing without direct authority.

• Superior written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn analysis into recommendations and to use numbers to tell a story.

• Experience in a private-equity-backed company, including lender or sponsor reporting.

• Experience with M&A, including synergy tracking or post-acquisition integration.

• Experience with a modern planning platform (Pigment preferred) or similar tools such as Adaptive, Anaplan, or Planful.

• Experience with a multi-product or multi-entity software business.

Education:

• A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

We will disclose intended pay ranges in our job ads for US-based opportunities – This role can be performed 100% remote anywhere in the US. Anticipated Pay Range: $160,000-170,000 Annually USD

Total compensation includes US employee benefits and annual bonus eligibility.

Benefits we offer:

• STD, LTD & Group Life Insurance

• Paid Parental Leave

jobs.description:
